name: About Wikipedia
description: Compose activity screen showing the app About page with top app bar, Wikipedia logo/wordmark, version, contributor/translator/library/license link sections, WMF footer, and snackbar feedback after the hidden developer-settings logo tap gesture.

flows.name: Confirm developer settings already enabled
flows.description: As a user who has already enabled developer settings, I want to repeat the seven-tap logo gesture, so that I receive feedback that developer settings are already enabled.

flows.name: Enable hidden developer settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Wikipedia logo seven times, so that I can unlock developer settings and receive confirmation that I am now a Wikipedia developer.

flows.name: Navigate back from About
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the top app bar navigation button to leave the About Wikipedia screen, so that I can return to the previous screen.

flows.name: Open Wikimedia Foundation website
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Wikimedia Foundation footer link, so that I can learn more about the organization that produces the app.

flows.name: Open app and content license links
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the app and content license links, so that I can read the applicable Apache and Creative Commons license terms externally.

flows.name: Open contributors team page
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the contributors team-page link, so that I can view information about the people who contribute to the Android app.

flows.name: Open source code links
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap source-code links such as GitHub, so that I can inspect the app's source code externally.

flows.name: Open third-party library websites
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the third-party library name links, so that I can visit the project or license websites for libraries used by the app.

flows.name: Open translator credits page
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the translatewiki.net translator link, so that I can learn about the volunteer translators who localized the app.

flows.name: Scroll About information
flows.description: As a user, I want to scroll through the About Wikipedia page, so that I can read the logo, version, credits, licenses, and Wikimedia Foundation footer content that does not fit on one screen.

flows.name: Select and copy About text
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the version and about-page text, so that I can copy or share information such as version, credits, and license details.

flows.name: View app version
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the app version on the About Wikipedia screen, so that I can identify which version of the app I am using.

flows.name: View bundled third-party library licenses
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a third-party library license link, so that I can view the bundled license text for that library inside the app.

name: About preferences
description: About PreferenceScreen containing app information, feedback, FAQ, privacy policy, terms of use, and legal/safety contact external-link preferences.

name: AboutActivity
description: About Wikipedia app surface.

name: Account preferences
description: Account PreferenceScreen with account category and logout preference.

name: Activity Tab
description:
Main Activity tab surface implemented as a Compose Fragment.
Shows logged-out prompt or a personalized dashboard with reading history/time spent, editing insights and impact cards, WikiGames highlights, donation history, and a paged timeline, with overflow actions for customization/history/help/reporting.

flows.name: Clear donation history
flows.description: As a user, I want to clear local donation history from the Activity tab overflow menu, so that donation information is removed from my dashboard.

flows.name: Clear reading history
flows.description: As a user, I want to clear all reading history from the Activity tab overflow menu, so that my local reading activity is removed and the dashboard updates.

flows.name: Create account from logged-out prompt
flows.description: As a logged-out user, I want to start account creation from the Activity tab, so that I can sign up and see personalized activity.

flows.name: Explore Wikipedia when no reading activity
flows.description: As a logged-in user with no articles read this month, I want to tap the Explore Wikipedia button, so that I can find content to read.

flows.name: Jump to WikiGames from external entry point
flows.description: As a user arriving from a WikiGames entry point, I want the Activity tab to scroll directly to the games module, so that I can find game highlights quickly.

flows.name: Learn more about Activity tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to open Activity tab help information from the overflow menu, so that I can understand the feature.

flows.name: Load more timeline items
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want the timeline to load more items as I scroll, so that I can browse older reading, saved, and contribution activity.

flows.name: Log in from logged-out prompt
flows.description: As a logged-out user, I want to log in from the Activity tab, so that I can access my personalized activity dashboard.

flows.name: Open Activity tab customization
flows.description: As a user, I want to open Activity tab customization from the overflow menu, so that I can choose which dashboard modules are shown.

flows.name: Open WikiGames stats
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to tap the WikiGames stats card, so that I can view my games hub and detailed game stats.

flows.name: Open customization from empty modules state
flows.description: As a logged-in user with all modules hidden, I want to open customization from the empty Activity tab message, so that I can re-enable dashboard sections.

flows.name: Open donation flow from donation history
flows.description: As a donor, I want to tap my last donation card, so that I can open the donation dialog.

flows.name: Open most viewed edited article
flows.description: As a logged-in editor, I want to tap a most-viewed edited article, so that I can open that article in a new tab.

flows.name: Open timeline article
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to tap a non-edit timeline item, so that I can open the related article in the current tab.

flows.name: Open top reading category
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to tap a top category in my reading insights, so that I can browse pages in that category.

flows.name: Play WikiGames from highlights
flows.description: As a logged-in user with no game history, I want to tap the play WikiGames button, so that I can start an On This Day game.

flows.name: Refresh activity dashboard
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to pull to refresh the Activity tab, so that my reading, editing, game, donation, and timeline data is up to date.

flows.name: Report Activity tab feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to report a problem or send feedback from the Activity tab overflow menu, so that I can share issues with the app team.

flows.name: Retry WikiGames stats load
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to retry loading WikiGames stats after an error, so that game highlights can be displayed.

flows.name: Retry impact load
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to retry loading editing insights or impact after an error, so that my contribution data can be displayed.

flows.name: Retry reading history load
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to retry loading reading history after an error, so that the reading module can recover.

flows.name: Review empty timeline guidance
flows.description: As a logged-in user with no timeline activity, I want to see an empty timeline message, so that I understand there is no activity to show yet.

flows.name: See reading challenge reward
flows.description: As a user returning from a reading challenge reward, I want the Activity tab to show my reward dialog, so that I can acknowledge the achievement.

flows.name: Start suggested edits
flows.description: As a logged-in user with no edits this month, I want to tap the suggested edits button, so that I can start contributing.

flows.name: View WikiGames highlights
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to see my WikiGames play count, streaks, and average score, so that I can track my game activity.

flows.name: View all-time editing impact
flows.description: As a logged-in editor, I want to see all-time edits, thanks, streaks, recent edits, and pageviews, so that I can understand my contribution impact.

flows.name: View combined activity timeline
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to see a date-grouped timeline of reading history, saved pages, and edits, so that I can review my recent activity in one place.

flows.name: View contribution list from editing insights
flows.description: As a logged-in editor, I want to tap my contributions card, so that I can see my contribution history.

flows.name: View donation history summary
flows.description: As a donor, I want to see when I last donated, so that I can review my local donation history from the Activity tab.

flows.name: View editing insights
flows.description: As a logged-in editor, I want to see my most viewed edited articles and recent contribution counts, so that I can understand the effect of my editing activity.

flows.name: View monthly articles read details
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to tap my monthly articles read card, so that I can go to Search and continue exploring my reading activity.

flows.name: View personalized reading summary
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to see my weekly time spent, monthly articles read, saved articles, and top categories, so that I can understand my Wikipedia reading habits.

flows.name: View saved articles
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to tap my monthly saved articles card, so that I can open my reading lists.

flows.name: View timeline edit changes
flows.description: As a logged-in editor, I want to tap an edit timeline item or its View changes button, so that I can review the edit details and diff.

flows.name: View total edits across projects
flows.description: As a logged-in editor, I want to tap my total edits across projects card, so that I can open my contribution list.

name: Activity Tab customization
description: Compose settings surface for choosing which Activity tab modules are visible via switches for time spent, reading insights, editing insights, impact, games, donations, and timeline.

flows.name: Persist module preferences
flows.description: As a user, I want my Activity tab module selections to be saved immediately, so that my customized Activity tab remains the same after leaving the screen or reopening the app.

flows.name: Return from customization
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the top app bar navigation button to leave Activity Tab customization, so that I can return to the previous screen when I am done changing settings.

flows.name: Show only applicable customization options
flows.description: As a user, I want the customization screen to show only Activity tab modules that are relevant to me, so that I am not asked to configure unavailable games or donation modules.

flows.name: Toggle Donations module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Donations Activity tab module on or off when I have donation history, so that I can control whether donation information appears in my Activity tab.

flows.name: Toggle Editing Insights module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Editing Insights Activity tab module on or off, so that I can control whether editing insights appear in my Activity tab.

flows.name: Toggle Games module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Games Activity tab module on or off when games are available for my language, so that I can control whether games content appears in my Activity tab.

flows.name: Toggle Impact module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Impact Activity tab module on or off, so that I can control whether my impact information appears in my Activity tab.

flows.name: Toggle Reading Insights module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Reading Insights Activity tab module on or off, so that I can control whether reading insights appear in my Activity tab.

flows.name: Toggle Time Spent module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Time Spent Activity tab module on or off, so that I can control whether time-spent information appears in my Activity tab.

flows.name: Toggle Timeline module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Timeline Activity tab module on or off, so that I can control whether timeline information appears in my Activity tab.

name: Activity Tab onboarding
description: Full-screen Compose onboarding shown before first use of the Activity tab, explaining reading patterns, impact, engagement, and control, with Continue and Learn more actions.

flows.name: Continue to Activity tab
flows.description: As a first-time Activity tab user, I want to tap Continue after reading the onboarding, so that the onboarding is marked as shown and I can proceed into the Activity tab without seeing the introduction again.

flows.name: Dismiss onboarding without completing
flows.description: As a first-time Activity tab user, I want to leave the onboarding with the system back action, so that I can postpone entering the Activity tab and be prompted again later if I have not chosen Continue or Learn more.

flows.name: Learn more about Activity tab
flows.description: As a first-time Activity tab user, I want to tap Learn more, so that I can open the Activity tab information page in an external browser and get additional details about the feature.

flows.name: View Activity tab onboarding information
flows.description: As a first-time Activity tab user, I want to view and scroll through an introduction explaining reading patterns, impact, engagement options, and control over my data, so that I understand what the Activity tab offers before using it.

name: ActivityTabCustomizationActivity
description: Activity tab customization surface.

name: ActivityTabOnboardingActivity
description: Activity tab onboarding surface.

name: Add languages list screen
description:
Compose screen for adding an app language.
Presents a searchable top app bar, loading/error/empty states, and grouped language lists with Suggested and All headers; selecting a language adds it to the app language list and returns to the caller.

flows.name: Add a language
flows.description: As a user, I want to select a language from the list, so that it is added to my app language list and I can return to the previous screen.

flows.name: Clear language search
flows.description: As a user, I want to clear my language search query, so that I can return to the unfiltered language list.

flows.name: Exit search mode
flows.description: As a user, I want to leave the search mode from the search bar, so that I can go back to the normal add-language toolbar and unfiltered results.

flows.name: Leave from error state
flows.description: As a user, I want to go back from the error state, so that I can abandon adding a language when the list cannot be loaded.

flows.name: Retry after loading error
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry loading languages after an error, so that I can recover and add a language when the fetch succeeds.

flows.name: Return without adding language
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the back button to leave the add-language screen without selecting a language, so that I can return to the previous screen while preserving whether I searched.

flows.name: Search languages
flows.description: As a user, I want to search the language list by language code, localized name, or canonical name, so that I can quickly find the language I want to add.

flows.name: See no matching languages
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an empty-results message when my search matches no languages, so that I understand there are no languages to select for that query.

flows.name: Understand loading state
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a loading indicator while languages are being fetched, so that I know the app is working on showing the list.

flows.name: View available languages
flows.description: As a user, I want to view available app languages grouped into Suggested and All sections, so that I can browse and choose a language to add.

name: Add to reading list bottom sheet
description:
Extended bottom-sheet dialog for adding one or more pages to a reading list.
Displays a recycler list of reading lists, a create-list button, automatically prompts to create a list when none are available, enforces list/article limits, and shows snackbar feedback with a View List action after adding.

flows.name: Add pages to an existing reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to select an existing reading list, so that the selected page or pages are saved to that list.

flows.name: Automatically prompt to create first list
flows.description: As a user with no available reading lists, I want the app to automatically open the create-list prompt, so that I can immediately create a list and save the selected page or pages.

flows.name: Create a new reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to create a new reading list from the add-to-reading-list sheet, so that I can save the selected page or pages into a newly named list.

flows.name: Dismiss after add flow completes
flows.description: As a user, I want the add-to-reading-list sheet to close after the save action completes or cannot proceed, so that I can return to the previous screen with clear feedback.

flows.name: Open the updated reading list from feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the snackbar's View List action after saving pages, so that I can immediately open the reading list I just updated.

flows.name: Prevent creating too many reading lists
flows.description: As a user who has reached the reading-list limit, I want to be told that I cannot create another list, so that I understand why the create action was not completed.

flows.name: Prevent exceeding article limit in a list
flows.description: As a user, I want the app to block adding pages when the target reading list would exceed its article limit, so that the list stays within supported limits.

flows.name: Receive add-to-list feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to see snackbar feedback after adding pages or attempting to add pages that are already in the list, so that I know the result of my action.

flows.name: Validate new reading list details
flows.description: As a user, I want the create-list prompt to require a non-empty unique list name and allow an optional description, so that I do not create invalid or duplicate reading lists.

flows.name: View available reading lists
flows.description: As a user, I want to see my available reading lists in the add-to-reading-list sheet, so that I can choose where to save the selected page or pages.

name: AddLanguagesListActivity
description: Add languages list/search surface.

name: Alpha update available notification
description:
Background recurring alpha-build update checker notification.
When a newer alpha build hash is detected and notification permission is granted, it posts a low-importance notification with alpha update title/text; tapping it opens the latest alpha APK download URL in a browser/downloader.

flows.name: Dismiss notification after opening
flows.description: As an alpha-build user, I want the update notification to disappear after I tap it, so that my notification shade stays clear once I have acted on the update.

flows.name: Manage alpha notification channel
flows.description: As an alpha-build user, I want the alpha update alert to use its own low-importance notification channel in the Other notifications group, so that I can recognize or manage these notifications separately in system settings.

flows.name: Open alpha APK download
flows.description: As an alpha-build user, I want to tap the update notification to open the latest alpha APK download URL, so that I can download and install the newest alpha build.

flows.name: Receive alpha update notification
flows.description: As an alpha-build user, I want to receive a low-importance notification when the app detects a newer alpha build, so that I know an updated test APK is available without manually checking for it.

flows.name: Respect notification permission
flows.description: As an alpha-build user, I want alpha update notifications to be shown only when I have granted notification permission, so that my notification preferences are respected.

name: Android system Add account entry point
description: System account-authenticator surface for adding a Wikimedia account; when invoked by Android account settings it returns an intent to the app's LoginActivity for SOURCE_SYSTEM login.

name: App Icon Picker Bottom Sheet
description: Bottom sheet dialog that displays available launcher icons in a flexbox RecyclerView grid; selecting an icon updates the app launcher alias, dismisses the sheet, and shows a confirmation toast.

flows.name: Confirm icon change
flows.description: As a user, I want the picker to close and show a confirmation after I choose an icon, so that I know my app icon change was applied.

flows.name: Dismiss icon picker without changes
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the app icon picker without selecting an icon, so that I can leave my current launcher icon unchanged.

flows.name: Identify selected app icon
flows.description: As a user, I want the currently selected app icon to be visually highlighted, so that I know which launcher icon is active.

flows.name: Open app icon picker
flows.description: As an eligible settings user, I want to open the app icon picker from Settings, so that I can choose which launcher icon the Wikipedia app uses.

flows.name: Restore default app icon
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the default app icon, so that I can deactivate the alternate launcher icon and return to the standard Wikipedia icon.

flows.name: Select alternate app icon
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the alternate contributor app icon, so that my launcher icon celebrates my Year in Review contributions.

flows.name: View available app icons
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the available app icon choices in the bottom sheet, so that I can compare the default and alternate launcher icons before selecting one.

name: App notification surface
description: Android system notifications for Wikimedia app events, including individual Echo notifications, grouped/multiple-unread notifications, suggested edits reactivation notifications, notification channels/categories, action buttons, content intents, and optional direct reply handling.

flows.name: Grant notification permission
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to be prompted to allow app notifications when needed, so that I can receive Wikimedia alerts from the app.

flows.name: Manage notification categories
flows.description: As a user, I want Wikimedia notifications to be organized into Android notification channels and groups, so that I can control which categories of app notifications I receive in system settings.

flows.name: Open edit diff from notification action
flows.description: As a user, I want a diff action on a notification to open edit details in the app, so that I can inspect the edit associated with the alert.

flows.name: Open multiple unread notifications
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the multiple-unread summary notification to open the notifications area, so that I can review all new alerts together.

flows.name: Open notification destination
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a system notification to open the relevant in-app notification destination, so that I can read and act on the notification details.

flows.name: Open suggested edits from reactivation notification
flows.description: As a user, I want tapping a suggested edits reactivation notification to open the Suggested Edits tab, so that I can immediately resume contributing.

flows.name: Open talk notification directly
flows.description: As a user, I want a user-talk notification to open the related talk topic from the system notification, so that I can review the conversation quickly.

flows.name: Receive anonymous editor talk alert
flows.description: As an anonymous editor, I want the app to detect recent talk-page messages after I edit, so that I can be notified about feedback related to my contribution.

flows.name: Receive category-specific notification presentation
flows.description: As a user, I want different notification types to use category-specific names, icons, colors, and importance, so that I can recognize the kind of alert at a glance.

flows.name: Receive individual Echo notification
flows.description: As a user, I want to receive a system notification for a new unread Wikimedia Echo notification, so that I can notice important account activity without opening the app.

flows.name: Receive multiple unread summary notification
flows.description: As a user, I want multiple new unread notifications to be summarized into one system notification, so that my notification shade is not overwhelmed when several alerts arrive at once.

flows.name: Receive notifications after background polling
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want the app to check for unread notifications in the background when push is not active, so that I can still be alerted about new Wikimedia activity.

flows.name: Receive suggested edits reactivation notification
flows.description: As a user who has not returned to suggested edits recently, I want to receive a reactivation notification after a delay, so that I am reminded to continue contributing edits.

flows.name: Reply directly from notification
flows.description: As a user, I want to submit a direct reply from a notification when a reply action is available, so that I can respond to a talk message without first opening the app.

flows.name: Resume notification polling after device restart
flows.description: As a user, I want notification polling to resume after my device restarts, so that I continue receiving alerts without manually opening the app.

flows.name: Use notification action buttons
flows.description: As a user, I want action buttons on a notification to open its primary or secondary links, so that I can jump directly to the most relevant task or page.

name: Archived talk pages screen
description: Activity displaying archived talk subpages in a paged RecyclerView, with toolbar title link back to the article/user page, loading/error retry rows, empty state, and navigation into selected archived talk pages.

flows.name: Load more archived talk pages
flows.description: As a user, I want additional archived talk pages to load as I scroll through the list, so that I can browse all available archives without leaving the screen.

flows.name: Open archived talk page
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap an archived talk page in the list, so that I can open and read its archived discussion topics.

flows.name: Open parent article or user page
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the linked page title in the toolbar, so that I can navigate back to the related article or user page in a new tab.

flows.name: Retry failed archive loading
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry loading archived talk pages when a loading error is shown, so that I can recover from network or service failures.

flows.name: Return to previous screen
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the toolbar back button to leave the archived talk pages screen, so that I can return to where I came from.

flows.name: See no archives message
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an empty-state message when no archived talk pages are found, so that I understand there are no archives to browse.

flows.name: View archived talk pages
flows.description: As a user, I want to view a list of archived talk subpages for the current talk page, so that I can find older discussions.

name: ArchivedTalkPagesActivity
description: Archived talk pages surface.

name: Article Card
description: Reusable Compose article/page card showing optional thumbnail, title, description, selectable background, and selected checkmark indicator.

flows.name: Handle missing article media or description
flows.description: As a user, I want the article card layout to remain usable when an article has no thumbnail or description, so that I can still identify and interact with the article.

flows.name: Open links in article text
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap links that appear in formatted article text, so that I can open the linked content in an external browser.

flows.name: Open or select article card
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap an article card, so that the containing screen can open or select the represented article.

flows.name: Read formatted article text
flows.description: As a user, I want article titles and descriptions containing HTML formatting to be rendered as readable formatted text, so that article information displays correctly.

flows.name: Recognize selected article
flows.description: As a user, I want a selected article card to show a distinct background and checkmark indicator, so that I can tell which article is currently selected.

flows.name: View article summary card
flows.description: As a user, I want to view an article card with its thumbnail, title, and description when available, so that I can quickly recognize and evaluate the article.

name: Article Page screen
description:
Core article-reading surface hosted by PageActivity/PageFragment.
Displays the article WebView with swipe refresh, loading/progress and error states, top toolbar (back, search, tabs, notifications, overflow), bottom configurable page-action bar, and routes article actions such as language links, gallery, edit, talk page, categories, watchlist, and link preview bottom sheets.

flows.name: Change article language
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view language links and switch the article language, so that I can read the article in another language.

flows.name: Change reading theme
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open theme and reading appearance controls from the article page, so that I can adjust the reading experience to my preferences.

flows.name: Customize page action toolbar
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open toolbar customization from the article overflow menu, so that I can configure which page actions are easiest to access.

flows.name: Edit article
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to start editing the current article or a section, so that I can improve Wikipedia content.

flows.name: Edit article description or image metadata
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to add or edit article descriptions, captions, or image tags from article prompts, so that I can improve article metadata and media information.

flows.name: Find within article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to search for text within the current article, so that I can quickly locate specific information on the page.

flows.name: Follow article links
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap internal article links and section anchors, so that I can navigate to related pages or jump within the same article.

flows.name: Handle article load errors
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see an error state with retry and back options when an article cannot load, so that I can recover or leave the failed page.

flows.name: Handle protected or unavailable actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want page actions to be disabled, hidden, or show an unavailable message when the article state does not support them, so that I understand why an action cannot be completed.

flows.name: Load more reading suggestions
flows.description: As a reader, I want more related reading content to load as I near the end of an article, so that I can continue discovering relevant pages.

flows.name: Manage article tabs
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the tab switcher and create new tabs from the article page, so that I can manage multiple article browsing contexts.

flows.name: Navigate back and forward
flows.description: As a reader, I want to navigate backward and forward through article history within a tab, so that I can return to pages I previously viewed.

flows.name: Open external and special links
flows.description: As a reader, I want external, special, file, talk, category, and contribution links to open in the appropriate app screen or browser, so that each link type is handled in a useful context.

flows.name: Open license and browser links
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the article license or view the current article in an external browser, so that I can access web-based information outside the app.

flows.name: Open media gallery
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap article images or media to open the gallery, so that I can view media in detail when online.

flows.name: Open notifications
flows.description: As a user with notifications, I want to open my notifications or anonymous talk messages from the article toolbar, so that I can review updates relevant to me.

flows.name: Open table of contents
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open and dismiss the article table of contents, so that I can jump between sections of the article.

flows.name: Open talk page
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the article talk page from page actions or footer links, so that I can read or participate in discussion about the article.

flows.name: Play pronunciation audio
flows.description: As a reader, I want to play or stop pronunciation audio in an article, so that I can hear how a term is pronounced.

flows.name: Preview article links
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see a preview for article links and choose whether to open them in the current or background tab, so that I can inspect linked content without losing my place.

flows.name: Read article content
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view and scroll an article page, so that I can read Wikipedia content and related sections.

flows.name: Refresh article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to pull to refresh or retry loading an article, so that I can get the latest content or recover from a loading failure.

flows.name: Respond to article campaign dialogs
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see and respond to article campaign or donation reminder prompts, so that I can decide whether to support or postpone campaign actions.

flows.name: Resume reading
flows.description: As a reader, I want the article page to restore my current tab and scroll position after returning to the app, so that I can continue reading where I left off.

flows.name: Return home
flows.description: As a reader, I want to go to the app home screen from the article page, so that I can resume browsing the main app experience.

flows.name: Save article to reading list
flows.description: As a reader, I want to save or manage the current article in my reading lists, so that I can read it later or organize it in a list.

flows.name: Search from article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to start Wikipedia search from the article toolbar, so that I can find another article without leaving the reading context manually.

flows.name: Select article text actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to select article text and use contextual actions such as sharing or defining terms, so that I can reuse or understand selected content.

flows.name: Share article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to share the current article link, so that I can send it to other people or apps.

flows.name: Use overflow article actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the article overflow menu, so that I can access additional page actions that are not shown in the bottom bar.

flows.name: View article on map
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the article location on a map when coordinates are available, so that I can understand where the subject is located.

flows.name: View categories
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view the categories for the current article, so that I can explore related topics and classifications.

flows.name: View edit diff details
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open revision diff links from the article, so that I can inspect the details of a specific edit.

flows.name: View edit history
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view the article edit history, so that I can inspect past changes and revisions.

flows.name: View page issues
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open article issue notices, so that I can understand maintenance warnings or quality concerns for the page.

flows.name: View references
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap article references to open their details and navigate backlinks, so that I can verify sources and return to cited text.

flows.name: Watch or unwatch article
flows.description: As a logged-in reader, I want to add or remove the current article from my watchlist, so that I can track changes to pages I care about.

name: Article edit diff details screen
description:
Activity/fragment UI for reviewing a page revision diff.
Shows article title, previous/current revision metadata, diff line list with expandable unchanged/changed blocks, ORES quality/intent chips for recent edits, navigation arrows, watch/thank/undo/talk actions, overflow actions for share/copy/history/learn more/feedback/saved messages, loading/error/diff-unavailable states, and snackbar feedback after watch/thank/undo/rollback/talk actions.

flows.name: Copy diff link
flows.description: As a user, I want to copy a link to the current revision diff, so that I can paste it elsewhere.

flows.name: Expand and collapse diff blocks
flows.description: As a reader or editor, I want to expand or collapse individual unchanged or changed diff blocks, so that I can focus on the parts of the revision that matter to me.

flows.name: Keep revision context visible while scrolling
flows.description: As a user, I want the from and to revision timestamps to remain visible in an overlay while I scroll the diff, so that I can keep context for the comparison.

flows.name: Learn more about editing or patrolling
flows.description: As a patroller reviewing recent edits, I want to open the editing FAQ or learn-more page from the overflow menu, so that I can understand how the feature works.

flows.name: Navigate to adjacent revisions
flows.description: As a reader or editor, I want to move to the previous or next revision diff using navigation arrows, so that I can review a sequence of edits on the page.

flows.name: Open article from title
flows.description: As a reader or editor, I want to tap the article title to open the appropriate page preview, file page, talk page, or external page, so that I can inspect the page associated with the diff.

flows.name: Open page edit history
flows.description: As a patroller reviewing recent edits, I want to open the page edit history from the diff overflow menu, so that I can inspect other revisions to the page.

flows.name: Open saved warning messages
flows.description: As a patroller reviewing recent edits, I want to open my saved talk warning messages, so that I can manage reusable messages for patrolling.

flows.name: Prompt for recent edits feedback after actions
flows.description: As a patroller reviewing recent edits, I want the app to prompt me for feedback after completing certain patrolling actions, so that I can share my experience with the feature.

flows.name: Receive action result feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to receive snackbar or error feedback after watch, unwatch, thank, undo, rollback, copy-link, and talk-message actions, so that I know whether my action succeeded or failed.

flows.name: Receive quality and intent tooltip guidance
flows.description: As a first-time patroller reviewing a recent edit, I want to see guided tooltips for the quality and intent chips, so that I understand how to use those scores while patrolling.

flows.name: Recover from loading error
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error state and use its back action when the revision or diff cannot be loaded, so that I can leave the failed diff review gracefully.

flows.name: Report recent edits feature feedback
flows.description: As a patroller reviewing recent edits, I want to open a feedback form from the overflow menu, so that I can report issues or opinions about the patrolling feature.

flows.name: Review revision diff
flows.description: As a reader or editor, I want to view the article title, previous and current revision metadata, edit comments, byte change, and highlighted diff lines, so that I can understand what changed in a page revision.

flows.name: Rollback latest contributor edits
flows.description: As a logged-in user with rollback rights, I want to choose and confirm rollback for the latest eligible revision, so that I can quickly revert edits by that contributor.

flows.name: Set watchlist expiry after watching
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to open watchlist expiry choices after adding the page to my watchlist, so that I can decide how long to watch the page.

flows.name: Share diff link
flows.description: As a user, I want to share a link to the current revision diff, so that I can send the change to someone else.

flows.name: Thank revision contributor
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to confirm and send thanks to the contributor of an eligible revision, so that I can acknowledge their contribution.

flows.name: Track operation progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see loading progress while revision details, diff content, undo, or rollback actions are being processed, so that I know the app is working.

flows.name: Understand unavailable protected diff
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a protected-diff unavailable message when the app is not allowed to load the diff, so that I understand why the revision details cannot be reviewed.

flows.name: Undo revision
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to confirm an undo action and provide an undo summary for an eligible revision, so that I can revert that edit with an explanatory comment.

flows.name: View posted talk warning
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open the talk page from the snackbar after publishing a warning message, so that I can verify or continue the discussion.

flows.name: View quality and intent explanation
flows.description: As a patroller reviewing recent edits, I want to tap ORES quality or intent chips, so that I can learn what those edit prediction scores mean.

flows.name: View revision contributor options
flows.description: As a reader or editor, I want to tap the previous or current revision username to see user and talk options for that contributor, so that I can learn about or contact the editor responsible for the revision.

flows.name: Warn contributor on talk page
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open a talk warning flow for the contributor of the current revision, so that I can leave an appropriate message about the edit.

flows.name: Watch or unwatch page
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to add or remove the page from my watchlist from the diff screen, so that I can control whether I monitor future changes to the page.

name: Article helper dialogs and snackbars
description: Transient article-page feedback and confirmation UI, including the reverted description-edit help dialog, anonymous description-edit limit login dialog, WebView-update toast/error feedback, edit/save/watchlist snackbars, gallery-offline snackbar, redirect snackbar, and one-time customize-toolbar/theme tooltip.

name: Article link preview and other exclusive bottom sheets presenter
description:
Coordinator/base UI for article bottom sheets.
ExclusiveBottomSheetPresenter ensures only one bottom sheet is displayed at a time; ExtendedBottomSheetDialogFragment supplies the themed Material bottom-sheet dialog behavior used by article sub-surfaces such as link previews, references, theme chooser, categories, Wiktionary, and watchlist expiry.

name: Article reference navigation action bar
description:
Contextual find-reference-in-page UI shown after selecting a reference backlink.
Presents previous/next reference navigation, current match count, and a reference label that returns to the selected reference anchor in the article WebView.

flows.name: Dismiss reference backlink navigator
flows.description: As a reader, I want to dismiss the reference backlink navigation mode, so that I can resume normal article reading with backlink highlights removed.

flows.name: Navigate to next reference backlink
flows.description: As a reader, I want to move to the next highlighted backlink for the selected reference, so that I can inspect each citation occurrence in article order.

flows.name: Navigate to previous reference backlink
flows.description: As a reader, I want to move to the previous highlighted backlink for the selected reference, so that I can revisit earlier citation occurrences without leaving the navigator.

flows.name: Open reference backlink navigator
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open a contextual navigation bar when I select a reference backlink, so that I can review every place in the article that cites the selected reference.

flows.name: Return to reference anchor
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the reference label to return to the selected reference entry in the article, so that I can go back from citation occurrences to the reference details.

flows.name: View backlink position count
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see the current backlink number and total matches, so that I understand where I am within the reference backlink results.

flows.name: View selected reference label
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see the selected reference label in the action bar, so that I know which reference's backlinks I am navigating.

flows.name: Wrap around reference backlink results
flows.description: As a reader, I want previous and next navigation to wrap between the first and last backlink, so that I can continuously browse all occurrences of the selected reference.

name: Article table of contents side panel
description:
Drawer-style table-of-contents panel for the article page.
Shows article sections, highlights current section while scrolling, supports RTL placement, and includes a draggable page scroller button for quick navigation through the article.

flows.name: Browse article sections in side panel
flows.description: As a reader, I want to browse the article's lead, top-level sections, subsections, and About this article entry in a side panel, so that I can understand the article structure and choose where to go.

flows.name: Close contents after using page scroller
flows.description: As a reader, I want the table of contents panel to close when I finish dragging the page scroller, so that I can resume reading at the new position.

flows.name: Contents unavailable while article is loading or disabled
flows.description: As a reader, I want the table of contents drawer to be disabled while an article is loading or unavailable, so that I do not interact with stale or incomplete section navigation.

flows.name: Dismiss table of contents by tapping article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the article while the table of contents panel is open, so that I can dismiss the panel without changing sections.

flows.name: Dismiss table of contents with back
flows.description: As a reader, I want to press Back while the table of contents panel is open, so that I can close the panel and continue reading the article.

flows.name: Dismiss table of contents with swipe out
flows.description: As a reader, I want to swipe the table of contents panel away, so that I can close it using a drawer gesture.

flows.name: Navigate to About this article from contents
flows.description: As a reader, I want to select the About this article entry in the table of contents, so that I can jump to the article footer information.

flows.name: Navigate to article lead from contents
flows.description: As a reader, I want to select the lead article entry in the table of contents, so that I can quickly return to the top of the article.

flows.name: Navigate to selected section
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a table-of-contents entry, so that the article scrolls directly to that section and the panel closes.

flows.name: Open table of contents from article actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the article table of contents from the Contents action, so that I can see the structure of the article without leaving the page.

flows.name: Open table of contents with edge swipe
flows.description: As a reader, I want to swipe from the article edge to open the table of contents panel, so that I can access article navigation with a gesture.

flows.name: See scroller position reflect reading position
flows.description: As a reader, I want the page scroller button position to track my current scroll position in the article, so that I have a visual indication of where I am in the page.

flows.name: Show current section when opening contents
flows.description: As a reader, I want the table of contents to highlight and scroll to my current article section when I open it, so that I can orient myself within the article.

flows.name: Use localized RTL table of contents placement
flows.description: As a reader of a right-to-left language article, I want the table of contents and page scroller to appear on the appropriate side with matching layout direction, so that navigation feels natural for my language.

flows.name: Use page scroller for quick navigation
flows.description: As a reader, I want to drag the page scroller button alongside the table of contents, so that I can quickly move through the article while seeing the corresponding section highlighted.

name: Article toolbar and bottom page actions widget
description: Reusable/configurable action surfaces for an article page: the bottom PageActionTabLayout builds action tabs from the user's customized toolbar order, while PageFragment/PageActivity provide the overflow menu, contextual text-selection action mode, find-in-article action mode, save/watch/share/theme/categories/edit actions, and toolbar buttons.

flows.name: Browse open tabs
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the tabs view from the article toolbar, so that I can switch tabs, create a tab, or manage open article tabs.

flows.name: Change article language
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open language options for the current article, so that I can read the page in another available language.

flows.name: Change reading theme
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the theme chooser from page actions, so that I can adjust the article reading appearance.

flows.name: Close find in article
flows.description: As a reader using find in article, I want to close the find toolbar and clear highlights, so that I can return to normal article reading.

flows.name: Create new article tab
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open a new tab from page actions, so that I can start browsing another page without replacing my current tab.

flows.name: Customize toolbar actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open toolbar customization from the overflow menu, so that I can change which article actions appear in the toolbar and menu.

flows.name: Define selected text
flows.description: As a reader, I want to define selected article text from the contextual text menu when supported, so that I can understand unfamiliar words without leaving the article.

flows.name: Edit article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to start editing the current article from page actions, so that I can improve the article content when editing is allowed.

flows.name: Edit from selected text
flows.description: As a reader, I want to edit the section or description related to selected article text, so that I can quickly improve the content I am reading.

flows.name: Find text in article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to search for text within the current article, so that I can quickly locate matching content on the page.

flows.name: Go forward in article tab history
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the forward action when available, so that I can return to a page I navigated back from in the current tab.

flows.name: Handle gallery unavailable offline
flows.description: As an offline reader, I want to see feedback when the gallery cannot open, so that I know the image viewer requires connectivity.

flows.name: Leave failed page load
flows.description: As a reader seeing a page load error, I want to go back from the error view, so that I can return to a previous article or exit the article screen.

flows.name: Manage saved article lists
flows.description: As a reader with an already saved article, I want to use the save action menu to add or move the article between reading lists, so that my saved pages stay organized.

flows.name: Navigate back from article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the toolbar back button or system back, so that I can close overlays, go back in article history, close the tab, or return to the previous screen.

flows.name: Navigate find results
flows.description: As a reader using find in article, I want to move to the next, previous, first, or last match, so that I can review all occurrences of my search term.

flows.name: Navigate reference backlinks
flows.description: As a reader viewing a reference, I want to move between the places that cite that reference and return to the reference, so that I can understand where a citation is used in the article.

flows.name: Open article talk page
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the article talk page from page actions, so that I can read or participate in discussion about the article.

flows.name: Open footer article tools
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use article footer items for talk page, languages, edit history, coordinates, page issues, license, and browser view, so that I can access related article information and external views from the page.

flows.name: Open link preview or article link
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap links in the article, so that I can preview or navigate to related pages while preserving my reading flow.

flows.name: Open media gallery
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap an article image or media item, so that I can view it in the media gallery.

flows.name: Open notifications
flows.description: As a user with available notifications, I want to open notifications from the article toolbar, so that I can review unread account or talk messages.

flows.name: Open overflow actions menu
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the article overflow menu, so that I can access additional page actions that are not shown in the bottom toolbar.

flows.name: Open table of contents
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the article table of contents from page actions or by swiping from the edge, so that I can jump between sections.

flows.name: Play pronunciation audio
flows.description: As a reader, I want to play or stop pronunciation audio from the article, so that I can hear how a term is pronounced.

flows.name: Pull to refresh article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to pull to refresh the article, so that I can reload the current page content from the network when available.

flows.name: Respond to anonymous edit limit
flows.description: As an anonymous reader who reaches the description edit limit, I want to see a login prompt and choose whether to log in, so that I understand how to continue editing descriptions.

flows.name: Retry failed page load
flows.description: As a reader seeing a page load error, I want to retry loading the article, so that I can recover if the error was temporary.

flows.name: Return to home
flows.description: As a reader, I want to go to the app home screen from page actions, so that I can leave the article and browse the main feed.

flows.name: Save article to reading list
flows.description: As a reader, I want to save an article from the page actions, so that I can find it later in my reading lists.

flows.name: Search Wikipedia from article toolbar
flows.description: As a reader, I want to start Wikipedia search from the article toolbar, so that I can find another page while reading.

flows.name: See map unavailable feedback
flows.description: As a reader, I want to be told when an article has no map coordinates, so that I understand why the map action cannot show a location.

flows.name: Share article link
flows.description: As a reader, I want to share the current article from page actions, so that I can send the page to someone else or another app.

flows.name: Use customized bottom action tabs
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use article actions from the bottom toolbar in my customized order, so that my preferred actions are quickly accessible while reading.

flows.name: View article categories
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the article categories from page actions, so that I can explore related category pages.

flows.name: View article on map
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the article's location on a map when geographic coordinates are available, so that I can see where the topic is located.

flows.name: View edit history
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the article edit history, so that I can review recent and past changes to the page.

flows.name: Watch or unwatch article
flows.description: As a logged-in reader, I want to add or remove the article from my watchlist, so that I can track or stop tracking changes to the page.

name: ArticleEditDetailsActivity
description: Article edit diff/details surface.

name: Auto-Summarizing EditText Preference
description: Reusable settings preference widget based on EditTextPreference that updates its summary to the persisted text value or a 'no value' placeholder when attached or changed.

flows.name: Cancel text edit
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to dismiss the edit dialog without saving changes, so that I can leave the persisted value and displayed summary unchanged.

flows.name: Clear saved preference text
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to save an empty or cleared text value in the preference, so that the stored setting and its displayed summary reflect that cleared value.

flows.name: Edit and save preference text
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to open the edit text preference, enter a text value, and save it, so that the setting is persisted and reflected immediately in the preference summary.

flows.name: View saved text summary
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to see the preference summary automatically show the saved text value when the setting is displayed, so that I can understand the current setting without opening it.

flows.name: View unset placeholder
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to see an 'Unset' placeholder when the preference has no saved value, so that I can distinguish an unconfigured setting from one with an actual value.

name: Background login warning toasts
description:
Toast-based warning popups shown when background login cannot continue because an additional UI step is required, such as captcha, two-factor authentication/module selection, or email authentication.
These are emitted from LoginClient during non-interactive login flows.

flows.name: Warn about captcha during background login
flows.description: As a logged-out user in a background login flow, I want to be warned when a captcha is required, so that I know to return to the main screen and log in manually.

flows.name: Warn about email authentication during background login
flows.description: As a logged-out user in a background login flow, I want to be warned when email verification is required, so that I know to log in from the main screen with my email verification code.

flows.name: Warn about two-factor authentication during background login
flows.description: As a logged-out user in a background login flow, I want to be warned when two-factor authentication or module selection is required, so that I know to log in from the main screen with my 2FA code.

name: Balloon Tooltip Popup
description: Reusable Balloon popup/tooltip anchored above or below a view, supporting either plain-text tooltip content with optional dismiss button/count or a supplied custom layout resource.

flows.name: Align tooltip arrow to anchor
flows.description: As a user, I want the tooltip arrow to point at the related control, so that I can clearly connect the guidance with the exact interface element it describes.

flows.name: Dismiss auto-dismissible tooltip by tapping outside
flows.description: As a user, I want an auto-dismissible tooltip to close when I tap outside it, so that temporary guidance does not remain in my way.

flows.name: Dismiss persistent tooltip on next screen touch
flows.description: As a user, I want a persistent tooltip to close when I interact elsewhere on the screen, so that only one persistent help popup remains active and it does not block continued use.

flows.name: Dismiss tooltip with action button
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss a tooltip by tapping its visible dismiss button, so that I can close the guidance when I am done reading it.

flows.name: Position tooltip above or below anchor
flows.description: As a user, I want the tooltip to appear above or below the anchored view as appropriate, so that the help message is visible without unnecessarily covering the interface.

flows.name: Show anchored text tooltip
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a plain-text tooltip anchored to the relevant control, so that I can understand what that control or feature does in context.

flows.name: Show custom tooltip layout
flows.description: As a user, I want a tooltip to display custom-designed content when needed, so that richer contextual guidance can be presented in the same anchored popup style.

flows.name: View tooltip step count
flows.description: As a user, I want a tooltip in a multi-step guidance sequence to show its current step count, so that I know where I am in the sequence.

name: Based on interest feed carousel module
description: Compose For You feed carousel module that pages through article recommendations based on selected interests, using shared ForYouCardContent with page open, save, share, hide, module hide, customize interests, and impression callbacks.

flows.name: Customize interests
flows.description: As a user, I want to open interest customization from the card menu, so that I can adjust which interests influence my article recommendations.

flows.name: Hide based-on-interest module
flows.description: As a user, I want to hide the entire based-on-interest recommendation module from the card menu, so that I no longer see this type of recommendation in my feed.

flows.name: Hide individual recommendation
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss an individual recommended article from the card menu, so that I can remove suggestions I am not interested in.

flows.name: Open card actions menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the overflow menu on a recommended article card, so that I can access additional actions for that recommendation.

flows.name: Open recommended article
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a recommended article card, so that I can read the full article from the feed.

flows.name: Page through interest recommendations
flows.description: As a user, I want to swipe through article recommendations in the based-on-interest carousel, so that I can browse multiple suggested articles without leaving the feed.

flows.name: Register viewed recommendation
flows.description: As a user, I want recommendations to be registered when I bring them into view, so that the feed can track seen suggestions and improve recommendation handling.

flows.name: Save recommended article
flows.description: As a user, I want to save a recommended article from the card menu, so that I can find and read it later from my saved list.

flows.name: See recommendation reason
flows.description: As a user, I want to see why an article is being recommended based on my interests, so that I can understand the source of the suggestion.

flows.name: Share recommended article
flows.description: As a user, I want to share a recommended article from the card menu, so that I can send it to someone else or another app.

name: Because you read feed carousel module
description: Compose For You feed carousel module for article recommendations based on reading history, using shared ForYouCardContent with history footer, page open, save, share, hide, customize interests, and impression callbacks.

flows.name: Browse recommendation carousel
flows.description: As a reader, I want to swipe through multiple recommended articles in the carousel, so that I can browse all suggestions in the module.

flows.name: Customize feed interests
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open interest customization from the card menu, so that I can tune future For You recommendations.

flows.name: Hide Because you read module
flows.description: As a reader, I want to hide the entire Because you read recommendation module from the card menu, so that I can stop seeing this type of recommendation.

flows.name: Hide recommendation card
flows.description: As a reader, I want to hide an individual recommendation from the card menu, so that I can remove suggestions I am not interested in.

flows.name: Open card overflow menu
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the article card overflow menu, so that I can access additional actions for the recommendation.

flows.name: Open recommended article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a recommended article card, so that I can open and read the full article.

flows.name: Record recommendation impression
flows.description: As a reader, I want recommendations to count as viewed only when they are actually visible, so that the app can provide accurate analytics and improve future recommendations without counting unseen cards.

flows.name: Save recommended article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to save a recommended article from the card menu, so that I can add it to my reading list for later.

flows.name: Share recommended article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to share a recommended article from the card menu, so that I can send it to someone else.

flows.name: Track carousel position
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see page indicator dots when there are multiple recommendations, so that I know my position in the carousel.

flows.name: Undo hidden module
flows.description: As a reader, I want to undo hiding the Because you read module, so that I can restore the recommendations if I hid the module by mistake.

flows.name: Undo hidden recommendation card
flows.description: As a reader, I want to undo hiding an individual recommendation, so that I can restore it if I dismissed it by mistake.

flows.name: View reading-history recommendations
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see article recommendations labeled as being because of an article I read, so that I understand why these articles are being suggested to me.

flows.name: View recommendations without images
flows.description: As a reader, I want recommended articles without suitable thumbnails to still be shown as readable text cards, so that I can consider recommendations even when images are unavailable.

name: Campaign donation dialog
description: Alert dialog for donation/announcement campaigns; renders campaign text/footer links and positive, neutral, negative, and close actions, including donate launch, already-donated feedback, maybe-later/reminder behavior, and donor-experience analytics.

flows.name: Choose maybe later
flows.description: As a reader, I want to choose the maybe-later action when reminders are not enabled, so that the campaign is dismissed and I am reminded again tomorrow.

flows.name: Confirm already donated
flows.description: As a donor, I want to indicate that I have already donated, so that the campaign dialog is dismissed and I receive a thank-you confirmation.

flows.name: Dismiss campaign with close button
flows.description: As a reader, I want to close the campaign dialog, so that I can return to reading and avoid seeing the same campaign again during the current suppression period.

flows.name: Handle unavailable campaign actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want the dialog to hide its action area if valid campaign actions cannot be loaded, so that I am not shown broken or unusable buttons.

flows.name: Open footer policy links
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap footer links such as donor policy links, so that I can review policy or legal information in an external browser.

flows.name: Open links in campaign message
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap links embedded in the campaign message, so that I can learn more from referenced pages without leaving the dialog context unexpectedly.

flows.name: Set donation reminder
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the neutral reminder action when donation reminders are enabled, so that I can configure a reminder instead of donating immediately.

flows.name: Start donation
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the primary donate action, so that I can begin the donation process for the current campaign.

flows.name: Use localized campaign actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want the dialog actions to use the campaign-provided button labels for my language, so that the available choices are clear and localized.

flows.name: View campaign message
flows.description: As a reader, I want to read the donation or announcement campaign message in a scrollable dialog, so that I can understand what Wikipedia is asking me to do.

name: Categories bottom sheet
description:
Bottom-sheet dialog listing categories for a page.
Shows the page title, progress, error, empty state, and a RecyclerView of category rows; selecting a row opens the Category members screen.

flows.name: Browse page categories
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view and scroll through the list of categories for the page, so that I can discover how the page is classified.

flows.name: Handle category loading error
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see an error message if categories cannot be loaded and have a way to close the sheet, so that I can recover from the failed request and return to the page.

flows.name: Open category members
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a category row, so that I can open the Category members screen for that category.

flows.name: See categories loading state
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see a progress indicator while categories are being loaded, so that I know the app is working on retrieving the category list.

flows.name: See no categories message
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see a no-categories message when the page has no categories, so that I understand there are no category links to browse.

flows.name: View categories in page language direction
flows.description: As a reader of pages in different languages, I want the categories sheet layout to follow the page language direction, so that the content is readable for both left-to-right and right-to-left languages.

flows.name: View categories sheet for page
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open a categories bottom sheet that shows the current page title, so that I know which article's categories I am viewing.

name: Category Playground
description:
Compose developer playground activity for category database testing.
Provides Entry, Filter, and Delete chip modes, forms for adding single or random bulk category rows, controls for filtering/deleting categories, and a table of category records.

flows.name: Add random bulk category entries
flows.description: As a developer user, I want to specify a number of rows and year and add random bulk category rows, so that I can quickly populate the category database with test data.

flows.name: Add single category entry
flows.description: As a developer user, I want to enter a title, language code, and year and add a single category row, so that I can create specific test category data.

flows.name: Delete all category records
flows.description: As a developer user, I want to delete all category records from the playground, so that I can reset the category database for testing.

flows.name: Delete categories before year
flows.description: As a developer user, I want to enter a cutoff year and delete category records before it, so that I can test cleanup behavior for older category data.

flows.name: Filter categories by year
flows.description: As a developer user, I want to enter a year and filter the category table, so that I can inspect category records from a specific time range.

flows.name: Open Category Playground
flows.description: As a developer user, I want to open the Category Playground from developer settings, so that I can test category database operations.

flows.name: Return from Category Playground
flows.description: As a developer user, I want to use the top app bar back button, so that I can leave the Category Playground and return to the previous screen.

flows.name: See database operation errors
flows.description: As a developer user, I want to see an error message when adding or deleting category data fails, so that I understand that the requested database operation did not complete.

flows.name: See loading state
flows.description: As a developer user, I want to see a loading indicator while category records are being loaded, so that I know the playground is fetching database data.

flows.name: Switch playground mode
flows.description: As a developer user, I want to switch between Entry, Filter, and Delete modes, so that I can choose the type of category database operation I need to perform.

flows.name: Validate required form input
flows.description: As a developer user, I want the playground to warn me when required fields are empty, so that I do not accidentally run category operations with incomplete input.

flows.name: View category records table
flows.description: As a developer user, I want to view category records in a table with title, language, and year or count information, so that I can inspect the contents of the category database.

name: Category members screen
description:
CategoryActivity surface showing a category title in a toolbar, tabs for pages vs subcategories, paged RecyclerView lists of category members with thumbnails/descriptions, loading/error/empty rows, and a toolbar action that opens the containing-categories bottom sheet.
Page items open link previews; subcategory items open another category screen.

flows.name: Close category screen
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the toolbar up button or system back to leave the category members screen, so that I can return to where I came from.

flows.name: Load more category pages while scrolling
flows.description: As a user, I want the category pages list to load additional results as I scroll, so that I can continue browsing large categories without manually paging.

flows.name: Load more subcategories while scrolling
flows.description: As a user, I want the subcategories list to load additional results as I scroll, so that I can browse all child categories in a large category.

flows.name: Open containing categories sheet
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the categories action from the toolbar overflow, so that I can see the categories that contain the current category page.

flows.name: Open containing category
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a category in the containing-categories bottom sheet, so that I can navigate to that category's members screen.

flows.name: Open page link preview
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a page in the category pages list to open its link preview, so that I can inspect or continue to the article without immediately leaving the category screen.

flows.name: Open subcategory
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a subcategory item to open that subcategory's category members screen, so that I can drill down into the category hierarchy.

flows.name: Retry failed member loading
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry loading category pages or subcategories after an error, so that I can recover from network or service failures.

flows.name: Switch back to pages tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to switch from subcategories back to pages, so that I can return to the article/page members of the current category.

flows.name: Switch to subcategories tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to switch from pages to subcategories, so that I can browse child categories within the current category.

flows.name: View category pages
flows.description: As a user, I want to view the pages that belong to a category with their titles, thumbnails, and descriptions, so that I can browse category members and choose relevant articles.

flows.name: View containing categories states
flows.description: As a user, I want the containing-categories bottom sheet to show loading, error, empty, or results states, so that I understand whether parent categories are being fetched, unavailable, absent, or ready to browse.

flows.name: View empty category messages
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an empty-state message when a category has no pages or no subcategories, so that I understand the list finished loading and contains no results.

name: CategoryActivity
description: Category browsing surface.

name: CategoryDeveloperPlayGround
description: Developer playground surface for category UI.

name: Clear Recent Searches Confirmation Dialog
description: Material alert dialog launched from the Recent Searches panel to confirm deleting all recent searches, with Yes and No actions.

flows.name: Cancel clearing recent searches
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose No in the clear recent searches confirmation dialog, so that my recent search history is kept unchanged.

flows.name: Confirm clearing recent searches
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm the clear recent searches dialog with Yes, so that all of my saved recent search history is deleted and the recent searches panel is refreshed.

flows.name: Dismiss clear recent searches dialog
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the clear recent searches confirmation dialog without confirming, so that I can return to the recent searches panel without deleting my search history.

name: Clear history confirmation dialog
description:
Material confirmation dialog shown before deleting all browsing history.
Provides title/message plus Yes and No actions, then clears history and related cached data on confirmation.
