flows.name: Cancel clearing browsing history
flows.description: As a user, I want to decline or dismiss the clear history confirmation, so that my browsing history remains unchanged if I do not want to delete it.

flows.name: Confirm clearing browsing history
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm that all browsing history should be deleted, so that my history and related cached history data are removed only after I explicitly approve the destructive action.

name: Close all tabs confirmation dialog
description: Material confirmation dialog launched from the tabs overflow/menu action before removing all open tabs, with positive close-all and negative cancel actions.

flows.name: Cancel close all tabs
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the close-all-tabs confirmation, so that my open tabs remain unchanged if I decide not to close them.

flows.name: Confirm close all tabs
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm that I want to close all open tabs, so that I can remove every tab at once without closing them individually.

flows.name: Undo close all tabs
flows.description: As a user, I want to undo closing all tabs from the snackbar after confirming, so that I can restore the tabs if I closed them by mistake.

name: Community Modules All-Off Confirmation Dialog
description:
Alert dialog shown when the user disables every community module.
Allows confirming that all modules stay off or cancelling, which re-enables the last toggled module.

flows.name: Cancel all community modules disabled
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the all-off warning, so that the last community module I turned off is re-enabled and the community feed is not left empty.

flows.name: Confirm all community modules disabled
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm the all-off warning, so that all community modules remain disabled after turning off the last visible module.

flows.name: Dismiss all-off warning
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the all-off warning without choosing a dialog button, so that I can close the interruption and return to the community modules settings screen.

flows.name: Warn when disabling final community module
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a confirmation dialog when I turn off the last visible community module, so that I understand I am about to leave all community modules disabled.

name: Community Modules Settings
description: Compose toggle-list screen for choosing which community home-feed modules are visible, including Featured article, Top read, Did you know, News, On this day, and Featured image.

flows.name: Cancel turning off all community modules
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the warning shown when I turn off every Community feed module, so that the last module I disabled is restored and at least one Community module remains enabled.

flows.name: Confirm turning off all community modules
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm when I have turned off every Community feed module, so that I can intentionally keep the Community feed tab with no enabled modules.

flows.name: Persist community module visibility preferences
flows.description: As a user, I want my Community module visibility choices to be saved, so that the same modules remain enabled or disabled after I leave the screen or restart the app.

flows.name: Return from community module settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to navigate back from the Community Modules Settings screen, so that I can return to the previous settings screen when I am done reviewing module options.

flows.name: Review community module options
flows.description: As a user, I want to view explanatory text and the current on/off state of each Community feed module, so that I can understand and manage what appears in my Community feed tab.

flows.name: Toggle Did you know module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Did you know Community module on or off, so that I can control whether Did you know content appears in my Community feed tab.

flows.name: Toggle Featured article module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Featured article Community module on or off, so that I can control whether featured article content appears in my Community feed tab.

flows.name: Toggle Featured image module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Featured image Community module on or off, so that I can control whether featured image content appears in my Community feed tab.

flows.name: Toggle News module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the News Community module on or off, so that I can control whether news content appears in my Community feed tab.

flows.name: Toggle On this day module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the On this day Community module on or off, so that I can control whether historical anniversary content appears in my Community feed tab.

flows.name: Toggle Top read module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Top read Community module on or off, so that I can control whether top-read article content appears in my Community feed tab.

name: Community feed card container overflow menu
description: Reusable Community module header/container with localized title/subtitle, optional context icon, impression tracking, and overflow dropdown actions to dismiss the card or hide the module.

flows.name: Dismiss a community feed card
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose the dismiss-card action from a community feed card's overflow menu, so that I can remove that individual card from my feed.

flows.name: Dismiss card overflow menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the open overflow menu without choosing an action, so that I can return to browsing the community feed unchanged.

flows.name: Hide a community feed module
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose the hide-module action from a community feed card's overflow menu, so that I can stop seeing that entire type of module in my feed.

flows.name: Open card overflow menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the three-dot overflow button on a community feed card, so that I can see the available management actions for that card or module.

flows.name: Track card impression when visible
flows.description: As a user, I want the app to register when a community feed card becomes sufficiently visible, so that feed engagement can be measured without requiring me to tap anything.

flows.name: Undo dismissed community feed card
flows.description: As a user, I want to undo a dismissed community feed card from the confirmation snackbar, so that I can restore the card if I dismissed it by mistake.

flows.name: Undo hidden community feed module
flows.description: As a user, I want to undo a hidden community feed module from the confirmation snackbar, so that I can restore the module if I hid it by mistake.

flows.name: View localized module header
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a community feed module header with a localized title, subtitle, and optional context icon, so that I understand what kind of content the card contains in my selected language.

name: Community feed empty/loading/error utilities
description: Shared feed UI widgets for community and For You feeds including date header, community disclaimer, load more button, loading spinner, error/retry view, and all-modules-hidden/no-data empty state with CTA.

flows.name: Browse feed in language direction
flows.description: As a reader, I want community feed utility content to respect the selected wiki language's text direction, so that the feed is readable in both left-to-right and right-to-left languages.

flows.name: Load more community content
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a load more button when more community feed content is available, so that I can continue browsing additional feed items.

flows.name: Manage modules from empty feed
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the empty feed call-to-action to manage feed modules when no community content is available or all modules are hidden, so that I can enable content that should appear in my feed.

flows.name: Read empty-state explanation
flows.description: As a reader, I want the empty feed view to show an illustration, title, and HTML-capable explanatory text, so that I understand why there is no feed content and what I can do next.

flows.name: Retry after partial-feed error
flows.description: As a reader, I want to retry loading more feed content when an error appears after existing cards, so that I can keep the already loaded content and attempt to fetch more.

flows.name: Retry from full-feed error
flows.description: As a reader, I want to retry loading the community feed when an error prevents any content from appearing, so that I can recover from a network or service problem.

flows.name: See initial loading state
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see a loading indicator while the community feed is initially loading, so that I know content is being fetched.

flows.name: See pagination loading state
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see a loading indicator after requesting more community feed content, so that I know the next set of items is being fetched.

flows.name: View community disclaimer
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see a community feed disclaimer at the top of the feed, so that I understand the context of community-provided content before browsing it.

flows.name: View localized date headers
flows.description: As a reader, I want feed sections to be grouped under localized date headers, so that I can understand when each group of feed content belongs.

name: Compose Wiki Error View
description: Reusable Compose error-state view with error icon, HTML-capable message, context-sensitive action button, optional footer details, and retry/back/login/next callbacks.

flows.name: Continue from empty error state
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap Next from an empty-result error state, so that I can continue past unavailable or empty content.

flows.name: Go back from generic error
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap Back from a generic error state when retry is not offered, so that I can return to the previous or main screen.

flows.name: Go back from missing page error
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap Back when a page does not exist, so that I can leave the unavailable page and return to where I came from.

flows.name: Log in from authentication error
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Login or Join Wikipedia action when an error indicates I am not logged in, so that I can authenticate and continue using the feature.

flows.name: Read HTML-formatted error message
flows.description: As a user, I want error messages to render formatted text and links from HTML, so that important emphasis and linked context remain understandable and usable.

flows.name: Retry after offline error
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap Retry when the error says I am offline, so that I can reload the failed content after reconnecting to the internet.

flows.name: Retry after timeout error
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap Retry when Wikipedia cannot be reached due to a timeout, so that I can try loading the content again.

flows.name: Retry generic error
flows.description: As a user, I want a generic error state to offer a Retry action when retrying is appropriate, so that I can attempt the failed operation again without leaving the screen.

flows.name: Understand missing user page error
flows.description: As a user, I want a missing user page error to show the user page link and username details, so that I understand why the user page is unavailable and can verify the user identity.

flows.name: View contextual error state
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error icon and a message that matches the failure type, so that I understand why the screen content cannot be shown.

flows.name: View server-provided error message
flows.description: As a user, I want server-provided API error messages to be displayed when available, so that I can see the specific reason the request failed.

flows.name: View supplemental error details
flows.description: As a user, I want additional non-server exception details to appear below the main error message when available, so that I have more context about what went wrong.

name: Continue reading feed carousel module
description: Compose For You feed carousel module for resuming articles from history or reading lists, using shared ForYouCardContent with continue/bookmark footer, page open, save, share, hide, customize interests, and impression callbacks.

flows.name: Browse continue reading carousel
flows.description: As a user, I want to swipe through multiple continue reading cards, so that I can choose which recent or saved article to resume.

flows.name: Customize feed interests
flows.description: As a user, I want to open interest customization from the continue reading card menu, so that I can adjust the personalization of my For You feed.

flows.name: Dismiss individual card
flows.description: As a user, I want to hide a single continue reading card from the overflow menu, so that I can remove an article recommendation I do not want to see.

flows.name: Hide continue reading module
flows.description: As a user, I want to hide the entire continue reading module from the overflow menu, so that this type of feed content no longer appears in my For You feed.

flows.name: Identify article source
flows.description: As a user, I want each continue reading card to indicate whether it comes from my reading list or reading history, so that I understand why the article is being shown.

flows.name: Open card overflow menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the overflow menu on a continue reading card, so that I can access additional actions for the article or feed module.

flows.name: Open continue reading article
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a continue reading card, so that I can resume reading the selected article from my feed.

flows.name: Record viewed card impression
flows.description: As a user, I want a card to count as viewed only when it is substantially visible, so that feed recommendations and analytics reflect what I actually saw.

flows.name: Save article to reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to save a continue reading article from the card menu, so that I can keep it in my default reading list for later.

flows.name: Share article from card
flows.description: As a user, I want to share a continue reading article from the card menu, so that I can send the article to someone else or another app.

flows.name: Undo dismissed card
flows.description: As a user, I want to undo hiding a continue reading card after dismissing it, so that I can restore the card if I made a mistake.

flows.name: Undo hidden module
flows.description: As a user, I want to undo hiding the continue reading module, so that I can bring the module back if I hid it accidentally.

flows.name: View carousel position
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a page indicator when there are multiple continue reading cards, so that I know my position in the carousel.

name: Create account IP block snackbar
description: Snackbar/error popup shown when account creation fails due to an IP block, with a Details action that opens block-help content in the external browser.

flows.name: Open IP block details help
flows.description: As a user whose IP address is blocked from creating an account, I want to tap the Details action in the snackbar to open block-help content in my external browser, so that I can learn more about the block and what to do next.

flows.name: Show IP block account creation error
flows.description: As a user creating an account from a blocked IP address, I want to see a clear snackbar explaining that my IP address is currently blocked from creating new accounts, so that I understand why account creation cannot continue.

name: Create account email recommendation dialog
description: Non-cancelable Material alert shown when the user tries to create an account without an email address; explains the recommendation and offers actions to create without email or return to the email field.

flows.name: Create account without email
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose to create my account without providing an email address, so that I can continue registration even if I do not want to add an email.

flows.name: Require explicit email decision
flows.description: As a user, I want the email recommendation dialog to stay open until I choose one of its actions, so that I do not accidentally proceed or dismiss the recommendation without deciding.

flows.name: Return to email field
flows.description: As a user, I want to return from the recommendation dialog to the email field, so that I can add an email address before creating my account.

flows.name: Show email recommendation warning
flows.description: As a user creating an account without an email address, I want to see a recommendation explaining why an email is useful, so that I can make an informed choice before continuing.

name: Create account screen
description: Full-screen account registration Activity with toolbar title, username/password/repeat-password/email text fields, inline validation errors, email recommendation copy, Next/Create account submission, login link, privacy/forgot-password/footer links, optional temporary-account notice, hCaptcha disclaimer, embedded captcha challenge, progress indicator, and full-screen WikiErrorView retry/back error state.

flows.name: Cancel account creation with back
flows.description: As a user, I want to go back from the create account screen or cancel an active captcha, so that I can leave the registration flow without creating an account.

flows.name: Check username availability
flows.description: As a new user, I want my chosen username to be checked while I type and to be warned if it is unavailable or blocked, so that I can choose a usable account name.

flows.name: Complete hCaptcha verification
flows.description: As a new user, I want to complete an hCaptcha challenge when required, so that I can continue creating my account securely.

flows.name: Create account without email
flows.description: As a new user, I want to be prompted when I leave email blank and be able to continue creating the account without an email address, so that I can register even if I do not want to provide one.

flows.name: Open forgot password page
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the forgot password link, so that I can recover an existing account instead of creating a new one.

flows.name: Open hCaptcha disclaimer links
flows.description: As a new user, I want to open links in the hCaptcha disclaimer, so that I can review the related privacy and terms information.

flows.name: Open privacy policy
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the privacy policy from the create account screen, so that I can understand how my information will be handled.

flows.name: Open request-account help from captcha
flows.description: As a new user, I want to open the request-account help link shown with the captcha, so that I can learn an alternate way to request an account if needed.

flows.name: Recover from full-screen error
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the full-screen error view's retry or back actions after an account creation error, so that I can dismiss the error and try again or return to the captcha flow.

flows.name: Reload captcha challenge
flows.description: As a new user, I want to request a new captcha image, so that I can complete account creation if the current challenge is unreadable.

flows.name: Return to add email
flows.description: As a new user, I want to choose to add an email when warned that email is recommended, so that I can provide a recovery email before creating my account.

flows.name: See inline form validation
flows.description: As a new user, I want the create account form to show inline errors for invalid usernames, weak passwords, passwords matching my username, mismatched passwords, and invalid email addresses, so that I can correct mistakes before submitting.

flows.name: Show or hide password text
flows.description: As a new user, I want to toggle visibility of the password and repeated password fields, so that I can verify what I typed before creating my account.

flows.name: Solve embedded captcha
flows.description: As a new user, I want to view and answer an embedded captcha challenge when required, so that I can complete account creation after proving I am not automated.

flows.name: Submit registration form
flows.description: As a new user, I want to enter a username, password, repeated password, and optional email and create an account, so that I can start using Wikipedia with a registered account.

flows.name: Switch to login
flows.description: As a user who already has an account, I want to use the login link, so that I can return to sign in instead of creating a new account.

flows.name: View temporary account notice
flows.description: As a temporary account user, I want to see a notice showing my temporary account status on the create account screen, so that I understand which temporary account I am currently using while registering.

name: CreateAccountActivity
description: Account creation surface.

name: CustomDatePicker dialog
description: DialogFragment that presents a custom calendar date picker in a MaterialAlertDialog, with month navigation, selectable day grid, and OK/Cancel actions returning the selected date via callback.

flows.name: Cancel date selection
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the dialog without applying changes, so that I can keep the existing On This Day date.

flows.name: Confirm selected date
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm the selected date with the OK action, so that the On This Day screen loads content for that date.

flows.name: Dismiss dialog without confirming
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the date picker using standard dialog dismissal behavior, so that I can leave date selection without changing the current date.

flows.name: Navigate to next month
flows.description: As a user, I want to move the calendar to the next month, so that I can choose an On This Day date from a later month.

flows.name: Navigate to previous month
flows.description: As a user, I want to move the calendar to the previous month, so that I can choose an On This Day date from an earlier month.

flows.name: Recognize today and selected day
flows.description: As a user, I want today's date and the selected date to be visually distinguished in the calendar, so that I can orient myself and avoid choosing the wrong day.

flows.name: Select a day in month
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a day in the displayed month, so that the dialog updates the selected date that I can apply.

flows.name: View current selected date
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the currently selected On This Day date in the dialog header and month grid, so that I know which date will be applied if I confirm.

name: Customize toolbar item row widget
description: Reusable row used on the customize-toolbar screen; displays a page action title/icon and a drag handle with tooltip/touch listener for reordering.

flows.name: Drag item to reorder
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to drag a toolbar item row using its handle, so that I can change the order of actions in the customize toolbar screen.

flows.name: Get row control feedback
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want the row and drag handle to provide content descriptions and toast feedback, so that I can understand the purpose of the item and reorder handle, including when using accessibility support.

flows.name: Show or hide reorder handle
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want the row to show a drag handle only when reordering is available, so that I understand when an item can be moved and avoid distracting controls otherwise.

flows.name: View toolbar action row
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to see each customizable page action with its icon and localized title, so that I can recognize which toolbar or menu action I am arranging.

name: Customize toolbar screen
description:
Single-fragment activity for rearranging article toolbar and overflow-menu actions.
Presents a RecyclerView with description, Toolbar/Menu headers, draggable action rows, empty placeholders, and a reset-to-default row; saves order changes after drag operations.

flows.name: Identify draggable controls accessibly
flows.description: As a reader using accessibility services, I want action rows and drag handles to expose helpful descriptions, so that I can identify which controls are for toolbar customization and dragging.

flows.name: Keep toolbar within five-item limit
flows.description: As a reader, I want the app to automatically keep no more than five actions in the Toolbar section when I drag extra actions into it, so that the article toolbar remains usable and valid.

flows.name: Move actions between toolbar and menu
flows.description: As a reader, I want to drag article actions between the Toolbar and Menu sections, so that I can choose which actions are immediately available on the toolbar and which remain in the overflow menu.

flows.name: Persist customized action order
flows.description: As a reader, I want my toolbar and menu order changes to be saved after dragging actions, so that my customized article toolbar and overflow menu remain the same when I return later.

flows.name: Reorder overflow menu actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to drag article action rows within the Menu section, so that the overflow menu lists actions in the order I prefer.

flows.name: Reorder toolbar shortcuts
flows.description: As a reader, I want to drag article action rows within the Toolbar section, so that the bottom article toolbar displays my preferred shortcuts in my chosen order.

flows.name: Reset toolbar customization to defaults
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap Reset to default, so that the Toolbar and Menu sections return to the app’s default article action order.

flows.name: Understand customization limit
flows.description: As a reader, I want to read an explanation that the bottom toolbar can be customized with the five shortcuts I find most useful, so that I understand how to configure the screen before rearranging actions.

flows.name: Use empty section placeholder as drop target
flows.description: As a reader, I want an empty Toolbar or Menu section to show a drag-and-drop placeholder, so that I know I can drag favorite actions back into that section.

flows.name: View customizable article actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see my article actions grouped into Toolbar and Menu sections with their icons and names, so that I can understand which shortcuts are currently shown on the article toolbar versus in the overflow menu.

name: CustomizeToolbarActivity
description: Article toolbar customization surface.

name: Description edit bottom article bar widget
description:
Reusable ConstraintLayout shown at the bottom of the description edit UI.
Displays the edited article/image title with language-aware layout direction and optional thumbnail, and is shown/hidden by DescriptionEditView; taps are routed by the host screen to preview the page or image.

name: Description edit license notice widget
description:
Reusable license/anonymous-warning notice for description and caption editing.
Shows different Terms/CC license text depending on description source or image caption mode, exposes clickable links, provides login callback for anonymous warning login link, and supports a dark variant for caption review.

name: Description edit revert help view
description:
Scrollable help content explaining how to revert description edits.
Renders formatted body text with subtitle, intro, history link for a Wikidata Q-number, and bulleted revert reasons with clickable links.

flows.name: Dismiss reverted edit help dialog
flows.description: As a contributor reading the reverted edit help, I want to close the dialog with the OK button, so that I can return to the article page after reviewing the guidance.

flows.name: Open Wikidata edit history
flows.description: As a contributor whose edit was reverted, I want to tap the edit history link for the affected Q-number, so that I can review the Wikidata history and understand the revert context.

flows.name: Open description guidelines
flows.description: As a contributor whose edit was reverted, I want to tap the guidelines link in the revert reason, so that I can learn the rules for writing acceptable Wikidata descriptions.

flows.name: Scroll revert help content
flows.description: As a contributor reading revert guidance, I want to scroll through the help content when it does not fit on screen, so that I can read the full explanation and all revert reasons.

flows.name: View reverted edit explanation
flows.description: As a contributor whose description edit was reverted, I want to see a help dialog explaining that my edit was reverted and listing possible reasons, so that I can understand what may have happened.

name: Description edit screen
description:
Single-fragment activity for adding/translating article descriptions or image captions/tags.
Hosts DescriptionEditFragment and FragmentDescriptionEditBinding/DescriptionEditView, handles back navigation between edit and review modes, launches the first-time tutorial for add-description flows, shows loading/error/save states, supports login, captcha, voice input, machine-generated description suggestions, review-before-save, and post-save success flow.
The bottom article bar can open an image preview bottom sheet for caption tasks or a link preview bottom sheet for article-description tasks.

flows.name: Add article description
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to enter a new short article description, so that I can improve an article that lacks one.

flows.name: Add or edit image caption
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to add or edit an image caption, so that media on Commons has a useful caption for readers.

flows.name: Cancel captcha challenge
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to cancel an active captcha challenge, so that I can return to editing without submitting the challenge.

flows.name: Cancel editing
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to cancel the description or caption edit, so that I can leave the screen without saving changes.

flows.name: Choose machine-generated description
flows.description: As a contributor adding an article description, I want to view and choose a machine-generated suggestion, so that I can quickly start from a proposed description.

flows.name: Edit article description
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to modify an existing article description, so that I can correct or improve the article summary shown to readers.

flows.name: Handle edit errors
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to see errors when loading or saving fails or editing is not allowed, so that I understand why I cannot complete the contribution.

flows.name: Handle save progress and success
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to see that my save is in progress and then be taken to the appropriate success result, so that I know my contribution was submitted.

flows.name: Launch description edit tutorial
flows.description: As a first-time contributor adding an article description, I want to see a tutorial before editing, so that I understand how to add a useful description.

flows.name: Log in from license notice
flows.description: As an anonymous contributor, I want to log in from the review license notice, so that I can submit the contribution under my account.

flows.name: Open learn more help
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to open help about article descriptions or image captions, so that I can learn the contribution guidelines.

flows.name: Open license and terms links
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to open the terms of use and license links shown in the review notice, so that I can understand the legal terms of my contribution.

flows.name: Preserve draft across configuration changes
flows.description: As a contributor, I want my entered text and review mode to be preserved when the screen is recreated, so that I do not lose my in-progress contribution.

flows.name: Preview related article or image
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to open the bottom article or image bar, so that I can review the source article context or image preview while editing.

flows.name: Return from review to editing
flows.description: As a contributor reviewing my contribution, I want to go back to edit mode, so that I can revise the text before submitting.

flows.name: Review contribution before saving
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to review how my description or caption will appear before submitting it, so that I can confirm the contribution is correct.

flows.name: Solve captcha before saving
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to complete a captcha challenge when required, so that my description or caption edit can be submitted.

flows.name: Submit contribution
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to save my reviewed description or caption, so that my contribution is published.

flows.name: Translate article description
flows.description: As a multilingual contributor, I want to translate an article description into the target language, so that readers in that language see an appropriate description.

flows.name: Translate image caption
flows.description: As a multilingual contributor, I want to translate an image caption into another language, so that more readers can understand the image.

flows.name: Use voice input
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to dictate a description or caption with voice input, so that I can enter text more easily.

flows.name: Validate description text
flows.description: As a contributor, I want the screen to warn me about invalid or suspicious description text, so that I can fix issues before saving.

flows.name: View highlighted existing description text
flows.description: As a contributor opening an existing description from a highlighted edit source, I want the relevant text highlighted in the editor, so that I can quickly see what needs attention.

name: Description edit success screen
description:
Transparent single-fragment success surface shown after a description/caption edit is saved.
Displays success messaging with an edit hint icon and a Done button that returns RESULT_OK_FROM_EDIT_SUCCESS and dismisses the activity.

flows.name: Dismiss success screen
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to tap Done on the success screen, so that I can close the confirmation and return to the previous context with the edit marked as successfully completed.

flows.name: Read article editing tip
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to read a did-you-know hint about editing articles in the app, so that I can discover another way to make future contributions.

flows.name: View edit success confirmation
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to see a success confirmation after my description or caption edit is saved, so that I know my contribution was published and improved Wikipedia for others.

name: Description edit tutorial onboarding
description:
Single-fragment onboarding flow for suggested description editing.
Uses a ViewPager-backed onboarding fragment with two or three pages depending on whether AI onboarding should be shown, custom Start editing done button, per-page onboarding layouts, optional hiding of tertiary text, and analytics when the AI page is displayed.

flows.name: Go back to previous tutorial page
flows.description: As a contributor, I want the back action to return me to the previous onboarding page when I am not on the first page, so that I can review earlier tutorial information without leaving the flow.

flows.name: Move forward through tutorial
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to continue or swipe forward through the onboarding pages, so that I can progress through the tutorial at my own pace.

flows.name: Skip tutorial
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to skip the description editing tutorial before the last page, so that I can leave onboarding and proceed without reading every page.

flows.name: Start editing from tutorial
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to tap Start editing on the final onboarding page, so that I can complete the tutorial and begin editing article descriptions.

flows.name: Track tutorial position
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to see and have accessible feedback for which onboarding page I am on, so that I know my progress through the tutorial.

flows.name: View description editing introduction
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to view the description editing onboarding pages, so that I understand what article descriptions are and how to keep them short before editing.

flows.name: View machine suggestion guidance
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to see the optional machine suggestions onboarding page when it is available, so that I understand that suggested descriptions are machine generated rather than written by volunteers or the Wikimedia Foundation.

name: Description/caption edit review widget
description:
Embedded review UI used before publishing a description or image caption.
For article descriptions it shows title, proposed subtitle, extract, optional thumbnail, and license notice; for caption review it switches to a dark gallery layout with image, caption text, and dark license notice.

flows.name: Hide anonymous warning after login
flows.description: As a logged-in contributor, I want the anonymous IP attribution warning to be hidden in the review notice, so that I only see warnings relevant to my signed-in publishing state.

flows.name: Log in from anonymous warning
flows.description: As an anonymous contributor, I want to use the log in link in the privacy warning, so that my edit can be associated with my account instead of my device IP address.

flows.name: Open license and terms links
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to open the Terms of Use and Creative Commons license links from the review notice, so that I can read the legal terms before deciding to publish.

flows.name: Review article description before publishing
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to review the article title, my proposed description, the article extract, and any available thumbnail before publishing, so that I can confirm the description will appear in the right article context.

flows.name: Review article description without thumbnail
flows.description: As a contributor, I want the description review to still show the title, proposed description, and a longer extract when no thumbnail is available, so that I can review my change even for articles without images.

flows.name: Review image caption in gallery layout
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to review my proposed image caption over the image in a dark gallery-style layout, so that I can verify the caption matches the image before publishing.

flows.name: Review right-to-left or language-specific content direction
flows.description: As a multilingual contributor, I want the review content to follow the article or caption language direction, so that titles, descriptions, extracts, and captions are readable in their correct script direction.

flows.name: Select caption text during review
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to select the caption text in the image caption review, so that I can inspect or copy the exact text I am about to publish.

flows.name: View publishing license notice
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to see the correct publishing license notice for an article description, existing-description edit, local-description wiki, or image caption, so that I understand the terms that apply before I publish.

name: Description/caption edit view
description:
Reusable full edit surface for adding, editing, or translating article descriptions and image captions.
Includes toolbar header with save/cancel, text input with validation, voice input icon, article summary/read-article bar, learn-more link, captcha container, loading save state, AI suggested-description chip with tooltip and suggestion dialog launch, and transitions into an embedded review state.

flows.name: Cancel captcha challenge
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to cancel an active captcha challenge, so that I can return to the edit flow without submitting the captcha.

flows.name: Cancel editing
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to cancel or go back from the edit screen, so that I can leave without submitting my changes.

flows.name: Complete captcha challenge
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to complete a captcha challenge when required by the wiki, so that I can continue submitting my edit.

flows.name: Enter or edit description/caption
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to type or change an article description or image caption in the edit field, so that I can prepare the text I want to contribute.

flows.name: Learn about AI suggestion chip
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to see a one-time tooltip explaining the suggested-description chip, so that I understand what the AI suggestion control does.

flows.name: Log in from anonymous warning
flows.description: As an anonymous contributor, I want to tap the login link in the review warning, so that I can sign in before submitting my edit.

flows.name: Open learn more help
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to open a learn-more link for descriptions or captions, so that I can understand what makes a good contribution.

flows.name: Open license and terms links
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to tap links in the license notice, so that I can read the terms of use and licensing details before submitting.

flows.name: Preview source article or image context
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to tap the article summary or read-article bar to preview the related article or image, so that I can review the context before writing or saving my text.

flows.name: Recover draft and review state
flows.description: As a contributor, I want my current text and whether I am reviewing to be restored after the screen is recreated, so that I do not lose progress during configuration changes.

flows.name: Return from review to editing
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to cancel or go back from the review state to the edit state, so that I can revise my contribution before submitting it.

flows.name: Review contribution before final submit
flows.description: As a contributor, I want saving from the edit form to show an embedded review screen with my proposed description or caption in context, so that I can verify it before final submission.

flows.name: Save only valid changes
flows.description: As a contributor, I want the save action to become available only after I enter a valid change, so that unchanged or invalid contributions cannot be submitted accidentally.

flows.name: See AI suggestion loading and unavailability
flows.description: As a contributor, I want the suggested-description chip to show loading progress and hide when suggestions are unavailable or inappropriate, so that I understand whether AI suggestions can be used for this article.

flows.name: See license and anonymous warning
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to see the applicable license notice and anonymous editing warning during review, so that I understand the terms and privacy impact before submitting.

flows.name: See loading and disabled edit states
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to see progress indicators and disabled controls while the screen loads context or saves my contribution, so that I know the app is working and do not submit duplicate edits.

flows.name: See save or load errors
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to see errors when loading context, requesting suggestions, or saving fails, so that I know the contribution did not complete and can try again or fix the issue.

flows.name: See save success outcome
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to see the appropriate success flow after my edit is saved, so that I know my contribution was accepted and can return to the previous task.

flows.name: Submit reviewed contribution
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to save from the review state, so that my description or caption is posted to the appropriate wiki.

flows.name: Use AI suggested description
flows.description: As a contributor adding a description, I want to open the suggested-description chip and choose a machine-generated suggestion, so that I can quickly populate the description field with a proposed description.

flows.name: Use voice input
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to dictate a description or caption using voice input when available, so that I can fill the edit field without typing.

flows.name: Validate entered text
flows.description: As a contributor, I want the edit view to validate my description or caption and show errors or warnings for invalid, too short, too long, punctuated, article-prefixed, lowercase, or wrong-language text, so that I can correct the contribution before saving.

flows.name: View edit tutorial on first add-description use
flows.description: As a first-time description contributor, I want the description editing tutorial to open before I add a description, so that I understand how to make a good edit.

name: DescriptionEditActivity
description: Wikidata/page description editing surface.

name: DescriptionEditSuccessActivity
description: Fullscreen translucent success surface after description edits.

name: DescriptionEditTutorialActivity
description: Tutorial/onboarding surface for description editing.

name: Developer Error Alert Dialog
description: Generic Material alert dialog used by developer preference test operations to display caught exception messages with an OK action.

flows.name: Dismiss developer error alert
flows.description: As a developer user, I want to acknowledge and dismiss the developer error alert with the OK action, so that I can return to the developer preferences screen after reviewing the exception message.

flows.name: View developer operation error
flows.description: As a developer user, I want to see the exception message from a failed developer preference operation in an alert dialog, so that I can understand what went wrong during the test operation.

name: Developer Missing Description Test Dialog
description: Developer-only Material alert dialog showing a suggested article's title and extract for missing-description testing, with Go and Cancel actions.

flows.name: Acknowledge missing-description fetch error
flows.description: As a developer, I want to see and acknowledge an error message if fetching a missing-description article fails, so that I understand why the test dialog could not be shown.

flows.name: Cancel suggested article dialog
flows.description: As a developer, I want to cancel the missing-description test dialog, so that I can dismiss the suggestion without navigating away from developer settings.

flows.name: Fetch missing-description article suggestion
flows.description: As a developer, I want to request a random article that has no description in the current app language and view its title and extract in a dialog, so that I can test missing-description workflows with real article data.

flows.name: Fetch second-language missing-description suggestion
flows.description: As a developer, I want to request an article that has a description in the current app language but is missing one in the second app language and view its target article title and extract in a dialog, so that I can test description translation scenarios.

flows.name: Open suggested article
flows.description: As a developer, I want to tap Go in the missing-description test dialog, so that I can open the suggested article in a new page tab for further inspection or testing.

name: Developer Settings
description:
Developer/debug settings preference screen hosted by DeveloperSettingsActivity/DeveloperSettingsFragment.
Includes a searchable preferences list for test data, notifications, remote config/dev feature toggles, playground launches, simulators, and other debugging controls.

flows.name: Add malformed reading-list pages
flows.description: As a developer, I want to add malformed pages to the default reading list, so that I can test reading-list error handling.

flows.name: Configure API endpoints
flows.description: As a developer, I want to override RESTBase and MediaWiki endpoint settings, so that I can test the app against production, beta, labs, or local services.

flows.name: Configure Activity tab flags
flows.description: As a developer, I want to toggle Activity tab onboarding and game stats snackbar state, so that I can retest Activity tab first-use behaviors.

flows.name: Configure On This Day game state
flows.description: As a developer, I want to edit On This Day game dialog, date, question count, history, and first-played flags, so that I can test game scenarios.

flows.name: Configure Year in Review state
flows.description: As a developer, I want to edit Year in Review visited state, survey state, and experiment group, so that I can test Year in Review flows.

flows.name: Configure announcement testing
flows.description: As a developer, I want to override announcement country, URLs, timing, date, version, and debug flags, so that I can test announcement behavior under controlled conditions.

flows.name: Configure donation test state
flows.description: As a developer, I want to enable donation test environment mode and edit donation result data, so that I can test donation-related experiments and surveys.

flows.name: Configure hybrid search flags
flows.description: As a developer, I want to set hybrid search experiment group and toggle onboarding and enabled flags, so that I can test hybrid search variants.

flows.name: Configure logging and analytics intake
flows.description: As a developer, I want to change network log level, session timeout, app channel, event platform intake endpoint, and event queue size, so that I can debug logging and analytics behavior.

flows.name: Configure new Explore feed state
flows.description: As a developer, I want to toggle new Explore feed prompt flags and choose the home feed preference selection, so that I can test feed onboarding and selection behavior.

flows.name: Configure onboarding and tooltip flags
flows.description: As a developer, I want to toggle onboarding prompts, tutorials, sync reminders, tooltips, and first-run counters, so that I can re-test first-time user experiences.

flows.name: Configure reading-list sharing flags
flows.description: As a developer, I want to toggle reading-list URL shortening and share tooltip state, so that I can test reading-list sharing flows.

flows.name: Configure recommended reading-list notifications
flows.description: As a developer, I want to enable recommended reading lists, set onboarding state, choose a notification frequency, and simulate the notification, so that I can test recommended reading-list notifications.

flows.name: Configure suggested-edits state
flows.description: As a developer, I want to edit suggested-edits pause dates, revert counts, contribution count overrides, onboarding flags, and feedback flags, so that I can reproduce suggested-edits scenarios.

flows.name: Create test reading lists
flows.description: As a developer, I want to create a chosen number of reading lists with sample articles, so that I can test reading-list behavior at scale.

flows.name: Create test reading-list articles
flows.description: As a developer, I want to add a chosen number of test articles to a reading list, so that I can populate reading-list data for testing.

flows.name: Delete generated reading lists
flows.description: As a developer, I want to delete a chosen number of generated reading lists, so that I can clean up test reading-list data.

flows.name: Edit donation reminder experiment values
flows.description: As a developer, I want to edit donation reminder configuration and experiment group, so that I can test donation reminder variants after restart.

flows.name: Edit miscellaneous app state flags
flows.description: As a developer, I want to manually edit miscellaneous stored app values such as language state, install IDs, visited page state, toolbar order, notification fields, login flags, and daily task timestamps, so that I can reproduce specific app states.

flows.name: Enable memory leak testing
flows.description: As a developer, I want to enable the memory leak test setting, so that I can initialize leak detection while debugging.

flows.name: Fetch cross-language missing-description article
flows.description: As a developer, I want to fetch and preview an article that has a description in the current language but not the second app language and optionally open it, so that I can test multilingual description workflows.

flows.name: Fetch missing-description article
flows.description: As a developer, I want to fetch and preview a random article missing a description in the current language and optionally open it, so that I can test suggested edit description flows.

flows.name: Launch category playground
flows.description: As a developer, I want to open the category playground from developer settings, so that I can test category-related UI in an isolated environment.

flows.name: Open reading challenge widget playground
flows.description: As a developer, I want to open the reading challenge widget configuration playground when available, so that I can test widget configuration UI.

flows.name: Reset On This Day notification state
flows.description: As a developer, I want to reset the On This Day notification state and cancel the daily notification, so that I can retest notification eligibility.

flows.name: Reset donation reminder configuration
flows.description: As a developer, I want to reset donation reminder configuration or clear the last prompt seen date, so that I can retest donation reminder prompts from an earlier state.

flows.name: Reset shown announcements
flows.description: As a developer, I want to clear the record of already shown announcement dialogs, so that I can re-test announcement display flows.

flows.name: Reset stored Places location
flows.description: As a developer, I want to clear the stored Places location and zoom level, so that I can test Places startup behavior without previous location state.

flows.name: Reset talk topics unread state
flows.description: As a developer, I want to clear all seen talk page topics, so that I can test unread talk topic behavior from a clean state.

flows.name: Search developer settings
flows.description: As a developer, I want to search the developer settings list from the toolbar, so that I can quickly find a specific diagnostic preference.

flows.name: Show On This Day notification
flows.description: As a developer, I want to manually show the On This Day game notification, so that I can test notification presentation and behavior.

flows.name: Simulate suggested-edits reactivation notifications
flows.description: As a developer, I want to enable reactivation notification testing and manually show stage one or stage two notifications, so that I can verify suggested-edits re-engagement behavior.

flows.name: Trigger test crash
flows.description: As a developer, I want to deliberately crash the app from developer settings, so that I can verify crash reporting and recovery behavior.

name: Developer Settings Search Action Mode
description: Contextual toolbar/search UI on the Developer Settings screen for filtering developer preferences by title or summary.

flows.name: Clear search query
flows.description: As a developer settings user, I want to clear the text in the search field, so that I can remove the current filter and start a new search.

flows.name: Exit search and restore full preferences
flows.description: As a developer settings user, I want to close the contextual search mode, so that I can return to the complete unfiltered developer settings list.

flows.name: Filter preferences by title or summary
flows.description: As a developer settings user, I want to type a search query and filter preferences by matching title or summary text, so that I can locate the relevant setting without scrolling through the full list.

flows.name: Hide empty preference categories during search
flows.description: As a developer settings user, I want preference categories with no matching settings to be hidden while searching, so that the filtered results only show relevant sections.

flows.name: Open developer preferences search
flows.description: As a developer settings user, I want to tap the search action in the toolbar to open a contextual search field, so that I can quickly find developer preferences.

flows.name: Search without case or whitespace sensitivity
flows.description: As a developer settings user, I want search matching to ignore letter case and surrounding spaces in my query, so that small typing differences do not prevent me from finding preferences.

name: Developer preferences
description: Developer settings PreferenceScreen containing diagnostic and test categories for announcements, RESTBase/MediaWiki endpoints, logging/event platform, miscellaneous flags, onboarding state, reading lists, suggested edits, surveys/tests, On This Day game, recommended reading list, playground, Year in Review, donation reminders, Activity tab, Hybrid Search, widgets, and new Explore Feed.

name: DeveloperSettingsActivity
description: Developer settings UI surface.

name: Did you know detail screen
description: Compose activity screen launched from the feed to show the full Did You Know list in a scaffold with top app bar/back navigation; each HTML fact row can open linked pages.

flows.name: Navigate back from Did You Know detail
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the top app bar back button, so that I can return to the previous feed screen when I am done browsing Did You Know facts.

flows.name: Open linked article from fact
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a linked article inside a Did You Know fact, so that I can open and read the related Wikipedia article in a new tab.

flows.name: Scroll through Did You Know facts
flows.description: As a reader, I want to scroll through the Did You Know facts, so that I can read facts that do not fit on the screen at once.

flows.name: View full Did You Know list
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view the full list of Did You Know facts from the feed, so that I can browse all available facts in one dedicated screen.

name: Did you know feed module
description: Compose home/community feed module showing up to three Did You Know fact rows, link handling to article pages, a More footer button opening the detail screen, and hide-card/module controls.

flows.name: Dismiss did you know card
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the Did You Know module overflow menu to dismiss the current card, so that this specific card is removed from my feed.

flows.name: Hide did you know module
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the Did You Know module overflow menu to hide the entire module type, so that Did You Know cards no longer appear in my feed.

flows.name: Open linked article from fact
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a linked article inside a Did You Know fact, so that I can open and read the related Wikipedia article.

flows.name: Open more did you know facts
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the More button in the Did You Know feed module, so that I can open the full Did You Know detail screen with the complete list of facts.

flows.name: View did you know facts
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view a Did You Know feed module with its title, subtitle, and up to three fact rows, so that I can quickly discover interesting Wikipedia facts from my home feed.

name: DidYouKnowActivity
description: Did You Know feed/card surface.

name: Disable Year in Review Confirmation Dialog
description: Material alert dialog displayed from Settings when turning off Year in Review, with disable and cancel actions.

flows.name: Cancel disabling Year in Review
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to cancel the Year in Review disable confirmation, so that Year in Review remains enabled and my personalized insights are kept.

flows.name: Confirm disabling Year in Review
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to confirm that I am sure about turning off Year in Review, so that the feature is hidden and my stored personalized Year in Review insights are cleared.

flows.name: Dismiss disable confirmation without changes
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to dismiss the disable confirmation without choosing to turn off Year in Review, so that I can leave the setting unchanged if I opened the dialog by mistake.

name: Donate bottom sheet
description:
Extended bottom sheet donation UI.
Initially shows loading while Google Pay availability is checked, then displays donation content with Google Pay and other payment method buttons; can adapt to donation reminder mode with a prefilled amount, different Google Pay amount, hidden GPay header, external donate link fallback, and error message feedback.

flows.name: Dismiss donation bottom sheet
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the donation bottom sheet without donating, so that I can return to what I was doing.

flows.name: Donate reminder amount with Google Pay
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to donate the reminder's prefilled amount with Google Pay, so that I can quickly complete the suggested donation.

flows.name: Donate reminder different amount with Google Pay
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to choose a different Google Pay amount, so that I can donate an amount other than the reminder's suggested amount.

flows.name: Donate with Google Pay
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose Google Pay from the donation bottom sheet, so that I can continue donating with Google Pay in the app.

flows.name: Donate with another payment method
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose another payment method, so that I can complete my donation through the external Wikimedia donation page.

flows.name: Donation reminder other payment method
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to choose another payment method, so that I can complete my reminder donation through the external donation page instead of Google Pay.

flows.name: Fallback to external donation when Google Pay is unavailable
flows.description: As a user, I want to be taken directly to the external donation page when Google Pay is unavailable, so that I can still donate using another supported payment method.

flows.name: See Google Pay availability error feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error message if checking Google Pay availability fails, so that I understand why donation options could not be shown normally.

flows.name: View donation options after availability check
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a loading state while Google Pay availability is checked and then view available donation options, so that I know when I can choose a payment method.

name: Donation Reminder Card Widget
description:
Reusable legacy View card prompting the user about a donation reminder.
Displays a title with heart icon, message body, and positive/negative Material text buttons inside a WikiCardView-styled container.

flows.name: Dismiss donation reminder for now
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the negative button on the donation reminder card, so that I can hide the reminder, dismiss that reminder instance, and continue reading without donating immediately.

flows.name: Modify reminder after dismissal
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the snackbar action shown after dismissing the donation reminder, so that I can adjust my donation reminder settings if I do not want the current reminder behavior.

flows.name: Start donation from reminder
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the positive button on the donation reminder card, so that I can begin the donation flow from the reminder and stop seeing that reminder instance.

flows.name: View donation reminder prompt
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see a donation reminder card with a heart-marked title, reminder message, and action buttons when I reach my configured reminder milestone, so that I can understand why I am being prompted to donate.

name: Donation Reminder Custom Input Dialog
description:
Modal Compose dialog for entering a custom read frequency or custom donation amount.
Contains centered title, focused numeric outlined text field with optional currency prefix or articles suffix, validation error/supporting text and error icon, plus a Done action.

flows.name: Dismiss custom input dialog
flows.description: As a donor configuring a reminder, I want to dismiss the custom input dialog without saving the entered value, so that I can return to the reminder settings unchanged.

flows.name: Enter custom donation amount
flows.description: As a donor configuring a reminder, I want to enter a custom donation amount with the currency prefix shown in the dialog, so that I can choose the amount I intend to donate later.

flows.name: Enter custom read frequency
flows.description: As a donor configuring a reminder, I want to enter a custom number of articles in the read frequency dialog, so that I can choose when I am reminded based on my own reading milestone.

flows.name: Submit custom donation amount
flows.description: As a donor configuring a reminder, I want to confirm a valid custom donation amount with the Done action or keyboard send action, so that the reminder uses my custom amount and the dialog closes.

flows.name: Submit custom read frequency
flows.description: As a donor configuring a reminder, I want to confirm a valid custom read frequency with the Done action or keyboard send action, so that the reminder uses my custom article count and the dialog closes.

flows.name: Validate custom donation amount
flows.description: As a donor configuring a reminder, I want the dialog to show an error when my custom donation amount is below the minimum or at or above the maximum, so that I can enter an acceptable donation amount before saving it.

flows.name: Validate custom read frequency
flows.description: As a donor configuring a reminder, I want the dialog to show an error when my custom article frequency is outside the allowed range, so that I can correct the value before saving it.

name: Donation Reminder Info Tooltip
description: Plain tooltip popup shown from the info icon beside article frequency, explaining the frequency setting on the donation reminder screen.

flows.name: Dismiss article frequency info tooltip
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want the article frequency info tooltip to go away after I finish viewing it, so that I can return to configuring my reminder without the popup obscuring the screen.

flows.name: View article frequency info tooltip
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to tap the info icon beside the article frequency setting, so that I can understand that the article count used for reminders is stored locally on my device.

name: Donation Reminder Option Selector Dropdowns
description:
Dropdown popup surfaces for selecting preset article frequency and preset donation amount values, including a custom option.
Rendered from disabled text fields with trailing dropdown arrows within the donation reminder configuration screen.

flows.name: Dismiss article frequency dropdown
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to dismiss the article frequency dropdown without selecting an option, so that I can keep my current reminder frequency unchanged.

flows.name: Dismiss custom article frequency input
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to dismiss the custom article frequency dialog, so that I can cancel entering a custom frequency and keep the existing value.

flows.name: Dismiss custom donation amount input
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to dismiss the custom donation amount dialog, so that I can cancel entering a custom amount and keep the existing value.

flows.name: Dismiss donation amount dropdown
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to dismiss the donation amount dropdown without selecting an option, so that I can keep my current donation amount unchanged.

flows.name: Open article frequency dropdown
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to open the article frequency selector from the disabled text field, so that I can see the available reminder frequency options.

flows.name: Open custom article frequency input
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to choose the custom option from the article frequency dropdown, so that I can enter a reminder frequency that is not one of the presets.

flows.name: Open custom donation amount input
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to choose the custom option from the donation amount dropdown, so that I can enter a donation amount that is not one of the presets.

flows.name: Open donation amount dropdown
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to open the donation amount selector from the disabled text field, so that I can see the available donation amount options.

flows.name: Save custom article frequency
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to enter and save a valid custom article frequency, so that my reminder uses my preferred number of articles read.

flows.name: Save custom donation amount
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to enter and save a valid custom donation amount, so that my reminder uses my preferred donation amount.

flows.name: Select preset article frequency
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to choose a preset article frequency from the dropdown, so that my reminder can be scheduled after that number of articles read.

flows.name: Select preset donation amount
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to choose a preset donation amount from the dropdown, so that the reminder uses that amount for my future donation.

flows.name: Validate custom article frequency limits
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to see an error when my custom article frequency is outside the allowed range, so that I can correct it before saving.

flows.name: Validate custom donation amount limits
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to see an error when my custom donation amount is below the minimum or above the maximum allowed amount, so that I can correct it before saving.

flows.name: View article frequency help
flows.description: As a donation reminder user, I want to open the article frequency info tooltip, so that I can understand what the frequency selector means.

name: Donation Reminder Overflow Menu
description:
Dropdown popup opened from the settings screen overflow icon.
Presents menu items such as Learn more and Report/problem with feature, each with leading icons and actions to open experiment information or compose a feedback email.

flows.name: Dismiss overflow menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the donation reminder overflow menu without choosing an item, so that I can return to the donation reminder settings unchanged.

flows.name: Learn more about experiment
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose Learn more from the overflow menu, so that I can open information about the customizable donation reminder experiment in an external browser.

flows.name: Open overflow menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the donation reminder overflow menu from the settings app bar, so that I can access additional actions for the donation reminder experiment.

flows.name: Report feature problem
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose Problem with feature from the overflow menu, so that I can compose a prefilled feedback email reporting an issue with donation reminders.

name: Donation Reminder Settings Screen
description:
Full-screen Compose Activity for configuring donation reminders.
Shows an app bar with back and overflow actions, loading/error states, thank-you header, optional enable/disable switch when opened from settings, read-frequency and donation-amount selectors, confirm/no-thanks/about-experiment footer actions, and saves reminder settings through DonationReminderViewModel.

flows.name: Auto-save changed settings on exit
flows.description: As a user, I want changed reminder settings to be saved when I leave the settings screen, so that my updated donation amount or reading frequency is not lost.

flows.name: Choose preset donation amount
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose a preset donation amount for reminders, so that the reminder uses an amount I am comfortable donating.

flows.name: Choose preset reading frequency
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose a preset number of articles to read before being reminded, so that the reminder appears at a convenient reading milestone.

flows.name: Confirm donation reminder setup
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm my donation reminder choices, so that the app saves my reminder settings and enables future reminders.

flows.name: Decline donation reminder setup
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose no thanks when prompted to configure donation reminders, so that I can dismiss setup without enabling a reminder.

flows.name: Disable donation reminders from settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn donation reminders off from settings, so that I stop receiving donation reminder prompts.

flows.name: Dismiss loading error
flows.description: As a user, I want to go back from the donation reminder error state, so that I am not stuck on a screen that failed to load.

flows.name: Enable donation reminders from settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn donation reminders on from settings, so that the app can remind me to donate after my chosen reading milestone.

flows.name: Enter custom donation amount
flows.description: As a user, I want to enter a custom donation amount, so that my reminder is configured with the amount I prefer.

flows.name: Enter custom reading frequency
flows.description: As a user, I want to enter a custom article frequency for donation reminders, so that the reminder cadence matches my reading habits.

flows.name: Go back from donation reminder settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to leave the donation reminder settings screen using the back action, so that I can return to where I came from without making further changes.

flows.name: Learn more about donation reminders
flows.description: As a user, I want to open more information about the donation reminders experiment, so that I can understand why this feature is being offered.

flows.name: Open experiment information from footer
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the about-experiment link from the settings footer, so that I can learn about the donation reminders experiment from the settings entry point.

flows.name: Open overflow menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the overflow menu, so that I can access additional donation reminder information and support actions.

flows.name: Report a problem with donation reminders
flows.description: As a user, I want to report a problem with the donation reminders feature by email, so that I can provide feedback or get help.

flows.name: Retry after loading error
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry loading donation reminder settings when an error is shown, so that I can recover from a temporary failure and configure my reminder.

flows.name: Validate custom donation amount
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error when my custom donation amount is below the minimum or above the maximum, so that I can enter an acceptable amount before saving.

flows.name: Validate custom reading frequency
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error when my custom article frequency is outside the allowed range, so that I can correct it before saving the reminder setting.

flows.name: View reading frequency explanation
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the information icon next to the article frequency setting, so that I can understand how the reading milestone works.

name: DonationReminderActivity
description: Donation reminder surface.

name: Edit Notices Dialog
description: Material AlertDialog showing a list of edit notices for a wiki site, with clickable notice links, a close button, and a checkbox controlling whether edit notices are shown automatically.

flows.name: Close edit notices dialog
flows.description: As an editor, I want to close the edit notices dialog when I am done reading it, so that I can return to editing.

flows.name: Open notice links
flows.description: As an editor, I want to tap links embedded in edit notices, so that I can open related policy or help pages in an external browser.

flows.name: Read edit notices
flows.description: As an editor, I want to view and scroll through the edit notices for the current wiki site or article, so that I can understand important guidance before editing.

flows.name: Toggle automatic edit notices
flows.description: As an editor, I want to enable or disable showing edit notices automatically, so that I can control whether this dialog appears by default in future editing sessions.

name: Edit Section Screen
description:
Full-screen article/source editor for editing a page section or full article.
Shows a toolbar with Next/Save, theme, find, edit notices, and temporary-account actions; a syntax-highlightable wikitext editor with optional line numbers and custom keyboard overlays; loading/error/captcha states; transitions into preview and edit-summary fragments; launches insert-media, template search, link search, login, theme chooser, edit notices, and link preview flows; includes confirmation and retry/error dialogs for abandon/edit-conflict/save failure/temp-account/talk-source prompts.

flows.name: Acknowledge talk-source prompt
flows.description: As an editor of a talk page source, I want to see and acknowledge talk-page editing guidance, so that I understand source editing expectations for discussions.

flows.name: Add edit summary
flows.description: As an editor, I want to enter an edit summary before saving, so that other readers and editors understand what I changed.

flows.name: Apply editing preferences
flows.description: As an editor, I want syntax highlighting, typing suggestions, monospace font, text size, and line number preferences to apply in the editor, so that the source editor matches my preferred editing environment.

flows.name: Auto-see edit notices guidance
