flows.description: As an editor, I want edit notices to appear automatically or be introduced with a tooltip based on my preferences, so that I am alerted to important page guidance without having to discover it manually.

flows.name: Cancel failed-save retry dialog
flows.description: As an editor, I want to dismiss a failed-save retry dialog, so that I can review or change my edit before trying again.

flows.name: Cancel recommended image insertion
flows.description: As an editor in the image recommendation workflow, I want canceling image insertion to exit the editor, so that I return without making a recommended image edit.

flows.name: Change editing appearance
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open editing theme and font options, so that I can adjust the editor appearance for comfortable editing.

flows.name: Collapse keyboard syntax overlays
flows.description: As an editor, I want to close formatting and heading overlays, so that I can return to the main editing keyboard controls.

flows.name: Complete captcha challenge
flows.description: As an editor, I want to complete a captcha challenge after a save attempt, so that I can resubmit an edit that requires verification.

flows.name: Confirm leaving from preview links
flows.description: As an editor, I want to be warned before opening links from the preview, so that I do not accidentally leave the edit workflow with unsaved changes.

flows.name: Continue image recommendation workflow
flows.description: As an editor adding a recommended image, I want the editor to launch image insertion immediately and continue to preview after insertion, so that I can review the recommended image addition efficiently.

flows.name: Dictate edit summary
flows.description: As an editor, I want to use voice input for the edit summary, so that I can enter the summary hands-free.

flows.name: Discard unsaved edits
flows.description: As an editor with unsaved changes, I want to confirm before discarding my edits, so that I do not lose work accidentally.

flows.name: Dismiss temporary-account prompt
flows.description: As an anonymous or temporary-account editor, I want to dismiss the account attribution prompt, so that I can continue editing with the current account state.

flows.name: Do not show talk-source prompt again
flows.description: As an editor of a talk page source, I want to opt out of future talk-source prompts, so that I am not repeatedly shown guidance I already understand.

flows.name: Edit wikitext content
flows.description: As an editor, I want to edit the article or section wikitext directly, so that I can update page content.

flows.name: Exit when no unsaved changes
flows.description: As an editor, I want to leave the editor without confirmation when I have not changed anything, so that navigation remains quick.

flows.name: Find within editor
flows.description: As an editor, I want to search within the wikitext and move between matches, so that I can locate text in a long source document.

flows.name: Format selected text
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove common text formatting such as bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, superscript, subscript, big, small, or code, so that I can format content using wikitext shortcuts.

flows.name: Go back from load error
flows.description: As an editor, I want to leave the editor from the loading error state, so that I am not stuck on a failed edit screen.

flows.name: Handle unavailable voice input
flows.description: As an editor, I want to receive feedback when voice input is unavailable, so that I understand why dictation cannot be used.

flows.name: Highlight selected source text
flows.description: As an editor opening source from selected article text, I want the matching wikitext to be highlighted, so that I can quickly find the passage I intended to edit.

flows.name: Insert heading markup
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove heading levels 2 through 5, so that I can structure page sections from the editor keyboard.

flows.name: Insert internal link
flows.description: As an editor, I want to wrap selected text as a wiki link or search for a page to insert as a link, so that I can add internal links accurately.

flows.name: Insert lists
flows.description: As an editor, I want to insert bulleted or numbered list syntax, so that I can format lists in the article source.

flows.name: Insert media
flows.description: As an editor, I want to launch the media insertion flow and insert the resulting image markup into the wikitext, so that I can add media to the page.

flows.name: Insert reference tags
flows.description: As an editor, I want to wrap selected text or place my cursor inside reference tags, so that I can add citations in wikitext.

flows.name: Insert template
flows.description: As an editor, I want to search for and insert a template into the wikitext, so that I can add structured wiki markup without typing it manually.

flows.name: Keep editing after abandon prompt
flows.description: As an editor with unsaved changes, I want to cancel the abandon confirmation, so that I can continue editing without losing work.

flows.name: Learn about edit summaries
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open help about edit summaries, so that I can write better summaries.

flows.name: Learn about minor edits
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open help about minor edits, so that I understand when to mark an edit as minor.

flows.name: Learn about watching pages
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open help about watching pages, so that I understand the watchlist option before saving.

flows.name: Load editable wikitext
flows.description: As an editor, I want to load the current wikitext for a section or full article, so that I can make changes from the latest revision.

flows.name: Log in or create account from temp-account prompt
flows.description: As an anonymous or temporary-account editor, I want to log in or create an account from the account prompt, so that I can edit under an account instead of anonymously or temporarily.

flows.name: Mark edit as minor
flows.description: As a logged-in editor, I want to mark my edit as minor, so that the saved revision is categorized appropriately.

flows.name: Open license links
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open terms and license links shown in the edit flow, so that I can review the conditions for submitting edits.

flows.name: Open link preview page
flows.description: As an editor viewing a link preview, I want to open the linked page after confirming if I have unsaved changes, so that I can navigate to relevant content intentionally.

flows.name: Open references in preview
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open references shown in the preview, so that I can inspect citation details before saving.

flows.name: Prevent navigation during requests
flows.description: As an editor, I want back navigation to be ignored while a loading or save request is in progress, so that the edit operation is not interrupted in an unsafe state.

flows.name: Preview edited wikitext
flows.description: As an editor, I want to preview my edited wikitext before saving, so that I can verify how my changes will render.

flows.name: Preview link from wikitext
flows.description: As an editor, I want to preview an internal link found in or around my selection, so that I can verify the linked page without manually leaving the editor.

flows.name: Recover from edit conflict
flows.description: As an editor, I want to be notified of an edit conflict and returned to the edit flow start, so that I can resolve the conflict safely.

flows.name: Restore draft after recreation
flows.description: As an editor, I want my in-progress wikitext to be restored after the screen is recreated, so that I do not lose edits during configuration changes.

flows.name: Resume editing after link preview
flows.description: As an editor dismissing a link preview, I want focus and the keyboard to return to the editor, so that I can continue editing quickly.

flows.name: Retry failed edit load
flows.description: As an editor, I want to retry loading the editor after an error, so that I can continue editing when the problem is temporary.

flows.name: Retry failed save
flows.description: As an editor, I want to retry saving after a save failure, so that a temporary problem does not force me to abandon my changes.

flows.name: Return from preview to editor
flows.description: As an editor, I want to go back from preview to the source editor, so that I can revise my changes before continuing.

flows.name: Return from summary to preview
flows.description: As an editor, I want to go back from the edit summary step to preview, so that I can recheck the rendered changes before saving.

flows.name: Review temporary-account status
flows.description: As an anonymous or temporary-account editor, I want to view my editing account status from the toolbar, so that I understand how my edit will be attributed.

flows.name: Save edited page
flows.description: As an editor, I want to submit my edited wikitext with summary, minor-edit, and watchlist choices, so that my changes are published to the wiki.

flows.name: Set watchlist preference for saved edit
flows.description: As a logged-in editor, I want to choose whether to watch the page when saving, so that I can control follow-up notifications for the page.

flows.name: Show successful save result
flows.description: As an editor, I want the screen to close and refresh the article at the edited section after a successful save, so that I can see my published change in context.

flows.name: Undo and redo edits
flows.description: As an editor, I want to undo and redo wikitext changes from the editor keyboard overlay, so that I can correct mistakes while editing.

flows.name: Use suggested edit summary
flows.description: As an editor, I want to choose a suggested edit summary chip, so that I can quickly fill a clear summary for common edits.

flows.name: View edit notices
flows.description: As an editor, I want to view page edit notices and warnings, so that I understand page-specific guidance before saving changes.

flows.name: View editing errors
flows.description: As an editor, I want to see abuse-filter, spam-blacklist, permission, or other editing errors, so that I understand why my edit cannot proceed.

name: Edit history filter overflow popup
description: PopupWindow anchored to an edit history filter control, showing selectable edit-history filters (all, user, anonymous, bot count display/selection state) and dismissing after selection.

flows.name: Dismiss filter popup after selection
flows.description: As a user, I want the filter overflow popup to close after I choose a filter, so that I can immediately return to the updated edit history list.

flows.name: Dismiss filter popup without changing filter
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the filter overflow popup without selecting an option, so that I can keep the current edit history filter unchanged.

flows.name: Filter by all edits

flows.name: Filter by anonymous edits
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the anonymous edits filter, so that the edit history list shows revisions made by anonymous or temporary-account editors.

flows.name: Filter by registered-user edits
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the registered-user edits filter, so that the edit history list shows revisions made by registered editors.

flows.name: View bot edit count as unavailable filter
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the bot edits count shown as a disabled-looking filter option, so that I know bot edit statistics exist even though this popup does not currently let me select that filter.

description: Activity showing a page's revision history with stats header, search/filter bar, paged revision list, separators, loading/error rows, empty states, pull-to-refresh, search action mode, filter overflow, and compare mode with selected from/to cards and compare confirmation.

flows.name: Browse paged revision list
flows.description: As a reader, I want to scroll through a paged list of revisions grouped by date, so that I can review the page's edit history over time.

flows.name: Cancel compare mode
flows.description: As a reader, I want to cancel compare mode with the toolbar cancel button or the back button, so that I can return to normal revision browsing without selections.

flows.name: Compare selected revisions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to confirm comparison after selecting two revisions, so that I can view the diff between those revisions.

flows.name: Enter compare mode
flows.description: As a reader, I want to enter revision compare mode from the toolbar or by long-pressing a revision, so that I can select two revisions to compare.

flows.name: Exit search mode
flows.description: As a reader, I want to close search mode, so that I can return to the normal edit history view with the search cleared.

flows.name: Filter revisions by contributor type
flows.description: As a reader, I want to filter the revision list to all edits, registered-user edits, or anonymous/temp-account edits, so that I can focus on a specific type of contribution.

flows.name: Handle no matching revisions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see an empty-state message when search or filters return no revisions, so that I know there are no matching edits and can adjust the criteria.

flows.name: Leave edit history screen
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the back button when not comparing, so that I can leave the edit history screen.

flows.name: Limit comparison selection
flows.description: As a reader, I want to be warned when I try to select more than two revisions for comparison, so that I understand only two revisions can be compared at once.

flows.name: Open article from history header
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the page title in the edit history header, so that I can open the article in a new tab.

flows.name: Open contributor actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a revision contributor's username, so that I can open contributor-related actions or talk-page options for that edit.

flows.name: Open filters from empty state
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the filter menu from the empty-state message, so that I can change or clear filters that produced no results.

flows.name: Recognize active filters
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see when an edit-history filter is active and which filter is selected, so that I understand why the list results are limited.

flows.name: Refresh edit history
flows.description: As a reader, I want to pull down to refresh the edit history, so that I can reload the latest revisions and statistics.

flows.name: Retry failed loading
flows.description: As a reader, I want to retry when the history list fails to load or load more items, so that I can recover from network or service errors.

flows.name: Search revision history
flows.description: As a reader, I want to search revisions by edit comment, content, or contributor, so that I can find relevant edits quickly.

flows.name: Select revisions for comparison
flows.description: As a reader, I want to select and deselect up to two revisions in compare mode, so that I can choose the from and to revisions for a diff comparison.

flows.name: View revision details
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a revision in the history list, so that I can view the details and diff for that specific edit.

flows.name: View revision history summary
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view a page's edit history summary with title, total edits, and activity graph, so that I can understand the page's editing activity at a glance.

name: Edit history revision row widget
description: RecyclerView row for a single revision, displaying diff size, username/account type icon, comment/minor-edit marker, timestamp, selection checkbox, and selected-from/selected-to visual styling; supports click, long-click, username click, and compare selection.

flows.name: Distinguish compare endpoints
flows.description: As a reader selecting revisions to compare, I want selected rows to be visually marked as the from and to revisions, so that I can tell which two revisions will be compared.

flows.name: Highlight matching revision text
flows.description: As a reader searching edit history, I want matching text in revision comments, usernames, and diff-size text to be highlighted in the row, so that I can identify why the revision matched my search.

flows.name: Open editor actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the username in a revision row, so that I can view actions or information for that editor, including anonymous and temporary account editors.

flows.name: Open revision details
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a revision row, so that I can open the detailed edit diff for that revision.

flows.name: Prevent selecting more than two revisions
flows.description: As a reader in compare mode, I want the row to reject selecting a third revision and show a message, so that I understand only two revisions can be compared at a time.

flows.name: Select revisions for comparison
flows.description: As a reader in compare mode, I want to tap a revision row, its username area, or its selection checkbox, so that I can select or deselect the two revisions to compare.

flows.name: Start compare from row
flows.description: As a reader, I want to long-press a revision row, so that I can enter compare mode and select that revision for comparison.

flows.name: View revision summary
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see a revision row with its edit size change, editor identity type, comment or placeholder, minor-edit marker, and timestamp, so that I can quickly understand what changed in that revision.

name: Edit preview panel
description: Fragment in the edit workflow that loads server-rendered HTML preview of edited wikitext into a WebView, with license/footer spacing, link handling, reference bottom-sheet integration, progress visibility callbacks, and hide/show preview state.

flows.name: Browse grouped references
flows.description: As an editor, I want to swipe between multiple references in the reference bottom sheet, so that I can inspect all citations associated with a selected reference group.

flows.name: Confirm leaving for internal article link
flows.description: As an editor, I want to be warned before opening an internal article link from the preview, so that I do not accidentally leave the edit workflow with unsaved changes.

flows.name: Ignore unsupported preview media links
flows.description: As an editor, I want unsupported media links in the preview to avoid interrupting my editing session, so that accidental taps on media do not take me out of the workflow.

flows.name: Open edit diff link from preview
flows.description: As an editor, I want to confirm and open a diff link from the preview, so that I can review revision details when I intentionally leave editing.

flows.name: Open external link from preview
flows.description: As an editor, I want to confirm and open an external link from the preview, so that I can inspect off-wiki content when I intentionally leave editing.

flows.name: Open internal article from preview
flows.description: As an editor, I want to confirm and open an internal article link from the preview, so that I can view linked wiki content when I intentionally leave editing.

flows.name: Open license footer links
flows.description: As an editor, I want to tap links in the preview license footer, so that I can review the terms of use and license details before publishing.

flows.name: Open links from reference details
flows.description: As an editor, I want to tap links shown inside reference details, so that I can inspect citation targets or related pages from the preview.

flows.name: Preview edited wikitext
flows.description: As an editor, I want to load and view a server-rendered HTML preview of my edited wikitext, so that I can verify how my changes will look before saving.

flows.name: Preview new page edits
flows.description: As an editor creating a new page, I want to preview my wikitext even though the target page does not yet exist, so that I can review the rendered content before publishing.

flows.name: Read license footer while previewing
flows.description: As an editor, I want the edit license footer to remain visible below the preview without covering the article content, so that I understand the publishing terms before saving.

flows.name: Return from preview to editing
flows.description: As an editor, I want to hide the preview and return to the edit form, so that I can continue changing my wikitext after reviewing it.

flows.name: Show preview loading progress
flows.description: As an editor, I want to see progress while the preview is being fetched and rendered, so that I know the app is working and when the preview is ready.

flows.name: Stay in edit workflow after link warning
flows.description: As an editor, I want to cancel the leave-edit warning after tapping a preview link, so that I can remain in the preview without losing my place.

flows.name: View reference details
flows.description: As an editor, I want to tap a reference in the preview and see its details in a bottom sheet, so that I can verify citations without leaving the edit workflow.

name: Edit summary panel
description:
Fragment shown in the edit workflow for entering an edit summary before publishing.
Includes an AutoCompleteTextView for past summaries, voice-input end icon, suggested summary chips, minor-edit and watch-page checkboxes with help links, learn-more link, and temporary/anonymous account footer messaging.

flows.name: Dictate edit summary
flows.description: As an editor, I want to use voice input for the edit summary, so that I can enter the summary by speaking instead of typing.

flows.name: Dismiss summary panel with back
flows.description: As an editor, I want to go back from the edit summary panel, so that I can return to the previous edit workflow step instead of publishing immediately.

flows.name: Enter edit summary
flows.description: As an editor, I want to type an edit summary before publishing, so that other readers and editors can understand what I changed.

flows.name: Handle unavailable voice input
flows.description: As an editor, I want to be informed when voice input is not available, so that I understand why dictation cannot be used.

flows.name: Learn about minor edits
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open help about minor edits, so that I can decide whether marking my edit as minor is appropriate.

flows.name: Learn about watching pages
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open help about watching pages, so that I can understand what the watch-page option does.

flows.name: Mark edit as minor
flows.description: As a logged-in editor, I want to mark my edit as minor, so that the published edit is labeled appropriately in page history and watchlists.

flows.name: Open account-status help from footer
flows.description: As a temporary or anonymous editor, I want to open the help link in the account-status footer, so that I can learn more about temporary accounts or anonymous editing before publishing.

flows.name: Open edit summary help
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open learn-more information about edit summaries, so that I can understand how to write a useful summary before publishing.

flows.name: Publish edit from summary panel
flows.description: As an editor, I want to continue from the edit summary panel using the Next or keyboard Done action, so that my edit is published with the selected summary, minor-edit setting, and watch-page setting.

flows.name: Reuse past summary
flows.description: As an editor, I want to select from previously used edit summaries in the summary field, so that I can quickly reuse common descriptions of my changes.

flows.name: Save summary for future reuse
flows.description: As an editor, I want a non-empty summary that I publish with to be saved, so that it can appear as a past summary in future edit summary panels.

flows.name: See default watch status
flows.description: As a logged-in editor, I want the watch-page option to reflect whether the page is already watched or my account watches edited pages by default, so that the publishing choice matches my preferences.

flows.name: Understand unavailable watch option when logged out
flows.description: As a logged-out editor, I want the watch-page option to be disabled, so that I understand I cannot add the page to a watchlist without an account.

flows.name: Use suggested summary chip
flows.description: As an editor, I want to tap a suggested summary chip, so that I can quickly fill the edit summary with a common reason for the edit.

flows.name: View temporary or anonymous account notice
flows.description: As a temporary or anonymous editor, I want to see a footer explaining how my edit will be attributed, so that I understand the privacy and account-status implications before publishing.

flows.name: Watch or unwatch page after edit
flows.description: As a logged-in editor, I want to choose whether to watch the page after publishing my edit, so that I can control whether future page changes appear on my watchlist.

name: Edit summary suggestions popup
description: Autocomplete drop-down attached to the edit summary input, populated from locally persisted recent edit summaries using a simple list item adapter.

flows.name: Dismiss popup with back
flows.description: As an editor, I want pressing Back while the edit summary popup is open to close it, so that I can return to the edit preview without leaving the editor.

flows.name: Focus summary field from popup area
flows.description: As an editor, I want tapping the edit summary popup area to focus the summary input, so that I can immediately type or open suggestions.

flows.name: Prioritize most recently used summaries
flows.description: As an editor, I want recently reused or newly entered edit summaries to appear first in the suggestions, so that the most relevant summaries are easiest to pick.

flows.name: Save submitted summary for future suggestions
flows.description: As an editor, I want my non-empty edit summary to be saved after I submit an edit, so that it can appear as a suggestion the next time I edit.

flows.name: Select a recent summary suggestion
flows.description: As an editor, I want to tap a suggested recent edit summary from the autocomplete drop-down, so that the edit summary field is filled without retyping it.

flows.name: Use language-appropriate text direction
flows.description: As an editor, I want the edit summary input and its suggestions to follow the article language direction, so that summaries are readable for left-to-right and right-to-left languages.

flows.name: View recent edit summary suggestions
flows.description: As an editor, I want to see an autocomplete drop-down of my recently used edit summaries when editing the summary field, so that I can quickly reuse a previous summary.

name: EditHistoryListActivity
description: Page edit history list surface.

name: EditSectionActivity
description: Article section editing surface.

name: Editor Syntax Keyboard Adapter
description:
Controller for editor accessory keyboard surfaces.
Shows/hides the base wikitext keyboard and headings/formatting overlays based on IME visibility and focus, and routes insert-link, insert-template, insert-media, heading, formatting, and link-preview actions to their respective activities/dialogs.

name: Experimental preferences
description: Experimental PreferenceScreen/category placeholder for experimental settings.

name: Explore Feed Update Prompt Screen
description:
Full-screen Compose announcement prompt for the updated Explore/Home feed.
Presents a title, four onboarding benefit rows, and two bottom actions: customize feed (opens personalization) or set it up with defaults.

flows.name: Accept default feed setup
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to choose to have the feed set up for me, so that I can dismiss the prompt and continue with the default Home feed configuration.

flows.name: Customize feed from prompt
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to choose to customize my feed from the update prompt, so that I can open feed personalization and set my Home feed preferences myself.

flows.name: Dismiss prompt with system back
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to leave the feed update prompt using the system back action, so that I can return to the Home feed without selecting either setup option.

flows.name: Do not show prompt again after it appears
flows.description: As a returning Wikipedia reader, I want the feed update prompt to be marked as shown once it has appeared, so that I am not repeatedly interrupted by the same announcement on future visits to the Home feed.

flows.name: Scroll announcement content
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to scroll through the update prompt content, so that I can read all onboarding benefit rows on devices where the full announcement does not fit on screen.

flows.name: View updated Home feed announcement
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to see an announcement explaining that Explore is now Home and what benefits the updated feed offers, so that I understand the new feed experience before continuing.

name: Explore feed building screen
description:
Temporary onboarding/progress screen shown while the Explore feed is being built.
It is a Compose screen with centered explanatory text and a looping Lottie animation, then automatically finishes after a short delay and returns RESULT_OK.

flows.name: Automatically finish feed building
flows.description: As a user, I want the feed-building screen to automatically complete after a short delay, so that I can continue to the Explore feed without taking any manual action.

flows.name: Dismiss feed building with system back
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the system back action to leave the feed-building screen before it completes, so that I can cancel or return from the temporary progress surface if I do not want to wait.

flows.name: View feed building progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a temporary feed-building message with an animated progress illustration, so that I understand the app is setting up my Explore feed.

name: ExploreFeedBuildingActivity
description: Explore feed building/progress surface.

name: ExploreFeedUpdatePromptActivity
description: Explore feed update prompt surface.

name: Fancy CAPTCHA widget
description:
Reusable CAPTCHA UI handler backed by group captcha binding.
Swaps or reveals the CAPTCHA panel over a primary view, loads CAPTCHA images, provides a text field, submit button, request-account link, progress indicator, error text and reload-on-image-tap behavior.

flows.name: Enter CAPTCHA answer
flows.description: As a user, I want to type the text from the CAPTCHA image into the answer field, so that my response can be submitted with the parent form.

flows.name: Recover from CAPTCHA reload failure
flows.description: As a user, I want to be shown an error and returned out of the CAPTCHA challenge if loading a new CAPTCHA fails, so that I am not left stuck on a broken challenge.

flows.name: Reload CAPTCHA image
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the CAPTCHA image to request a new CAPTCHA, so that I can replace an unreadable challenge with a new one.

flows.name: Request an account
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the request-account link from the CAPTCHA panel when it is available, so that I can ask for account assistance instead of completing the current flow.

flows.name: Return to parent screen after CAPTCHA completes
flows.description: As a user, I want the CAPTCHA panel to be hidden after it is canceled or no longer needed, so that I can return to the original screen content.

flows.name: See CAPTCHA answer errors
flows.description: As a user, I want the CAPTCHA answer field to show an error message when my answer is missing or invalid, so that I know what to correct before continuing.

flows.name: See CAPTCHA reload progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a progress indicator while a new CAPTCHA image is loading, so that I know my reload request is being processed.

flows.name: Submit CAPTCHA from widget
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the CAPTCHA panel's submit button when it is displayed, so that I can retry or continue the parent action after entering the CAPTCHA answer.

flows.name: View CAPTCHA challenge
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a CAPTCHA panel with an explanation and challenge image when extra verification is required, so that I understand I must complete the CAPTCHA before continuing.

name: Featured Page App Widget
description: Home-screen app widget displaying a featured article title, optional description and thumbnail, opening the article when tapped.

flows.name: Add featured article widget
flows.description: As a user, I want to add the Featured Page app widget to my home screen, so that I can see a highlighted Wikipedia article without opening the app.

flows.name: Automatically refresh featured article
flows.description: As a user, I want the widget to periodically refresh its featured article content, so that the home screen shows up-to-date featured page information.

flows.name: Handle missing article details
flows.description: As a user, I want the widget to hide unavailable descriptions or thumbnails gracefully, so that the featured article remains readable even when some details are not provided.

flows.name: Open featured article
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the featured page widget, so that the featured article opens in the Wikipedia app for reading.

flows.name: Resize featured article widget
flows.description: As a user, I want to resize the featured page widget on my home screen, so that it fits my preferred home screen layout.

flows.name: View featured article information
flows.description: As a user, I want to view the featured article title with its available description and thumbnail on the widget, so that I can decide whether the article interests me at a glance.

name: Featured article feed module
description: Compose home/community feed card module showing a featured article with image or fallback background, title/description/extract, bookmark and share actions, and hide-card/module controls via the module container.

flows.name: Hide featured article card
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the current featured article card from the module overflow menu, so that I no longer see that specific card in my feed.

flows.name: Hide featured article module
flows.description: As a user, I want to hide the featured article module from the module overflow menu, so that featured article cards stop appearing in my feed.

flows.name: Open featured article
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the featured article card, so that I can open and read the full article.

flows.name: Open module overflow menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the featured article module overflow menu, so that I can access controls for hiding this card or the entire module.

flows.name: Save featured article
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the bookmark button on the featured article, so that I can add the article to my default reading list for later.

flows.name: Share featured article
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the share button on the featured article, so that I can share the article title/link through Android sharing options.

flows.name: Undo featured article card hide
flows.description: As a user, I want to undo dismissing the featured article card from the confirmation snackbar, so that the card is restored to my feed.

flows.name: Undo featured article module hide
flows.description: As a user, I want to undo hiding the featured article module from the confirmation snackbar, so that featured article cards can appear in my feed again.

flows.name: View featured article preview
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the featured article card with its title, description, extract, and image or fallback background, so that I can quickly understand the highlighted article before opening it.

name: Featured image feed module
description: Compose home/community feed card module for picture of the day, displaying a large Commons image with description, artist/credit, license details, download/share actions, and hide-card/module controls via the module container.

flows.name: Download featured image
flows.description: As a user, I want to download the picture of the day from the feed card, so that I can save the image to my device.

flows.name: Grant download permission
flows.description: As a user, I want to grant storage permission when required for downloading the featured image, so that the app can save the image to my device on older Android versions.

flows.name: Hide featured image card
flows.description: As a user, I want to hide the current featured image card from the feed, so that I no longer see this specific item.

flows.name: Hide featured image module
flows.description: As a user, I want to hide the featured image module from the feed, so that pictures of the day are removed from my home feed experience.

flows.name: Open featured image file page
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the featured image card to open its Wikimedia Commons file page, so that I can see the full file details and related media information.

flows.name: Open image metadata links
flows.description: As a user, I want to open links in the image description, artist, credit, and license text, so that I can learn more about the image, creator, attribution, or license terms.

flows.name: Share featured image
flows.description: As a user, I want to share the picture of the day from the feed card, so that I can send the image and its source link to other people or apps.

flows.name: View featured image details
flows.description: As a user, I want to view the picture of the day with its description, artist, credit, and license information, so that I can understand the image and its attribution.

name: Featured page app widget
description: Home-screen app widget surface provided by WidgetProviderFeaturedPage.

name: Feed Home Preference Selection Screen
description:
Compose UI for selecting Community-first versus Personalized/For-you-first home feed order.
Shows radio-button sections with preview article cards, tag badges, horizontal carousels, shimmer loading, empty personalized state, and retryable error views.

flows.name: Browse community preview cards
flows.description: As a user, I want to browse preview cards for community-curated feed content, so that I can understand what Community-first will show before choosing it.

flows.name: Browse personalized preview cards
flows.description: As a user, I want to browse preview cards for personalized feed content, so that I can understand what For-you-first will show before choosing it.

flows.name: Complete preference onboarding
flows.description: As a user, I want to continue from the home preference selection screen using the next button, so that I can finish the personalization flow after choosing my feed order.

flows.name: Keep preference selection persisted
flows.description: As a user, I want my selected home feed order preference to be saved, so that the app remembers my Community-first or For-you-first choice after I leave the screen or reopen the app.

flows.name: Recognize loading previews
flows.description: As a user, I want to see loading placeholders while feed preview content is being fetched, so that I know the screen is still preparing the available choices.

flows.name: Retry failed preview loading
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry loading community or personalized preview content after an error, so that I can recover from a failed network or data load without leaving the screen.

flows.name: Select Community-first feed order
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the Community-first home feed option, so that community-curated content appears first in my home feed.

flows.name: Select For-you-first feed order
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the Personalized or For-you-first home feed option when personalized content is available, so that content based on my interests or reading activity appears first in my home feed.

flows.name: Skip preference onboarding
flows.description: As a user, I want to skip the personalization flow from this screen when skip is available, so that I can leave onboarding without changing or completing this step.

flows.name: Swipe between onboarding pages
flows.description: As a user, I want to swipe horizontally between personalization onboarding pages when multiple pages are present, so that I can navigate to or away from the home preference selection step naturally.

flows.name: Understand unavailable personalized option
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an empty-state explanation and disabled personalized option when there is not enough personalized content, so that I understand why I cannot choose For-you-first yet.

name: Feed Interest Selection Screen
description: Compose UI for choosing personalization interests: title/back affordance, search card, horizontally scrollable topic filter chips, staggered grid of selectable article cards, loading/error states, and bottom bar showing selected count plus deselect-all action.

flows.name: Browse suggested article cards
flows.description: As a user, I want to scroll through a staggered grid of suggested article cards, so that I can review potential article interests.

flows.name: Browse topic filters
flows.description: As a user, I want to horizontally browse available topic filter chips, so that I can discover the personalization topics I can choose from.

flows.name: Continue to the next personalization step
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the next button from the interest selection step, so that I can continue through personalization after choosing interests.

flows.name: Deselect all interests
flows.description: As a user, I want to clear all selected topics and articles from the bottom bar, so that I can quickly restart my interest choices.

flows.name: Go back from interest selection
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the back affordance on the interest selection screen, so that I can return to the previous screen without continuing personalization.

flows.name: Load articles for selected topic
flows.description: As a user, I want the article grid to refresh with articles related to my selected topic, so that I can choose more specific article interests within that subject.

flows.name: Restore saved interest selections
flows.description: As a returning user, I want my previously selected topics and articles to appear selected when I revisit the screen, so that my personalization choices persist across sessions.

flows.name: Retry article loading after an error
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error message and tap retry when interest articles fail to load, so that I can recover from temporary loading problems.

flows.name: Search for interest articles
flows.description: As a user, I want to open search from the interest selection screen, so that I can find and add specific articles as personalization interests.

flows.name: See minimum selection prompt
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a prompt when no interests are selected, so that I know I should choose interests to personalize my feed.

flows.name: Select or deselect a topic interest
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a topic chip to select or deselect it, so that my feed recommendations reflect the broad subjects I care about.

flows.name: Select or deselect an article interest
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap an article card to select or deselect it, so that I can personalize recommendations with specific articles I like.

flows.name: Skip personalization onboarding
flows.description: As a user, I want to skip the personalization onboarding from the interest selection step, so that I can continue without choosing interests.

flows.name: Use localized and RTL layout
flows.description: As a user reading in a right-to-left or localized language, I want topic labels and article browsing layout to follow my language direction, so that the interest selection experience feels natural in my language.

flows.name: View loading placeholders
flows.description: As a user, I want to see loading placeholders while articles are being fetched, so that I understand the interest suggestions are still loading.

flows.name: View selected interest count
flows.description: As a user, I want to see how many topics and articles I have selected, so that I understand the current size of my personalization set.

name: Feed Personalization Curiosity Intro Page
description: First onboarding page introducing personalized recommendations with a puzzle/browser image, headline, and explanatory text, displayed inside the personalization pager.

flows.name: Continue to interest selection
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to tap the Next arrow on the curiosity introduction page, so that I can proceed to selecting topics that will personalize my feed.

flows.name: Skip personalization onboarding
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to tap Skip on the curiosity introduction page, so that I can leave personalization onboarding without choosing personalization options.

flows.name: Swipe to next personalization page
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to swipe horizontally from the curiosity introduction page, so that I can move through the personalization onboarding pages at my own pace.

flows.name: Track onboarding progress
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to see the page indicator while on the curiosity introduction page, so that I know this is one step in a multi-page personalization setup flow.

flows.name: View personalization introduction
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to see an introductory page explaining personalized feed recommendations and minimal anonymized data collection, so that I understand why the app is asking me to choose interests.

name: Feed Personalization Onboarding Flow
description:
Compose onboarding/customization Activity for feed personalization.
Hosts a horizontal pager over curiosity, interest selection, and home preference pages, with skip/next bottom navigation and instrumentation; can also be launched in interests-only mode from settings/search flows.

flows.name: Advance through onboarding pages
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the next button to move through the personalization onboarding pages, so that I can complete the setup flow step by step.

flows.name: Choose home feed preference
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose between community-first and personalized-first home feed ordering, so that the feed prioritizes the kind of content I prefer.

flows.name: Clear all selected interests
flows.description: As a user, I want to deselect all selected topics and articles at once, so that I can quickly reset my personalization choices.

flows.name: Complete full personalization onboarding
flows.description: As a user, I want to finish the full personalization onboarding flow, so that my selections are saved and the app can build my customized Explore feed.

flows.name: Complete interests-only personalization
flows.description: As a user, I want to finish the interests-only personalization screen, so that changes made from settings or search flows are saved and reported back to the previous screen.

flows.name: Preview home feed options
flows.description: As a user, I want to preview example community and personalized feed content, so that I can make an informed choice about my home feed preference.

flows.name: Restore saved personalization choices
flows.description: As a returning user, I want my previously selected topics, articles, and home feed preference to be restored when I open personalization, so that I can review or modify my existing setup without starting over.

flows.name: Retry loading home preference previews
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry loading a home preference preview when it fails, so that I can compare feed options before completing onboarding.

flows.name: Retry loading interest recommendations
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry loading recommended articles when an error occurs, so that I can continue selecting interests after a temporary failure.

flows.name: Return from interests-only mode
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the back button in interests-only personalization mode, so that I can return to the previous settings or search flow with my changes saved.

flows.name: Search for interest articles
flows.description: As a user, I want to search for an article and add it to my selected interests, so that I can personalize my feed with articles not shown in the recommendations.

flows.name: Select interest topics
flows.description: As a user, I want to select and deselect interest topics, so that my feed can recommend articles related to subjects I care about.

flows.name: Select recommended articles
flows.description: As a user, I want to select and deselect recommended articles, so that specific articles can influence my personalized feed recommendations.

flows.name: Skip personalization onboarding
flows.description: As a user, I want to skip the multi-page personalization onboarding flow, so that I can leave setup without making personalization choices.

flows.name: Track onboarding progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see which onboarding page I am on, so that I understand my progress through the personalization setup flow.

flows.name: Understand unavailable personalized preference
flows.description: As a user, I want to see when personalized feed preview content is unavailable and the option is disabled, so that I know why I cannot select personalized-first ordering yet.

flows.name: View personalization introduction
flows.description: As a user, I want to view an introductory curiosity page for feed personalization, so that I understand why customizing my feed can improve my experience.

flows.name: View selected interest count
flows.description: As a user, I want to see how many topics and articles I have selected, so that I know the current extent of my feed personalization.

name: Feed article list item widget
description:
Reusable article row used by feed/detail list surfaces.
Shows title, subtitle/description, optional thumbnail, offline availability greying, click with shared-element transition, and long-press menu actions for open, open in new tab, save, or move between reading lists.

flows.name: Add article to another reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to add an already saved article to another reading list from the row action menu, so that I can organize it in multiple lists.

flows.name: Copy article link from action menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to copy an article link from the row action menu, so that I can paste the article URL elsewhere.

flows.name: Move article between reading lists
flows.description: As a user, I want to move an article from its current reading list to another reading list from the row action menu, so that I can reorganize saved articles.

flows.name: Open article from action menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose Open from the article row action menu, so that I can open the selected article from the menu.

flows.name: Open article from row
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap an article row to open the article with a shared-element transition when possible, so that I can move from the list into the article smoothly.

flows.name: Open article in new tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose Open in new tab from the article row action menu, so that I can keep my current place while opening the article in the background.

flows.name: Open row action menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to long-press or context-click an article row to open an action menu, so that I can choose article actions without immediately opening the article.

flows.name: Remove article from reading lists
flows.description: As a user, I want to remove a saved article from reading lists from the row action menu, so that I can clean up articles I no longer want saved.

flows.name: Save article to default reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to save an unsaved article from the row action menu to my default reading list, so that I can read it later.

flows.name: See offline availability state
flows.description: As a user, I want articles that are not available offline to appear visually greyed out, so that I can understand their offline availability at a glance.

flows.name: Share article from action menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to share an article from the row action menu, so that I can send the article to another person or app.

flows.name: View article summary row
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an article row with its title, subtitle or description, and thumbnail when available, so that I can recognize the article before opening it.

flows.name: View article without optional content
flows.description: As a user, I want article rows to hide missing subtitles or thumbnails cleanly, so that list items remain readable when some article metadata is unavailable.

name: Feed configuration information screen
description:
Compose screen explaining and linking to the data sources that drive the feed.
Shows loading state with a progress indicator, then a scrollable list of items for interests, location, reading history, and languages.

flows.name: Confirm interests update
flows.description: As a user, I want to receive confirmation after updating my interests from the feed configuration flow, so that I know my changes were saved.

flows.name: Go back from feed configuration
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the top app bar navigation control to leave the feed configuration information screen, so that I can return to the previous settings screen or exit if there is no previous screen.

flows.name: Open interests customization
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the interests data source item, so that I can customize the interests used to personalize my feed.

flows.name: Open language settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the languages data source item, so that I can manage the languages used to shape my feed.

flows.name: Open location settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the location data source item, so that I can update or review the location information used by my feed.

flows.name: Open reading history
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the reading history data source item, so that I can review the reading activity that may influence my feed.

flows.name: Scroll feed configuration list
flows.description: As a user, I want to scroll through the feed configuration information, so that I can view all available data source items on screens where they do not fit at once.

flows.name: See whether interests are configured
flows.description: As a user, I want the interests data source item to indicate whether I have saved topics or article interests, so that I can understand whether interests are currently influencing my feed.

flows.name: See whether reading history exists
flows.description: As a user, I want the reading history data source item to indicate whether I have reading history, so that I can understand whether my past reading is currently influencing my feed.

flows.name: View feed configuration loading state
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a loading indicator while feed configuration information is being prepared, so that I know the app is working before the data source list appears.

flows.name: View feed data source information
flows.description: As a user, I want to read an explanation and list of the data sources that drive my feed, so that I can understand how my feed recommendations are determined.

name: Feed configuration item widget
description:
Reusable Compose row used by the feed configuration screen.
Displays an icon, title, and description and handles clicks for the corresponding feed data source.

flows.name: Open interest customization
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the interests feed configuration item, so that I can customize the topics and articles used to personalize my feed.

flows.name: Open language settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the languages feed configuration item, so that I can manage the Wikipedia languages used to personalize my feed.

flows.name: Open location settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the location feed configuration item, so that I can update the location information used to personalize my feed.

flows.name: Open reading history
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the reading history feed configuration item, so that I can review or manage reading activity that may influence my feed.

flows.name: See whether interests are configured
flows.description: As a user, I want the interests item description to reflect whether I have saved topics or articles, so that I can understand if interest data is currently contributing to my feed.

flows.name: See whether reading history exists
flows.description: As a user, I want the reading history item description to reflect whether I have reading history, so that I can understand if past reading activity is currently contributing to my feed.

flows.name: View feed configuration option
flows.description: As a user, I want to see each feed configuration option with an icon, title, and description, so that I can understand what data source influences my home feed before choosing it.

name: Feedback Snackbar
description: Reusable transient Snackbar surface for showing errors and messages, with HTML/link handling and optional indefinite OK dismissal; chooses an anchor view based on current activity or topmost eligible bottom sheet.

flows.name: Copy indefinite snackbar text
flows.description: As a user, I want to select and copy text from an indefinite snackbar, so that I can preserve or share detailed feedback such as long error messages.

flows.name: Dismiss long error snackbar
flows.description: As a user, I want long error messages to remain visible until I tap OK, so that I have enough time to read and dismiss them when I am ready.

flows.name: Display snackbar above current bottom sheet
flows.description: As a user, I want snackbar feedback to appear over the active eligible bottom sheet, so that messages remain visible in the context where I am working.

flows.name: Display snackbar in current activity context
flows.description: As a user, I want snackbar feedback to appear in the appropriate area of the current app screen, so that it does not obscure unrelated content or appear detached from my current task.

flows.name: Open links from snackbar text
flows.description: As a user, I want links shown in snackbar text to be tappable, so that I can open relevant external information directly from the feedback message.

flows.name: Read formatted snackbar content
flows.description: As a user, I want snackbar messages that contain HTML formatting to be rendered as readable text, so that feedback appears clean and understandable.

flows.name: Show error feedback snackbar
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a readable error message in a snackbar when something goes wrong, so that I know why an action failed.

flows.name: Show plain text feedback from HTML
flows.description: As a user, I want feedback that may contain HTML to be displayed as plain readable text when appropriate, so that markup does not clutter the message.

flows.name: Show transient message snackbar
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a temporary snackbar message when the app needs to give me feedback, so that I can understand the result of my action without leaving the current screen.

name: File page screen
description:
Full-screen Commons/file details surface hosted by FilePageActivity/FilePageFragment.
Shows loading/error states, a toolbar menu for save/share, a zoomable image preview, filename, caption/tags metadata, author/date/source/licensing/more-info rows, and edit action buttons for adding captions or image tags when allowed.

flows.name: Grant storage permission for saving
flows.description: As a user, I want to grant storage permission when saving requires it, so that the app can download the image to my device.

flows.name: Handle denied save permission
flows.description: As a user, I want to receive feedback when I deny storage permission for saving, so that I understand why the image was not downloaded.

flows.name: Open image caption editor
flows.description: As a user, I want to add or edit the image caption when editing is allowed, so that the file has a useful caption in the appropriate language.

flows.name: Open image tags editor
flows.description: As a user, I want to add image tags when editing is allowed and tags are missing for my language, so that the file is better described and discoverable.

flows.name: Open licensing link
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the licensing row when a license URL is available, so that I can read the full license terms in a browser.

flows.name: Open links in metadata
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap links shown in caption, author, source, or other metadata fields, so that I can navigate to related Wikipedia pages or external websites.

flows.name: Open original file page
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the more-info file page link, so that I can view the original Commons or Wikipedia file page for additional details.

flows.name: Recover from file loading error
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error message when file information cannot be loaded and be able to leave the screen, so that I am not stuck on a failed file page.

flows.name: Refresh after caption edit
flows.description: As a user, I want the file page to refresh and show success feedback after I add a caption, so that I can confirm my contribution was saved.

flows.name: Refresh after image tags edit
flows.description: As a user, I want the file page to refresh and show success feedback after I add image tags, so that I can confirm my contribution was saved.

flows.name: Refresh file details
flows.description: As a user, I want to pull to refresh the file page, so that I can retry loading or see updated file metadata after changes.

flows.name: Save file image
flows.description: As a user, I want to save the file image to my device, so that I can access it outside the app.

flows.name: Scroll file details
flows.description: As a user, I want to scroll through the file page content, so that I can review all metadata rows on smaller screens.

flows.name: See loading state
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a loading indicator while file information is being fetched, so that I know the file page is still working.

flows.name: Share file image
flows.description: As a user, I want to share the file image along with its title and page link, so that I can send the media to another app or person.

flows.name: View file details
flows.description: As a user, I want to view a file's preview, filename, caption, image tags, author, date, source, licensing, and more-info rows, so that I can understand the media and its attribution details.

flows.name: Zoom image preview
flows.description: As a user, I want to zoom and inspect the image preview, so that I can see details in the media more clearly.

name: FilePageActivity
description: Commons file page surface.

name: Find in Editor Action Mode
description:
Contextual action-mode search surface inside the edit screen.
Provides a find text field with next/previous navigation, match count, close action, selection/highlight updates in the wikitext editor, and scrolls the editor to the current result.

flows.name: Clear search query
flows.description: As an editor, I want clearing the find field to hide the match count, disable result navigation, and clear the active search selection/highlights, so that the editor returns to an unsearched state.

flows.name: Dismiss find and clear highlights
flows.description: As an editor, I want to dismiss find-in-editor and have search highlights cleared while keeping my cursor in the editor, so that I can continue editing normally after searching.

flows.name: Dismiss find by returning to editor
flows.description: As an editor, I want tapping in the wikitext editor to close the find action mode, so that I can quickly return from searching to editing.

flows.name: Get boundary feedback on long press
flows.description: As an editor, I want a message when I long-press previous while already on the first match or next while already on the last match, so that I understand I am already at the boundary result.

flows.name: Jump to first match
flows.description: As an editor, I want to long-press the previous control to jump directly to the first search match, so that I can quickly return to the beginning of the results.

flows.name: Jump to last match
flows.description: As an editor, I want to long-press the next control to jump directly to the last search match, so that I can quickly reach the final occurrence in the editor.

flows.name: Navigate to next match
flows.description: As an editor, I want to move to the next search match, wrapping from the last match to the first, so that I can review every occurrence in the wikitext.

flows.name: Navigate to previous match
flows.description: As an editor, I want to move to the previous search match, wrapping from the first match to the last, so that I can review occurrences in reverse order.

flows.name: Open find in editor
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open the find-in-editor action mode from the edit screen, so that I can search within the wikitext I am editing without leaving the editor.

flows.name: Preserve query after closing find
flows.description: As an editor, I want the find query to be preserved when I close and reopen find-in-editor, so that I can resume the same search without retyping it.

flows.name: Search editor wikitext
flows.description: As an editor, I want to type a search query in the find field, so that matching text in the wikitext editor is selected, highlighted, counted, and scrolled into view.

flows.name: See no-match state
flows.description: As an editor, I want to see a clear 0/0 result state and disabled navigation controls when my query has no matches, so that I know the text was not found and cannot navigate empty results.

name: Find in Page Action View
description: Toolbar action provider UI for in-page search, containing a SearchView query field, match count display, previous/next navigation controls, and toast feedback at first/last occurrences.

flows.name: Clear find query state
flows.description: As a user, I want the find controls and match count to clear when the search text is empty, so that the toolbar reflects that there is no active find search.

flows.name: Enter find query
flows.description: As a user, I want to type text into the find-in-page search field, so that matching occurrences in the current page or editor can be found.

flows.name: Jump to first match
flows.description: As a user, I want to long-press the previous control, so that I can jump directly to the first matching occurrence.

flows.name: Jump to last match
flows.description: As a user, I want to long-press the next control, so that I can jump directly to the last matching occurrence.

flows.name: Know when already at first match
flows.description: As a user, I want to receive feedback when I long-press previous while already on the first occurrence, so that I know I cannot jump farther backward.

flows.name: Know when already at last match
flows.description: As a user, I want to receive feedback when I long-press next while already on the last occurrence, so that I know I cannot jump farther forward.

flows.name: Navigate to next match
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the next control, so that I can move forward through the matching occurrences.

flows.name: Navigate to previous match
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the previous control, so that I can move backward through the matching occurrences.

flows.name: See no-match feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a zero-match indication and disabled navigation controls when my query has no results, so that I understand there are no occurrences to navigate to.

flows.name: Use accessible find navigation controls
flows.description: As a user using accessibility services, I want the previous and next find controls to have descriptive labels, so that I can navigate search results with assistive technology.

flows.name: View match count
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the current match number and total number of matches for my query, so that I know where I am within the search results.

name: For You all modules off dialog
description:
Compose WikipediaAlertDialog shown when the user toggles off every For You module.
Offers a positive confirmation to keep all modules off or a cancel action that re-enables the last toggled module.

flows.name: Cancel disabling the final module
flows.description: As a For You settings user, I want to cancel after being warned about turning off every For You module, so that the last module I toggled off is re-enabled and the For You feed still has content.

flows.name: Confirm all modules disabled
flows.description: As a For You settings user, I want to confirm that all For You modules should remain disabled, so that my preference to hide every For You module is saved.

flows.name: Dismiss all modules off dialog
flows.description: As a For You settings user, I want to dismiss the all-modules-off warning using the system dialog dismissal behavior, so that I can return to the module settings screen without choosing a dialog button.

flows.name: Warn when disabling the final For You module
flows.description: As a For You settings user, I want to be warned when I turn off the last enabled For You module, so that I understand the For You feed will have no active modules before the change is finalized.

name: For You card surface and overflow menu
description: Full-screen personalized recommendation card component with image/text-only variants, article title/extract/description, footer metadata, and overflow dropdown actions for share, save, dismiss card, hide module, and customize interests.

flows.name: Browse multiple cards in a module
flows.description: As a reader, I want to swipe through multiple recommendation cards in the same For You module and see my position, so that I can explore all suggestions in that module.

flows.name: Customize interests from card
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open interest customization from a recommendation card's overflow menu, so that I can improve the personalization of future recommendations.

flows.name: Dismiss a recommendation card
flows.description: As a reader, I want to dismiss an individual recommendation card from the overflow menu, so that I no longer see that specific suggestion in my For You feed.

flows.name: Dismiss card overflow menu
flows.description: As a reader, I want to dismiss the card overflow menu without choosing an action, so that I can return to browsing recommendations unchanged.

flows.name: Hide recommendation module
flows.description: As a reader, I want to hide the current recommendation module from the card overflow menu, so that this type of For You content no longer appears in my feed.

flows.name: Manage hidden modules from empty feed
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open module management when all For You modules are hidden, so that I can re-enable content in my feed.

flows.name: Open Places recommendation setup
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the places call-to-action when location-based recommendations need setup, so that I can go to Places and enable nearby article discovery.

flows.name: Open card overflow menu
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the three-dot overflow button on a recommendation card, so that I can access actions for that card and module.

flows.name: Open recommended article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a For You recommendation card, so that I can open and read the suggested Wikipedia article.

flows.name: Retry failed feed loading
flows.description: As a reader, I want to retry loading For You content when the feed shows an error, so that I can recover from a temporary loading failure.

flows.name: Review recommendation details
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see the recommendation's image or text-only card, title, extract or description, and footer context, so that I can decide whether the article is relevant before opening it.

flows.name: Save recommended article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to save a recommended article from the card overflow menu, so that I can read it later from my default reading list.

flows.name: Share recommended article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to share a recommended article from the card overflow menu, so that I can send it to someone else without first opening the article.

flows.name: Shuffle random recommendation
flows.description: As a reader, I want to shuffle the random article recommendation from the card footer, so that I can get a different random article suggestion.

flows.name: Start personalization from empty feed
flows.description: As a reader, I want to add or customize interests from an empty or end-of-feed message, so that my For You feed can provide more personalized recommendations.

flows.name: Switch to Community from feed message
flows.description: As a reader, I want to navigate to the Community tab from an empty or end-of-feed message, so that I can continue discovering content when For You has no more recommendations.

name: For You empty/end-of-feed message view
description: Message/empty-state screenlet for the For You tab, used for no-data and end-of-feed states with illustration, title, description, and link-style rows to customize interests or switch to Community.

flows.name: Add interests from empty feed
flows.description: As a reader with an empty For You feed, I want to open interest customization from the empty-state action, so that I can add interests and improve personalized recommendations.

flows.name: Add interests from end of feed
flows.description: As a reader at the end of the For You feed, I want to open interest customization from the end-of-feed action, so that I can add new interests and improve future recommendations.

flows.name: Explore Community from empty feed
flows.description: As a reader with an empty For You feed, I want to switch to the Community tab from the empty-state action, so that I can find other content while my personalized feed has no items.

flows.name: Explore Community from end of feed
flows.description: As a reader at the end of the For You feed, I want to switch to the Community tab from the end-of-feed action, so that I can continue discovering content after finishing today’s recommendations.

flows.name: View empty For You feed guidance
flows.description: As a reader with no personalized For You content yet, I want to see an empty-feed message explaining that the feed will populate as I explore, so that I understand why no recommendations are currently shown and how to get started.

flows.name: View empty feed without interest action
flows.description: As a reader whose interest module is hidden, I want the empty For You message to omit the add-interests action while still offering other guidance, so that the screen only shows actions that are currently available to me.

flows.name: View end-of-feed guidance
flows.description: As a reader who reaches the end of today’s For You recommendations, I want to see an end-of-feed message explaining that new personalized articles will be available later, so that I understand there is no more For You content right now.

name: For You module pager widget
description: Reusable Compose horizontal pager widget for For You feed modules, including visibility/impression threshold tracking and a bottom page indicator when multiple cards are present.

flows.name: Swipe through module cards
flows.description: As a feed user, I want to swipe horizontally through a For You module's cards, so that I can browse multiple recommendations within the same module.

flows.name: Track visible card impressions
flows.description: As a feed user, I want a card to be considered viewed only when it is sufficiently visible in the pager, so that the app can accurately react to cards I have actually seen.

flows.name: View current page indicator
flows.description: As a feed user, I want to see a page indicator when a module has multiple cards, so that I know my current position and that more cards are available to browse.

name: For You modules settings screen
description:
Compose toggle-list settings screen for controlling visibility of For You feed modules, including Based on interest, Because you read, Continue reading, Places of interest, and Random.
Includes a description with a link to feed configuration.

flows.name: Cancel disabling all For You modules
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel when warned that all For You modules are off, so that the last disabled module is turned back on and my For You feed keeps at least one visible module.

flows.name: Confirm disabling all For You modules
flows.description: As a user, I want to continue after being warned that all For You modules are off, so that I can intentionally leave my For You feed empty.

flows.name: Dismiss all-modules-off warning
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the warning that my For You feed will be empty, so that I can return to the module settings without choosing a dialog action.

flows.name: Navigate back from For You module settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to go back from the For You modules settings screen, so that I can return to the previous settings screen or exit the settings flow.

flows.name: Open feed configuration from module description link
flows.description: As a user, I want to open feed configuration from the What's driving your feed link, so that I can understand and manage the data used to personalize my For You feed.

flows.name: Toggle Based on your interests module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Based on your interests module on or off, so that I can control whether interest-based recommendations appear in my For You feed.

flows.name: Toggle Because you read module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Because you read module on or off, so that I can control whether recommendations based on my reading history appear in my For You feed.

flows.name: Toggle Continue reading module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Continue reading module on or off, so that I can control whether unfinished or recent reading prompts appear in my For You feed.

flows.name: Toggle Places of interest module
