flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Places of interest module on or off, so that I can control whether location-related suggestions appear in my For You feed.

flows.name: Toggle Random module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn the Random module on or off, so that I can control whether random article suggestions appear in my For You feed.

name: Gallery full-screen media viewer
description:
Dark full-screen gallery Activity for viewing article media.
Uses a ViewPager2 of gallery pages, top toolbar with share/save/visit-image-page menu, linear loading indicator, bottom metadata panel with image/video description, editable caption button, suggested-edit CTA for adding captions/tags/translations, license icons and attribution text, transition preview image, and a full-screen WikiErrorView with retry/back actions.
Also shows a protected-page Material alert when caption editing is blocked; link clicks in description/credit can open link preview bottom sheet or external links.

flows.name: Add image tags
flows.description: As a logged-in contributor, I want to add structured image tags for the current media item, so that the media is easier to identify and discover.

flows.name: Add missing media caption
flows.description: As a logged-in contributor, I want to add a missing caption for the current media item, so that the gallery media is better described for readers.

flows.name: Browse article media gallery
flows.description: As a reader, I want to swipe through the article’s images and videos in a full-screen gallery, so that I can explore all media associated with the article.

flows.name: Close gallery viewer
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the back/up control to close the media viewer, so that I can return to the article or previous screen.

flows.name: Edit existing caption
flows.description: As a logged-in contributor, I want to edit the current media caption from the gallery, so that I can improve the caption without leaving the viewer.

flows.name: Handle save permission denial
flows.description: As a reader, I want to be informed when storage permission is needed or denied for saving media, so that I understand why the download cannot continue.

flows.name: Leave gallery from error state
flows.description: As a reader, I want to go back from the full-screen error view, so that I can return to the previous screen when the gallery cannot load.

flows.name: Navigate from link preview to article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open an article from a gallery link preview, so that I can continue reading the linked page in the main article view.

flows.name: Open external metadata links
flows.description: As a reader, I want external links in the media description or credit to open outside the gallery, so that I can view source or attribution information on the web.

flows.name: Open internal metadata links in preview
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap Wikipedia links in the media description or credit to see a link preview, so that I can inspect related pages without immediately leaving the gallery.

flows.name: Open license URL
flows.description: As a reader, I want to long-press the license area to open the license URL, so that I can read the full license terms.

flows.name: Play video media
flows.description: As a reader, I want to start playback for a video item from its thumbnail, so that I can watch videos included in the article gallery.

flows.name: Retry loading after gallery error
flows.description: As a reader, I want to retry loading the gallery after an error, so that I can recover from network or loading failures.

flows.name: Save current media
flows.description: As a reader, I want to download the current media item to my device, so that I can keep a local copy for later use.

flows.name: See protected caption warning
flows.description: As a logged-in contributor, I want to be warned when caption editing is blocked by page protection, so that I know why I cannot edit the media caption.

flows.name: Share current media
flows.description: As a reader, I want to share the currently displayed media item, so that I can send the image or its page link to another app.

flows.name: Show license name
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the license icons to see the license name, so that I can quickly understand the media’s usage terms.

flows.name: Toggle viewer controls
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the media to hide or show the toolbar and metadata panel, so that I can switch between an unobstructed media view and access to controls.

flows.name: Translate media caption
flows.description: As a multilingual contributor, I want to add a caption translation for the current media item, so that readers in another app language can understand the media.

flows.name: View media description and attribution
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see the media description, caption, license icons, and attribution, so that I can understand the media and its reuse terms.

flows.name: View selected media first
flows.description: As a reader, I want the gallery to open on the media item I selected from the article, so that I can immediately view the item I was interested in.

flows.name: Visit media file page
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the file page for the current media item, so that I can view more details and actions for that file.

flows.name: Zoom and pan media image
flows.description: As a reader, I want to zoom and pan an image in the full-screen viewer, so that I can inspect visual details more closely.

name: Gallery media page
description:
Per-item Fragment shown inside the gallery pager.
Displays a zoomable PhotoView for images or a video playback surface with thumbnail and large play button for videos, centered loading spinner, tap-to-toggle gallery controls, and menu actions for sharing, saving/downloading with runtime permission handling, and visiting the Commons/file page.
Reports media load/error state back to the Gallery Activity.

flows.name: Disable unavailable media actions
flows.description: As a gallery viewer, I want share, save, and file-page menu actions to be disabled until the current media information is available, so that I do not try actions that cannot yet succeed.

flows.name: Grant storage permission for saving
flows.description: As a gallery viewer on older Android versions, I want to grant storage write permission when saving media requires it, so that the app can complete the download.

flows.name: Handle image load error
flows.description: As a gallery viewer, I want to be notified when an image cannot be displayed, so that I understand why the media is unavailable.

flows.name: Handle video playback error
flows.description: As a gallery viewer, I want to be notified if a video cannot be played and returned to the preview state, so that I can recover without being stuck on a failed player.

flows.name: Play gallery video
flows.description: As a gallery viewer, I want to tap the video preview to load and play the video with playback controls, so that I can watch video media in the gallery.

flows.name: Save current media
flows.description: As a gallery viewer, I want to save or download the current media item from the gallery menu, so that I can keep a local copy on my device.

flows.name: See media loading progress
flows.description: As a gallery viewer, I want to see a centered loading indicator while media is being fetched or prepared, so that I know the page is working.

flows.name: Share current media
flows.description: As a gallery viewer, I want to share the current media item from the gallery menu, so that I can send it to another app or person.

flows.name: Toggle gallery controls
flows.description: As a gallery viewer, I want to tap the media to show or hide gallery controls, so that I can switch between an uncluttered media view and available actions/details.

flows.name: Understand denied save permission
flows.description: As a gallery viewer, I want to see an explanation when I deny the storage permission required for saving, so that I know why the media was not saved.

flows.name: View gallery image
flows.description: As a gallery viewer, I want to see the selected image loaded at an appropriate size, so that I can inspect the media item in the gallery.

flows.name: View video preview
flows.description: As a gallery viewer, I want to see a video thumbnail with a prominent play button, so that I can recognize video media before playing it.

flows.name: Visit media file page
flows.description: As a gallery viewer, I want to open the current media item's Commons or file page from the gallery menu, so that I can view source details and more information about the file.

flows.name: Zoom and pan image
flows.description: As a gallery viewer, I want to zoom and pan the displayed image, so that I can examine details closely while still being able to page away when zoomed out.

name: Gallery thumbnail strip widget
description:
Horizontal RecyclerView widget for thumbnail previews.
Renders square image thumbnails with press/release animations and notifies a listener when a thumbnail is clicked with the selected image view, thumb URL, and file name; used as an embeddable gallery entry/preview surface outside the full-screen viewer.

flows.name: Receive press feedback on thumbnails
flows.description: As a user, I want thumbnails to animate when I press and release them, so that I get clear visual feedback that my touch interaction is being recognized.

flows.name: Scroll through thumbnails
flows.description: As a user, I want to horizontally scroll through the thumbnail strip, so that I can browse gallery images beyond the thumbnails initially visible on screen.

flows.name: Select a thumbnail
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a thumbnail, so that the app can open or otherwise handle the selected gallery image using its thumbnail image, URL, and file name.

flows.name: View gallery thumbnail strip
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a horizontal strip of square image thumbnails, so that I can quickly preview the available gallery images from the embedded surface.

name: GalleryActivity
description: Fullscreen media gallery surface.

name: Games Hub
description: Compose-based hub listing available games by language, with language filter chips, pull-to-refresh, loading shimmer, error/retry state, On This Day today/recent/archive cards, unavailable-language snackbar, and launch paths into game play or results.

flows.name: Continue an in-progress On This Day game
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to continue an in-progress On This Day game from its card, so that I can resume where I left off.

flows.name: Filter games by supported language
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to select a supported language chip, so that the Games Hub reloads game cards for that language.

flows.name: Handle unsupported language
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to be informed when I select a language where games are unavailable and have an option to learn more, so that I understand why I cannot play in that language.

flows.name: Launch selected archive date game
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to select a date from the archive picker, so that I can launch the On This Day game for that date and language.

flows.name: Learn more about games
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to open a learn-more link from the Games Hub, so that I can read more information about Wikipedia games.

flows.name: Navigate back from Games Hub
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to use the toolbar back button to leave the Games Hub, so that I can return to where I came from.

flows.name: Open archive date picker
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to open the archive date picker from the Games Hub, so that I can choose an older On This Day game date to play.

flows.name: Open notifications
flows.description: As a logged-in Wikipedia app user, I want to open my notifications from the Games Hub toolbar, so that I can review unread or recent account notifications.

flows.name: Play a recent archive game
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to open an On This Day game from one of the recent date cards, so that I can play or revisit games from the last few days.

flows.name: Play today's On This Day game
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to start today's On This Day game from its game card, so that I can play the daily challenge.

flows.name: Refresh completed daily card after countdown
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want the completed daily game card to update when its countdown finishes, so that the next available daily game appears without manually leaving the screen.

flows.name: Refresh games
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to pull to refresh the Games Hub, so that I can reload the latest game availability and progress states.

flows.name: Retry after loading error
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to retry loading games when an error is shown, so that I can recover from network or loading failures.

flows.name: Review today's game results
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to review results for a completed daily On This Day game, so that I can see how I performed.

flows.name: View game stats
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to open my game stats from the Games Hub overflow menu, so that I can see my game activity and progress.

flows.name: View games hub content
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to view the Games Hub with available languages and On This Day game cards for today, recent days, and archives, so that I can discover games I can play or review.

name: GamesHubActivity
description: Games hub surface.

name: General Compose UI Widgets
description: Shared Compose UI building blocks: language-code box, buttons, text with inline element, charts, skeleton loader, async image, HTML/license text helpers.

name: Google Pay Donation
description: Donation checkout screen for Google Play flavor that lets users enter/select a donation amount, choose transaction fee/recurring/email options, launch Google Pay, handle loading/error states, and report success back to the caller.

flows.name: Cancel Google Pay payment
flows.description: As a donor, I want to cancel the Google Pay payment flow, so that I can return to the donation checkout without completing a donation.

flows.name: Choose preset donation amount
flows.description: As a donor, I want to choose a preset donation amount, so that I can quickly fill the donation amount without typing it manually.

flows.name: Complete donation successfully
flows.description: As a donor, I want my successful Google Pay donation to be submitted and reported back to the app, so that my donation is recorded and I can continue from the calling flow.

flows.name: Cover transaction fee
flows.description: As a donor, I want to choose whether to add the transaction fee to my donation, so that more of my intended donation reaches Wikimedia.

flows.name: Enter custom donation amount
flows.description: As a donor, I want to type a custom donation amount, so that I can donate an amount that matches my preference.

flows.name: Handle checkout loading failure
flows.description: As a donor, I want to see an error state if the donation checkout cannot load, so that I know something went wrong and can leave the screen.

flows.name: Leave donation checkout
flows.description: As a donor, I want to navigate back from the Google Pay donation checkout, so that I can return to where I came from without donating.

flows.name: Make donation recurring
flows.description: As a donor, I want to choose whether my donation is recurring, so that I can set up monthly support when I want to.

flows.name: Open Google Pay to donate
flows.description: As a donor, I want to open Google Pay with my selected amount and options, so that I can authorize the donation securely with my Google Pay payment method.

flows.name: Open disclaimer links
flows.description: As a donor, I want to open links in the donation disclaimers, so that I can read related privacy or cancellation information before donating.

flows.name: Open donation FAQ
flows.description: As a donor, I want to open the donation FAQ, so that I can learn answers to common questions before donating.

flows.name: Open donation problem help
flows.description: As a donor, I want to open help for problems donating, so that I can get assistance if the donation flow does not work for me.

flows.name: Open other ways to give
flows.description: As a donor, I want to open information about other ways to give, so that I can choose another donation method if Google Pay is not right for me.

flows.name: Open tax deductibility information
flows.description: As a donor, I want to open tax deductibility information, so that I can understand whether my donation may be tax deductible.

flows.name: Opt in to email updates
flows.description: As a donor in a country where email opt-in is required, I want to choose whether Wikimedia may send me email, so that my communication preference is respected.

flows.name: See Google Pay payment error
flows.description: As a donor, I want to see an error message if Google Pay cannot start or process my payment request, so that I know the donation was not completed through that attempt.

flows.name: See donation amount validation errors
flows.description: As a donor, I want to be warned when my donation amount is below the minimum or above the maximum, so that I can correct it before opening Google Pay.

flows.name: Use alternate donate link when Google Pay is unavailable
flows.description: As a donor without an available Google Pay donation method, I want to be sent to the regular donation link, so that I still have a way to donate.

flows.name: View Google Pay donation checkout
flows.description: As a donor, I want to open the Google Pay donation checkout and see available donation options in my currency, so that I can decide how much and how to donate.

flows.name: Wait while donation content loads
flows.description: As a donor, I want to see a loading indicator while donation configuration and payment information are being prepared, so that I understand the checkout is still loading.

name: History filter action mode
description:
Contextual search/filter surface launched from the History screen.
Hides the bottom nav and presents an ActionMode search field backed by SearchActionProvider for filtering history results.

flows.name: Clear filter query
flows.description: As a user, I want to clear the text in the filter search field, so that I can return to seeing the unfiltered history results while staying in filter mode.

flows.name: Delete filtered history item by swiping
flows.description: As a user, I want to swipe a history result while filtering, so that I can remove that page from my history without leaving the filtered list.

flows.name: Enter history filter mode
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the history filter action mode from the History screen, so that I can focus on searching my browsing history without the bottom navigation taking space.

flows.name: Exit history filter mode
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the history filter action mode, so that my query is cleared and I can return to the normal History screen with bottom navigation visible.

flows.name: Filter history by text
flows.description: As a user, I want to type a query in the action mode search field, so that I can narrow my history list to matching pages.

flows.name: Open filtered history item
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a history result while filtering, so that I can reopen the matching page from my history.

flows.name: Undo deleted filtered history item

flows.name: View no filter results state

name: History screen
description:
Fragment showing browsing history in the main app.
Includes a search card header with voice search/filter/clear actions, date section headers, history article rows with thumbnails/offline greying, empty states, swipe-to-delete, and multi-select behavior.

flows.name: Cancel clearing all history
flows.description: As a reader, I want to cancel the clear-history confirmation dialog, so that I can keep my browsing history unchanged if I change my mind.

flows.name: Clear all history
flows.description: As a reader, I want to clear all browsing history after confirming a warning dialog, so that I can remove my entire local history record.

flows.name: Delete selected history items
flows.description: As a reader, I want to delete the articles I selected in history, so that I can remove multiple unwanted entries in one action.

flows.name: Exit history filtering
flows.description: As a reader, I want to exit the history filter mode, so that I can return to the full unfiltered history list and normal navigation.

flows.name: Exit multi-select mode
flows.description: As a reader, I want to leave multi-select mode by backing out or deselecting everything, so that I can return to normal history browsing without performing an action.

flows.name: Filter history by text
flows.description: As a reader, I want to filter my browsing history by typing a query, so that I can find previously viewed articles matching the text.

flows.name: Identify offline-unavailable history items
flows.description: As an offline reader, I want history articles that are unavailable offline to appear visually greyed out with an explanatory toast, so that I know which previously viewed pages may not open without a connection.

flows.name: Open history article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap an article in my history, so that I can reopen and continue reading that page.

flows.name: See no filter results
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see a no-results message when my history filter matches nothing, so that I understand there are no matching history entries.

flows.name: Select multiple history items
flows.description: As a reader, I want to long-press a history article to enter multi-select mode and tap additional articles to select or deselect them, so that I can manage multiple history entries at once.

flows.name: Start article search
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the search card on the History screen, so that I can search Wikipedia from my history area.

flows.name: Start voice search
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the voice search button when available, so that I can search Wikipedia by speaking instead of typing.

flows.name: Swipe delete history item
flows.description: As a reader, I want to swipe a history article row to delete it, so that I can remove an individual page from my browsing history quickly.

flows.name: Undo deleted history items
flows.description: As a reader, I want to undo a recent history deletion from the snackbar, so that I can restore articles I removed by mistake.

flows.name: View browsing history
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view my recent browsing history grouped by date with article titles, descriptions, and thumbnails, so that I can quickly find pages I have read before.

flows.name: View empty history state
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see an empty state when I have no browsing history, so that I know there are no recently viewed articles to show.

name: Home feed language dropdown menu
description:
Popup dropdown opened from the language code pill in the Home tab bar.
Lists app languages with current-language checkmark and a Manage languages action.

flows.name: Dismiss language dropdown
flows.description: As a home feed user, I want to dismiss the language dropdown without choosing an option, so that I can return to the feed unchanged.

flows.name: Identify current feed language
flows.description: As a home feed user, I want the currently selected feed language to be marked with a checkmark in the dropdown, so that I can confirm which language is active.

flows.name: Open language dropdown
flows.description: As a home feed user, I want to tap the language code pill in the Home tab bar to open a dropdown menu, so that I can see language-related actions for the feed.

flows.description: As a home feed user, I want to choose Manage languages from the dropdown, so that I can add, remove, or reorder the app languages available for the Home feed.

flows.name: Switch feed language
flows.description: As a home feed user, I want to select a language from the dropdown, so that the Home feed changes to content for that language and remembers my selection.

flows.name: View available feed languages
flows.description: As a home feed user, I want to see my app languages listed with their language codes and localized names, so that I can recognize which language feeds are available to choose from.

Main Compose-backed Home tab hosted by HomeFragment.
Shows the Wikipedia wordmark toolbar, tab count and notifications, Community/For you tab switcher, language selector, pull-to-refresh, and either community feed cards or personalized For You full-screen modules with loading, error, empty, and load-more states.

flows.name: Change feed language
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the language selector and choose one of my app languages, so that the home feed content is shown in that language.

flows.name: Complete home feed update prompt
flows.description: As a returning user, I want to respond to the home feed update prompt, so that I can set up or customize the new home feed experience before using the tab.

flows.name: Customize For You interests
flows.description: As a user, I want to open interest customization from For You cards or empty/end-of-feed messages, so that my personalized recommendations better match my interests.

flows.name: Dismiss feed card
flows.description: As a user, I want to hide an individual feed card and optionally undo it, so that unwanted recommendations are removed from my home feed.

flows.name: Dismiss swipe prompt
flows.description: As a user, I want to acknowledge the swipe-to-explore prompt, so that I can continue browsing For You content without the prompt reappearing.

flows.name: Download featured image
flows.description: As a user, I want to download the featured image from its feed card, so that I can keep a copy on my device.

flows.name: Go to Places from location prompt
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Places call to action when location-based recommendations need setup, so that I can configure or use Places to get nearby article recommendations.

flows.name: Hide feed module
flows.description: As a user, I want to hide an entire feed module and optionally undo it, so that categories of content I do not want no longer appear in the home feed.

flows.name: Load more community content
flows.description: As a user, I want to load more Community feed cards, so that I can continue browsing older feed content.

flows.name: Manage feed languages
flows.description: As a user, I want to open language management from the feed language menu, so that I can add or edit the languages available for the home feed.

flows.name: Manage hidden or disabled modules
flows.description: As a user, I want to open feed module settings from an empty feed state, so that I can re-enable or customize the modules shown on the current tab.

flows.name: Navigate from For You message to Community

flows.name: Open article from feed card

flows.name: Open more items for community modules
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a module footer for Top read, On this day, or Did you know, so that I can see the full list for that module.

flows.name: Open news item
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a news item in the Community feed, so that I can explore articles related to that news story.

flows.name: Open notifications
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the notification bell, so that I can review my Wikipedia notifications.

flows.name: Open random article shuffle
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the shuffle control in the random recommendation module, so that I can discover a random article.

flows.name: Open tab switcher
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the open-tabs count in the home toolbar, so that I can view and manage my browser tabs.

flows.name: Refresh current feed
flows.description: As a user, I want to pull down to refresh the selected home feed tab, so that I can fetch the latest community or personalized content.

flows.name: Retry feed after error
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry loading the feed when an error is shown, so that I can recover from network or loading failures.

flows.description: As a user, I want to save an article from a feed card to my reading list, so that I can read it later.

flows.name: Share feed article
flows.description: As a user, I want to share an article from a feed card, so that I can send it to someone else or another app.

flows.name: Swipe through For You modules

flows.name: Switch home feed tabs

flows.name: Use article overflow actions

name: Home feed settings screen

Root Compose settings screen for home feed configuration.

flows.name: Exit home feed settings

flows.name: Open feed data information
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the information about what is driving my For You feed, so that I can understand and adjust the data used to personalize my feed.

flows.description: As a search user, I want to tap the hybrid search information icon, so that I can see options for learning about or opting out of hybrid search.

flows.name: Turn off hybrid search experiment
flows.description: As a search user, I want to turn off the hybrid search experiment from the information menu, so that future searches use the standard search experience while keeping my current query.

name: Hybrid Search Onboarding
description:
Full-screen Compose onboarding activity for the hybrid search experiment.
Presents a beta-tagged title, explanatory onboarding items, suggested example query chips, Learn More action, and bottom Get Started action that proceeds to Search.

flows.name: Learn more about hybrid search
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to tap Learn More, so that I can open additional information about hybrid search in an external browser.

flows.name: Review hybrid search onboarding
flows.description: As an eligible Wikipedia user, I want to see a beta-tagged hybrid search onboarding screen with explanatory items, so that I understand what the hybrid search experiment offers before using it.

flows.name: Scroll onboarding content
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user on a smaller screen, I want to scroll the onboarding content, so that I can read all explanations and access the suggested query examples.

flows.name: Search with an example query
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to tap a suggested example query, so that Search opens with that query and hybrid search is initiated immediately.

flows.name: Start search without a preset query
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to tap Get Started to continue to the Search screen, so that I can begin using hybrid search with my own query.

flows.name: View localized suggested searches
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to see suggested example search queries localized for my app language when available, so that I can quickly understand the kinds of questions hybrid search can answer.

name: Hybrid Search Results
description:
Compose results surface for hybrid semantic search, combining lexical result rows with horizontally scrolling semantic result cards depending on A/B group.
Includes loading skeletons, error view, semantic result snippets with links, article-row navigation, feedback thumbs, and empty-result toast hooks.

flows.name: Browse semantic result cards horizontally
flows.description: As a search user, I want to horizontally scroll through semantic result cards, so that I can review multiple meaning-based results without leaving the results screen.

flows.name: Close search from error state
flows.description: As a search user, I want to go back or close search from the error view, so that I can leave the failed search experience.

flows.name: Give negative semantic result feedback
flows.description: As a search user, I want to tap the thumbs-down button on a semantic result, so that I can indicate that the result was not useful.

flows.name: Give positive semantic result feedback
flows.description: As a search user, I want to tap the thumbs-up button on a semantic result, so that I can indicate that the result was useful.

flows.name: Learn more about semantic search
flows.description: As a search user, I want to select the learn-more option from the semantic search menu, so that I can read more information about the beta semantic search feature.

flows.name: Open lexical result long-press menu
flows.description: As a search user, I want to long-press a lexical article row, so that I can access additional actions for that result.

flows.name: Open lexical search result
flows.description: As a search user, I want to tap a lexical article row, so that I can open the selected article.

flows.name: Open linked article from semantic snippet
flows.description: As a search user, I want to tap a link inside a semantic result snippet, so that I can open the linked Wikipedia article directly.

flows.name: Open semantic result article row
flows.description: As a search user, I want to tap the article row at the bottom of a semantic result card, so that I can open that card's article from its title and description area.

flows.name: Open semantic result from card snippet
flows.description: As a search user, I want to tap the main body of a semantic result card, so that I can open the article associated with that semantic result.

flows.name: Open semantic search info menu
flows.description: As a search user, I want to tap the semantic search information icon, so that I can see actions related to the beta semantic search experience.

flows.name: Receive lexical results empty message
flows.description: As a search user, I want to be notified when lexical search results are empty, so that I understand why standard article rows are not shown.

flows.name: Receive semantic results empty message
flows.description: As a search user, I want to be notified when semantic search results are empty, so that I understand why semantic cards are not shown.

flows.name: Retry failed hybrid search
flows.description: As a search user, I want to retry when hybrid search fails, so that I can attempt to load results again after an error.

flows.name: Turn off hybrid search experiment
flows.description: As a search user, I want to turn off the hybrid search experiment from the semantic search menu, so that I can return to the standard search experience for my query.

flows.name: View hybrid search loading state
flows.description: As a search user, I want to see loading skeletons while hybrid search results are being fetched, so that I know the search is in progress.

flows.name: View lexical search results
flows.description: As a search user, I want to see matching article result rows from lexical search, so that I can choose a relevant article from standard search results.

flows.name: View localized result layout direction
flows.description: As a search user reading in a right-to-left language, I want the hybrid search results layout to follow my language direction, so that the results are easier to read and navigate.

flows.name: View semantic search result cards
flows.description: As a search user, I want to see semantic result cards with snippets in a horizontal carousel, so that I can discover results related to the meaning of my query.

name: Hybrid Search Suggestions
description: Compose suggestion list shown during hybrid-search experiment before semantic search is opened: title-only lexical suggestions and a fixed bottom call-to-action to run semantic search for the current query when no title matches.

flows.name: Close search after suggestion loading error
flows.description: As a search user, I want to close the search screen from the error state, so that I can leave search when suggestions cannot be loaded.

flows.name: Open semantic search from a title suggestion
flows.description: As a search user in the hybrid-search experiment, I want to tap a lexical title suggestion, so that semantic search opens using that article title as the query.

flows.name: Retry after suggestion loading error
flows.description: As a search user, I want to retry the search when the suggestion list fails to load, so that I can recover from a temporary error without leaving search.

flows.name: Run semantic search for unmatched query
flows.description: As a search user in the hybrid-search experiment, I want to tap the bottom “Search for” call-to-action when no displayed title matches my query, so that I can search semantically for the exact text I entered.

flows.name: Run semantic search when no title results exist
flows.description: As a search user in the hybrid-search experiment, I want to see and tap a “Search for” call-to-action when lexical search returns no article titles, so that I can still continue with semantic search for my query.

flows.name: View title-only lexical suggestions
flows.description: As a search user in the hybrid-search experiment, I want to see a list of matching article titles with my typed query emphasized, so that I can quickly recognize possible title matches before opening semantic search.

name: HybridSearchOnboardingActivity
description: Hybrid search onboarding surface.

name: Image preview bottom sheet
description:
Bottom-sheet dialog for previewing image/file details.
Displays a title header, loading/error states, and the reusable FilePageView content with image, caption/tags and metadata; dismisses from the toolbar/header area and sets a custom peek height.

flows.name: Dismiss image preview
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the image preview header to dismiss the bottom sheet, so that I can return to the previous screen when I am done previewing the file.

flows.name: Open file page for more information
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the more information file-page link, so that I can view the full file page on Commons or Wikipedia.

flows.name: Open license link
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the license information link, so that I can open the full license details in a browser.

flows.name: Open links in detail text
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap links contained in image detail text, so that I can navigate to related Wikipedia pages or external resources.

flows.name: Scroll image details
flows.description: As a user, I want to scroll through the bottom sheet content, so that I can review all available image details even when they do not fit on the screen.

flows.name: Select detail text
flows.description: As a user, I want to select text in image detail fields, so that I can copy or reuse caption and metadata information.

flows.name: View image caption or description
flows.description: As a user, I want to view the image caption or description in the preview, so that I can understand what the image depicts.

flows.name: View image metadata
flows.description: As a user, I want to view image metadata such as author, date, source, and license, so that I can understand attribution and reuse information for the file.

flows.name: View image preview title
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the file or image title in the bottom sheet header, so that I can identify which item I am previewing.

flows.name: View image tags
flows.description: As a user, I want to view the image tags in my relevant language when available, so that I can understand the depicted subjects associated with the file.

flows.name: View preview error state
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error message if image details cannot be loaded, so that I understand why the preview content is unavailable.

flows.name: View preview image
flows.description: As a user, I want to view the image in the preview sheet at an appropriate size, so that I can inspect the visual content before taking any further action.

flows.name: View preview loading state
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a loading indicator while image details are being fetched, so that I know the preview is still being prepared.

flows.name: Zoom preview image
flows.description: As a user, I want to zoom into the preview image, so that I can inspect image details more closely.

name: Initial onboarding flow
description:
Full-screen Compose onboarding shown on first app launch.
Presents a multi-step flow with intro, data privacy, and app languages pages; includes forward navigation, links to About/Privacy/Terms, add-language action, and finishes into personalization.

flows.name: Add app language
flows.description: As a new user, I want to tap Add language during onboarding, so that I can choose additional Wikipedia languages for the app.

flows.name: Advance through onboarding pages
flows.description: As a new user, I want to tap the forward button to move through the onboarding steps, so that I can continue the setup flow at my own pace.

flows.name: Finish initial onboarding
flows.description: As a new user, I want to tap the forward button on the final onboarding page, so that onboarding is completed and I can continue to personalization.

flows.name: Open About Wikipedia from intro
flows.description: As a new user, I want to tap the Learn more link on the introduction page, so that I can read more information about Wikipedia.

flows.name: Open privacy policy
flows.description: As a new user, I want to tap the privacy policy link in the data privacy page, so that I can read the app’s privacy policy.

flows.name: Open terms of use
flows.description: As a new user, I want to tap the terms of use link in the data privacy page, so that I can read the terms that apply to using Wikipedia.

flows.name: Persist onboarding completion
flows.description: As a new user, I want the app to remember that I completed initial onboarding, so that the same introductory flow is not shown again on future launches.

flows.name: Review app languages
flows.description: As a new user, I want to view my current app languages and primary language, so that I know which languages Wikipedia will use for my experience.

flows.name: Review data privacy information
flows.description: As a new user, I want to view the data privacy onboarding page, so that I understand how privacy is presented before using the app.

flows.name: Scroll language list
flows.description: As a new user, I want to scroll the app language list when it contains multiple languages, so that I can review all selected languages during onboarding.

flows.name: See updated languages after returning
flows.description: As a new user, I want the onboarding language page to reflect language changes after I return from language selection, so that I can confirm my chosen app languages before finishing.

flows.name: View onboarding introduction
flows.description: As a new user, I want to see an introductory Wikipedia onboarding page on first launch, so that I understand the app’s purpose before getting started.

name: InitialOnboardingActivity
description: Initial app onboarding surface.

name: Insert media advanced settings panel
description:
Fragment surface for configuring advanced inserted-image options: wrap image toggle, image position, image type, and image size.
Presents Save action in the host toolbar and launches option pickers as bottom sheets.

flows.name: Choose image display type
flows.description: As an editor, I want to choose the image display type from thumbnail, frame, frameless, or basic, so that the inserted image uses the presentation style I need.

flows.name: Choose wrapped image position
flows.description: As an editor, I want to choose the position of a wrapped image from right, center, or left, so that the image appears in the desired location in the article layout.

flows.name: Configure image size
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open the image size picker and choose between the default size and a custom size, so that the inserted image uses an appropriate display size.

flows.name: Enter custom image dimensions
flows.description: As an editor, I want to enter custom width and height pixel values for the image, so that I can control the exact displayed dimensions of the inserted media.

flows.name: Read image type guidance
flows.description: As an editor, I want to see guidance in the image type picker, so that I can better understand which display type to select.

flows.name: Reset image size to default
flows.description: As an editor, I want to turn off custom image sizing, so that the image size returns to the default dimensions.

flows.name: Return from advanced settings
flows.description: As an editor, I want to go back from the advanced settings panel to the media caption/settings panel, so that I can continue editing the image insertion without changing screens unexpectedly.

flows.name: Save advanced media settings
flows.description: As an editor, I want to save my advanced inserted-image settings, so that my chosen wrap, position, type, and size options are applied when I continue inserting the image.

flows.name: Toggle image wrapping
flows.description: As an editor, I want to turn image wrapping on or off, so that the inserted image can either float within article text or appear with no wrapping.

flows.name: View current advanced settings
flows.description: As an editor, I want to see the current wrap, position, type, and size selections when the advanced settings panel opens, so that I understand what options will be applied before saving.

name: Insert media caption and alternative text settings panel
description: Fragment surface shown within InsertMediaActivity for entering image caption and alternative text, with voice-input end icons, help links, image info preview bottom sheet trigger, validation-driven Insert/Continue action enablement, and advanced settings navigation.

flows.name: Continue recommendation flow with text
flows.description: As an editor reviewing a recommended image, I want the Continue action to become available only after both caption and alternative text are provided, so that I can proceed with an accepted recommendation that includes the required metadata.

flows.name: Dictate alternative text by voice
flows.description: As an editor, I want to use voice input to fill the alternative text field, so that I can add accessibility text without typing.

flows.name: Dictate caption by voice
flows.description: As an editor, I want to use voice input to fill the caption field, so that I can add caption text without typing.

flows.name: Enter alternative text
flows.description: As an editor, I want to enter or edit alternative text for the selected image, so that the inserted media is accessible to users who cannot see the image.

flows.name: Enter media caption
flows.description: As an editor, I want to enter or edit a caption for the selected image, so that the inserted media has descriptive text for readers.

flows.name: Handle unavailable voice input
flows.description: As an editor, I want to be notified when voice input is not available, so that I understand why dictation cannot be used.

flows.name: Insert media with required text
flows.description: As an editor, I want the Insert action to become available only after both caption and alternative text are provided, so that I insert media with the required descriptive information.

flows.name: Open advanced media settings
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open advanced media settings from the caption panel, so that I can configure how the image will be inserted.

flows.name: Open alternative text help
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open the alternative text guidance link, so that I can learn how to write useful accessibility text.

flows.name: Open caption help
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open the caption guidance link, so that I can learn how to write an appropriate image caption.

flows.name: Preview selected image details
flows.description: As an editor, I want to tap the selected image information card to view an image preview and details, so that I can verify I am captioning the correct media.

flows.name: Restore existing caption and alternative text
flows.description: As an editor, I want previously supplied caption and alternative text to appear when the panel opens, so that I can review or revise existing insert-media values without retyping them.

flows.name: Return from caption panel
flows.description: As an editor, I want to press Back from the caption panel, so that I can return to image selection or leave the insert-media flow when no selection list is available.

name: Insert media custom image size bottom sheet
description:
Bottom-sheet dialog for default versus custom image size.
Provides a custom-size switch and width/height text fields, enables/disables fields with the switch, persists width x height into InsertMediaViewModel on dismiss, and refreshes the advanced settings summary.

flows.name: Enable custom image size
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn on custom image size, so that I can edit the width and height fields for the image I am inserting.

flows.name: Enter custom image dimensions
flows.description: As a user, I want to enter numeric width and height values in pixels, so that the inserted image uses my desired custom dimensions.

flows.name: Open image size settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the image size bottom sheet from advanced media settings, so that I can review or change the size used for the inserted image.

flows.name: Refresh image size summary
flows.description: As a user, I want the advanced settings screen to update its image size summary after the bottom sheet closes, so that I can see whether the image size is default or custom.

flows.name: Return to default image size
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn off custom image size, so that the image size resets to the app's default dimensions and the custom fields are disabled.

flows.name: Review current image size mode
flows.description: As a user, I want the image size bottom sheet to show whether the current size is default or custom and to display the current width and height values, so that I can understand the image size setting before making changes.

flows.name: Save image size on dismiss
flows.description: As a user, I want my selected image width and height to be saved when I close the bottom sheet, so that the setting is applied to the media insertion flow.

name: Insert media image position picker bottom sheet
description:
Bottom-sheet dialog for choosing inserted image position (right, center, left).
Displays selectable rows with bold text and checkmark state, updates the shared InsertMediaViewModel, notifies the advanced settings panel, and dismisses on selection.

flows.name: Dismiss image position picker without changing selection
flows.description: As a user choosing an image position, I want to dismiss the bottom sheet without selecting a new option, so that I can keep the current image position unchanged.

flows.name: Open image position picker
flows.description: As a user configuring inserted media advanced settings, I want to open the image position picker from the Image position control, so that I can choose where the inserted image will be placed.

flows.name: Return to advanced settings after position selection
flows.description: As a user selecting an image position, I want the picker to close after I choose an option, so that I can continue editing the remaining advanced media settings.

flows.name: Select center image position
flows.description: As a user choosing an image position, I want to select Center, so that the inserted image is centered and the advanced settings summary is updated.

flows.name: Select left image position
flows.description: As a user choosing an image position, I want to select Left, so that the inserted image is positioned on the left and the advanced settings summary is updated.

flows.name: Select right image position
flows.description: As a user choosing an image position, I want to select Right, so that the inserted image is positioned on the right and the advanced settings summary is updated.

flows.name: View current image position selection
flows.description: As a user choosing an image position, I want the currently selected position to be shown with bold text and a checkmark, so that I can understand the existing setting before making a change.

name: Insert media image type picker bottom sheet
description:
Bottom-sheet dialog for choosing inserted image type (thumbnail, frame, frameless, basic).
Displays selectable rows with selected-state bolding/checkmark, updates the shared InsertMediaViewModel, notifies the advanced settings panel, and dismisses on selection.

flows.name: Dismiss picker after selection
flows.description: As an editor configuring inserted media, I want the image type picker to close after I choose an option, so that I can return directly to advanced settings with the selected value shown.

flows.name: Open image type picker
flows.description: As an editor configuring inserted media, I want to open the image type picker from advanced settings, so that I can choose how the image should be rendered in the article.

flows.name: Read image type guidance
flows.description: As an editor configuring inserted media, I want to read guidance about image type choices in the picker, so that I can make an informed selection.

flows.name: Select basic image type
flows.description: As an editor configuring inserted media, I want to select the basic image type, so that the inserted image uses basic rendering without an image-type magic word in the article markup.

flows.name: Select framed image type
flows.description: As an editor configuring inserted media, I want to select the framed image type, so that the inserted image uses framed rendering in the article markup.

flows.name: Select frameless image type
flows.description: As an editor configuring inserted media, I want to select the frameless image type, so that the inserted image uses frameless rendering in the article markup.

flows.name: Select thumbnail image type
flows.description: As an editor configuring inserted media, I want to select the thumbnail image type, so that the inserted image uses thumbnail rendering in the article markup.

flows.name: View current image type selection
flows.description: As an editor configuring inserted media, I want to see which image type is currently selected in the picker, so that I can understand the current setting before changing it.

name: Insert media search and selection screen
description:
Activity UI for searching Wikimedia Commons media in a grid, selecting an image, previewing the selected image, opening file details, and progressing to caption/alt-text settings.
Includes toolbar actions, search action mode, refresh/empty/loading states, and selected-image header behavior.

flows.name: Choose image position
flows.description: As an editor, I want to choose the image position, so that the inserted image is aligned right, center, or left as needed.

flows.name: Choose image type
flows.description: As an editor, I want to choose the image type, so that the inserted image uses the thumbnail, frame, frameless, or basic display style I prefer.

flows.name: Continue from preselected recommendation
flows.description: As an editor reviewing an image recommendation, I want the screen to open directly to caption entry for a preselected image, so that I can quickly accept the recommendation and continue.

flows.name: Dictate caption or alternative text
flows.description: As an editor, I want to use voice input for the caption or alternative text fields, so that I can fill them more easily without typing.

flows.name: Enter caption and alternative text
flows.description: As an editor, I want to enter an image caption and alternative text, so that the inserted image is understandable and accessible.

flows.name: Handle unavailable voice input
flows.description: As an editor, I want to be informed when voice input is unavailable, so that I understand why dictation cannot be started.

flows.name: Insert selected image
flows.description: As an editor, I want to insert the selected image after providing caption and alternative text, so that the image and its metadata are returned to the editor.

flows.name: Navigate back through insert media steps
flows.description: As an editor, I want the Back action to return from advanced settings to caption entry, from caption entry to search results, or close the screen when appropriate, so that I can revise choices or cancel the flow.

flows.name: Open advanced image settings
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open advanced image settings from the caption screen, so that I can customize how the image will appear in wikitext.

flows.name: Open caption and alt-text guidance
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open the caption and alternative text help links, so that I can learn how to write suitable image text.

flows.name: Open selected image file details
flows.description: As an editor, I want to tap the selected image preview to open its file details page, so that I can inspect the image before inserting it.

flows.name: Preview image from settings
flows.description: As an editor, I want to tap the image information area on the caption screen to preview the selected image, so that I can confirm I am describing the correct media.

flows.name: Preview selected image header
flows.description: As an editor, I want the selected image to appear in the header, so that I can review the current choice before continuing.

flows.name: Proceed to caption and alt text
flows.description: As an editor, I want to continue after selecting an image, so that I can add the required caption and alternative text before insertion.

flows.name: Refresh media results
flows.description: As an editor, I want to pull to refresh the media search results, so that I can retry or update the Commons results list.

flows.name: Save advanced settings
flows.description: As an editor, I want to save advanced image settings, so that my custom image appearance choices are kept when I return to the caption workflow.

flows.name: Search Commons media
flows.description: As an editor, I want to edit the media search query from the search bar, so that I can search Wikimedia Commons for images relevant to my article.

flows.name: See empty search state
flows.description: As an editor, I want to see an empty-state message when a Commons search has no image results, so that I understand there is nothing to select for the current query.

flows.name: See media loading state
flows.description: As an editor, I want to see a loading indicator while media results or a selected image preview are loading, so that I know the screen is working.

flows.name: Select or deselect an image
flows.description: As an editor, I want to tap a media result to select it, or tap it again to deselect it, so that I control which image will be inserted.

flows.name: Set image size
flows.description: As an editor, I want to use the default image size or enter a custom width and height, so that the inserted image has the appropriate dimensions.

flows.name: Toggle image wrapping
flows.description: As an editor, I want to turn image wrapping on or off, so that I can choose whether article text flows around the inserted image.

flows.name: View media search results grid
flows.description: As an editor, I want to view Wikimedia Commons media search results in a grid with thumbnails and descriptions, so that I can find an image to insert.

name: Insert template parameters panel
description:
Fragment overlay/panel within the template search flow shown after a template is selected.
Displays the template title, description, missing-TemplateData notice with links, learn-more action, and dynamic required/suggested/optional parameter text fields used to generate inserted wikitext.

flows.name: Dismiss insert panel
flows.description: As a user, I want to press Back from the insert parameters panel, so that I can dismiss it and return to the template search results without inserting the template.

flows.name: Enter template parameter values
flows.description: As a user, I want to fill in required, suggested, and optional template parameter fields with visible labels, descriptions, and example values, so that I can customize the inserted template wikitext accurately.

flows.name: Insert generated template wikitext
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap Insert after entering parameter values, so that the app generates template wikitext from the selected template and non-empty parameters and returns it to the editor.

flows.name: Open template help page
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap Learn more to open the selected template page externally, so that I can get additional information about the template before using it.

flows.name: Review selected template details
flows.description: As a user, I want to review the selected template's title and description in the insert panel, so that I can confirm I am configuring the correct template before inserting it.

flows.name: Scroll parameter form
flows.description: As a user, I want to scroll through the template parameter panel, so that I can view and complete all available fields when a template has more parameters than fit on screen.

flows.name: Understand missing TemplateData
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a notice when a template is missing TemplateData and read links about TemplateData and autogenerated parameters, so that I understand why parameter information may be incomplete.

flows.name: Validate required parameters
flows.description: As a user, I want the Insert action to remain disabled until all required template parameters are filled, so that I do not accidentally insert an incomplete required template configuration.

name: InsertMediaActivity
description: Media insertion/search surface while editing.

name: LangLinksActivity
description: Language links selection surface for an article/page.

name: Language link row widget
description: Reusable Compose list row displaying localized language name, optional canonical language name, and article title; used within the language links screen.

flows.name: Select language link
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a language link row, so that I can open the current article in that selected language.

flows.name: View language link details
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see each available language with its localized language name, optional canonical language name, and translated article title, so that I can understand which article and language I am choosing.

flows.name: View language without canonical name
flows.description: As a reader, I want language rows without a canonical language name to omit that secondary label, so that the row only shows relevant language and article information.

name: Language links screen
description:
Compose activity for choosing an article's available languages.
Shows a searchable top app bar, loading/error/empty states, section headers, and tappable language rows that return the selected page language.

flows.name: Clear or exit language search
flows.description: As a reader, I want to clear my language search or return from search mode to the normal app bar, so that I can reset the list and browse all available languages again.

flows.name: Dismiss language links
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the back button in the top app bar, so that I can leave the language chooser without changing the article language.

flows.name: Leave after unrecoverable error
flows.description: As a reader, I want to go back from an error state when retry is not applicable, so that I can return to the previous article instead of being stuck on the language chooser.

flows.name: Remember recently selected language
flows.description: As a reader, I want my selected article language to be remembered as recently used, so that future language lists prioritize languages I commonly choose.

flows.name: Retry after loading error
flows.description: As a reader, I want to retry loading language links when an error occurs, so that I can recover from network or server problems without leaving the screen.

flows.name: Search language links
flows.description: As a reader, I want to search the available article languages by localized or canonical language name, so that I can quickly narrow the list to the language I need.

flows.name: See loading progress
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see a loading indicator while available language links are being fetched, so that I know the screen is working and data is not ready yet.

flows.name: See no matching languages feedback
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see an empty-state message when my language search has no matches or no languages are available, so that I understand why the list is blank.

flows.name: Select an article language
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a language row, so that the article opens or is returned in the selected language.

flows.name: View available article languages
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see the article's available language versions grouped into my Wikipedia languages and all other languages, so that I can quickly find a language version that is relevant to me.

name: Launcher app shortcuts
description: Dynamic launcher shortcut entries for Search, Continue reading, Random article, and Places; each appears in the launcher shortcut popup and deep-links into MainActivity with shortcut-specific extras.

flows.name: Continue reading from launcher shortcut
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Continue reading launcher shortcut, so that Wikipedia opens directly to my current or most recent reading page and I can resume where I left off.

flows.name: Open Places from launcher shortcut
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Places launcher shortcut, so that Wikipedia opens directly to location-based article discovery.

flows.name: Open random article from launcher shortcut
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Random article launcher shortcut, so that Wikipedia opens a random article for discovery without requiring me to navigate through the app first.

flows.name: Open search from launcher shortcut
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Search launcher shortcut, so that Wikipedia opens directly to the search experience and I can start looking for an article immediately.

flows.name: View launcher shortcuts
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the Wikipedia app launcher shortcut popup and see quick actions for Search, Continue reading, Random article, and Places, so that I can quickly choose a common destination without first opening the app normally.

name: Leaving edit confirmation dialog
description:
Material confirmation dialog shown from edit preview when a user taps an internal, external, or diff link that would leave the edit workflow.
Warns unsaved changes are not saved and offers Leave or Stay actions.

flows.name: Leave to diff details
flows.description: As an editor, I want to confirm leaving after tapping a diff link, so that I can view the edit details for that revision despite my changes not being published yet.

flows.name: Leave to external link
flows.description: As an editor, I want to confirm leaving after tapping an external link, so that I can open the external destination despite my changes not being published yet.

flows.name: Leave to internal article link
flows.description: As an editor, I want to confirm leaving after tapping an internal article link, so that I can open the linked Wikipedia page despite my changes not being published yet.

flows.name: Stay in edit workflow
flows.description: As an editor, I want to choose Stay or dismiss the confirmation dialog, so that I can remain in the edit workflow and continue working on my unpublished changes.

flows.name: Warn before leaving edit preview
flows.description: As an editor, I want to be warned when a link in the edit preview would leave the edit workflow, so that I understand my unpublished changes may be lost before navigating away.

name: License Viewer
description: Compose activity for displaying an asset license document with a top app bar and vertically scrollable HTML-formatted license text.

flows.name: Navigate back from license viewer
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the back navigation on the license viewer, so that I can return to the previous screen after reading the license.

flows.name: Scroll license text
flows.description: As a user, I want to vertically scroll through the license text, so that I can read long license documents in full.

flows.name: View license document
flows.description: As a user, I want to view the requested asset license document with its license-specific title and formatted text, so that I can understand the legal terms for the library or asset.

name: LicenseActivity
description: Open-source/license information surface.

name: Link Preview action overlay widget
description: Bottom overlay widget attached to the link-preview dialog with primary, secondary, and tertiary action buttons; button visibility/text and callbacks vary for normal previews, Places previews, and error states.

flows.name: Continue to linked page
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the primary action in a normal link preview to continue to the linked article, talk page, or disambiguation page, so that I can open the previewed page in my current reading tab.

flows.name: Dismiss unavailable preview
flows.description: As a reader, I want the overlay action to dismiss a link preview when the page is missing, the user page is missing, or another generic error occurs, so that I can return to the previous context after learning the preview cannot be shown.

flows.name: Manage already saved Places preview
flows.description: As a Places user, I want to tap the secondary action when the previewed place is already saved to choose reading-list actions such as adding or moving it, so that I can organize the saved article from the preview.

flows.name: Open preview in new tab
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the secondary action in a normal link preview to open the linked page in a new tab, so that I can keep my current page while saving the previewed page for separate reading.

flows.name: Read Places preview
flows.description: As a Places user, I want to tap the tertiary action in a Places link preview to read the previewed article, so that I can open the place page from the preview.

flows.name: Save Places preview to reading list
flows.description: As a Places user, I want to tap the secondary action in a Places link preview to save the place article to my reading list, so that I can find it again later.

flows.name: Save offline preview for later
flows.description: As a reader who cannot load a link preview because I am offline or the request timed out, I want the overlay action to add the page to my reading list, so that I can access it later when available.

flows.name: See context-appropriate overlay actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want the link preview overlay to show only the actions relevant to the current preview type and state, so that I am not presented with unavailable or inappropriate buttons.

flows.name: Share Places preview
flows.description: As a Places user, I want to tap the primary action in a Places link preview to share the previewed page, so that I can send the place article to someone else.

name: Link Preview bottom sheet
description: Extended bottom-sheet dialog shown for tapped article links/Places results; displays loading, error, summary title/extract, thumbnail/gallery, distance, edit affordance, overflow menu actions (save/share/watch/new tab/copy/map/directions), and bottom action overlay to read/open/share/save.

flows.name: Copy previewed page link
flows.description: As a user, I want to copy the previewed page link from the overflow menu, so that I can paste the URL elsewhere.

flows.name: Dismiss missing or failed preview
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the link preview when the page is missing or another error occurs, so that I can return to what I was doing.

flows.name: Dismiss preview without navigating
flows.description: As a user, I want to close the bottom-sheet preview without opening the page, so that I can stay on my current screen after inspecting the link.

flows.name: Edit stub article from preview
flows.description: As a user, I want to edit a stub article directly from the preview when no extract is available, so that I can improve the article content.

flows.name: Get directions to Places result
flows.description: As a user viewing a Places result preview, I want to get directions to the place, so that I can navigate there using a maps or directions app.

flows.name: Handle offline preview error
flows.description: As a user, I want to understand when a preview cannot load because I am offline and add the page to my reading list, so that I can access it later when available.

flows.name: Manage saved preview page
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose reading-list actions for a previewed page that is already saved, so that I can add it to another list or move it between lists.

flows.name: Open missing user page link
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the link shown in a missing user page error message, so that I can open the referenced user page URL externally if needed.

flows.name: Open preview gallery item
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap an image or media thumbnail in the preview gallery, so that I can view the media in the gallery and navigate to any selected page from there.

flows.name: Open previewed page
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the previewed page from the title area or primary read/continue button, so that I can read the full article or page.

flows.name: Open previewed page in new tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the previewed page in a new tab, so that I can keep my current reading context while saving the page for separate reading.

flows.name: Review disambiguation preview
flows.description: As a user, I want a disambiguation link preview to clearly indicate that the target is a disambiguation page, so that I understand I may need to choose among multiple topics before continuing.

flows.name: Save previewed page to reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to add or save the previewed page to a reading list, so that I can read it later or offline.

flows.name: Select preview extract text
flows.description: As a user, I want to select text in the article extract, so that I can copy or otherwise use useful information from the preview without opening the page.

flows.name: Share previewed page
flows.description: As a user, I want to share the previewed page from the bottom action or overflow menu, so that I can send the article link to another app or person.

flows.name: View link preview content
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a preview with the article title, extract, thumbnail or gallery, and relevant place distance, so that I can decide whether the linked page is worth opening.

flows.name: View previewed place on map
flows.description: As a user viewing a preview with coordinates, I want to open the page location on the map, so that I can see where the article subject is located geographically.

flows.name: Watch or unwatch Places article
flows.description: As a logged-in user viewing a Places result preview, I want to watch or unwatch the article from the overflow menu, so that changes to the page are tracked according to my preference.

name: Link Preview error widget
description: Inline error content for link-preview failures, showing an error icon/message and link handling for missing user pages; delegates add-to-reading-list or dismiss actions to the overlay button callbacks.

flows.name: Add unavailable preview to reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to add a link preview that failed because I am offline or timed out to my reading list, so that I can read it later when it is available.

flows.name: Dismiss non-recoverable preview error
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss a link preview error when the page is missing or another non-offline error occurs, so that I can return to the article without the failed preview overlay.

flows.name: Open missing user page link
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the link shown in a missing user page error message, so that I can open the referenced user page or related link externally when appropriate.

flows.name: View generic link preview error
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a generic error message when the link preview fails for an unknown reason, so that I understand the preview could not be loaded even if no specific cause is available.

flows.name: View missing page error
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a clear message when the linked page does not exist, so that I know the preview failed because there is no article to show.

flows.name: View offline link preview error
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an offline-specific link preview error with guidance to save the page, so that I understand the preview cannot load until connectivity is available.

name: Login screen
description:
Account login activity with toolbar, username/password fields, optional 2FA/email-auth field, inline captcha container, login and create-account actions, footer links for privacy and password recovery, linear progress indicator, and full-screen error/retry view.
Can route to create account or reset password flows and finishes on successful login.

flows.name: Auto-login after account creation
flows.description: As a user who has just created an account, I want the login screen to fill in my new credentials and sign me in automatically, so that I can continue without re-entering them.

flows.name: Complete captcha challenge
flows.description: As a user presented with a captcha during login, I want to view the captcha image, enter its text, and submit it with my credentials, so that I can prove the login attempt is legitimate.

flows.name: Complete email authentication
flows.description: As a user requiring email authentication, I want to enter the emailed authentication code when prompted, so that I can finish logging in to my account.

flows.name: Complete required password reset during login
flows.description: As a user whose login requires a password reset, I want to be routed to the reset-password flow and return logged in after completing it, so that I can regain secure account access.

flows.name: Complete two-factor authentication
flows.description: As a user with two-factor authentication, I want to enter the requested authenticator code after my username and password are accepted, so that I can complete secure login.

flows.name: Create a new account from login
flows.description: As a new user, I want to open the create-account flow from the login screen, so that I can register before signing in.

flows.name: Handle login failure message
