flows.description: As a user, I want to see feedback when my login attempt fails, so that I understand that my credentials or authentication response were not accepted.

flows.name: Log in with username and password
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to enter my username and password and submit the login form, so that I can sign in to my account and use authenticated features.

flows.name: Navigate back from login
flows.description: As a user, I want to leave the login screen with the back action, so that I can cancel signing in and return to the previous screen.

flows.name: Offer account creation before login
flows.description: As a prospective user arriving at the login flow, I want to be taken to account creation first when appropriate, so that I can register before attempting to sign in.

flows.name: Open forgot password help
flows.description: As a user who forgot my password, I want to open password recovery from the login footer, so that I can reset or recover access to my account.

flows.name: Open privacy policy
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the privacy policy from the login footer, so that I can review how my account and login data are handled.

flows.name: Recover from full-screen login error
flows.description: As a user, I want a full-screen error view with retry or back actions when login cannot proceed because of a network or unexpected error, so that I can either try again or leave the login flow.

flows.name: Request a new captcha
flows.description: As a user who cannot read the current captcha, I want to tap the captcha image to request a new captcha, so that I can continue the login attempt with a readable challenge.

flows.name: See empty captcha feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to be shown an inline captcha error when I try to continue without entering the captcha text, so that I know the challenge is required.

flows.name: See invalid username feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to be shown an inline error when my username format is invalid, so that I can correct it before trying to log in.

flows.name: Show or hide password
flows.description: As a user, I want to toggle password visibility while entering my password, so that I can verify it before submitting the login form.

flows.name: Submit login from keyboard
flows.description: As a user, I want to submit the login form from the password keyboard action, so that I can log in without tapping the login button.

flows.name: Validate required login fields
flows.description: As a user, I want the login button to be enabled only after required credentials are entered, so that I do not submit an incomplete login form.

flows.name: View login progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a progress indicator and disabled login action while login is processing, so that I know my sign-in request is in progress and avoid duplicate submissions.

flows.name: View temporary account status
flows.description: As a temporary account user, I want to see a notice showing my current temporary account status on the login screen, so that I understand what account I am replacing by logging in.

name: LoginActivity
description: User login surface.

name: Logout Account Preference Widget
description:
Custom account/logout preference row shown in Settings for logged-in users.
Displays account name and icon, temporary account expiry when applicable, a logout/end-session button, and an account vanish option for permanent accounts.

flows.name: Cancel account vanish request
flows.description: As a permanent-account user, I want to cancel the account vanish warning dialog, so that I can leave settings without starting the vanish request process.

flows.name: Cancel logout
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to cancel the logout confirmation dialog, so that I can remain signed in when I change my mind.

flows.name: Confirm logout
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to confirm logout from the settings account row, so that I can sign out of my account and stop account-dependent sync and suggested-edit settings.

flows.name: Continue to account vanish web form
flows.description: As a permanent-account user, I want to confirm the account vanish warning, so that I can open the account vanish web form and continue the request process.

flows.name: End temporary account session
flows.description: As a temporary-account user, I want to end my temporary account session with a dedicated confirmation prompt, so that I can intentionally leave the temporary account when I no longer want to use it.

flows.name: Open account vanish warning
flows.description: As a permanent-account user, I want to tap the account vanish option and read a warning dialog, so that I understand the consequences before proceeding with a vanish request.

flows.name: Open logout confirmation
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to tap the logout button and see a confirmation warning, so that I can avoid accidentally signing out of my account.

flows.name: View account vanish option
flows.description: As a permanent-account user, I want to see an account vanish option in the account preference row, so that I can discover the path for requesting account vanishing when it applies to my account type.

flows.name: View logged-in account preference
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to see my account name and account-type icon in Settings, so that I can confirm which account is currently active before managing it.

flows.name: View temporary account expiry
flows.description: As a temporary-account user, I want to see how many days remain before my temporary account expires, so that I understand the status and lifetime of my current session account.

name: Logout Confirmation Dialog
description: Material alert dialog shown from the logout preference before logging out or ending a temporary-account session.

flows.name: Cancel ending temporary-account session
flows.description: As a temporary-account user, I want to cancel the end-session confirmation dialog, so that I can continue using my temporary account.

flows.name: Cancel logout
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to cancel the logout confirmation dialog, so that I can remain signed in if I change my mind.

flows.name: Confirm ending temporary-account session
flows.description: As a temporary-account user, I want to confirm ending my session from the warning dialog, so that I am signed out of the temporary account and returned from settings.

flows.name: Confirm logout
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to confirm logout from the warning dialog, so that I am signed out and related account sync settings are disabled.

flows.name: Open logout confirmation
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to tap the logout button and see a confirmation warning, so that I can understand the consequences before signing out.

flows.name: Open temporary account end-session confirmation
flows.description: As a temporary-account user, I want to tap the end session button and see a confirmation warning, so that I can understand that continuing will end my temporary-account session.

name: Main navigation tabs widget
description: Bottom navigation view populated from NavTab entries, with per-tab icon/text colors and optional red overlay dot indicator (used for unread/new status cues).

flows.name: Complete Activity tab onboarding
flows.description: As a user, I want tapping the Activity tab for the first time to show onboarding instead of switching tabs, so that I can learn about the Activity feature before using it.

flows.name: Navigate to Activity tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Activity tab in the bottom navigation, so that I can view activity and suggested-edits content.

flows.name: Navigate to Home tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Home tab in the bottom navigation, so that I can return to the main home feed.

flows.name: Navigate to Saved tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Saved tab in the bottom navigation, so that I can view my reading lists and saved pages.

flows.name: Navigate to Search tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Search tab in the bottom navigation, so that I can access my search/history area.

flows.name: Open More menu from bottom navigation
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the More tab in the bottom navigation, so that I can open the app's additional navigation menu without leaving my current tab.

flows.name: Recognize current tab by selected styling
flows.description: As a user, I want each bottom navigation tab to display its label and icon with selected and unselected colors, so that I can understand where I am and what tabs are available.

flows.name: See first-time Search tab hint
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a one-time tooltip when I first switch to the Search tab, so that I understand the purpose of the Search navigation item.

flows.name: See unread or new indicators on tabs
flows.description: As a user, I want tabs with new or unread information to show a red dot indicator, so that I notice new recommended reading lists or first-time Activity content.

flows.name: Start search from selected Search tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Search tab again while already on the search/history tab, so that I can immediately open the search interface.

name: Main settings preferences
description: Primary settings PreferenceScreen with general options for language, home feed customization, Year in Review, link previews, table collapse, app theme/icon, recommended reading list, donations, reading-list sync, and data-usage/offline/image settings.

name: Main tab action widgets and prompts
description: UI widgets/prompts managed by the main host: bottom nav overlay dots for reading-list and activity onboarding, search-tab tooltip, toolbar action widgets for open tab count and notification unread count, import-reading-lists new-install alert dialog, and Reading Challenge install bottom sheet trigger from the Edits tab.

flows.name: Acknowledge imported reading lists alert
flows.description: As a user on a new install that receives imported reading lists, I want to see and dismiss a one-time alert explaining the imported lists, so that I understand why reading lists appeared on my device.

flows.name: Add Reading Challenge widget
flows.description: As an eligible enrolled user on a device that supports pinned widgets, I want to tap Add in the Reading Challenge install prompt, so that I can request the Reading Challenge widget be added to my home screen.

flows.name: Browse multiple open tabs from tab count
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the toolbar tab-count widget when I have multiple open tabs, so that I can review and choose among my open tabs.

flows.name: Dismiss Reading Challenge widget prompt
flows.description: As an eligible enrolled user, I want to close or acknowledge the Reading Challenge widget install prompt without adding the widget, so that I can continue using the app without taking action.

flows.name: Load selected tab after browsing tabs
flows.description: As a user, I want to return from the tab browser to a selected existing tab, so that I can continue reading where I left off.

flows.name: Navigate to Edits after activity onboarding
flows.description: As a user, I want to be taken to the Edits tab after successfully completing the activity tab onboarding, so that I can immediately start using the feature I just learned about.

flows.name: Open activity tab onboarding from indicator
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a dot on the Edits/Activity tab and be taken through its onboarding the first time I select it, so that I understand the feature before using it.

flows.name: Open current tab from tab count
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the toolbar tab-count widget when I have one open tab, so that I can return directly to that page.

flows.name: Open notifications from toolbar
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to tap the toolbar notifications widget, so that I can view my Wikipedia notifications.

flows.name: See tab count update after background tab open
flows.description: As a user, I want the toolbar tab-count widget to update and animate after I open an article in a background tab, so that I know the page was added to my open tabs.

flows.name: Show Reading Challenge widget install prompt
flows.description: As an eligible enrolled user, I want the Reading Challenge widget install bottom sheet to appear when I open the Edits tab, so that I can learn about adding the challenge widget to my device.

flows.name: Show first-time search tab tooltip
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a one-time tooltip when I open the Search tab, so that I understand where to access search from the main navigation.

flows.name: Start a new tab after browsing tabs
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose to create a new tab from the tab browser and return to a new main page tab, so that I can begin a fresh browsing session.

flows.name: View notification unread count
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want the toolbar notifications widget to show my unread notification count and animate when new unread notifications arrive, so that I notice account activity that needs attention.

flows.name: View recommended reading list indicator
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a dot on the Reading lists tab when recommended reading list onboarding is available or a new recommended list has been generated, so that I know there is new reading-list content to review.

name: Main tab host screen
description: Primary app container Activity/Fragment hosting the bottom navigation tabs (Home, Saved/Reading Lists, Search/History, Edits/Activity, More), top toolbar/wordmark, notification and tab-count action widgets, intent routing from shortcuts/deep links, onboarding launches, and feed actions such as search, share, image download, reading-list operations, and navigation to article/search/settings/notifications/tab browser screens.

flows.name: Add feed article to reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to save a feed article to a reading list, so that I can read it later.

flows.name: Change home feed language
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose a different language from the home feed, so that feed content is shown in the language I prefer.

flows.name: Complete initial onboarding
flows.description: As a new user, I want to be shown initial onboarding before using the main tabs, so that my app language and home feed preferences are set up for my first session.

flows.name: Copy feed article link
flows.description: As a user, I want to copy a feed article link, so that I can paste the URL elsewhere.

flows.name: Create tab after tab browser
flows.description: As a user, I want to start a new tab after choosing that option in the tab browser, so that I can begin reading from a main-page article in a new tab.

flows.name: Customize feed interests
flows.description: As a user, I want to open interest customization from the home feed, so that my personalized feed better matches topics I care about.

flows.name: Donate from More menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the donation flow from the More menu, so that I can support Wikipedia.

flows.name: Download featured image
flows.description: As a user, I want to download a featured image from the feed, so that I can save it on my device.

flows.name: Exit app from main host
flows.description: As a user, I want pressing Back on the main host with no tab or child back stack to close the app, so that I can leave the app using standard Android navigation.

flows.name: Handle image download permission denied
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an explanation if storage permission is denied for image download, so that I know why the image was not saved.

flows.name: Handle reading challenge widget join intent
flows.description: As a user entering from the reading challenge widget, I want the app to show reading challenge onboarding when appropriate, so that I can join or continue the challenge.

flows.name: Handle unavailable voice search
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error when voice search is unavailable, so that I understand why spoken search cannot start.

flows.name: Launch main tab host
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the app to the main tab host, so that I can access the primary areas of Wikipedia from one place.

flows.name: Load tab from tab browser back stack
flows.description: As a user, I want to return from the tab browser to a previously selected article tab, so that my tab selection is reflected in the reader.

flows.name: Manage Wikipedia languages
flows.description: As a user, I want to open language management from the home feed, so that I can add, remove, or reorder app languages.

flows.name: Manage home feed modules
flows.description: As a user, I want to open feed module settings from an empty or configurable home feed, so that I can choose which modules appear.

flows.name: Move feed article between reading lists
flows.description: As a user, I want to move a feed article from one reading list to another, so that my saved articles stay organized.

flows.name: Navigate back through tabs
flows.description: As a user, I want the Back button to return me to a previous main tab when appropriate, so that tab navigation feels reversible before exiting the app.

flows.name: Navigate to Saved after reading list deletion
flows.description: As a user returning after deleting a reading list, I want the main host to show the Saved tab, so that I can verify and continue managing my lists.

flows.name: Navigate to generated Year in Review list
flows.description: As a user, I want the app to take me to Saved when a Year in Review reading list is created, so that I can view the generated list immediately.

flows.name: Navigate to requested main tab
flows.description: As a user entering the app from another flow, I want intents that request a specific main tab to switch there automatically, so that I land in the correct section.

flows.name: Open More menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the More tab, so that I can open the menu with account and app options without leaving my current tab.

flows.name: Open Places from feed prompt
flows.description: As a user, I want to open Places from the home feed prompt, so that I can explore location-based Wikipedia content.

flows.name: Open Year in Review
flows.description: As a user, I want to open Year in Review from the main host, so that I can view my annual Wikipedia reading summary.

flows.name: Open app shortcut continue reading
flows.description: As a user, I want the Continue reading app shortcut to reopen my current article tab, so that I can resume reading quickly.

flows.name: Open app shortcut places
flows.description: As a user, I want the Places app shortcut to open nearby places, so that I can explore Wikipedia articles around me from the launcher.

flows.name: Open app shortcut random page
flows.description: As a user, I want the Random app shortcut to open a random Wikipedia article, so that I can quickly discover content from the launcher.

flows.name: Open app shortcut search
flows.description: As a user, I want the Search app shortcut to open search directly, so that I can find Wikipedia content without first navigating through the app.

flows.name: Open article from history
flows.description: As a user, I want to select a history entry from the Search history tab, so that I can reopen that article in the current tab.

flows.name: Open contributions
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to open my contributions from the More menu, so that I can review my editing activity.

flows.name: Open current page tabs
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the tab count button, so that I can reopen my current article tab or browse all open article tabs.

flows.name: Open featured image page
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a featured image from the feed, so that I can view its file page and details.

flows.name: Open feed article
flows.description: As a user, I want to select an article from the home feed, so that I can read it in an article tab.

flows.name: Open feed article in background tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to open a feed article in a new background tab, so that I can save it for later without leaving the feed.

flows.name: Open feed news story
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a news item from the feed, so that I can read the related news content.

flows.name: Open login from main host
flows.description: As a signed-out user, I want to open login from the main host or More menu, so that I can access account-based features.

flows.name: Open more Did You Know content
flows.description: As a user, I want to open more Did You Know content from a feed card, so that I can discover additional facts and related articles.

flows.name: Open more On This Day content
flows.description: As a user, I want to open more On This Day content from a feed card, so that I can explore additional historical events and articles.

flows.name: Open more top-read articles
flows.description: As a user, I want to open more top-read articles from a feed card, so that I can browse additional popular articles.

flows.name: Open notifications
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to tap the notifications button with an unread count, so that I can view my Wikipedia notifications.

flows.name: Open notifications from feed
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to open notifications from the home feed, so that I can review new account activity.

flows.name: Open saved overflow menu
flows.description: As a user on the Saved tab, I want to open the overflow menu, so that I can access additional reading-list actions.

flows.name: Open search from Search tab
flows.description: As a user already on the Search history tab, I want to tap the Search tab again, so that I can open the full search experience quickly.

flows.name: Open settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to open Settings from the More menu or feed callbacks, so that I can configure the app.

flows.name: Open tab browser from feed
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the tab browser from the home feed, so that I can manage my open article tabs.

flows.name: Open user page
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to tap my username in the More menu, so that I can open my user page.

flows.name: Open user talk page
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to open my talk page from the More menu, so that I can view discussions addressed to me.

flows.name: Open watchlist
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to open my watchlist from the More menu, so that I can monitor watched pages.

flows.name: Preview saved reading lists
flows.description: As a user entering from a saved reading-lists preview flow, I want the app to open the Saved tab and skip initial onboarding, so that I can immediately view reading lists.

flows.name: Refresh after settings changes
flows.description: As a user, I want the main host to refresh after language, feed configuration, or logout changes in Settings, so that the visible content matches my updated preferences.

flows.name: Refresh after successful login
flows.description: As a user who just logged in, I want the main content to refresh and show a success message, so that my signed-in state is reflected immediately.

flows.name: Refresh history when connectivity changes
flows.description: As a user, I want the Search history tab to refresh when the app goes online or offline, so that history-related content reflects current connectivity.

flows.name: Remove feed article from reading lists
flows.description: As a user, I want to remove a feed article from one or more reading lists, so that I can clean up saved content I no longer need.

flows.name: Restore recently viewed page
flows.description: As a returning user, I want the app to reopen my recently viewed article when I return soon after reading, so that I can continue where I left off.

flows.name: Route Wikipedia deep links
flows.description: As a user, I want Wikipedia deep links opened through the app icon alias to route to the article view, so that links open in the proper reading experience.

flows.name: Search saved pages and lists
flows.description: As a user on the Saved tab, I want to tap the search/filter action, so that I can search within my reading lists and saved articles.

flows.name: Share featured image
flows.description: As a user, I want to share a featured image from the feed, so that I can send the image and its source to another app.

flows.name: Share feed article
flows.description: As a user, I want to share an article from the home feed, so that I can send it to another person or app.

flows.name: Show Activity onboarding indicator
flows.description: As a user, I want the Activity tab to show an indicator until onboarding is completed, so that I know a new feature needs attention.

flows.name: Show import reading lists message
flows.description: As a user receiving imported reading lists on a new install, I want to see an explanatory dialog, so that I understand that shared reading lists were imported.

flows.name: Show reading challenge install prompt
flows.description: As a user visiting the Activity tab, I want to be prompted to install the reading challenge widget when eligible, so that I can track the challenge from my home screen.

flows.name: Show recommended reading list indicator
flows.description: As a user, I want the Saved tab to show an indicator when recommended reading-list content is new or onboarding is pending, so that I know there is something new to review.

flows.name: Show search tab tooltip
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a one-time tooltip when I first use the Search tab, so that I understand the purpose of the updated search navigation.

flows.name: Shuffle random feed card
flows.description: As a user, I want to shuffle a random feed card, so that I can discover a different random article.

flows.name: Switch to Activity tab with onboarding
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the Activity tab and see its onboarding the first time, so that I understand suggested edits and activity features before using them.

flows.name: Switch to Home tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the Home tab, so that I can view the home feed with the Wikipedia wordmark and home-specific navigation styling.

flows.name: Switch to Saved tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the Saved tab, so that I can view and manage my saved pages and reading lists.

flows.name: Switch to Search history tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the Search tab, so that I can view my history or start a search from the main navigation.

flows.name: Update content after account logout
flows.description: As a user who has logged out, I want the main host to dismiss account UI and refresh visible content, so that the app reflects my signed-out state.

flows.name: Use voice search from feed
flows.description: As a user, I want to start voice search from the home feed, so that I can search Wikipedia by speaking instead of typing.

name: MainActivity / launcher and wikipedia deep-link entry
description: Primary app launcher surface and handler for wikipedia:// deep links via launcher activity aliases (DefaultIcon/YIR25Icon) targeting MainActivity.

name: More navigation bottom sheet
description:
Full-height bottom-sheet menu opened from the More nav tab.
Shows account/login/profile area, Talk, Watchlist, Games, Places, Settings, Contributions, Donate, Year in Review, and Suggested Edits entries, with visibility/state depending on login, temporary account, Year in Review availability, and game language support.

flows.name: Browse full-height More menu
flows.description: As a user, I want the More navigation bottom sheet to open as a full-height scrollable menu, so that I can access all More navigation options even when they do not fit on screen.

flows.name: Open Contributions
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to open Contributions from the More navigation bottom sheet, so that I can view my edit history.

flows.name: Open Games hub
flows.description: As a user with a supported app language, I want to open Games from the More navigation bottom sheet, so that I can play Wikipedia games.

flows.name: Open Places
flows.description: As a user, I want to open Places from the More navigation bottom sheet, so that I can explore nearby Wikipedia content on a map.

flows.name: Open Settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to open Settings from the More navigation bottom sheet, so that I can change app preferences.

flows.name: Open Suggested Edits
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to open Suggested Edits from the More navigation bottom sheet, so that I can find editing tasks to improve Wikipedia.

flows.name: Open Talk
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to open Talk from the More navigation bottom sheet, so that I can view my user talk topics.

flows.name: Open Watchlist
flows.description: As a logged-in non-temporary user, I want to open Watchlist from the More navigation bottom sheet, so that I can review pages I am watching.

flows.name: Open Year in Review
flows.description: As a user when Year in Review is available and enabled, I want to open Year in Review from the More navigation bottom sheet, so that I can review my annual Wikipedia activity.

flows.name: Open login from account area
flows.description: As a logged-out or temporary-account user, I want to tap the account area in the More navigation bottom sheet to start login, so that I can sign in with a permanent account.

flows.name: Open user profile
flows.description: As a logged-in non-temporary user, I want to tap my account area in the More navigation bottom sheet, so that I can open my user profile page.

flows.name: See state-appropriate menu entries
flows.description: As a user, I want the More navigation bottom sheet to hide unavailable entries based on my login status, temporary-account status, game language support, and Year in Review availability, so that I only see actions I can use.

flows.name: See unvisited Year in Review indicator
flows.description: As a user, I want the More navigation bottom sheet to show a red dot on Year in Review when I have not visited it, so that I notice new Year in Review content.

flows.name: Start donation flow
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap Donate in the More navigation bottom sheet, so that I can support Wikipedia financially.

flows.name: View account state in menu
flows.description: As a user, I want the More navigation bottom sheet to show whether I am logged out, using a temporary account, or signed in with my username, so that I understand which account actions and menu entries are available to me.

name: Move to Reading List bottom sheet
description: Bottom sheet for moving one or more pages from a source reading list into another list, reusing the add-to-reading-list list picker while changing title and commit behavior.

flows.name: Auto-prompt to create a list when none are available
flows.description: As a user, I want to be prompted to create a reading list when there are no destination lists shown, so that I can still complete moving my selected page or pages.

flows.name: Cancel moving pages
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the move bottom sheet without choosing a destination, so that my pages remain in the original reading list when I change my mind.

flows.name: Choose destination reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to select an existing reading list as the destination, so that the selected page or pages are moved out of the source list into that list.

flows.name: Create destination reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to create a new reading list from the move bottom sheet, so that I can move the selected page or pages into a new destination list.

flows.name: Handle unavailable source list
flows.description: As a user, I want the move sheet to close if the source reading list no longer exists, so that I do not attempt an invalid move.

flows.name: Respect destination article limit
flows.description: As a user, I want to be told when the selected destination list cannot hold the pages being moved because it has reached the article limit, so that I know the move was not completed.

flows.name: Respect reading list count limit
flows.description: As a user, I want to be told when I cannot create another reading list because the maximum number of lists has been reached, so that I understand why moving to a new list is unavailable.

flows.name: Validate new list details
flows.description: As a user, I want the create-list dialog to prevent empty or duplicate reading list names while allowing an optional description, so that I can create a valid destination list for the move.

flows.name: View destination list after moving
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the destination reading list from the move confirmation message, so that I can verify or continue managing the moved pages.

name: News story detail screen
description:
Full-screen Explore feed news story view.
Displays a transparent-status-bar collapsing image header, the stripped news story text, and a list of linked article rows; tapping a row opens the article, while list-row actions can open in a background tab or add/move the article in reading lists.

flows.name: Add article to another reading list
flows.description: As a reader, I want to choose a non-default reading list for a linked article from the row action menu, so that I can organize the article in the list I prefer.

flows.name: Add article to default reading list
flows.description: As a reader, I want to save a linked article to my default reading list from the row action menu, so that I can find and read it later.

flows.name: Copy linked article URL
flows.description: As a reader, I want to copy a linked article's URL from the row action menu, so that I can paste the article link elsewhere.

flows.name: Move saved article to another reading list
flows.description: As a reader, I want to move a linked article that is already in a reading list to another list, so that my saved articles stay organized where I want them.

flows.name: Open article from row actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to choose Open from a linked article row's action menu, so that I can navigate to the article from the menu instead of tapping the row.

flows.name: Open article in background tab
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open a linked article in a background tab from the row action menu, so that I can save it for later without leaving the news story.

flows.name: Open linked article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a linked article row, so that I can open the related Wikipedia article in a new tab.

flows.name: Open long-press article actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to long-press a linked article row to see available article actions, so that I can choose how to open, save, share, copy, or manage that article.

flows.name: Read story without a header image
flows.description: As a reader, I want the news detail page to still show the story text and article links when no news image is available, so that I can use the story detail screen even for image-less news items.

flows.name: Remove saved article from reading lists
flows.description: As a reader, I want to remove a linked article from its reading list or lists from the row action menu, so that I can clean up articles I no longer want saved.

flows.name: Return from news story detail
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the toolbar back button or system back navigation to leave the news story detail screen, so that I can return to the feed or previous screen.

flows.name: Scroll news detail content
flows.description: As a reader, I want to scroll through the story text and linked article rows while the image header collapses, so that I can comfortably browse all related content on the screen.

flows.name: Select and copy story text
flows.description: As a reader, I want to select text from the news story, so that I can copy or reuse parts of the story text outside the app.

flows.name: Share linked article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to share a linked article from the row action menu, so that I can send the article to another person or app.

flows.name: View news story details
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open a news story detail page with its header image, stripped story text, and linked articles, so that I can read the full news item and choose related articles to explore.

name: NewsActivity
description: News feed card detail/list surface.

name: No Search Results Language Suggestions
description: Empty-results compose widget listing result counts per app language; languages with results are clickable to switch the selected search language, with special Places analytics for no-results impressions.

flows.name: Distinguish suggested languages by code
flows.description: As a multilingual search user, I want each language count to include a compact language-code badge when multiple app languages are present, so that I can tell which language each result count belongs to.

flows.name: Identify unavailable language suggestions
flows.description: As a search user, I want languages with zero results to be shown as unavailable and not selectable, so that I do not switch to another language that will still have no results.

flows.name: Switch search language from a suggestion
flows.description: As a search user, I want to tap a language suggestion that has results, so that the search switches to that language and I can view matching articles.

flows.name: Track Places no-results impression
flows.description: As a Places search user, I want the app to record when I see no-results language suggestions from Places search, so that the Places search experience can be measured and improved.

flows.name: View language result counts after no search results
flows.description: As a search user, I want to see how many results are available in each of my app languages when my current search has no results, so that I can decide whether another language may have useful matches.

name: Notification Actions Overflow Popup
description: PopupWindow anchored to a notification action view, showing primary/secondary notification links and a mark as read/unread action.

flows.name: Dismiss overflow popup after action
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want the overflow popup to close after I choose an action or link, so that I can return to the notifications list without manually closing it.

flows.name: Dismiss overflow popup without choosing an action
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to dismiss the overflow popup without selecting an action, so that I can cancel and return to the notifications list.

flows.name: Mark notification as read
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to mark an unread notification as read from the overflow popup, so that I can clear its unread status without opening it.

flows.name: Mark notification as unread
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to mark a read notification as unread from the overflow popup, so that I can keep it highlighted for later attention.

flows.name: Open notification overflow actions
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to open the overflow actions popup for a notification, so that I can access additional actions and links for that notification.

flows.name: Open primary notification link
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to select the primary link in the overflow popup, so that I can navigate to the main destination associated with the notification.

flows.name: Open secondary notification link
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to select a secondary link in the overflow popup, so that I can navigate to another relevant destination associated with the notification.

flows.name: Open tertiary notification link
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to select an additional secondary link when available in the overflow popup, so that I can navigate to another related notification destination.

flows.name: Open user talk page from user link
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to open the talk page action shown for a user-page notification link, so that I can view or participate in the related user talk discussion.

name: Notification Bell
description: Reusable Compose notification icon button with animated unread-count badge and circle-number badge widget.

flows.name: Cap large unread counts
flows.description: As a user with many unread notifications, I want the badge to show a capped count instead of overflowing the icon, so that the notification bell remains readable and usable.

flows.name: Hide badge with no unread notifications
flows.description: As a user, I want the unread badge to be hidden when there are no unread notifications, so that I can quickly tell that nothing needs my attention.

flows.name: Highlight newly received notifications
flows.description: As a user, I want the notification bell and badge to animate when my unread count increases, so that I notice newly received notifications.

flows.name: Open notifications
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to tap the notification bell, so that I can open my notifications and review updates that need my attention.

flows.name: Show notification bell only when available
flows.description: As a user, I want the notification bell to appear only when notifications are available to me, so that the toolbar does not show an unavailable action.

flows.name: View unread notification count
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a numbered badge on the notification bell when I have unread notifications, so that I know how many updates are waiting for me.

name: Notification Settings
description: Settings sub-screen for notification preferences, hosted by NotificationSettingsActivity/BaseSettingsActivity with a toolbar title and a PreferenceFragment list loaded from preferences_notifications; includes an entry that opens Android system app notification settings.

flows.name: Customize push notifications in system settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap Customize push notifications to open the Android system notification settings for the Wikipedia app, so that I can manage app-level push notification behavior such as notification permissions and channels.

flows.name: Hide read notifications
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn on Hide read notifications, so that notifications I have already read are hidden from the app's notification list.

flows.name: Leave notification settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the toolbar back button or system back action to leave Notification Settings, so that I can return to the previous notifications screen after changing preferences.

flows.name: Show read notifications
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn off Hide read notifications, so that read notifications remain visible in the app's notification list.

flows.name: View notification preferences
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the Notification Settings screen and see notification preferences grouped into push notification and display setting sections, so that I can understand which notification options are available to configure.

name: Notification direct reply toasts/fallback
description: Notification direct-reply helper surface that shows progress/success/error Toasts and falls back to opening the talk topics screen on failure.

name: Notification filter item row widget
description: Reusable row view used in notification filters, showing a language code or wiki/category icon, label text, and visible checkmark for enabled filters; also supports a single-label edit/update-languages row.

flows.name: See enabled filter state
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want enabled notification filters to display a checkmark and disabled filters to hide it, so that I can quickly see which wikis or notification types are currently included.

flows.name: Toggle all notification types
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to tap the All types filter row to enable or disable all notification categories at once, so that I can quickly broaden or silence all notification types.

flows.name: Toggle all wiki filters
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to tap the All wikis filter row to enable or disable all wiki notification sources at once, so that I can quickly include or exclude every configured wiki project.

flows.name: Toggle individual notification type filter
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to tap an individual notification type row to include or exclude that category of notifications, so that I can receive only the kinds of notifications I care about.

flows.name: Toggle individual wiki filter
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to tap an individual wiki filter row to include or exclude notifications from that wiki, so that I can control which wiki projects contribute to my notifications.

flows.name: Update app languages from row
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to tap the edit/update-languages row to open language settings, so that I can change which app languages appear as notification wiki filters.

flows.name: View filter row identity
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want each filter row to show a recognizable language code, wiki icon, or category icon with a localized label, so that I can understand which notification filter I am configuring.

name: Notification list item widget
description: RecyclerView item for a single notification, including category icon/color, unread emphasis, title/subtitle/body/source, wiki language/logo badge, timestamp, selection state, swipe read/unread affordance tags, and overflow entry point.

flows.name: Automatically mark opened notification as read
flows.description: As a user, I want a notification to be marked as read when I open it, so that my unread state stays up to date.

flows.name: Bulk mark selected notifications
flows.description: As a user, I want to mark selected notifications as read or unread, so that I can update multiple notification statuses efficiently.

flows.name: Distinguish unread notifications
flows.description: As a user, I want unread notifications to be emphasized with category color, bold text, and active timestamp/menu coloring, so that I can quickly identify items that still need attention.

flows.name: Enter multi-select mode
flows.description: As a user, I want to long-press a notification item to select it, so that I can perform actions on one or more notifications at once.

flows.name: Handle offline read-state changes
flows.description: As a user, I want the notification item to prevent read or unread changes and show an offline message when I am not connected, so that I understand why the action cannot be completed.

flows.name: Highlight matching search text
flows.description: As a user, I want notification titles, subtitles, descriptions, and sources to highlight my current search query, so that I can quickly see why an item matched my search.

flows.name: Identify external notification links
flows.description: As a user, I want notification source links that open outside the app to display an external-link indicator, so that I know when navigation may leave the app.

flows.name: Mark notification from overflow
flows.description: As a user, I want to mark a notification as read or unread from its overflow menu, so that I can manage its status without opening it.

flows.name: Open notification overflow menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the overflow button on a notification item, so that I can access additional actions for that notification.

flows.name: Open notification target
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a notification item to open its primary target, so that I can respond to or view the content related to the notification.

flows.name: Open overflow link actions
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose available primary, secondary, or tertiary link actions from a notification's overflow menu, so that I can navigate directly to the relevant notification destination.

flows.name: Open user talk action
flows.description: As a user, I want the overflow menu to offer a user talk page action when a notification links to a user page, so that I can go directly to the conversation context.

flows.name: Recognize notification category
flows.description: As a user, I want each notification item to show a category-specific icon and color, so that I can quickly tell what type of notification it is.

flows.name: Recognize notification source wiki
flows.description: As a user, I want the notification item to show the source wiki using a language code or project logo badge, so that I know which Wikimedia project the notification came from.

flows.name: Respect notification language direction
flows.description: As a user, I want each notification item to follow the layout direction of its source language, so that notifications in right-to-left or left-to-right languages are readable and natural.

flows.name: See selected item state
flows.description: As a user, I want selected notification items to show a checkmark and selected styling, so that I can clearly tell which notifications are included in a bulk action.

flows.name: See swipe action affordance
flows.description: As a user, I want the swipe action to indicate whether it will mark the item as read or unread, so that I understand the result before completing the gesture.

flows.name: Select or unselect all visible notifications
flows.description: As a user, I want to select all visible notification items or clear all selections in multi-select mode, so that I can quickly prepare or cancel a bulk action.

flows.name: Toggle item selection
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap notification items while in multi-select mode to select or deselect them, so that I can choose exactly which notifications a bulk action applies to.

flows.name: Toggle read state by swiping
flows.description: As a user, I want to swipe a notification item to mark it as read or unread, so that I can manage notifications quickly from the list.

flows.name: Undo read state change
flows.description: As a user, I want to undo a swipe or bulk read-state change from the snackbar, so that I can recover if I changed a notification by mistake.

flows.name: View notification summary
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a notification's category, title, subtitle, body, source wiki, timestamp, and source page in the list item, so that I can understand what happened without opening it.

name: Notification search/filter bar widget
description: Card-like list header within the notifications screen that starts search action mode when tapped, includes a filter button, and shows an active filter count badge when filters are excluded.

flows.name: Clear or exit notification search
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to clear or close notification search mode, so that I can return to the normal notifications list and tabs.

flows.name: Filter notifications by search text
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to type a search query in notification search mode, so that I can narrow the list to notifications whose title, header, body, or link text matches my query.

flows.name: Handle no matching notifications
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to see an empty-result message when search text or filters exclude all notifications, so that I understand there are no notifications matching my current criteria.

flows.name: Open filters from empty filtered state
flows.description: As a notifications user, I want to open notification filters from the empty filtered-results message, so that I can adjust filters that may be hiding notifications.

flows.name: Open notification filters during search

flows.name: Highlight notification search matches
