flows.description: As a player, I want to see my final score and the countdown until the next daily game, so that I can understand my performance and know when I can play again.

flows.name: View game statistics
flows.description: As a logged-in player, I want to see my total games played, current streak, best streak, and average score, so that I can track my performance over time.

flows.name: View result error state
flows.description: As a player, I want to see an error message if the game result cannot be loaded, so that I understand why the result content is unavailable.

flows.name: View result loading state
flows.description: As a player, I want to see a loading indicator while my game result is being prepared, so that I know the app is working.

name: On This Day game score view widget
description: Custom LinearLayout widget that renders a horizontal row of circular score indicators, updating each slot with unanswered, correct, or incorrect themed icons.

flows.name: Reset score indicators for a new game
flows.description: As a game player, I want the score indicators to be regenerated for a new game, so that stale progress from a previous game is cleared before tracking the current game.

flows.name: See correct answers in score row
flows.description: As a game player, I want questions I answered correctly to be shown with a success-colored check icon, so that I can recognize my correct answers at a glance.

flows.name: See incorrect answers in score row
flows.description: As a game player, I want questions I answered incorrectly to be shown with a destructive-colored cancel icon, so that I can recognize my mistakes at a glance.

flows.name: See unanswered questions
flows.description: As a game player, I want unanswered questions to appear as neutral circular indicators, so that I can distinguish remaining questions from completed ones.

flows.name: Update current question after submission
flows.description: As a game player, I want the current question's score indicator to change only after I submit an answer, so that the score row reflects completed answers rather than the question currently being viewed.

flows.name: Use themed score colors
flows.description: As a game player, I want the score indicators to use the app's current theme colors for neutral, correct, and incorrect states, so that the score row remains visually consistent and readable in the current theme.

flows.name: View score progress slots
flows.description: As a game player, I want to see a row of circular score indicators for all questions in the game, so that I can understand how many questions are included and track my overall progress.

name: On This Day game share preview content
description: Offscreen/shareable result layout assembled by the result fragment with score text, correctness dots, and a list of article topics; rendered to bitmap before invoking the Android share flow.

name: On this day article card long-press menu
description:
Context popup for article cards inside the On This Day event carousel.
A long press opens a LongPressMenu with actions to open the article, open it in a new background tab, add it to a reading list, or move it between reading lists.

flows.name: Add article to another reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to add an On This Day article that is already saved to another reading list, so that I can organize it in multiple lists.

flows.name: Add article to default reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to add an unsaved On This Day article to my default reading list from the long-press menu, so that I can find and read it later.

flows.name: Copy article link
flows.description: As a user, I want to copy the selected On This Day article link from the long-press menu, so that I can paste the article URL elsewhere.

flows.name: Move article between reading lists
flows.description: As a user, I want to move an On This Day article from its current reading list to another list, so that I can keep my saved articles organized in the right place.

flows.name: Open article from menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the selected On This Day article from the long-press menu, so that I can read the full article.

flows.name: Open article in background tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the selected On This Day article in a new background tab, so that I can save it for later while staying in the carousel.

flows.name: Open long-press menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to long-press an On This Day article card to open a context menu, so that I can quickly choose actions for that article without opening it first.

flows.name: Remove article from reading lists
flows.description: As a user, I want to remove a saved On This Day article from one or more reading lists from the long-press menu, so that my reading lists no longer include articles I do not want saved.

flows.name: Share article
flows.description: As a user, I want to share the selected On This Day article from the long-press menu, so that I can send the article link to someone else or another app.

name: On this day detail screen
description:
Full-screen On This Day timeline opened from the Explore feed.
Shows a collapsing date header, loading/error states, a scrollable list of historical events by year, article page carousels with page indicators, a footer shortcut back to the current date, and a custom date picker dialog for choosing another month/day.

flows.name: Browse related article carousel
flows.description: As a reader, I want to swipe through the related article cards for an event and see the page indicators, so that I can compare all articles linked to that event.

flows.name: Change On This Day date
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open a date picker and choose another month and day, so that I can explore historical events for a different date.

flows.name: Jump back to top of timeline
flows.description: As a reader at the end of the timeline, I want to use the footer shortcut to jump back to the newest events at the top, so that I can resume browsing from the beginning.

flows.name: Navigate back from screen
flows.description: As a reader, I want to leave the On This Day detail screen using the back affordance, so that I can return to where I came from.

flows.name: Open related article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a related article card, so that I can open and read that article in a new tab.

flows.name: Return to today's date
flows.description: As a reader viewing another date, I want to tap the current-date shortcut in the toolbar, so that I can quickly reload events for today.

flows.name: Scroll with collapsing date header
flows.description: As a reader, I want the date header to collapse into the toolbar while I scroll, so that I can keep date context while maximizing space for the event list.

flows.name: See loading and error states
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see when On This Day content is loading or unavailable, so that I understand the screen state and can recover from failures.

flows.name: Select event text
flows.description: As a reader, I want to select the text of a historical event, so that I can copy or reuse information from the timeline.

flows.name: Start near selected year
flows.description: As a reader opening On This Day from a specific feed event, I want the detail timeline to scroll to that event's year, so that I can continue from the item I selected.

flows.name: Use article long-press actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to long-press a related article card to open its context menu, so that I can open it, open it in a background tab, or manage it in my reading lists.

flows.name: View historical events timeline
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view a chronological timeline of historical events for the selected day, so that I can discover what happened on that date across years.

name: OnThisDayActivity
description: On This Day feed/card surface.

name: OnThisDayGameActivity
description: On This Day game surface.

name: Onboarding List Item and Two Button Bottom Bar
description: Reusable Compose onboarding widgets: icon/title/subtitle list item and a bottom bar with secondary and animated primary buttons.

flows.name: Choose primary bottom-bar action
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the primary button in the onboarding bottom bar, so that I can continue with or confirm the main action of the onboarding flow.

flows.name: Choose secondary bottom-bar action
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the secondary button in the onboarding bottom bar, so that I can take the alternate action offered by the onboarding flow.

flows.name: See updated primary action label
flows.description: As a user, I want the primary button label to update with animation when the onboarding flow changes its main action, so that I can clearly recognize the current action I am about to take.

flows.name: View onboarding feature item
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an onboarding item with an icon, title, and explanatory subtitle, so that I can understand a feature or benefit being introduced.

flows.name: View personalized onboarding subtitle
flows.description: As a user, I want an onboarding item to show a provided custom subtitle when available, so that the explanation can reflect the specific context of the onboarding flow.

name: Onboarding page widget
description:
Reusable custom onboarding page view used by XML-based onboarding pages.
Displays optional centered image, primary/secondary/tertiary text, HTML links, optional patroller task buttons, and adjusts scrolling layout for small screens.

flows.name: Open onboarding text links
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap links embedded in the onboarding text, so that I can view related policies, help, or external information.

flows.name: Scroll onboarding content on small screens
flows.description: As a user, I want to scroll onboarding page content when it does not fit on my screen, so that I can read all of the information and still see the illustration where possible.

flows.name: View onboarding page content
flows.description: As a user, I want to view an onboarding page with optional illustration, title, explanatory text, and note text, so that I can understand the feature being introduced.

flows.name: View patroller task onboarding details
flows.description: As a user, I want to view the patroller task explanation items when they are included on an onboarding page, so that I can understand the different types of patrolling actions and expectations.

name: Onboarding pager fragment
description:
Reusable ViewPager-based onboarding UI container with page indicator, skip, forward, and done controls.
Handles page advancement/back navigation and delegates completion/skip callbacks to host implementations.

flows.name: Advance to next onboarding page
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the forward/continue control to move to the next onboarding page, so that I can progress through the onboarding flow at my own pace.

flows.name: Finish onboarding from final page
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the final done/get started control on the last onboarding page, so that I can complete onboarding and continue into the host flow.

flows.name: Go back to previous onboarding page
flows.description: As a user, I want the system back action to return me to the previous onboarding page when I am not on the first page, so that I can revisit earlier onboarding information without leaving the flow.

flows.name: Hear page position with screen reader
flows.description: As a screen reader user, I want the page indicator to announce the current page number and total pages, so that I can understand my progress through onboarding accessibly.

flows.name: Hide skip when skipping is disabled
flows.description: As a user, I want onboarding flows that require completion to hide the Skip control, so that I understand I should proceed through the required pages instead of skipping them.

flows.name: Leave first onboarding page with back
flows.description: As a user, I want the system back action on the first onboarding page to be passed to the host screen, so that I can exit or navigate according to the host flow's normal behavior.

flows.name: Navigate by selecting page indicator dots
flows.description: As a user, I want to select a page indicator dot to move to a different onboarding page, so that I can jump directly between pages in the onboarding flow.

flows.name: Skip onboarding
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap Skip before the final page, so that I can leave onboarding without reviewing every page.

flows.name: Swipe between onboarding pages
flows.description: As a user, I want to swipe horizontally through onboarding pages, so that I can browse the onboarding content naturally.

flows.name: Use page indicator to view progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a page indicator that updates with the current onboarding page, so that I know where I am in the onboarding sequence.

name: Open tabs screen
description: Full activity showing the current browser tab stack as a RecyclerView of tab cards with toolbar actions for new tab, close all tabs, save all tabs, return home, notification shortcut, tap-to-select, close button, and swipe-to-close behavior.

flows.name: Cancel close all tabs
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the close-all-tabs confirmation dialog, so that I do not accidentally clear my tab stack.

flows.name: Close a tab by swiping
flows.description: As a user, I want to swipe a tab card away to close it, so that I can quickly remove unwanted tabs with a gesture.

flows.name: Close a tab with close button
flows.description: As a user, I want to close an individual tab using its close button, so that I can remove tabs I no longer need.

flows.name: Close all tabs
flows.description: As a user, I want to close all open tabs after confirming the action, so that I can quickly clear my tab stack.

flows.name: Open a new tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to open a new browser tab from the tabs screen, so that I can start browsing a new page without using an existing tab.

flows.name: Open notifications
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to open notifications from the tabs screen, so that I can check my account notifications without leaving the tab-management context first.

flows.name: Return from tabs screen
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the tab count/back control to leave the open tabs screen, so that I can return to where I came from without changing tabs.

flows.name: Return to home
flows.description: As a user, I want to go to the app's Home tab from the tabs screen, so that I can leave tab management and return to the main home experience.

flows.name: Save all tabs to reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to save all open tabs to a reading list, so that I can keep the pages for later reading.

flows.name: See unread notification count
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to see my unread notification count on the notifications shortcut, so that I know whether there are notifications needing attention.

flows.name: Select an open tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a tab card to make that tab active, so that I can return to browsing the selected page.

flows.name: Undo close all tabs
flows.description: As a user, I want to undo closing all tabs from the snackbar, so that I can restore my entire tab stack if I cleared it by mistake.

flows.name: Undo closed tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to undo closing an individual tab from the snackbar, so that I can restore a tab I closed by mistake.

flows.name: View open tabs
flows.description: As a user, I want to see my currently open browser tabs as cards with each page title and description, so that I can understand and manage my tab stack.

name: Page Header Edit Popup Menu
description:
Popup menu shown from a page header edit action when both lead-section and description editing are available.
Offers edit-description and edit-lead-section choices, then dispatches to the description editor or edit-section screen.

flows.name: Dismiss edit popup menu
flows.description: As a page reader, I want to dismiss the page header edit popup menu without choosing an edit option, so that I can return to reading the article without making changes.

flows.name: Handle description edit limit
flows.description: As an anonymous page reader who has reached the description edit limit, I want to be prompted to log in or cancel after choosing edit description, so that I understand why I cannot continue editing anonymously and can decide whether to sign in.

flows.name: Open description editor
flows.description: As a page reader, I want to choose the edit-description option from the page header edit popup menu, so that I can add or update the article description.

flows.name: Open lead section editor
flows.description: As a page reader, I want to choose the edit-lead-section option from the page header edit popup menu, so that I can edit the article's lead section.

name: Page Indicator
description: Reusable Compose pager indicator row with animated active/inactive dot colors and size gradient for large page counts.

flows.name: Animate page changes
flows.description: As a user, I want the active indicator color and dot size to animate when the current page changes, so that page transitions feel smooth and I can easily track my new position.

flows.name: Display equal dots for short pagers
flows.description: As a user, I want all page dots to remain the same size when there are only a few pages, so that short paged flows are easy to read at a glance.

flows.name: Scale indicators for many pages
flows.description: As a user, I want distant page dots to appear smaller when there are many pages, so that the indicator remains compact while still communicating that more pages exist.

flows.name: Show pager position
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a row of page indicator dots that reflects the total number of pages and highlights my current page, so that I can understand where I am in a paged carousel or onboarding flow.

name: Page Overflow Menu
description: Reusable Compose dropdown popup menu for page overflow actions; expands for a selected menu key and renders labeled menu items with dismiss animation.

flows.name: Add page to another reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to add a page that is already in a reading list to another reading list, so that I can organize it in multiple saved collections.

flows.name: Add page to default reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to add a page that is not already in any reading list to my default reading list, so that I can save it for later.

flows.name: Close menu after selecting an action
flows.description: As a user, I want the page overflow menu to close after I select an action, so that I receive clear feedback that my selection was accepted.

flows.name: Copy page link
flows.description: As a user, I want to copy the selected page link from the overflow menu, so that I can paste the article URL elsewhere.

flows.name: Dismiss overflow menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the page overflow menu by tapping outside it, so that I can return to the previous screen without choosing an action.

flows.name: Move page to another reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to move a page from its current reading list to another reading list, so that I can reorganize my saved pages.

flows.name: Open page
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the selected page from the overflow menu, so that I can read the article.

flows.name: Open page in new tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the selected page in a new tab from the overflow menu, so that I can keep my current reading context while viewing another article.

flows.name: Remove page from reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to remove a saved page from its reading list or lists, so that my saved collections stay up to date.

flows.name: Share page
flows.description: As a user, I want to share the selected page from the overflow menu, so that I can send the article to someone else or another app.

flows.name: Show overflow menu for selected page
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the page overflow menu for a selected page, so that I can see the actions available for that specific page.

name: Page action overflow menu popup
description: A PopupWindow-hosted overflow menu shown from the page action toolbar anchor, containing forward navigation, customizable page actions, and a customize-toolbar entry.

flows.name: Customize toolbar actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open customize toolbar from the overflow menu, so that I can choose and reorder which page actions appear in the toolbar and overflow menu.

flows.name: Dismiss menu after action selection
flows.description: As a reader, I want the overflow menu to close after I select an action, so that I can continue with the selected task without the menu blocking the page.

flows.name: Display customized overflow order
flows.description: As a reader, I want the overflow menu to reflect my customized action order, so that the menu matches the toolbar layout I configured.

flows.name: Edit article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to select edit article from the overflow menu, so that I can contribute changes to the current article when editing is available.

flows.name: Find text in article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to start find-in-article from the overflow menu, so that I can search within the current page.

flows.name: Go to home
flows.description: As a reader, I want to select home from the overflow menu, so that I can leave the article and return to the app's Home tab.

flows.name: Handle missing map location
flows.description: As a reader, I want to receive feedback when the current article cannot be viewed on a map, so that I understand why the map action did not open a location.

flows.name: Navigate forward
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the overflow menu to go forward in my page navigation history, so that I can return to an article I previously navigated back from.

flows.name: Open a new tab
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open a new tab from the overflow menu, so that I can start browsing another page without replacing the current tab.

flows.name: Open language options
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the language action from the overflow menu, so that I can view or switch to other language versions of the article.

flows.name: Open reading theme settings
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open theme settings from the overflow menu, so that I can adjust the article reading appearance.

flows.name: Open table of contents
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open contents from the overflow menu, so that I can navigate the article by section.

flows.name: Open talk page
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the talk page from the overflow menu, so that I can view discussions about the current article.

flows.name: Save or manage saved page
flows.description: As a reader, I want to select the save action from the overflow menu, so that I can add the current article to my reading list or manage where an already-saved article is stored.

flows.name: Share article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to select share from the overflow menu, so that I can send the current article link to another app or person.

flows.name: Show only available page actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want the overflow menu to show only actions that are valid for the current page, login state, and mobile-web availability, so that I am not offered actions that cannot be used.

flows.name: View article categories
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open categories from the overflow menu, so that I can see the categories associated with the current article.

flows.name: View article on map
flows.description: As a reader, I want to select view on map from the overflow menu, so that I can see the current article's geographic location when location data is available.

flows.name: View edit history
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open edit history from the overflow menu, so that I can review revisions made to the current article.

flows.name: Watch or unwatch article
flows.description: As a logged-in reader, I want to watch or unwatch the current article from the overflow menu, so that I can control whether changes to the page appear in my watchlist.

name: Page issues dialog
description: Material alert dialog listing page issue/edit notice HTML messages in a RecyclerView, with themed dividers and clickable links that notify the host and dismiss the dialog.

flows.name: Dismiss page issues dialog
flows.description: As a reader, I want to close the page issues dialog when I am done reading, so that I can return to the article.

flows.name: Open notice link
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a link inside a page issue notice, so that I can navigate to the linked article, policy, or other destination for more information.

flows.name: Review page issue notices
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view the page issue and edit notice messages for the current article in a dialog, so that I can understand concerns or notices related to the page.

flows.name: Scroll page issues
flows.description: As a reader, I want to scroll through the list of page issue messages, so that I can read all notices when there are more than fit on the screen.

name: PageActivity
description: Article/page viewing surface, exported for http/https Wikipedia app links under /wiki/ and selected language path patterns.

name: PersonalizationActivity
description: Explore feed personalization surface.

name: Places language filter screen
description:
Activity screen for selecting the wiki language used by Places.
Shows a toolbar with up navigation and a recycler list containing a header, app languages with radio/check visibility for the selected Places language, and a footer row to add/manage languages via the languages activity.

flows.name: Close language filter
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the toolbar up navigation to close the Places language filter, so that I can return to the Places map with any language changes applied.

flows.name: Handle removed selected language
flows.description: As a user, I want Places to fall back to an available app or system language if the selected Places language is removed, so that Places continues to have a valid language selection.

flows.name: Manage app languages
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the app language management screen from the Places language filter, so that I can add or edit the languages available for Places.

flows.name: Refresh languages after managing them
flows.description: As a user, I want the Places language list to update after I return from managing app languages, so that newly added, removed, or changed languages are reflected immediately.

flows.name: Select Places wiki language
flows.description: As a user, I want to select one of my app languages as the Places wiki language, so that nearby place results are shown from the wiki language I prefer.

flows.name: View available Places languages
flows.description: As a user, I want to view my app languages and see which one is currently selected for Places, so that I can understand which wiki language is being used for nearby place results.

name: Places map and nearby articles screen
description: Places activity/fragment surface with full-screen MapLibre map and nearby Wikipedia article markers/clusters, search bar, tabs button, back button, language filter button, current-location permission flow, map/list toggle, nearby article list rows, marker detail bottom-sheet link previews, and long-press actions for places results.

flows.name: Add list result to reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to add a long-pressed nearby article to a reading list, so that I can save the place for later reading.

flows.name: Clear selected place search
flows.description: As a user, I want to clear the selected place in the search bar, so that the map returns to an unselected nearby-articles browsing state.

flows.name: Copy list result link
flows.description: As a user, I want to copy a nearby article link from the long-press menu, so that I can paste or store the place link elsewhere.

flows.name: Dismiss article preview
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss a place article preview, so that I can return to browsing the map without a selected marker or search text.

flows.name: Explore map area
flows.description: As a user, I want to pan and zoom the map to load nearby articles for the visible area, so that I can explore places in different locations.

flows.name: Filter places by language
flows.description: As a user, I want to change the language used for nearby place results, so that I can discover articles from the wiki language I prefer.

flows.name: Get directions to list result
flows.description: As a user, I want to get directions to a nearby article's location from the long-press menu, so that I can navigate to the physical place.

flows.name: Grant location permission
flows.description: As a user, I want to grant location permission when prompted, so that the app can show my current position and nearby places on the map.

flows.name: Handle denied location permission
flows.description: As a user, I want to be notified when location permission is denied, so that I understand why the map cannot center on my current location.

flows.name: Leave places screen
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the back button in the places search bar, so that I can exit the places screen and return to where I came from.

flows.name: Move saved list result between reading lists
flows.description: As a user, I want to move a saved nearby article between reading lists from the long-press menu, so that I can organize saved places.

flows.name: Open article from list
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a nearby article row in the list, so that I can read the full Wikipedia page for that place.

flows.name: Open article from preview
flows.description: As a user, I want to open a place article from its map preview, so that I can read the full Wikipedia page.

flows.name: Open list result in new tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to open a long-pressed nearby article in a new tab, so that I can keep the places screen open while saving the article for reading.

flows.name: Open preview article in background tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to open a place article preview in a new background tab, so that I can save it for later while staying on the places map.

flows.name: Open tabs from places screen
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the tabs button from the places screen, so that I can view my open Wikipedia tabs or current page.

flows.name: Preview article from map marker
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a map marker for a nearby article, so that I can view a bottom-sheet preview of that place without leaving the map.

flows.name: Remove list result from reading lists
flows.description: As a user, I want to remove a saved nearby article from my reading lists using the long-press menu, so that my saved places stay up to date.

flows.name: Resume previous map position
flows.description: As a user, I want the places screen to remember the last map position and zoom level, so that I can return to the area I was exploring after reopening the screen.

flows.name: Search for a place
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the search bar to find a Wikipedia place result, so that the map moves to that place and shows its nearby articles.

flows.name: See no-results feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to see feedback when no nearby articles are found for the current area, so that I understand why the map or list has no places to show.

flows.name: Share list result
flows.description: As a user, I want to share a nearby article from the long-press menu, so that I can send the place to someone else.

flows.name: Switch back to map view
flows.description: As a user, I want to switch from the nearby articles list back to the map, so that I can continue exploring places spatially.

flows.name: Switch to nearby articles list
flows.description: As a user, I want to switch from the map to a list of nearby articles, so that I can browse results in a compact readable format with titles, descriptions, thumbnails, and distances.

flows.name: Use current location
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the current-location button, so that the map centers on my location and shows nearby articles around me.

flows.name: Use empty list guidance
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an empty-state message when no nearby articles are available in list view and use its link to return to the map, so that I know how to continue exploring.

flows.name: Use long-press actions on list result
flows.description: As a user, I want to long-press a nearby article result, so that I can access contextual actions for that place.

flows.name: View nearby articles on map
flows.description: As a user, I want to see nearby Wikipedia articles as markers and clusters on a full-screen map, so that I can discover places around the current map area.

flows.name: Zoom into article cluster
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a cluster of nearby article markers, so that I can zoom in and reveal individual places in that area.

name: Places nearby data surface
description: ViewModel-backed data surface for the Places feature that loads geosearch nearby pages for the saved language/location, maps them to PageTitle/NearbyPage items with thumbnails/descriptions, sorts by last known location, and exposes loading result LiveData to the Places UI.

name: Places of interest feed modules
description: Explore feed Places surfaces: a location-permission prompt with image grid, explanatory text, and button to go to Places; and a paged article module showing nearby place article cards with location footer, open/share/save/hide/customize actions.

flows.name: Browse nearby place cards
flows.description: As a user, I want to swipe through paged nearby place article cards, so that I can explore multiple places of interest near me.

flows.name: Customize interests from place card
flows.description: As a user, I want to open interest customization from a nearby place card action menu, so that I can adjust the recommendations shown in my feed.

flows.name: Go to Places from location prompt
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Places call-to-action in the Places of interest prompt, so that I can open the Places experience and enable location-based discovery.

flows.name: Hide Places of interest module
flows.description: As a user, I want to hide the Places of interest module from the action menu, so that this category no longer appears in my feed.

flows.name: Hide nearby place card
flows.description: As a user, I want to hide an individual nearby place card from the action menu, so that the feed stops showing me that specific recommendation.

flows.name: Open nearby place article
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a nearby place card, so that I can open and read the full Wikipedia article for that place.

flows.name: Preview nearby place details
flows.description: As a user, I want each nearby place card to show the article title, summary or fallback text presentation, image when available, and distance footer, so that I can decide whether the place is relevant before opening it.

flows.name: Save nearby place article
flows.description: As a user, I want to save a nearby place article from the card action menu, so that I can read or revisit it later from my saved list.

flows.name: See nearby places loading state
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a loading indicator while Places of interest articles are being fetched, so that I know nearby recommendations are still loading.

flows.name: Share nearby place article
flows.description: As a user, I want to share a nearby place article from the card action menu, so that I can send the place to someone else.

flows.name: View Places prompt explanation
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an image grid with explanatory Places of interest text when location access is not available, so that I understand why the feed is inviting me to use Places.

name: PlacesActivity
description: Places/nearby map or list surface.

name: PlacesFilterActivity
description: Places filters surface.

name: Random article carousel screen
description:
Fragment-based random article surface showing a swipeable ViewPager of random article cards.
Each card has thumbnail/title/description/extract, loading and error states with retry/back, controls for next/back, shake-to-next, save/bookmark actions, and opens the selected article with shared-element transition.

name: Random article feed module
description:
Explore feed random-article pager built on ForYouCardContent.
Shows random article cards with open/share/save/hide/customize actions and a footer shuffle button with dice icon to fetch/show new random content.

flows.name: Browse multiple random cards
flows.description: As a reader, I want to swipe horizontally through multiple random article cards and see which card is selected, so that I can browse several random suggestions in the feed module.

flows.name: Customize feed interests
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open interest customization from a random article card, so that I can adjust the topics used to personalize my feed.

flows.name: Hide random article card
flows.description: As a reader, I want to dismiss an individual random article card from the options menu, so that I no longer see that specific suggestion in my feed.

flows.name: Hide random article module
flows.description: As a reader, I want to hide the random article feed module from the options menu, so that random article suggestions are removed from my Explore feed.

flows.name: Open card options menu
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the overflow menu on a random article card, so that I can access actions for that article or feed module.

flows.name: Open random article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a random article card, so that I can open and read the full article.

flows.name: Save random article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to save a random article from the card options menu, so that I can find it later in my reading list.

flows.name: Share random article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to share a random article from the card options menu, so that I can send the article to someone else.

flows.name: Shuffle to random article experience
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap the dice shuffle button in the random article card footer, so that I can launch the random article experience and get new random content.

flows.name: View random article cards
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view random article cards with an image or text preview, title, description or extract, and random-article label, so that I can discover articles that may interest me.

name: Random article pager card transition widget
description: ViewPager2 PageTransformer used by the random article screen to animate article cards with rotation, vertical offset, z-order, alpha, and RTL-aware swiping behavior.

name: Random article screen
description:
Activity-hosted screen for browsing random Wikipedia articles.
RandomActivity creates the RandomFragment with the selected WikiSite/invoke source and removes action-bar elevation; companion provides the launch intent.

flows.name: Advance to next random article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to request the next random article using the dice next button, so that I can continue discovering new articles.

flows.name: Browse in landscape layout
flows.description: As a reader using landscape orientation, I want the random article carousel and controls arranged to fit the wider screen, so that I can browse comfortably without the controls covering article content.

flows.name: Browse language-direction-aware articles
flows.description: As a reader, I want random article content and carousel motion to respect the article language direction, so that right-to-left and left-to-right languages feel natural to browse.

flows.name: Keep controls accessible around snackbars
flows.description: As a reader, I want the random article controls to move above snackbars, so that messages do not block navigation or bookmark actions.

flows.name: Leave after random article load error
flows.description: As a reader, I want to go back from the random article error state, so that I can leave the screen if loading cannot be recovered.

flows.name: Manage saved random article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the bookmark control on an already saved random article to manage which reading list contains it, so that my saved article is organized where I want it.

flows.name: Open selected random article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a random article card to open the full article, so that I can read more about the topic I discovered.

flows.name: Retry failed random article load
flows.description: As a reader, I want to retry when a random article fails to load, so that I can recover from a network or service error without leaving the screen.

flows.name: Return to previous random article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to go back to the previous random article card when one is available, so that I can revisit a random article I just browsed past.

flows.name: Save random article to reading list
flows.description: As a reader, I want to bookmark an unsaved random article to my default reading list, so that I can find and read it later.

flows.name: See bookmark status
flows.description: As a reader, I want the bookmark icon to show whether the current random article is already saved, so that I know its reading-list status before acting.

flows.name: Shake for next random article
flows.description: As a reader, I want to shake my device to move to the next random article with haptic feedback, so that I can discover another article using a playful hands-on gesture.

flows.name: Swipe through random articles
flows.description: As a reader, I want to swipe the carousel between random article cards, so that I can browse random articles with a natural paging gesture.

flows.name: View random article card
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see a randomly selected Wikipedia article card with its thumbnail, title, description, and extract, so that I can quickly discover an article that may interest me.

name: Random screen bottom bar snackbar avoidance behavior
description: CoordinatorLayout behavior for the random screen bottom controls; detects SnackbarLayout dependencies and translates the bottom view upward while snackbars are visible, then restores it.

name: RandomActivity
description: Random article surface.

name: Reading Challenge App Widget
description: GlanceAppWidget entry point that observes Reading Challenge state and renders either large or small widget content based on widget width.

flows.name: Automatically refresh challenge status
flows.description: As a Reading Challenge user, I want the widget to update when my enrollment, streak, or read-today status changes, so that the home-screen widget always reflects my current challenge progress.

flows.name: Collect challenge prize
flows.description: As a user who completed the Reading Challenge, I want to tap the widget to collect my prize, so that I can view or claim my completion reward in the app.

flows.name: Explore before challenge starts
flows.description: As a user, I want to open Wikipedia from the widget when the Reading Challenge is not live yet, so that I can continue exploring articles while waiting for the challenge to begin.

flows.name: Join reading challenge
flows.description: As a user who has not enrolled, I want to tap the widget to join the Reading Challenge, so that I can start participating from the app.

flows.name: Open a random article from large widget
flows.description: As an enrolled user, I want to open a random article from the large widget, so that I can quickly choose something to read for the challenge.

flows.name: Open app after challenge ends or is removed
flows.description: As a user whose challenge has ended or been removed, I want to tap the widget to open Wikipedia, so that I can continue using the app even though the challenge is no longer active.

flows.name: Open app to continue streak
flows.description: As an enrolled user with an active challenge, I want to tap the widget's streak or reminder area to open Wikipedia, so that I can continue working on the Reading Challenge.

flows.name: Open feed after enrollment
flows.description: As an enrolled user who has not started reading yet, I want to open the Wikipedia feed from the widget, so that I can find an article and begin my challenge streak.

flows.name: Search for an article from large widget
flows.description: As an enrolled user, I want to start a Wikipedia search from the large widget, so that I can quickly find an article to read for the challenge.

flows.name: See loading state
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a branded loading state while the widget reads my Reading Challenge status, so that I know the widget is active and preparing current information.

flows.name: View active streak needing reading
flows.description: As an enrolled user with an active streak who has not read today, I want the widget to show my current streak and a reminder to read, so that I know I need to read an article to keep my streak going.

flows.name: View incomplete challenge result
flows.description: As a user whose Reading Challenge concluded before completion, I want the widget to show my final streak or incomplete status, so that I understand how the challenge ended for me.

flows.name: View read-today streak progress
flows.description: As an enrolled user who has already read today, I want the widget to show my current streak and progress toward the 25-day goal, so that I can see my challenge status at a glance.

flows.name: View responsive widget layout
flows.description: As a Reading Challenge participant, I want the widget to automatically show a compact or expanded layout based on its home-screen size, so that the challenge information remains usable wherever I place the widget.

name: Reading Challenge Install Widget Bottom Sheet
description: Expanded bottom sheet Compose dialog prompting users to install/add the Reading Challenge home-screen widget, with close, Got it, and optional Add actions plus widget preview imagery.

flows.name: Acknowledge prompt with Got it
flows.description: As a user, I want to acknowledge the widget install prompt by tapping Got it, so that the prompt is dismissed without adding the widget.

flows.name: Add Reading Challenge widget
flows.description: As a user on a device that supports pinned widgets, I want to tap Add to start adding the Reading Challenge widget to my home screen, so that I can track my reading challenge progress from the launcher.

flows.name: Dismiss prompt with close button
flows.description: As a user, I want to close the Reading Challenge widget install prompt using the close button, so that I can return to the app without taking action.

flows.name: Do not show install prompt again after it appears
flows.description: As a user who has already been shown the Reading Challenge widget install prompt, I want the app to remember that it was shown, so that I am not repeatedly interrupted by the same bottom sheet.

flows.name: Scroll prompt content if needed
flows.description: As a user on a smaller screen or with larger display settings, I want to scroll the widget install prompt content, so that I can access the full message, preview, and available actions.

flows.name: Use simplified prompt when widget pinning is unavailable
flows.description: As a user on a device that does not support in-app widget pinning, I want the prompt to show only a Got it action instead of an Add action, so that I am not offered an unsupported installation option.

flows.name: View widget install prompt
flows.description: As a reading challenge participant, I want to see an expanded bottom sheet explaining the Reading Challenge home-screen widget with preview imagery, so that I understand I can track my challenge progress from my homescreen.

name: Reading Challenge Large App Widget
description: Glance home-screen app widget content for the Reading Challenge large widget, rendering loading, not enrolled, not live, enrolled not started, ongoing streak, needs-reading reminder, completed, and concluded states with CTAs and mascot artwork.

flows.name: Collect challenge reward
flows.description: As a participant who completed the Reading Challenge, I want to tap the widget or Collect your prize button, so that I can open the app and claim my completion reward.

flows.name: Explore before challenge starts
flows.description: As a user viewing the widget before the challenge is live, I want to tap the widget or Explore Wikipedia button to open Wikipedia, so that I can continue reading while waiting for the challenge to begin.

flows.name: Join reading challenge
flows.description: As a user who has not enrolled, I want to tap the large widget or its join button to start the Reading Challenge onboarding, so that I can enroll in the challenge.

flows.name: Open Wikipedia after challenge concludes
flows.description: As a user viewing a concluded or removed challenge state, I want to tap the widget to open Wikipedia, so that I can continue reading outside the challenge.

flows.name: Open Wikipedia from active streak widget
flows.description: As a participant viewing my active streak, I want to tap the widget to open Wikipedia, so that I can continue using the app from my challenge status.

flows.name: Open Wikipedia from needs-reading reminder
flows.description: As a participant who has not read today, I want to tap the reminder area of the widget to open Wikipedia, so that I can read an article and maintain my streak.

flows.name: Open random article from challenge widget
flows.description: As an enrolled challenge participant, I want to tap the Random button from the widget, so that I can quickly discover an article to read for my challenge streak.

flows.name: Search for an article from challenge widget
flows.description: As an enrolled challenge participant, I want to tap the Search button from the widget, so that I can find an article to read for my challenge streak.

flows.name: Show loading placeholder
flows.description: As a widget user, I want to see a loading state while my Reading Challenge status is being resolved, so that I know the widget is initializing instead of broken.

flows.name: View active streak progress
flows.description: As a participant who has already read today, I want the widget to show my current streak and progress toward the 25-day goal, so that I can track my Reading Challenge status at a glance.

flows.name: View concluded incomplete result
flows.description: As a participant whose challenge concluded without completion, I want the widget to show that the challenge ended and display my final streak when available, so that I understand my final result.

flows.name: View enrolled not started prompt
flows.description: As an enrolled participant who has not started reading yet, I want the widget to show a start-reading prompt with search and random article options, so that I can begin my challenge streak.

flows.name: View needs-reading reminder
flows.description: As a participant who has not read today, I want the widget to show my current streak with a reminder to read, so that I know I need to read an article to keep my streak alive.

name: Reading Challenge Login Prompt Dialog
description: Compose WikipediaAlertDialog shown from the onboarding activity when an unauthenticated user tries to join, offering Login or No thanks actions.

flows.name: Continue to login
flows.description: As an unauthenticated user, I want to choose Login from the reading challenge prompt, so that I can sign in and continue toward joining the challenge.

flows.name: Decline login prompt
flows.description: As an unauthenticated user, I want to choose No thanks from the reading challenge login prompt, so that I can decline joining through login and leave the onboarding flow.

flows.name: Dismiss login prompt
flows.description: As an unauthenticated user, I want to dismiss the reading challenge login prompt without choosing an action, so that I can return to the onboarding screen and decide what to do next.

flows.name: See login prompt when joining unauthenticated
flows.description: As an unauthenticated user, I want to see a login prompt when I try to join the reading challenge, so that I understand I need to log in before joining.

name: Reading Challenge Onboarding Activity
description: Full-screen Compose onboarding activity announcing the Reading Challenge with close control, explanatory onboarding items, Join challenge and Learn more bottom actions, and note text.

flows.name: Cancel login prompt
flows.description: As a logged-out Wikipedia user, I want to dismiss the Reading Challenge login prompt without choosing login or no thanks, so that I can return to the onboarding screen and reconsider my options.

flows.name: Decline login prompt
flows.description: As a logged-out Wikipedia user, I want to decline the Reading Challenge login prompt, so that I can exit without logging in or joining the challenge.

flows.name: Dismiss onboarding
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to close the Reading Challenge onboarding screen, so that I can leave the announcement without joining the challenge.

flows.name: Join challenge while logged in
flows.description: As a logged-in Wikipedia user, I want to join the Reading Challenge from the onboarding screen, so that my enrollment date is saved and the challenge widget/progress can be updated for participation.

flows.name: Learn more about challenge
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to open the Reading Challenge learn-more page from the onboarding screen, so that I can read additional details before deciding whether to join.

flows.name: Log in or create account for challenge
flows.description: As a logged-out Wikipedia user, I want to proceed from the Reading Challenge login prompt to the login or account-creation flow, so that I can authenticate and join the challenge.

flows.name: Prompt login to join challenge
flows.description: As a logged-out Wikipedia user, I want to be prompted to log in or create an account when I try to join the Reading Challenge, so that I understand an account is required to track my progress.

flows.name: Review reading challenge introduction
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to review the Reading Challenge announcement, rules, benefits, widget reminder explanation, challenge dates, and privacy note, so that I can decide whether to participate with enough context.

name: Reading Challenge Playground Bottom Sheet
description:
Expanded, non-draggable developer bottom sheet for inspecting and editing Reading Challenge widget state.
Contains current state, streak stepper, switches for enrollment/onboarding/widget prompt/fast cycle, date fields and quick chips, save buttons, explicit widget update scheduling, and reset all.

flows.name: Adjust reading streak
flows.description: As a developer, I want to increment or decrement the reading challenge streak, so that I can test widget behavior for different streak counts without reading articles.

flows.name: Dismiss playground
flows.description: As a developer, I want to close the Reading Challenge Playground with the back button in the sheet header, so that I can return to developer settings when I am done testing.

flows.name: Edit challenge end date
flows.description: As a developer, I want to manually enter and save the Reading Challenge end date, so that I can test active, concluded, and buffer-period challenge states.

flows.name: Edit challenge start date
flows.description: As a developer, I want to manually enter and save the Reading Challenge start date, so that I can test pre-launch and active challenge timing states.

flows.name: Edit last read date
flows.description: As a developer, I want to manually enter and save the last read date, so that I can test read-today, needs-reading, active-streak, and broken-streak challenge states.

flows.name: Inspect current challenge state
flows.description: As a developer, I want to view the current resolved Reading Challenge state, so that I can verify how stored preferences map to widget challenge states.

flows.name: Open Reading Challenge Playground
flows.description: As a developer, I want to open the Reading Challenge Playground from developer settings, so that I can inspect and manipulate Reading Challenge widget state in a dedicated bottom sheet.

flows.name: Persist changes and refresh widgets
flows.description: As a developer, I want changes made in the playground to be saved to preferences and refresh Reading Challenge widgets, so that the widget immediately reflects the scenario I am testing.

flows.name: Reset all reading challenge test values
flows.description: As a developer, I want to reset all Reading Challenge playground values to their defaults, so that I can return to a clean baseline after testing scenarios.

flows.name: Toggle challenge enrollment
flows.description: As a developer, I want to mark the user as enrolled or not enrolled in the Reading Challenge, so that I can test enrolled and unenrolled widget states.

flows.name: Toggle fast widget update cycle
flows.description: As a developer, I want to enable or disable the fast Reading Challenge widget update cycle when an active enrolled state supports it, so that I can test scheduled widget updates without waiting until midnight.

flows.name: Toggle onboarding shown flag
flows.description: As a developer, I want to set whether Reading Challenge onboarding has already been shown, so that I can test onboarding eligibility and related widget flows.

flows.name: Toggle widget install prompt shown flag
flows.description: As a developer, I want to set whether the Reading Challenge widget install prompt has already been shown, so that I can test prompt eligibility and display behavior.

flows.name: Use last read date presets
flows.description: As a developer, I want to quickly set the last read date to today, yesterday, three days ago, or clear it, so that I can rapidly test common streak scenarios.

flows.name: Validate date input before saving
flows.description: As a developer, I want date save actions to be disabled for invalid date formats while allowing empty values, so that Reading Challenge test preferences remain parseable.

name: Reading Challenge Reward Bottom Sheet
description: Expanded bottom sheet dialog shown when the reading challenge is completed, with reward artwork, title/body text, close button, and external prize/store action.

flows.name: Close reward bottom sheet
flows.description: As a reading challenge participant, I want to close the reward bottom sheet when I am done viewing it, so that I can return to the app without taking the prize action.

flows.name: Open Wikipedia Store reward
flows.description: As a reading challenge participant, I want to tap the reward action button to open the Wikipedia Store discount page in an external browser, so that I can redeem my completion prize.

flows.name: Scroll reward content
flows.description: As a reading challenge participant, I want to scroll the reward bottom sheet content when it does not fit on my screen, so that I can read the full reward message and reach the action button.

flows.name: View completion reward details
flows.description: As a reading challenge participant, I want to see the completion reward artwork, title, and explanatory text, so that I can understand the prize I earned for finishing the challenge.

name: Reading Challenge Small App Widget
description: Glance small-size app widget content for Reading Challenge, with state-specific layouts for loading, not enrolled, active streak, completed, and concluded states.

flows.name: Adapt small widget layout to available space
flows.description: As a widget user, I want the small Reading Challenge widget content to scale its mascot, badge, and title icon for compact widget sizes, so that the widget remains readable and usable on my home screen.

flows.name: Collect completion prize
flows.description: As a user who completed the Reading Challenge goal, I want to tap the small widget or Collect prize button, so that I can open Wikipedia and claim my challenge reward.

flows.name: Continue streak needing reading
flows.description: As an enrolled user with an active streak who has not read today, I want to see my current streak with a warning indicator and tap the widget, so that I can open Wikipedia and read to keep my streak alive.

flows.name: Explore before challenge starts
flows.description: As a user viewing the widget before the Reading Challenge is live, I want to tap the widget or Explore button, so that I can open Wikipedia and browse content while waiting for the challenge to begin.

flows.name: Join reading challenge
flows.description: As a user who has not enrolled in the Reading Challenge, I want to tap the small widget or its Join challenge button, so that I can open the app and start the challenge onboarding flow.

flows.name: Open app after concluded or removed challenge
flows.description: As a user viewing a concluded challenge with no streak or a removed challenge state, I want to tap the small widget, so that I can open Wikipedia even though no challenge action remains available.

flows.name: Open feed after enrollment
flows.description: As an enrolled user who has not started reading yet, I want to tap the small widget or Feed button, so that I can open Wikipedia and find an article to begin my reading streak.

flows.name: Review incomplete final streak
flows.description: As a user whose Reading Challenge concluded with an incomplete streak, I want to see my final streak count and tap the widget, so that I can return to Wikipedia after the challenge has ended.

flows.name: Show loading widget
flows.description: As a widget user, I want to see a loading state while the Reading Challenge widget determines my challenge status, so that I know the widget is initializing rather than broken.

flows.name: View maintained streak
flows.description: As an enrolled user who has already read today, I want to see my current streak with a completed streak indicator and tap the widget, so that I can return to Wikipedia while knowing my streak is safe for today.

name: Reading List Sync Login Required Dialog
description: Material alert dialog displayed when a logged-out user tries to enable reading list sync, offering login or cancel actions.

flows.name: Cancel reading list sync login prompt
flows.description: As a logged-out user, I want to cancel or dismiss the login-required prompt, so that I can stay signed out and leave reading list sync disabled.

flows.name: Proceed to login for reading list sync
flows.description: As a logged-out user, I want to choose the login action from the reading list sync prompt, so that I can sign in and then enable syncing my reading lists.

flows.name: View login-required sync prompt

flows.name: Add article to another list
flows.description: As a user, I want to add an article from this reading list to another reading list, so that I can organize it in multiple lists.

flows.name: Add selected articles to another list
flows.description: As a user, I want to add selected articles to another reading list, so that I can organize multiple articles together.

flows.name: Allow mobile data for offline download
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm downloading reading list articles over mobile data when Wi-Fi-only downloading is enabled, so that I can choose to proceed without Wi-Fi.

flows.name: Customize recommended reading list settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to open recommended reading list settings from the screen or onboarding snackbar, so that I can adjust how recommendations are generated.

flows.name: Customize saved preview articles
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose which articles from a preview or recommended list will be saved and provide a valid list title, so that the saved list contains only the articles I want.

flows.name: Delete article from list
flows.description: As a user, I want to remove an article from the reading list using swipe or item actions, so that the list only contains articles I want to keep.

flows.name: Delete reading list

flows.name: Delete selected articles

flows.name: Export reading list

flows.name: Learn about recommended reading lists

flows.name: Move article to another list
flows.description: As a user, I want to move an article from this reading list to another reading list, so that I can reorganize my saved articles.

flows.name: Move selected articles to another list
flows.description: As a user, I want to move selected articles to another reading list, so that I can reorganize multiple articles at once.

flows.name: Open article from reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap an article in the reading list, so that I can read that saved or recommended article.

flows.name: Open list chip from article search result
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a list chip on an article search result, so that I can open the reading list containing that article.

flows.name: Open list from search results
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a reading list shown in search results, so that I can navigate to that list's detail screen.

flows.name: Refresh reading list sync
flows.description: As a user, I want to pull to refresh a standard reading list, so that my saved articles and list metadata are updated from sync.

flows.name: Rename reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to rename a non-default reading list and edit its description, so that the list is easier to identify.

flows.name: Return from reading list detail

flows.name: Save all articles offline

flows.description: As a user, I want to sort reading list articles by recent order in either direction, so that I can browse articles based on when they were added or updated.

flows.name: Toggle article offline availability
flows.description: As a user, I want to save or remove an individual article for offline reading, so that I can control which articles are stored on my device.

flows.name: Toggle recommended list notifications

flows.name: Undo article deletion

flows.name: View reading list header summary
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a collapsing header with list title, description, article counts, offline counts, storage size, and article thumbnails, so that I can quickly understand the list contents.

flows.description: As a reading list user, I want the default reading list overflow menu to omit rename and delete actions, so that I am not offered actions that cannot be applied to the default list.

flows.name: Remove all list articles from offline
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to remove all articles in a reading list from offline storage from the overflow menu, so that I can free up device storage.

flows.name: Rename reading list
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to rename a non-default reading list from the overflow menu, so that I can keep my saved lists organized with meaningful names and descriptions.

flows.name: Save all list articles offline

flows.name: Select reading list from menu
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to select or unselect a reading list from the long-press overflow menu, so that I can manage multiple lists in selection mode.

flows.name: Share reading list from menu
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to share a reading list from the overflow menu, so that I can send the list to another person or app.

name: Reading List page actions bottom sheet

flows.name: Add page to another list

flows.name: Hide unavailable actions during action mode
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want actions that conflict with the current selection mode to be hidden, so that I only see actions that are valid in the current context.

flows.name: Move page to another list
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to move the saved page to another reading list, so that I can reorganize my saved articles without keeping it in the current list.

flows.name: Remove page from list or lists
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to remove the saved page from its reading list or lists, so that I can delete unwanted saved articles from my collections.

flows.name: Select page for multi-select
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to select the saved page from the actions sheet, so that I can enter multi-select mode and perform bulk actions.

flows.name: Share saved page
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to share a saved page from the actions sheet, so that I can send the article to another person or app.

flows.name: Toggle offline availability

flows.name: View selected saved page actions

flows.name: See article details while choosing
flows.description: As a reading list preview user, I want to see each article’s title, optional description, and thumbnail in the checklist, so that I can identify which articles to save.

flows.name: Select articles to save
flows.description: As a reading list preview user, I want to select and deselect individual articles in the dialog checklist, so that only the articles I choose are saved into the new reading list.

flows.name: Learn about recommended lists
flows.description: As a user, I want to open About from a recommended reading-list menu, so that I can learn what recommended reading lists are and how they work.

flows.name: Manage recommended-list notifications
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the notifications control on a recommended reading list, so that I can manage whether recommendation notifications are enabled.

flows.name: Open reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a reading-list row, so that I can open and view the contents of that list.

flows.name: Select list with checkbox
flows.description: As a user, I want to check or uncheck a reading-list row while in selection mode, so that I can choose lists for bulk actions.

flows.name: Select or unselect from menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to select or unselect a reading list from the long-press menu, so that I can include or remove it from a multi-selection set.

flows.name: Share reading list

name: Reading List sync behavior dialogs

flows.name: Acknowledge sync disabled notice
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to acknowledge a dialog telling me that reading list sync was turned off for my account, so that I understand saved articles are no longer being backed up.

flows.name: Decline enabling reading list sync
flows.description: As a logged-in reading list user, I want to decline the prompt to enable reading list sync, so that I can continue using local reading lists without turning on syncing.

flows.name: Decline logging in for sync
flows.description: As a logged-out reading list user, I want to decline the login-to-sync prompt, so that I can continue without signing in or enabling synced reading lists.

flows.name: Enable reading list sync
flows.description: As a logged-in reading list user, I want to enable reading list syncing from the prompt, so that my saved reading list articles can be synced with my Wikipedia account.

name: Reading List title dialog
description: Reusable text-input dialog for creating or renaming a reading list, with fields for name and description, duplicate-title validation, empty-name validation, and cancel/success callbacks.

flows.name: Cancel reading list title dialog

flows.name: Import reading lists from JSON file

flows.name: Open Downloads from export notification
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the export completion notification, so that I can open the system Downloads view and access the exported reading-list file.

flows.name: Open Downloads from export snackbar
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the View action in the export completion snackbar, so that I can immediately open the Downloads view containing the exported file.

flows.name: Receive export completion notification

flows.name: Require list selection before export

flows.name: See export completion snackbar

flows.name: Choose reading lists to remove from
flows.description: As a user, I want to select which reading lists should remove the article when it appears in multiple lists, so that I can keep it saved where I still need it.

flows.name: Copy page link
flows.description: As a user, I want to copy the selected article link from the long-press menu, so that I can paste it elsewhere.

flows.name: Create reading list while adding
flows.description: As a user, I want to create a new reading list while adding the selected article, so that I can save it in a new custom collection without leaving the flow.

flows.name: Create reading list while moving
flows.description: As a user, I want to create a new reading list while moving an article, so that I can move it into a new custom collection in one flow.

flows.name: Get directions to place
flows.description: As a user viewing a place with location data, I want to get directions from the long-press menu, so that I can navigate to that place using a maps app.

flows.name: Handle add limits or duplicates
flows.description: As a user, I want to receive feedback when an article is already in a reading list or cannot be added because a limit is reached, so that I understand why the save action did not add another copy.

flows.name: Move to another reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to move an article from its current reading list to another list, so that I can reorganize saved articles without creating duplicates.

flows.name: Open in new tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the selected article in a new tab, so that I can keep my current page or list position while reading it separately.

flows.name: Open page
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the selected article from the long-press menu, so that I can read the page immediately.

flows.name: Open page in Places
flows.description: As a user browsing a Places result, I want to open the selected article in the Places experience, so that I can view the place-specific page context.

flows.name: Remove from one reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to remove an article from the single reading list that contains it, so that it is no longer saved in that list.

flows.name: Save to default reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to save an article to my default reading list from the long-press menu, so that I can find it again later.

flows.name: Share page
flows.description: As a user, I want to share the selected article from the long-press menu, so that I can send the page to another person or app.

flows.name: View destination list after adding
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the reading list from the add confirmation message, so that I can review the list I just saved the article to.

name: Reading list sync progress notification
description: Foreground/progress notification surface for reading list synchronization, displaying syncing title/description and progress while ReadingListSyncAdapter syncs remote and local reading lists.

flows.name: Monitor reading list sync progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a foreground notification while my reading lists are syncing with the number of lists being synced, the number remaining, and percentage progress, so that I know synchronization is actively running and how far along it is.

flows.name: See sync notification clear on completion
flows.description: As a user, I want the reading list sync progress notification to disappear when synchronization finishes, so that my notification shade only shows active sync work.

name: Reading lists overflow popup
description: PopupWindow-based overflow menu for reading lists, anchored to a view, with actions for sorting, creating/importing lists, selecting lists, refreshing, and showing last sync time.

flows.name: Create new reading list
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want to choose the create list option from the overflow popup, so that I can make a new reading list.

flows.name: Dismiss overflow after choosing an action
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want the overflow popup to close after I choose a menu action, so that I can continue working on the reading lists screen without the menu blocking content.

flows.name: Import reading list
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want to choose the import list option from the overflow popup, so that I can import a reading list from a JSON file.

flows.name: Open reading lists overflow menu
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want to open an overflow popup menu from the toolbar, so that I can access additional reading list actions.

flows.name: Refresh reading list sync
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want to choose the refresh option from the overflow popup, so that I can manually sync and update my reading lists.

flows.name: Select reading lists
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want to choose the select option from the overflow popup, so that I can enter multi-select mode for managing lists.

flows.name: Sort reading lists
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want to choose the sort option from the overflow popup, so that I can change the order in which my reading lists are displayed.

flows.name: View last sync time
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want to see the last sync time in the overflow popup when one is available, so that I know how recently my reading lists were synchronized.

name: ReadingChallengeOnboardingActivity
description: Reading challenge widget/onboarding surface.

name: ReadingListActivity
description: Reading list UI surface.

name: Recent Searches Panel
description: Search sub-panel showing recent query chips/list, namespace shortcut suggestions, empty-state text with optional add-languages button, swipe-to-delete recent entries, and a toolbar delete button.

flows.name: Add languages from empty state
flows.description: As a single-language user with no recent searches, I want to tap the add-languages button in the empty state, so that I can add more Wikipedia languages for multilingual searching.

flows.name: Browse namespace shortcuts
flows.description: As a user, I want to see horizontally listed namespace search shortcuts, so that I can discover scoped search options such as User, Portal, Help, Project, and Template.

flows.name: Cancel clearing recent searches
flows.description: As a user, I want to decline the clear-all confirmation dialog, so that my recent search history is kept unchanged if I tapped delete by mistake.

flows.name: Clear all recent searches
