flows.description: As a user, I want to use the toolbar delete button and confirm clearing my recent searches, so that I can remove my entire recent search history at once.

flows.name: Delete one recent search
flows.description: As a user, I want to swipe a recent search entry to delete it, so that I can remove an individual query from my search history.

flows.name: Run a recent search
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a recent search entry, so that the search field is populated and the search is run again without retyping the query.

flows.name: Search within a namespace
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a namespace shortcut, so that the search field starts a scoped search with that namespace prefix.

flows.name: View empty recent-search state
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an empty-state message when I have no recent searches, so that I understand why no recent search entries are shown.

flows.name: View recent searches
flows.description: As a user, I want to see my previous search queries listed in recent-first order, so that I can quickly find searches I have performed before.

name: Recent edits feedback tooltip popup
description: Tooltip-style popup anchored to the more options view after feedback submission for suggested edits recent edits, with dismiss button and no auto-dismiss.

flows.name: Dismiss feedback tooltip manually
flows.description: As a recent edits patroller, I want to dismiss the feedback tooltip with the Got it button, so that I can remove the popup when I am done reading it.

flows.name: Keep tooltip visible until dismissed
flows.description: As a recent edits patroller, I want the feedback tooltip to stay visible instead of disappearing automatically or when I tap outside it, so that I have enough time to read and act on it.

flows.name: Show feedback tooltip only once
flows.description: As a recent edits patroller, I want the feedback tooltip to be shown only the first time after submitting feedback, so that I am not repeatedly interrupted by the same guidance.

flows.name: View recent edits feedback tooltip after submission
flows.description: As a recent edits patroller, I want to see a tooltip after submitting feedback, so that I understand where to access the related more-options feedback entry point or information.

name: Recent edits filters
description: Patroller filter settings screen listing grouped filter categories (user status, latest revisions, automated contributions, contribution quality, user intent, significance), selection controls, reset menu, and optional language chooser entry.

flows.name: Filter automated contributions
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to choose whether to show all editors, bots, or humans, so that I can focus recent edits by automated or human contribution source.

flows.name: Filter by user status
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to include or exclude user status filters such as unregistered users, registered users, newcomers, learners, and experienced users, so that I can focus recent edits on contributors with the statuses I want to review.

flows.name: Filter contribution quality
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to include or exclude contribution quality predictions from good through very likely problematic, so that I can focus on edits with the damage risk levels I care about.

flows.name: Filter edit significance
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to choose whether to show all edits, minor edits, or non-minor edits, so that I can focus recent edits by significance.

flows.name: Filter latest revision state
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to choose whether to show latest revisions or not-latest revisions, so that I can focus on edits based on whether they are still current.

flows.name: Filter user intent
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to include or exclude good-faith prediction ranges from likely good-faith through very likely bad-faith, so that I can focus on edits with the intent signals I want to review.

flows.name: Reset filters to defaults
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to reset the recent edits filters to their default settings, so that I can quickly return to the standard patrol feed configuration.

flows.name: View grouped recent edits filters
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to view recent edits filter categories grouped by user status, latest revisions, automated contributions, contribution quality, user intent, and significance, so that I can understand the available ways to narrow the patrol feed.

name: Recent edits onboarding
description: Two-page onboarding flow for patroller/recent edits tasks with Get Started completion, skip/back handling, and links including privacy/external URLs.

flows.name: Complete onboarding with Get started
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to tap Get started after the final onboarding page, so that I can finish onboarding and begin using recent edits patrolling tasks.

flows.name: Continue to next onboarding page
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to tap Continue on the first onboarding page, so that I can advance to the next part of the introduction.

flows.name: Go back during onboarding
flows.description: As a patroller, I want the Back action to return me to the previous onboarding page or exit the flow when appropriate, so that I can recover from accidental navigation or leave onboarding.

flows.name: Open external onboarding link
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open external links from onboarding content, so that I can learn more from linked resources outside the onboarding screen.

flows.name: Open privacy policy link
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open a privacy policy link from onboarding content, so that I can review the privacy terms before proceeding.

flows.name: Review recent edits onboarding pages
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to read and move through the recent edits onboarding pages, so that I can understand how reviewing recent edits helps improve Wikipedia and what actions are available on the diff screen.

flows.name: Skip onboarding
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to skip the onboarding flow from an introductory page, so that I can leave the tutorial without paging through all of it.

name: Recent edits patrol list
description: Patroller recent changes screen with toolbar actions, notification button, pull-to-refresh paged list, search action mode, filter entry point, empty-filter message state, loading/error rows, and clickable recent edit cards/user menu triggers.

flows.name: Apply updated filters to list
flows.description: As a patroller, I want the recent edits list to refresh and show the number of active filters after I change filters, so that I can verify that my selected criteria are being used.

flows.name: Complete first-time onboarding
flows.description: As a new patroller, I want to see the recent edits onboarding the first time I open the screen, so that I can understand how to use edit patrol before reviewing edits.

flows.name: Exit search mode
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to close search mode and clear the current search query, so that I can return to the full recent edits list.

flows.name: Learn more about editing
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open the learn-more help item from the overflow menu, so that I can read the app editing FAQ while using recent edits patrol.

flows.name: Leave recent edits patrol
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to use the system back action to leave the recent edits patrol list, so that I can return to the previous part of the app.

flows.name: Load more recent edits
flows.description: As a patroller, I want more recent edits to load as I scroll, so that I can continue reviewing older edits without leaving the list.

flows.name: Modify filters from empty results
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to use the empty-results message link to modify active filters, so that I can recover when my filters produce no recent edits.

flows.name: Open edit patrol task
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to tap a recent edit card or its byte-difference button, so that I can open the vandalism patrol review workflow for that edit.

flows.name: Open editor actions menu
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to tap the editor name on a recent edit card, so that I can view user information and user-talk actions for the editor of that revision.

flows.name: Open notifications
flows.description: As a logged-in patroller, I want to tap the notifications button and see unread notification count changes, so that I can review account notifications while patrolling.

flows.name: Open recent edits filters
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open the filter screen from the search/filter bar or search action mode, so that I can narrow the recent edits list by edit and user criteria.

flows.name: Open saved warning messages
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open my saved warning messages from the overflow menu, so that I can manage reusable talk-page warning templates for patrol work.

flows.name: Pull to refresh recent edits
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to pull down on the recent edits list to refresh it, so that I can see the latest available edits and updated filter results.

flows.name: Report patroller tasks feedback
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to report feedback about the patroller tasks feature from the overflow menu, so that I can send issues or suggestions to the app team.

flows.name: Retry loading after error
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to retry when the recent edits list or next page fails to load, so that temporary network or server problems do not stop me from continuing patrol.

flows.name: Search recent edits
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open search mode and type a query that filters recent edits by title, comment, editor, tags, or date, so that I can find edits matching specific text.

flows.name: View recent edits list
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to view a paged list of recent edits with article title, edit summary, tags, timestamp, editor, byte difference, and date separators, so that I can quickly decide which edits may need review.

name: Recommended Reading List discover card widget
description: Composable card embedded in the Reading Lists screen that promotes the generated recommended reading list with title, made-for subtitle, description, image grid, and new-list indicator.

flows.name: Hide card when recommendations are unavailable
flows.description: As a Reading Lists user, I want the Discover card to be hidden when recommended reading lists are disabled, not ready, or have no generated articles, so that the Reading Lists screen only shows relevant available features.

flows.name: Notice newly generated recommendations
flows.description: As a Reading Lists user, I want the Discover card to show and update a new-list indicator when fresh recommendations have been generated, so that I can tell there is new recommended content to review.

flows.name: Open recommended reading list
flows.description: As a Reading Lists user, I want to tap the Discover card, so that I can open the generated recommended reading list and browse the recommended articles.

flows.name: Preview recommended topics with image grid
flows.description: As a Reading Lists user, I want the Discover card to show a grid of article thumbnails with neutral placeholders when images are missing or fail to load, so that I can preview the recommended content even when some images are unavailable.

flows.name: See personalized made-for subtitle
flows.description: As a Reading Lists user, I want the Discover card to indicate whether the list is made for me or for my logged-in username, so that I understand the recommendations are personalized to my current account state.

flows.name: Understand recommendation update frequency
flows.description: As a Reading Lists user, I want the Discover card description to explain whether the recommended list updates daily, weekly, or monthly, so that I know when to expect new recommendations.

flows.name: View recommended reading list discover card
flows.description: As a Reading Lists user, I want to see a Discover card when a recommended reading list is available, so that I can notice personalized article recommendations from the Reading Lists screen.

name: Recommended reading list interests selection screen
description:
Compose onboarding/settings screen for selecting interest articles for recommendations.
Shows a collapsible-title top bar, search entry card, staggered grid of article cards with selection state, bottom action bar with selected-count text, randomize button in onboarding mode, next button, loading/error states, and randomize confirmation dialog/snackbar undo flow.
Hosted by RecommendedReadingListOnboardingActivity via RecommendedReadingListInterestsFragment.

flows.name: Add searched article as selected interest
flows.description: As a user, I want an article returned from search to be inserted into the interest grid and selected automatically, so that my searched topic is immediately included in my recommendations.

flows.name: Cancel randomization
flows.description: As an onboarding user, I want to cancel the randomize confirmation dialog, so that my current interest selection remains unchanged.

flows.name: Confirm randomization
flows.description: As an onboarding user, I want to confirm before replacing my current interest selection with a random selection, so that I do not accidentally lose my choices.

flows.name: Continue from onboarding
flows.description: As an onboarding user, I want to continue after selecting at least one interest, so that recommended reading lists are enabled and I can see my recommended reading list.

flows.name: Exit after unrecoverable loading error
flows.description: As a user, I want to go back or exit when interest suggestions cannot be loaded because of a generic error, so that I am not stuck on a broken screen.

flows.name: Go back during onboarding
flows.description: As an onboarding user, I want to use the back button or top bar back arrow to return to the previous onboarding step, so that I can change earlier recommended reading list choices.

flows.name: Hide onboarding-only actions in settings
flows.description: As a settings user, I want randomize and next actions to be hidden while editing interests, so that the screen behaves like a settings editor instead of an onboarding step.

flows.name: Prevent continuing without interests
flows.description: As an onboarding user, I want the continue action to be disabled until I select at least one interest, so that I do not enable recommendations without any chosen topics.

flows.name: Randomize interest selection
flows.description: As an onboarding user, I want to randomize the suggested articles and automatically select a few of them, so that I can quickly create a recommendation profile without manually choosing every interest.

flows.name: Retry loading after recoverable error
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry loading interest suggestions after an offline or timeout error, so that I can recover when connectivity improves.

flows.name: Save interests from settings
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to leave the interests selection screen after editing my selected articles, so that my recommended reading interests are saved and settings can reflect the updated choices.

flows.name: Scroll interests with persistent actions
flows.description: As a user, I want to scroll through the interest article grid while the title collapses into the top bar and the bottom actions stay available, so that I can browse many suggestions without losing context or controls.

flows.name: Search for an interest article
flows.description: As a user, I want to open search from the interests screen and choose an article, so that I can add a specific topic that is not shown in the suggested grid.

flows.name: See loading progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a loading indicator while interest article suggestions are being prepared, so that I know the screen is working.

flows.name: See minimum interest warning in settings
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to see a warning when no interests are selected, so that I understand recommended reading needs at least one interest.

flows.name: See selected interest count
flows.description: As a user, I want to see how many articles I have selected, so that I know whether I can continue and how broad my recommendations will be.

flows.name: Select and deselect interest articles
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap article cards to select or deselect them as interests, so that my recommendation list reflects the topics I care about.

flows.name: Undo randomized selection
flows.description: As an onboarding user, I want to undo a randomized interest selection from the snackbar, so that I can restore my previous articles and selections.

flows.name: View suggested interest articles
flows.description: As a user, I want to view a scrollable grid of suggested articles based on my history, reading lists, saved interests, or random articles, so that I can choose topics for recommended reading.

name: Recommended reading list notification
description: System notification for scheduled recommended reading list updates, showing title/subtitle based on update frequency and opening the Recommended reading list mode in ReadingListActivity when tapped.

flows.name: Dismiss recommended reading notification
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the recommended reading notification when I am not interested, so that it no longer remains in my notification shade.

flows.name: Open recommended reading list from notification
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the recommended reading notification to open ReadingListActivity directly in Recommended reading list mode, so that I can immediately view my updated recommendations.

flows.name: Receive scheduled recommended reading notification
flows.description: As a user, I want to receive a scheduled recommended reading list notification at my configured daily, weekly, or monthly update frequency, so that I am reminded when fresh article recommendations are available.

flows.name: Refresh recommendations after notification
flows.description: As a user, I want the app to prepare a refreshed recommended reading list when the notification is shown, so that opening the recommendation list presents current suggestions instead of stale ones.

flows.name: See frequency-specific notification text
flows.description: As a user, I want the recommended reading notification title to reflect whether my updates are daily, weekly, or monthly, so that I understand which recommendation cycle the notification represents.

name: Recommended reading list settings dialogs
description: Dialogs used by recommended reading list settings: confirmation dialog when turning the feature off, confirmation dialog when disabling notifications, radio-list dialog for update frequency (daily/weekly/monthly), and the source-change confirmation dialog displayed when changing recommendation basis from settings.

flows.name: Apply recommendation source change
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm the source-change dialog, so that the app switches to the selected recommendation basis and rebuilds recommendations from that source.

flows.name: Cancel recommendation source change
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the source-change confirmation dialog, so that my current recommendation basis remains unchanged.

flows.name: Choose update frequency
flows.description: As a user, I want to open a radio-list dialog and choose how often recommendations update, so that I can receive new recommended articles daily, weekly, or monthly.

flows.name: Confirm changing recommendation source
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a confirmation dialog when I select a different basis for recommendations from settings, so that I understand changing the source will rebuild my recommendations before I proceed.

flows.name: Confirm disabling notifications
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a confirmation dialog when I try to turn off recommended reading notifications, so that I do not accidentally stop reminder notifications.

flows.name: Confirm turning off recommendations
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a confirmation dialog when I try to turn off the recommended reading list, so that I do not accidentally disable recommendations and related notifications.

flows.name: Continue to interests after source change
flows.description: As a user, I want to be taken to interest selection when I confirm changing the recommendation basis to interests, so that I can adjust the topics used for future recommendations.

flows.name: Disable notifications after confirmation
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm that recommended reading notifications should be turned off, so that I stop receiving recommendation reminders.

flows.name: Dismiss update frequency dialog
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the update frequency dialog without choosing an option, so that my existing update frequency remains unchanged.

flows.name: Keep notifications enabled
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose the dialog option that keeps recommended reading notifications enabled, so that I can cancel an accidental attempt to disable notifications.

flows.name: Keep recommendations enabled
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose the dialog option that keeps the recommended reading list enabled, so that I can cancel an accidental attempt to turn the feature off.

flows.name: Turn off recommendations after confirmation
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm that the recommended reading list should be turned off, so that recommendations are disabled and recommendation notifications are also turned off.

name: Recommended reading list settings screen
description:
Compose settings page for the Discover/recommended reading list feature.
Contains a top app bar, master enable switch, disabled explanatory state, article-count numeric field, update-frequency selector row, source row, interests row when applicable, notification switch row, progress/error state while regenerating recommendations, and snackbar undo after source changes.

flows.name: Change recommendation source
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the recommendation source selection flow, so that I can base recommendations on interests, saved pages, or reading history.

flows.name: Constrain article count input
flows.description: As a user, I want invalid article counts to be constrained to the supported range, so that my recommendation settings always use a valid number of articles.

flows.name: Disable recommendation notifications with confirmation
flows.description: As a user, I want to be prompted before turning off recommendation notifications and confirm my choice, so that I do not accidentally stop update reminders.

flows.name: Disable recommended reading list with confirmation
flows.description: As a user, I want to be prompted before turning off the recommended reading list and confirm my choice, so that I do not accidentally disable Discover recommendations.

flows.name: Dismiss update frequency selector
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the update frequency selector without choosing a different option, so that my current update schedule remains unchanged.

flows.name: Edit recommendation interests
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the interests selection flow when interests are the recommendation source, so that I can refine the topics used to build my recommended reading list.

flows.name: Enable recommendation notifications
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn on notifications for recommended reading list updates and grant notification permission if required, so that I can be reminded when new recommendations are available.

flows.name: Enable recommended reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn on the recommended reading list feature, so that I can configure and receive Discover article recommendations.

flows.name: Handle denied notification permission
flows.description: As a user, I want notification settings to remain off if I deny notification permission, so that the app respects my system permission choice.

flows.name: Keep recommendation notifications enabled from dialog
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the notification turn-off confirmation dialog, so that recommendation notifications stay enabled when I change my mind.

flows.name: Keep recommended reading list enabled from dialog
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the turn-off confirmation dialog, so that the recommended reading list remains enabled when I change my mind.

flows.name: Navigate back and apply settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to leave the recommended reading list settings screen and have any pending recommendation changes regenerated, so that my Discover recommendations reflect my saved settings.

flows.name: Recover from regeneration error
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error state with options to retry or go back when recommendations fail to regenerate, so that I can either try applying the settings again or leave the screen.

flows.name: Select update frequency
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the update frequency selector and choose daily, weekly, or monthly updates, so that recommendations refresh on my preferred schedule.

flows.name: Set article count
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose how many recommended articles are generated, so that the reading list contains the amount of content I prefer.

flows.name: Undo recommendation source change
flows.description: As a user, I want to undo a changed recommendation source from the snackbar, so that I can restore the previous source if I made the change by mistake.

flows.name: View current recommendation source summary
flows.description: As a user, I want to see which source currently drives my recommendations, so that I understand why particular articles are being suggested.

flows.name: View disabled feature explanation
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an explanatory message when recommended reading list is turned off, so that I understand why the recommendation settings are unavailable.

flows.name: View notification status summary
flows.description: As a user, I want to see whether recommendation notifications are enabled or disabled, so that I understand if I will receive update reminders.

flows.name: View regeneration progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a progress indicator while recommendations are being regenerated, so that I know my settings are being applied.

name: Recommended reading list source selection screen
description:
Compose onboarding/settings screen for choosing the basis of recommended reading lists (interests, saved pages, or history), with loading/error states, top navigation/close affordance, selectable source cards, and next action during onboarding.
Hosted by RecommendedReadingListOnboardingActivity via RecommendedReadingListSourceFragment.

flows.name: Adjust interests from settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to move from settings source selection into interest adjustment when I choose interests, so that I can update the topics used for recommendations.

flows.name: Cancel source change warning
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the source change confirmation dialog, so that I can keep my current recommendation source unchanged.

flows.name: Confirm changing source in settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to be warned before changing the recommendation source in settings, so that I understand the impact before applying a different basis for updates.

flows.name: Continue onboarding with selected source
flows.description: As a user, I want to continue from onboarding after choosing a recommendation source, so that I can finish setting up recommended reading lists.

flows.name: Dismiss onboarding source selection
flows.description: As a user, I want to close or go back from the onboarding source selection screen, so that I can leave recommended reading list setup without continuing.

flows.name: Finish onboarding with existing data source
flows.description: As a user, I want onboarding to enable recommended reading lists and open the recommended list when I choose saved pages or history, so that I can immediately view recommendations based on existing data.

flows.name: Leave after source loading error
flows.description: As a user, I want to go back from the error state, so that I can exit the source selection screen when available sources cannot be loaded.

flows.name: Proceed to interest selection during onboarding
flows.description: As a user, I want to proceed to the interest selection step when I choose interests during onboarding, so that I can specify the topics used for recommendations.

flows.name: Retry after source loading error
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry loading recommendation source options after an error, so that I can recover and complete source selection.

flows.name: Review loading state
flows.description: As a user, I want to see that source options are loading, so that I understand the screen is checking available recommendation sources.

flows.name: Save settings source selection on exit
flows.description: As a user, I want my recommendation source choice in settings to be saved when I leave the screen, so that future recommended reading list updates use my selected source.

flows.name: See current selected source
flows.description: As a user, I want the currently selected recommendation source to be visually highlighted, so that I know which basis will be used for my recommended reading list.

flows.name: Select history as source
flows.description: As a user, I want to select my reading history as the basis for recommendations when history is available, so that recommended reading lists can reflect pages I have viewed.

flows.name: Select interests as source
flows.description: As a user, I want to select interests as the basis for recommendations, so that recommended reading lists can be built from topics I choose.

flows.name: Select saved pages as source
flows.description: As a user, I want to select my saved pages as the basis for recommendations when saved pages are available, so that recommended reading lists can reflect pages I have already saved.

flows.name: View available recommendation sources
flows.description: As a user, I want to see only the recommendation source options that are available from my interests, saved pages, or browsing history, so that I can choose a valid basis for recommended reading lists.

name: RecommendedReadingListOnboardingActivity
description: Recommended reading list onboarding surface.

name: RecommendedReadingListSettingsActivity
description: Recommended reading list settings surface.

name: Reference bottom sheet dialog
description:
Extended bottom-sheet dialog for page citations/references.
Displays references in a ViewPager2 with a tab/page indicator, hides the indicator for a single reference, renders HTML citation content and fallback external-link anchors, and routes links through the page LinkHandler.

flows.name: Browse grouped references
flows.description: As a reader, I want to swipe between multiple references in the same reference group, so that I can review related citations from one dialog.

flows.name: Dismiss reference dialog
flows.description: As a reader, I want to dismiss the reference bottom sheet when I am done, so that I can return to the article or preview.

flows.name: Open citation links
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap links rendered inside a citation, so that I can navigate to referenced pages, media, anchors, email actions, diffs, maps, or external sources using the article link handler.

flows.name: Open fallback external reference links
flows.description: As a reader, I want citations with no visible HTML text to show numbered fallback links, so that I can still open the source URLs attached to the reference.

flows.name: Read single reference without pagination controls
flows.description: As a reader, I want a single-reference dialog to hide unnecessary pagination indicators, so that the citation content is simpler and less distracting.

flows.name: Scroll long reference content
flows.description: As a reader, I want to scroll the reference dialog when citation content is long, so that I can read the full source information within the bottom sheet.

flows.name: Select and copy reference text
flows.description: As a reader, I want to select the reference number or citation text, so that I can copy citation details for later use.

flows.name: Use page indicator for reference position
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see and use a page indicator when multiple references are available, so that I know my position in the reference group and can jump between citations.

flows.name: View selected reference in bottom sheet
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open a citation and see the selected reference in an expanded bottom-sheet dialog, so that I can read source details without leaving the article.

name: Remove all languages warning dialog
description:
Material alert shown when the user attempts to remove every configured language.
Warns that all languages cannot be removed and provides only an acknowledgement action.

flows.name: Acknowledge all-languages removal warning
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to acknowledge the warning with a single OK action, so that I can dismiss the dialog without removing any configured languages.

flows.name: Warn when removing all languages
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to be warned when I try to remove every configured language, so that I understand at least one language must remain for searching and reading content.

name: Remove from Reading Lists dialog
description: Confirmation/multi-choice dialog for removing an article from one or more reading lists, with immediate deletion when only one list contains the page.

flows.name: Cancel removal dialog
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to cancel the remove-from-lists dialog, so that no reading list memberships are changed.

flows.name: Confirm removal from selected lists
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to tap Remove after selecting one or more lists, so that the article is removed only from those selected reading lists.

flows.name: Confirm with no lists selected
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want pressing Remove with no lists selected to leave the article in all reading lists, so that I do not accidentally remove it without making a selection.

flows.name: Open remove-from-lists choices
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to open a removal dialog when an article belongs to multiple reading lists, so that I can choose exactly which lists should no longer contain the article.

flows.name: Remove immediately from only list
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want an article that belongs to only one reading list to be removed immediately without an extra choice dialog, so that single-list removals are faster.

flows.name: Review sorted reading lists
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to see all reading lists containing the article sorted by name, so that I can quickly find the lists I want to remove it from.

flows.name: See removal feedback
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to see feedback naming the article and reading lists after removal, so that I know which lists were updated.

flows.name: Select lists for removal
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to check or uncheck individual reading lists in the dialog, so that I can control which list memberships will be removed.

flows.name: Undo removal from lists
flows.description: As a reading list user, I want to undo removing an article from selected reading lists when an undo snackbar is shown, so that I can restore the article if I removed it by mistake.

name: Remove languages confirmation dialog
description:
Material alert shown from the Wikipedia languages multi-select action mode when one or more, but not all, languages are selected.
Confirms removal with Remove and Cancel actions.

flows.name: Cancel language removal
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to cancel the remove-languages confirmation dialog, so that I can keep my selected languages without changing my app language list.

flows.name: Confirm language removal
flows.description: As a Wikipedia user, I want to confirm removing the selected language or languages, so that my app language list is updated only after I approve the change.

name: Reset password screen
description:
Activity used when login requires a password reset.
Shows toolbar title and reset instructions, two password fields with validation errors, an optional 2FA/email-auth code field after server UI prompt, a submit/login button that switches to an in-progress state, a linear progress indicator, and a full-screen WikiErrorView with retry/back actions for unexpected errors.
Successful reset updates the account and closes; failures are surfaced through inline field errors, FeedbackUtil messages/errors, or the error view.

flows.name: Complete email authentication
flows.description: As a user who is prompted for email authentication, I want to enter the email authentication code, so that I can finish resetting my password and logging in.

flows.name: Complete two-factor authentication
flows.description: As a user with two-factor authentication enabled, I want to enter the requested authentication code after the server prompts for it, so that I can finish resetting my password and logging in securely.

flows.name: Dismiss unexpected error to retry form
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the full-screen error view with the retry action, so that I can return to the reset form and try submitting again.

flows.name: Finish after successful reset
flows.description: As a user, I want the app to update my account and close the reset screen after a successful password reset, so that I can return to the previous flow as a logged-in user.

flows.name: Go back from unexpected error
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the error view back action, so that I can leave the reset password screen when I cannot complete the reset.

flows.name: Prevent incomplete reset submission
flows.description: As a user, I want the reset password form to require both password fields before submission, so that I do not send an incomplete password reset request.

flows.name: Receive server failure feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a feedback message when the reset or login attempt fails on the server, so that I understand that the password reset was not completed.

flows.name: See reset in progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a progress indicator and disabled login button while the reset is being submitted, so that I know the request is processing and avoid duplicate submissions.

flows.name: Submit new password reset
flows.description: As a user required to reset my password, I want to enter and confirm a new password and submit it, so that I can update my account password and continue logging in.

flows.name: Submit reset from keyboard
flows.description: As a user, I want to submit the reset password form from the keyboard action, so that I can complete the reset without tapping the button.

flows.name: Toggle password visibility
flows.description: As a user, I want to show or hide the password text in the new password and confirmation fields, so that I can verify my entry while keeping it private when needed.

flows.name: Validate new password rules
flows.description: As a user, I want to see inline errors when my new password is too short or matches my username, so that I can choose an acceptable password before submitting.

flows.name: Validate password confirmation
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an inline error when the repeated password does not match the new password, so that I can correct the confirmation before submitting.

flows.name: View unexpected error details
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a full-screen error view when an unexpected reset error occurs, so that I know the process cannot continue normally.

name: ResetPasswordActivity
description: Password reset surface.

name: Rich HTML text rendering widget behavior
description:
Reusable TextView HTML rendering support for in-app rich text.
Parses HTML into spans, removes link underlines, colors red links, supports bold/no-underline URL spans, monospace code, ordered-list numbering, hidden spans, inline image placeholders/loading, and setHtml() extension for TextViews.
This is not a full screen/dialog, but defines user-visible rich-text widget behavior used by other surfaces.

name: Rollback confirmation dialog
description:
Simple Material confirmation dialog in the diff details screen for rollback.
Displays rollback confirmation message with OK and Cancel buttons, starts rollback on OK, and logs patroller analytics for confirm/cancel.

flows.name: Cancel rollback
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to cancel the rollback from the confirmation dialog, so that no rollback is performed if I change my mind.

flows.name: Confirm rollback
flows.description: As a patroller with rollback rights, I want to confirm the rollback in the confirmation dialog, so that the selected edit is rolled back and the diff details refresh to reflect the rollback result.

flows.name: See rollback failure feedback
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to be shown an error if the confirmed rollback fails, so that I know the edit was not rolled back and can decide what to do next.

flows.name: See rollback success feedback
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to see a success message after confirming a rollback, so that I know the rollback completed successfully.

name: Saved page sync progress notification
description:
System notification shown while offline reading-list pages are being downloaded/synced.
Displays pluralized syncing title/description with progress, and exposes pause/resume and cancel actions handled by SavedPageSyncNotification; can remain in a paused state or be canceled when sync completes.

flows.name: Cancel saved page sync
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the saved-page download from the notification, so that remaining queued pages are not downloaded for offline reading.

flows.name: Dismiss notification when sync ends
flows.description: As a user, I want the sync notification to disappear automatically when saved-page syncing finishes or is canceled, so that my notification shade only shows active or paused work.

flows.name: Keep notification paused until resumed or canceled
flows.description: As a user, I want the notification to remain visible in a paused state with a resume action when sync is paused, so that I can restart or cancel the remaining downloads later.

flows.name: Monitor saved page download progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a notification showing how many saved articles are being downloaded, how many remain, and the current percentage progress, so that I can monitor offline reading-list sync while it runs in the background.

flows.name: Pause saved page sync
flows.description: As a user, I want to pause the saved-page download from the notification, so that I can temporarily stop offline article downloads without losing the remaining queue.

flows.name: Resume paused saved page sync
flows.description: As a user, I want to resume a paused saved-page download from the notification, so that the remaining offline articles continue downloading.

name: Search
description:
Main search activity/fragment surface with a toolbar SearchView, back and clear controls, progress bar, language tab strip or add-language button, and panel switching between recent searches and live search results.
Supports normal search, Places/voice/share/process-text entry points, return-link behavior, and hybrid-search launching.

flows.name: Add search languages
flows.description: As a user with one or more languages to configure, I want to open the language settings from search, so that I can add or change the languages available for searching.

flows.name: Clear all recent searches
flows.description: As a user, I want to clear all recent searches after confirming, so that my search history is removed from the screen.

flows.name: Clear search text
flows.description: As a user, I want to clear the current search query, so that I can return to recent searches and start a different search.

flows.name: Close search screen
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the back control to leave search, so that I can return to where I came from.

flows.name: Delete one recent search
flows.description: As a user, I want to swipe away a recent search item, so that I can remove an individual query from my history.

flows.name: Enter live search query
flows.description: As a user, I want to type a search query and see live Wikipedia search results, so that I can quickly find matching articles.

flows.name: Launch semantic search suggestion
flows.description: As a user in the hybrid-search experiment, I want to tap a semantic search suggestion or title-only result, so that I can re-run the query with hybrid semantic results.

flows.name: Learn about hybrid search
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the hybrid search information menu and learn more, so that I understand how semantic search results work.

flows.name: Open article from search result
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a search result, so that I can open the selected article in the current tab.

flows.name: Open search with initial query
flows.description: As a user entering search from voice, share, Places, or another entry point with a query, I want results to load automatically, so that I do not need to re-enter the search term.

flows.name: Rate semantic result
flows.description: As a user, I want to give a thumbs-up or thumbs-down rating on a semantic search result, so that I can provide feedback on hybrid search quality.

flows.name: Retry failed search
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry when search results fail to load, so that I can recover from network or service errors.

flows.name: Return selected link
flows.description: As a user choosing a link for another workflow, I want tapping a search result to return that page to the caller instead of opening it, so that the selected article can be inserted or used elsewhere.

flows.name: Reuse recent search
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a recent search, so that I can repeat that search without typing it again.

flows.name: Search by namespace hint
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a namespace hint such as User, Help, or Template, so that I can start a search scoped by that namespace prefix.

flows.name: Search places results
flows.description: As a Places user, I want search to use the Places language and return a selected result with location data when available, so that I can choose a nearby article for the Places flow.

flows.name: Search shared or selected text
flows.description: As a user arriving from share or process-text actions, I want the shared or selected text to populate the search field automatically, so that I can search for it immediately.

flows.name: See loading progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a progress indicator while search results are loading, so that I know the app is working on my request.

flows.name: Submit hybrid search
flows.description: As a user, I want to submit my search query to launch hybrid search results when available, so that I can get semantic matches in addition to normal title matches.

flows.name: Switch language from no-results counts
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap another language shown in no-results counts, so that I can switch to a language where matches are available.

flows.name: Switch search language
flows.description: As a multilingual user, I want to choose a language tab for searching, so that results and recent searches are shown for the language I need.

flows.name: Turn off hybrid search experiment
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn off hybrid search from the semantic results menu, so that future searches use the standard search experience.

flows.name: Use search result long-press actions
flows.description: As a user, I want to long-press a search result and choose actions like open, open in a new tab, or save to a reading list, so that I can manage articles without opening them first.

flows.name: Use semantic result card
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a semantic result card, its article row, or a snippet link, so that I can open the most relevant article from hybrid search.

name: Search App Widget
description: Home-screen search widget with small, medium, and large RemoteViews variants that launch Wikipedia search when tapped.

flows.name: Open search from home-screen widget
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the Wikipedia search widget on my home screen, so that I can quickly open Wikipedia search and start finding articles.

flows.name: Use size-appropriate widget layout
flows.description: As a user, I want the search widget to display a compact, medium, or expanded layout based on the space available on my home screen, so that the widget remains usable and visually appropriate when resized.

name: Search Bar Card
description: Reusable Compose rounded search entry row with search icon, label text, and click handler.

flows.name: Identify search affordance with assistive technology
flows.description: As a user using assistive technology, I want the search icon to be announced as search, so that I can understand the purpose of the search entry row.

flows.name: Open search from card
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the search bar card, so that I can start the search flow provided by the current screen.

flows.name: View search prompt
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a clearly labeled search entry row with a search icon and prompt text, so that I can recognize where to begin searching.

name: Search Empty View
description: Reusable Compose empty search-results state with circular search icon and empty-state text.

flows.name: View empty search results message
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a clear empty-state message with a search icon when my search has no results, so that I understand there are no matching items to display.

name: Search Results
description:
Compose search results panel for standard/prefix search.
Shows paged result rows with title/snippet/thumbnail or saved/history/tab icons, redirect metadata, loading via parent progress bar, error state with retry/back actions, empty results, and long-press menu handling for opening or saving results.

flows.name: Add result to reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to add a long-pressed search result to a reading list, so that I can save the page for later.

flows.name: Close search from error state
flows.description: As a user, I want to go back or close search from the error state, so that I can leave the failed search experience.

flows.name: Move saved result between reading lists
flows.description: As a user, I want to move a saved search result to another reading list from the long-press menu, so that I can organize saved pages while searching.

flows.name: Open long-press menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to long-press a search result, so that I can access additional actions for that page without opening it immediately.

flows.name: Open place search result with location
flows.description: As a user searching from Places, I want to open a result with its location context, so that the app can navigate to the page while preserving the relevant map location.

flows.name: Open result from long-press menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose the open-link action from a long-pressed search result, so that I can open the page from the contextual menu.

flows.name: Open result in new tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to open a long-pressed search result in a new tab, so that I can keep my current context while saving the page for later viewing.

flows.name: Open search result
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a search result, so that I can open the selected Wikipedia page.

flows.name: Retry failed search
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry a failed search from the error state, so that I can recover from network or loading problems and see results.

flows.name: See search loading progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see loading progress while initial results or additional pages are being fetched, so that I know the search is still working.

flows.name: Start semantic search from result
flows.description: As a user in the hybrid search experiment, I want to tap a title-only standard result, so that I can use that title as a semantic search query.

flows.name: Start semantic search from suggestion
flows.description: As a user in the hybrid search experiment, I want to tap the semantic-search suggestion for my query, so that I can broaden the search beyond exact title matches.

flows.name: Start semantic search when no lexical results
flows.description: As a user in the hybrid search experiment, I want to use the bottom semantic-search prompt when standard search has no results, so that I still have a way to find conceptually related pages.

flows.name: Switch to language with results
flows.description: As a user, I want to see result counts in other app languages and tap a language that has matches, so that I can continue my search in a language where results are available.

flows.name: View paged search results
flows.description: As a user, I want to view a continuously loaded list of matching Wikipedia pages with titles, descriptions, redirect information, thumbnails, and saved/history/tab indicators, so that I can quickly identify the result I want.

name: Search Top App Bar
description: Reusable Compose search app bar with focused outlined text field, back navigation, optional actions, and breadcrumb logging.

flows.name: Accessible back navigation
flows.description: As a user using accessibility services, I want the search back button to have a descriptive label, so that I can understand and activate the navigation control reliably.

flows.name: Enter search query
flows.description: As a user, I want to type or edit a search query in the search app bar, so that I can search for content using my current input.

flows.name: Log search app bar usage
flows.description: As a user, I want my search app bar opening and back-button interactions to be recorded as breadcrumb events, so that app issues involving search can be diagnosed more effectively.

flows.name: Navigate back from search
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the back button in the search app bar, so that I can leave search mode or return to the previous screen.

flows.name: Start with focused search field
flows.description: As a user, I want the search field to be focused automatically when the search app bar opens, so that I can begin typing immediately without an extra tap.

flows.name: Use placeholder guidance
flows.description: As a user, I want to see placeholder text in the empty search field, so that I understand what kind of search input is expected.

flows.name: Use search app bar actions
flows.description: As a user, I want to use actions shown alongside the search field, so that I can perform search-related commands such as clearing or filtering depending on the screen using the app bar.

name: Search app widget
description: Home-screen app widget surface provided by WidgetProviderSearch.

name: SearchActivity
description: Search UI surface; also exported for text share and process-text intents.

name: Settings
description:
Main app settings preference screen hosted by SettingsActivity/SettingsFragment.
Shows configurable preferences such as languages, home feed customization, theme, app icon, Year in Review, sync, recommended reading lists, donation reminders, about/feedback, account/logout options, and developer settings menu entry when enabled.

flows.name: Cancel account logout
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to cancel the logout confirmation, so that I can remain signed in if I change my mind.

flows.name: Cancel account vanish request
flows.description: As a logged-in permanent-account user, I want to cancel the vanish request confirmation, so that I do not proceed to the account removal form if I change my mind.

flows.name: Cancel disabling reading list sync
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to cancel the reading list sync disable dialog, so that syncing remains enabled if I change my mind.

flows.name: Cancel login prompt for reading list sync
flows.description: As a logged-out user, I want to cancel the login prompt shown for reading list sync, so that I can leave syncing disabled without signing in.

flows.name: Choose app theme
flows.description: As a user, I want to open theme settings, so that I can change the app's color theme and reading appearance.

flows.name: Choose custom app icon
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the app icon selector when custom icons are available, so that I can personalize the Wikipedia app icon.

flows.name: Clear local donation history
flows.description: As a user, I want to delete my local donation history from Settings, so that previous donation records stored on this device no longer affect donation reminders.

flows.name: Configure donation reminders
flows.description: As a user, I want to open donation reminder settings when they are available, so that I can manage whether and how often I am reminded to donate.

flows.name: Customize home feed
flows.description: As a user, I want to open home feed customization from Settings, so that I can choose which feed cards appear and how they are ordered.

flows.name: Disable Year in Review with confirmation
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn off Year in Review only after confirming the warning, so that I understand that disabling it clears the related Year in Review data.

flows.name: Disable reading list sync with confirmation
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to confirm before turning off reading list sync, so that I understand my remote synced lists will be affected before sync is disabled.

flows.name: Enable Year in Review
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn on Year in Review from Settings when it is available, so that I can access my annual reading summary experience.

flows.name: Enable reading list sync while logged in
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to enable reading list sync, so that my reading lists can be synchronized with my account.

flows.name: End temporary account session
flows.description: As a temporary account user, I want to end my temporary account session after confirming, so that I can stop using that temporary identity on this device.

flows.name: Handle missing browser for external links
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error message if no browser can open a Settings external link, so that I understand why the requested page did not open.

flows.name: Keep Year in Review enabled
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the Year in Review disable confirmation, so that I can keep Year in Review enabled if I change my mind.

flows.name: Log out of account
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to log out after confirming the logout warning, so that I can end my signed-in session on this device.

flows.name: Manage app languages
flows.description: As a user, I want to open language settings from Settings, so that I can choose and reorder the languages used by the app.

flows.name: Manage recommended reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to open recommended reading list settings or onboarding, so that I can configure article recommendations based on my interests.

flows.name: Open Android app FAQ
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the Android app FAQ from Settings, so that I can get help and answers in a browser.

flows.name: Open developer settings
flows.description: As a user with developer settings enabled, I want to open Developer settings from the Settings menu, so that I can access advanced diagnostic and development options.

flows.name: Open legal and safety contacts
flows.description: As a user, I want to open legal and safety contact information from Settings, so that I can find official contact resources.

flows.name: Open privacy policy
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the privacy policy from Settings, so that I can review how my privacy is handled.

flows.name: Open terms of use
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the terms of use from Settings, so that I can review the rules for using Wikipedia services.

flows.name: Prefer offline content
flows.description: As a user, I want to prefer offline content when available, so that the app uses downloaded articles instead of network content when possible.

flows.name: Prompt login to enable reading list sync
flows.description: As a logged-out user, I want to be prompted to log in when enabling reading list sync, so that I can connect syncing to an account.

flows.name: Request account vanish
flows.description: As a logged-in permanent-account user, I want to start an account vanish request after confirming the warning, so that I can open the web form for requesting account removal.

flows.name: See no donation history feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to receive feedback when I try to delete donation history but none exists, so that I know there was nothing to remove.

flows.name: Send app feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to compose a feedback email from Settings with app and device information included, so that I can report feedback to the Wikipedia app team.

flows.name: Toggle Wi-Fi-only downloads
flows.description: As a user, I want to restrict downloads to Wi-Fi or allow mobile data, so that I can control data usage for offline content.

flows.name: Toggle article images
flows.description: As a user, I want to show or hide images in articles, so that I can control bandwidth usage and the visual reading experience.

flows.name: Toggle automatic reading list article downloads
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn automatic downloading of reading list articles on or off, so that I can control offline storage for my saved articles.

flows.name: Toggle link previews
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn link previews on or off, so that I can control whether article links show preview popups.

flows.name: Toggle table collapsing
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn automatic table collapsing on or off, so that I can control how tables are displayed in articles.

flows.name: View app information
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the About Wikipedia app page, so that I can see app information and related details.

flows.name: View logged-in account status
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to see my account name and account type details in Settings, so that I know which account is currently active.

flows.name: View temporary account expiry
flows.description: As a temporary account user, I want to see how many days remain before my temporary account expires, so that I understand the account's lifetime.

name: Settings Rows and Sections
description: Reusable Compose settings widgets: clickable row with title/subtitle/link handling/trailing content, and section header/container for grouped settings.

flows.name: Follow subtitle link
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap links embedded in a setting subtitle, so that I can open the related destination or contextual setting from within the description.

flows.name: Navigate back from toggle list
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the top app bar back button on a module toggle list, so that I can return to the previous settings screen.

flows.name: Open a clickable setting row
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a settings row that represents another option or screen, so that I can navigate to or perform the related settings action.

flows.name: Read setting details
flows.description: As a user, I want to see each setting row with a title and optional explanatory subtitle, so that I can understand what the setting controls before acting on it.

flows.name: Toggle module visibility
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn individual modules on or off from the module list, so that I can control which modules appear in my feed.

flows.name: Use row trailing controls
flows.description: As a user, I want a setting row to include an action control such as a switch on the trailing side, so that I can change the setting directly without leaving the row.

flows.name: View module toggle list
flows.description: As a user, I want to view a scrollable list of configurable modules with descriptions and switches, so that I can review which feed modules are available and whether they are currently enabled.

flows.name: View settings section groups
flows.description: As a user, I want to see settings organized under clear section headers, so that I can understand which options belong together.

name: SettingsActivity
description: Main settings UI surface.

name: Single WebView
description: Generic in-app WebView activity with toolbar, optional back button, progress indicator, external-browser menu action, JavaScript support, cookie setup, and form/back-navigation handling for donation/year-in-review style web content.

flows.name: Complete embedded web form
flows.description: As a user, I want to fill out and submit a web form inside the WebView, so that I can complete flows such as account vanishing, donation, or year-in-review web payment processing in the app.

flows.name: Handle external links from web forms
flows.description: As a user, I want links that leave an embedded web-form flow to close the in-app form and open non-main-page destinations in the system browser, so that external content is handled safely outside the form context.

flows.name: Navigate web history with device back
flows.description: As a user, I want the device back action to go to the previous WebView page when regular web content has browsing history, so that I can navigate within the in-app web session naturally.

flows.name: Open current page in system browser
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the currently loaded web page in my system browser, so that I can continue the web experience outside the app if needed.

flows.name: Respond to web confirmation dialogs
flows.description: As a user, I want JavaScript confirmation prompts from the web page to be shown as native dialogs with OK and Cancel choices, so that I can confirm or cancel web-page actions intentionally.

flows.name: Return from web screen
flows.description: As a user, I want to leave the web screen using the back action or visible return button when available, so that I can get back to the originating app experience.

flows.name: Return to originating article
flows.description: As a user, I want returning from donation or year-in-review web content to reopen the originating article when provided, so that I can continue reading where the web flow interrupted me.

flows.name: See page loading progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a loading indicator while the web page is navigating or loading, so that I understand the screen is working and content is not yet ready.

flows.name: Show return button after form submission
flows.description: As a user, I want a clear return button to appear after submitting an embedded web form, so that I can easily leave the processed form flow and return to the app.

flows.name: View in-app web content
flows.description: As a user, I want to view a provided web page inside the app with JavaScript, media playback, and relevant session cookies enabled, so that I can complete web-based flows without leaving the app.

name: SingleWebViewActivity
description: Generic single WebView content surface.

name: Sort Reading Lists bottom sheet
description: Bottom sheet dialog listing reading-list sort options with a checkmark on the currently selected option; selecting an option dismisses and updates sort order.

flows.name: Dismiss after selecting sort option
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want the sort bottom sheet to close after I select a sort option, so that I can immediately return to the updated reading lists view.

flows.name: Dismiss without changing sort
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want to dismiss the sort bottom sheet without choosing an option, so that I can leave my current reading-list order unchanged.

flows.name: See current sort selection
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want to see a checkmark beside the currently selected sort option, so that I know how my reading lists are currently ordered.

flows.name: Sort lists by created date ascending
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want to select the created date ascending sort option, so that my reading lists are ordered from oldest to newest.

flows.name: Sort lists by created date descending
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want to select the created date descending sort option, so that my reading lists are ordered from newest to oldest.

flows.name: Sort lists by name ascending
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want to select the name ascending sort option, so that my reading lists are ordered alphabetically from A to Z.

flows.name: Sort lists by name descending
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want to select the name descending sort option, so that my reading lists are ordered alphabetically from Z to A.

flows.name: View reading-list sort options
flows.description: As a reading lists user, I want to view all available reading-list sort options in a bottom sheet, so that I can decide how to order my lists.

name: Suggested Article Descriptions Dialog
description: Material alert dialog that presents one or two machine-generated article description suggestions, with close, suggestion selection, and flag/report actions.

flows.name: Cancel reporting a suggestion
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel or dismiss the report dialog without submitting a report, so that I can return without flagging the suggestion.

flows.name: Choose a suggested description
flows.description: As a user, I want to select a machine-generated description suggestion, so that the selected text can be used as the article description I am editing.

flows.name: Clear custom report reason
flows.description: As a user, I want to clear the custom report reason text with one action, so that I can quickly remove or rewrite my feedback.

flows.name: Close suggestions dialog
flows.description: As a user, I want to close the suggestions dialog without choosing a suggestion, so that I can return to editing without using a machine-generated description.

flows.name: Enter custom report reason
flows.description: As a user, I want to type an additional custom reason for reporting a generated description suggestion, so that I can describe an issue not covered by the predefined options.

flows.name: Open report dialog for a suggestion
flows.description: As a user, I want to flag a specific generated description suggestion, so that I can report that the suggestion has a problem.

flows.name: Prevent empty report submission
flows.description: As a user, I want the report action to require at least one selected or written reason, so that empty reports are not submitted accidentally.

flows.name: Select report reasons
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose one or more predefined reasons why a generated description suggestion is problematic, so that my report communicates the issue clearly.

flows.name: Submit suggestion report
flows.description: As a user, I want to submit my selected or written report reasons for a generated description suggestion, so that the problematic suggestion is reported and I receive confirmation.

flows.name: View generated description suggestions
flows.description: As a user, I want to view one or two machine-generated article description suggestions in a dialog, so that I can decide whether any suggested description is useful for the article.

name: Suggested Article Descriptions Report Dialog
description: Material alert dialog for reporting a suggested article description, including selectable report reasons, an optional free-text reason, Report and Cancel actions, and dismissal analytics.

flows.name: Cancel report dialog
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the report dialog without submitting feedback, so that I can return to the previous screen if I decide not to report the suggestion.

flows.name: Clear custom report reason
flows.description: As a user, I want to clear the custom reason text with a single action, so that I can quickly remove or replace my typed feedback.

flows.name: Dismiss report dialog without reporting
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the report dialog without pressing Report, so that I can leave the reporting flow and have that dismissal tracked for product analytics.

flows.name: Enter custom report reason
flows.description: As a user, I want to type an optional custom reason for reporting a suggested article description, so that I can provide feedback not covered by the predefined choices.

flows.name: Prevent empty report submission
flows.description: As a user, I want the dialog to avoid submitting a report when I have not selected or entered any reason, so that incomplete feedback is not sent accidentally.

flows.name: Select predefined report reasons
flows.description: As a user, I want to select one or more predefined reasons for reporting a suggested article description, so that I can quickly explain what is wrong with the suggestion.

flows.name: Submit report with reasons
flows.description: As a user, I want to submit a report after choosing or entering at least one reason, so that the problematic suggested article description is reported and I receive confirmation that it was submitted.

name: Suggested edit cards flow
description: Single-fragment activity surface for performing a suggested edit task (add/translate descriptions and captions, image tags, image recommendations, or vandalism patrol); hosts the suggested-edit card stack and delegates back navigation to its current child card.

flows.name: Accept image recommendation
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to accept a recommended image and confirm the edit summary, so that the image is added to the article.

flows.name: Add article description
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to open the edit form for an article missing a description and save a description, so that readers can better identify the article.

flows.name: Add custom image tag
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to search for and add a custom image tag when the suggested tags are not enough, so that I can accurately describe the image.

flows.name: Add image caption
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to open the edit form for an image missing a caption and save a caption, so that the image is more understandable in the selected language.

flows.name: Advance after vandalism patrol item
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to advance to the next patrol candidate after finishing a review, so that I can continue patrolling efficiently.

flows.name: Browse suggested edit cards
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to move forward and backward through suggested edit cards, so that I can choose which suggestion to work on.

flows.name: Choose translation languages
flows.description: As a multilingual contributor, I want to choose the source and target languages for translation suggestions, so that I can translate descriptions or captions between the languages I know.

flows.name: Complete image recommendation onboarding
flows.description: As a contributor starting image recommendations, I want to see onboarding the first time, so that I understand how to review recommended article images.

flows.name: Complete image tag onboarding
flows.description: As a contributor starting image tagging, I want to see the image tags onboarding the first time, so that I understand how image tagging works before contributing.

flows.name: Confirm abandoning selected image tags
flows.description: As a contributor with selected image tags, I want to be warned before leaving, so that I do not accidentally discard unpublished tag selections.

flows.name: Edit added description before advancing
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to reopen and edit the description I just added on the current card, so that I can correct it before moving on.

flows.name: Exit suggested edits
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to leave the suggested edit card flow with the system or toolbar back action, so that I can stop editing when I am done or do not want to continue.

flows.name: Handle no image recommendations
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to see when no image recommendations are available and return from the flow, so that I understand why I cannot continue that task.

flows.name: Leave from suggestion error state
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to go back from a failed suggestion card, so that I am not stuck on an unrecoverable loading error.

flows.name: Open suggested edit help
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to open contextual help for the current suggested edit task, so that I can understand how to make an appropriate contribution.

flows.name: Patrol suggested edit
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to review a suggested recent edit in the card flow, so that I can inspect potentially problematic edits for vandalism.

flows.name: Publish image tags
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to publish my selected image tags, so that the image's structured depicts data is improved.

flows.name: Reject image recommendation
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to reject an unsuitable image recommendation with reasons, so that the recommendation feedback is recorded and I can continue reviewing.

flows.name: Retry image recommendation loading
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to retry loading an image recommendation after an error, so that I can continue reviewing recommendations.

flows.name: Retry loading a suggestion
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to retry when a suggested edit card fails to load, so that I can continue receiving suggestions after an error.

flows.name: Review image recommendation
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to review a recommended image for an article, so that I can decide whether it should be added to the article.

flows.name: See saved contribution feedback
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to see my saved description, caption, or translation reflected on the card with a success message, so that I know the contribution was saved before the flow advances.

flows.name: Select image tags
