flows.description: As a contributor, I want to select one or more suggested depicts tags for an image, so that I can describe what the image contains.

flows.name: Skip image recommendation
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to mark an image recommendation as not sure or skip it, so that I can move to another recommendation without making a change.

flows.name: Swap translation languages
flows.description: As a multilingual contributor, I want to swap the source and target languages, so that I can quickly reverse the direction of translation suggestions.

flows.name: Translate article description
flows.description: As a multilingual contributor, I want to translate an existing article description into another language, so that the target-language article has a useful description.

flows.name: Translate image caption
flows.description: As a multilingual contributor, I want to translate an image caption into another language, so that the image is described for more readers.

flows.name: View suggestion media details
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to view article or image details on each suggested edit card, so that I can decide whether and how to contribute.

flows.name: Zoom suggested image
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to zoom into the image shown on a suggestion card, so that I can inspect the image before adding a caption, tag, or other edit.

name: Suggested edits article/image card
description: Individual card in the suggested-edits carousel showing loading/error states, an article or Commons image preview, title/description/extract or image metadata, optional added contribution subtitle, image zoom tooltip behavior, and tap-to-add/edit contribution.

flows.name: Learn image zoom gesture
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want tapping the image to show a one-time tooltip explaining that I can pinch to zoom, so that I can discover how to inspect the image more closely.

flows.name: Open contribution editor from card
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to tap a loaded card to start adding or editing the suggested description or caption, so that I can make the contribution for that item.

flows.name: Recover from card load error
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to see an error message with retry and back options when a suggestion cannot be loaded, so that I can either try again or leave the task.

flows.name: Review article suggestion details
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to view an article suggestion with its thumbnail, title, description or source description, and extract, so that I can understand the article before adding or translating a description.

flows.name: Review image caption suggestion details
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to view a Commons image suggestion with its preview, current caption or no-description message, file name, author, date, source, and license, so that I can understand the image before adding or translating a caption.

flows.name: Scroll card content
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to scroll the card content when it is taller than the available space, so that I can read all visible article text or image metadata on any device orientation.

flows.name: See added contribution on card
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want the card to show my added or edited contribution as a highlighted subtitle, so that I can confirm what I have contributed before continuing.

flows.name: View loading state
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to see a loading indicator while the next article or image suggestion is being fetched, so that I know the card is preparing content for me.

flows.name: Zoom image preview
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to pinch zoom the card image preview in place, so that I can inspect image details before deciding on a contribution.

name: Suggested edits card carousel
description:
Main suggested-edits card surface with toolbar, optional language-from/to spinners for translation tasks, a ViewPager of edit suggestion cards, back/next navigation, and bottom add/edit/save contribution button.
Hosts normal article/image caption/description cards or delegates to image tags, image recommendations, and vandalism patrol cards depending on action.

flows.name: Accept image recommendation
flows.description: As a user, I want to accept a recommended image for an article, so that I can add the image to the article through the edit flow.

flows.name: Add custom image tag
flows.description: As a user, I want to search for and add a custom image tag, so that I can describe an image when the visible tag suggestions are insufficient.

flows.name: Add or edit article description
flows.description: As a user, I want to add or edit the description for a suggested article, so that the article is easier to identify in search and previews.

flows.name: Add or edit image caption
flows.description: As a user, I want to add or edit the caption for a suggested image, so that image metadata is more useful to readers.

flows.name: Add or edit translation
flows.description: As a user, I want to add or edit a translated description or caption for the current suggestion, so that content is available in another language.

flows.name: Change translation source language
flows.description: As a multilingual user, I want to choose the source language for translation suggestions, so that I can translate content from the language I prefer.

flows.name: Change translation target language
flows.description: As a multilingual user, I want to choose the target language for translation suggestions, so that I can add translations in the language I intend to contribute to.

flows.name: Confirm abandoning selected image tags
flows.description: As a user, I want to be warned before leaving an image tagging task with selected tags, so that I do not accidentally lose unsaved work.

flows.name: Continue after vandalism patrol action
flows.description: As a patroller, I want the carousel to advance after I undo or rollback a problematic edit, so that I can continue patrolling the next edit.

flows.name: Dismiss carousel from toolbar
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the toolbar back/up control to leave the suggested edits carousel, so that I can return to the previous screen.

flows.name: Leave from suggestion error state
flows.description: As a user, I want to go back from an unrecoverable suggestion loading error, so that I can exit the task when suggestions cannot be shown.

flows.name: Move to next suggestion card
flows.description: As a user, I want to advance to the next suggested edit card, so that I can skip or continue reviewing more contribution opportunities.

flows.name: Open image recommendations help
flows.description: As a user, I want to open help for image recommendations, so that I can learn more about the feature and editing guidance.

flows.name: Open recommended image details
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the file page for a recommended image, so that I can inspect the image source and metadata before deciding.

flows.name: Open suggested edits help
flows.description: As a user, I want to open contextual help for the current suggested edit task, so that I can understand how to make the contribution correctly.

flows.name: Read more about recommended article
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the suggested article in a new tab, so that I can read more context before accepting an image recommendation.

flows.name: Receive quick-accept warning
flows.description: As a user, I want to be warned if I try to accept an image recommendation too quickly, so that I take time to review the suggestion before editing.

flows.name: Reject image recommendation with reasons
flows.description: As a user, I want to reject an image recommendation and choose rejection reasons, so that the unsuitable suggestion is recorded and I can move on.

flows.name: Report image recommendations problem
flows.description: As a user, I want to report a problem with image recommendations by email, so that I can provide feedback about the feature.

flows.name: Retry loading a suggestion
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry when a suggestion card fails to load, so that I can recover from temporary errors without leaving the screen.

flows.name: Return to previous suggestion card
flows.description: As a user, I want to go back to the previous suggested edit card when one exists, so that I can revisit an earlier suggestion.

flows.name: Return when image recommendations are depleted
flows.description: As a user, I want to leave the image recommendations task when there are no suggestions left, so that I can return to suggested edits instead of staying on an empty queue.

flows.name: Review vandalism patrol edit
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to review a suggested recent edit inside the carousel, so that I can decide whether it appears constructive or vandalism.

flows.name: Save image tags
flows.description: As a user, I want to save selected image tags, so that the tags are published and I can continue to the next image.

flows.name: See saved contribution on card
flows.description: As a user, I want to see my saved description, caption, or translation reflected on the card and then move to the next suggestion, so that I know my contribution was accepted.

flows.name: Select image tags
flows.description: As a user, I want to select and deselect suggested tags for an image, so that I can choose only accurate tags before saving.

flows.name: Skip failed image recommendation
flows.description: As a user, I want to move past a failed image recommendation card, so that one bad suggestion does not block the recommendation queue.

flows.name: Skip image recommendation
flows.description: As a user, I want to skip an image recommendation when I am not sure, so that I can continue without accepting or rejecting it.

flows.name: Swap translation languages
flows.description: As a multilingual user, I want to swap the translation source and target languages, so that I can quickly reverse the translation direction.

flows.name: Swipe between suggestion cards
flows.description: As a user, I want to swipe through the card carousel, so that I can browse suggested edits with gestures.

flows.name: View image file page from tag task
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the Commons file page for an image tagging suggestion, so that I can review more information about the image.

flows.name: View image recommendations tutorial
flows.description: As a user, I want to view the image recommendations tutorial tooltips, so that I understand how to evaluate recommendations.

flows.name: View image tags onboarding
flows.description: As a first-time image tags user, I want to see onboarding for the image tagging task, so that I understand how to contribute tags.

flows.name: View published image edit details
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the details of a successfully published image recommendation edit, so that I can review the saved contribution.

flows.name: Zoom suggested image
flows.description: As a user, I want to zoom or inspect the image shown on a suggestion card, so that I can better understand the media before contributing.

name: Suggested edits image recommendation card
description: Image recommendation review surface with article title/description/extract, recommended image preview in a gradient-backed card, caption/file/reason details in an expanded bottom sheet, accept/reject/not-sure actions, depleted and error states, menu actions for tutorial/help/report, and onboarding tooltip sequence.

flows.name: Accept recommended image
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to accept a recommended image and continue into the edit flow, so that I can add the image to the article.

flows.name: Cancel rejection dialog
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to cancel the rejection reason dialog, so that I can return to reviewing the recommendation without rejecting it.

flows.name: Dismiss onboarding permanently
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want the onboarding tooltip sequence to be marked complete after I finish it, so that it does not automatically appear every time I review an image recommendation.

flows.name: Expand image details sheet
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to expand and collapse the bottom sheet containing the recommendation details, so that I can see either more article context or more image information while reviewing.

flows.name: Handle no recommendations available
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to see when there are no image recommendations available and return from the task, so that I understand why I cannot continue reviewing.

flows.name: Leave after loading error
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to go back or advance away from an error state, so that I am not blocked when a recommendation cannot be loaded.

flows.name: Navigate back from recommendation
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to use the back action from the recommendation or no-suggestions state, so that I can leave the review surface when I am done.

flows.name: Open editing help
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to open help or learn-more information from the menu, so that I can understand image recommendations and editing guidance.

flows.name: Open full article
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to open the full article from the recommendation card, so that I can read more context before deciding on the image.

flows.name: Open image file page
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to open the recommended image's file page, so that I can inspect the image source and details before making a decision.

flows.name: Prevent rushed acceptance
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to be warned when I accept too quickly after opening a recommendation, so that I take enough time to review the image before adding it.

flows.name: Reject with reasons
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to reject a recommended image and select one or more rejection reasons, so that my feedback can improve future recommendations.

flows.name: Report image recommendations problem
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to report a problem with the image recommendations feature from the menu, so that I can send feedback to the app team.

flows.name: Retry after loading error
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to retry loading a recommendation after an error, so that I can continue reviewing image suggestions if the problem was temporary.

flows.name: Review recommendation context
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to view the article title, description, extract, recommended image, caption, filename, and suggestion reason, so that I can decide whether the image fits the article.

flows.name: Skip recommendation
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to mark that I am not sure about a recommendation, so that I can skip it and move to another suggestion without providing feedback.

flows.name: View published edit details
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to open the edit details after a successful image addition, so that I can verify the published change.

flows.name: View tutorial tooltips
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to view the image recommendation tutorial tooltip sequence, so that I understand how to evaluate and act on recommendations.

flows.name: Zoom recommended image preview
flows.description: As a suggested edits user, I want to zoom into the recommended image preview, so that I can inspect visual details without leaving the review card.

name: Suggested edits image recommendation rejection dialog
description: Material rejection-reasons dialog shown when rejecting an image recommendation, with six checkboxes, cancel/submit buttons, submit disabled until at least one reason is selected, and callback submission of selected reasons.

flows.name: Cancel rejection dialog
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the rejection-reasons dialog, so that I can return to the image recommendation without submitting rejection feedback.

flows.name: Prevent submitting without a reason
flows.description: As a user, I want the submit action to remain unavailable until I select at least one rejection reason, so that I do not accidentally reject an image without providing feedback.

flows.name: Review rejection reason options
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the available reasons for rejecting an image recommendation, so that I can choose the explanation that best matches my decision.

flows.name: Select rejection reasons
flows.description: As a user, I want to select one or more rejection reasons using checkboxes, so that I can accurately explain why the recommended image should not be used.

flows.name: Submit rejection reasons
flows.description: As a user, I want to submit my selected rejection reasons, so that the image recommendation is rejected with my feedback recorded.

name: Suggested edits image recommendations onboarding
description: Introductory onboarding activity for image recommendations, showing an onboarding page with multi-paragraph secondary text and a done/next button that completes the onboarding step.

flows.name: Get started with image recommendations
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to tap the Get started button on the image recommendations onboarding page, so that the onboarding activity closes successfully and I can continue into the image recommendation flow.

flows.name: View image recommendations onboarding
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to view an onboarding page explaining image recommendations, so that I understand that suggested images are machine generated, require my judgment, and come from freely licensed Wikimedia Commons images before I continue.

name: Suggested edits image tag search dialog
description: Top-positioned rounded DialogFragment for adding a custom Wikidata image tag, with search text field optionally prefilled from clipboard/last text, delayed entity search, empty/no-results state, and selectable label/description results list.

flows.name: Dismiss search dialog without selecting
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the image tag search dialog without choosing a result, so that I can return to the tagging screen while preserving my latest search text for later.

flows.name: Paste plain text into search field
flows.description: As a user, I want pasted content in the search field to be converted to plain text, so that formatted copied content does not interfere with my image tag search.

flows.name: Resume last search text
flows.description: As a user, I want the dialog to restore my previous search text when reopened, so that I can continue refining the same image tag search.

flows.name: Scroll through search results
flows.description: As a user, I want to scroll the list of matching image tags, so that I can browse beyond the initially visible results.

flows.name: Search Wikidata image tags
flows.description: As a user, I want to enter a custom image tag search term and see matching Wikidata entities, so that I can find a relevant tag for the image.

flows.name: Select Wikidata image tag result
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose a search result with its label and description, so that the selected Wikidata entity is added as my custom image tag.

flows.name: Start search from clipboard text
flows.description: As a user, I want the dialog to prefill the search field from my clipboard when appropriate, so that I can quickly search for a tag based on copied text.

flows.name: View no-results feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a no-results message when my image tag search returns no matches, so that I know I need to try a different search term.

name: Suggested edits image tags card
description: Image-tagging card surface used in the suggested-edits flow, showing a Commons image, caption/metadata, selectable Material chips including an add-tag chip, CC0/license/hint text, loading/error states, unsaved-exit confirmation, and a publish progress/success overlay.

flows.name: Confirm exit with unsaved selections
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to be warned when leaving after selecting tags that have not been published, so that I do not accidentally discard my choices.

flows.name: Confirm successful publish
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to see a published confirmation with success feedback, so that I know my tags were saved and I can move to the next suggestion.

flows.name: Exit without unsaved selections
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to leave the image-tagging card without confirmation when I have not selected any tags, so that I can move away without unnecessary prompts.

flows.name: Handle publish failure
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to see an error if publishing image tags fails, so that I understand the save did not complete and can try again later.

flows.name: Learn image zoom gesture
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to receive a one-time hint when tapping the image, so that I know I can zoom the image for closer inspection.

flows.name: Leave from error state
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to go back from the image-tagging error state, so that I can exit when no suggestion can be loaded.

flows.name: Open image file page
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to tap the image to open its Commons file page, so that I can inspect more information before deciding on tags.

flows.name: Open licensing and terms links
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to tap links in the CC0 notice, so that I can read the terms of use or CC0 information before contributing.

flows.name: Publish selected image tags
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to publish my selected image tags to Commons, so that the image gains the selected depicts statements.

flows.name: Recover from loading error
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to see an error state and retry loading the next image-tagging suggestion, so that I can continue tagging after a network or data failure.

flows.name: Resume previous tag search
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want the add-tag dialog to restore my last search term after I dismiss it, so that I can continue refining a previous tag search.

flows.name: Review CC0 notice before publishing
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to see the CC0 and terms notice after selecting a tag, so that I understand the licensing implications before publishing.

flows.name: Search for a custom image tag
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to open the add-tag chip and search Wikidata for an image tag, so that I can add a relevant tag that is not already shown.

flows.name: Search using caption text from clipboard
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want a long press on the caption followed by add-tag to prefill the search with clipboard text, so that I can quickly search for a tag related to copied caption text.

flows.name: See no custom tag results
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to see a no-results message when my tag search finds nothing, so that I know I need to try a different search term.

flows.name: Select a custom search result
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to choose a Wikidata search result from the add-tag dialog, so that the selected item becomes an active image tag chip for publishing.

flows.name: Select and deselect tag chips
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to select or deselect image tag chips, so that I can choose exactly which tags should be added to the image.

flows.name: Track publish progress
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to see a blocking publishing progress overlay after I submit tags, so that I know my contribution is being saved and avoid duplicate actions.

flows.name: View suggested image and caption
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to view the Commons image with its caption or metadata description, so that I can understand what tags may describe the image.

flows.name: Zoom image in place
flows.description: As a suggested-edits user, I want to zoom the displayed image, so that I can inspect visual details before choosing tags.

name: Suggested edits image tags edit screen
description: Dedicated image-tagging edit activity with action bar title, embedded image-tag fragment, portrait/landscape save controls, onboarding launch, and publish/next-page handling for a single Commons image.

flows.name: Confirm successful publish and return
flows.description: As a user, I want to see confirmation that my image tags were published and then return to the previous flow, so that I know my contribution succeeded and can continue.

flows.name: Continue editing after exit warning
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the exit warning when I have unpublished selected tags, so that I can return to the screen and finish publishing my contribution.

flows.name: Discard selected tags on exit
flows.description: As a user, I want to be warned before leaving with selected but unpublished tags, so that I do not accidentally lose my pending contribution.

flows.name: Exit without pending tags
flows.description: As a user, I want to leave the image tagging edit screen when I have no selected unpublished tags, so that I can abandon the task without an unnecessary confirmation.

flows.name: Handle publish failure
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error if publishing image tags fails, so that I understand the save did not complete and can try again.

flows.name: Learn image zoom gesture
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a one-time tooltip when I tap the image, so that I know I can zoom the image for closer inspection.

flows.name: Leave after load error
flows.description: As a user, I want to go back from the load error state, so that I can exit the image tagging task when it cannot be loaded.

flows.name: Open contribution terms links
flows.description: As a user, I want to open links in the licensing notice, so that I can read the terms of use or CC0 information before publishing.

flows.name: Open image file page
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the Commons file page for the displayed image, so that I can inspect more details about the image before tagging it.

flows.name: Publish selected image tags
flows.description: As a user, I want to save my selected image tags, so that they are published as depicts statements for the Commons image.

flows.name: Resume previous tag search
flows.description: As a user, I want the add-tag dialog to remember my last search text after I dismiss it, so that I can continue the same search when I reopen it.

flows.name: Retry loading image tagging task
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry when the image tagging task fails to load, so that I can recover from a temporary error and continue editing.

flows.name: Review license notice before publishing
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the CC0 and terms notice when I select tags, so that I understand the licensing terms for my contribution before saving.

flows.name: Search for an additional image tag
flows.description: As a user, I want to search Wikidata for an additional image tag, so that I can add a tag that is not already shown on the screen.

flows.name: See first-time image tags onboarding
flows.description: As a user, I want to be shown image-tagging onboarding the first time I open this edit screen, so that I understand how to contribute image tags.

flows.name: See no results for tag search
flows.description: As a user, I want to see when my tag search has no results, so that I know to try a different search term.

flows.name: Select and deselect image tags
flows.description: As a user, I want to select or deselect image tag chips, so that only accurate depicts tags are prepared for publishing.

flows.name: Select searched image tag
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose a tag from the Wikidata search results, so that it is added to my selected tags for the image.

flows.name: Use caption text when adding tag
flows.description: As a user, I want the add-tag search to prefill with copied caption text after long-pressing the caption, so that I can quickly search for a relevant tag from the caption.

flows.name: Use save controls for current orientation
flows.description: As a user, I want the save control to appear in a usable position in portrait or landscape orientation, so that I can publish selected tags regardless of how I hold the device.

flows.name: View image tagging task
flows.description: As a user, I want to view a Commons image with its caption and available image tag choices, so that I can decide which depicts tags to add.

flows.name: Wait for publishing progress
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a publishing overlay while my tags are being saved, so that I know my contribution is in progress and should not be changed.

flows.name: Zoom image in place
flows.description: As a user, I want to zoom the displayed image, so that I can inspect visual details before choosing tags.

name: Suggested edits image tags onboarding
description: Onboarding activity for image tagging suggested edits, using the tags onboarding layout and a done button that returns RESULT_OK and closes the screen.

flows.name: Get started with image tagging
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to tap the Get started button to complete the onboarding, so that I can return a successful result and continue into the image tagging suggested edit workflow.

flows.name: Leave onboarding without starting
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to use the system back navigation to leave the onboarding without confirming it, so that I can return to where I came from without starting the image tagging task from this screen.

flows.name: View image tags onboarding
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to read an introduction explaining how image tags help images become easier to find and that only my chosen tags will be added, so that I understand the purpose and impact of the suggested edit task before starting.

name: Suggested edits success snackbar sequence
description: Transient snackbar surfaces shown after a suggested edit is saved, optionally with a View action, followed by a feed-link snackbar with Get Started action or temporary-account welcome continuation.

flows.name: Continue temporary account welcome when feed prompt is skipped
flows.description: As a temporary-account contributor, I want the temporary account welcome message to appear even when the feed-link snackbar is not shown, so that important account information is still surfaced after saving an edit.

flows.name: Continue to more suggested edits
flows.description: As a suggested edits contributor, I want to see a follow-up prompt inviting me to help add more edits after my save confirmation, so that I can continue contributing through suggested edit tasks.

flows.name: Limit repeated follow-up prompts per session
flows.description: As a suggested edits contributor, I want the app to stop repeatedly showing the feed-link follow-up prompt after I have seen it a few times for the same edit context in a session, so that the snackbar sequence does not become intrusive.

flows.name: See localized translation save confirmation
flows.description: As a multilingual suggested edits contributor, I want the save confirmation to include the target language when I publish a translated description or caption, so that I can verify which language my contribution was saved in.

flows.name: See suggested edit save confirmation
flows.description: As a suggested edits contributor, I want to see a confirmation snackbar after my suggested edit is saved, so that I know my contribution was published successfully.

flows.name: See temporary account welcome after snackbar sequence
flows.description: As a temporary-account contributor, I want to see the temporary account welcome message after the suggested edit snackbar sequence finishes, so that I understand my temporary account status after contributing.

flows.name: Start suggested edit tasks from follow-up prompt
flows.description: As a suggested edits contributor, I want to tap Get started on the follow-up snackbar, so that I can open the suggested edits task flow for the type of edit I just completed.

flows.name: View saved edit target from confirmation
flows.description: As a suggested edits contributor, I want to tap View on the save confirmation when it is available, so that I can open the article or file page related to the edit I just saved.

name: Suggested edits tasks home
description: Main suggested edits task list screen with login/error/paused/disabled/onboarding message states, learn-more card, notification action, and task cards for descriptions, captions, image tags, image recommendations, and vandalism patrol.

flows.name: Add article descriptions
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to start an add-description suggested edit task, so that I can add missing article descriptions.

flows.name: Add image captions
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to start an add-caption suggested edit task, so that I can add missing image captions.

flows.name: Add image tags
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to start an add-image-tags suggested edit task, so that I can tag images and improve their discoverability.

flows.name: Add languages to unlock translation tasks
flows.description: As a contributor with too few app languages, I want to open language settings when I choose a translation task, so that I can add languages and unlock translation suggestions.

flows.name: Add recommended images
flows.description: As an eligible contributor, I want to start an image-recommendation task, so that I can add suggested images to articles that need them.

flows.name: Complete image tags onboarding before tagging
flows.description: As a contributor using image tags for the first time, I want to see and complete the image-tags onboarding before the task starts, so that I understand how to tag images correctly.

flows.name: Get help for blocked editing status
flows.description: As a blocked contributor, I want to open help from the IP or site block message, so that I can learn why tasks are unavailable and what I can do next.

flows.name: Identify new vandalism patrol task
flows.description: As a patroller, I want the vandalism patrol task to be marked as new until I have seen its onboarding, so that I can recognize newly available suggested edit functionality.

flows.name: Learn about paused or disabled suggested edits
flows.description: As a contributor whose suggested edits are paused or disabled, I want to open the help link from the status message, so that I can understand why I cannot currently receive tasks.

flows.name: Learn about suggested edits
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to open more information about suggested edits, so that I can understand what the feature is and how it works.

flows.name: Learn why suggested edits are contribution-gated
flows.description: As a contributor with too few edits, I want to open the learn-more help from the contribution gate message, so that I can understand how to become eligible for suggested edits.

flows.name: Log in to access suggested edits
flows.description: As a logged-out or temporary user, I want to start the login flow from the suggested edits screen, so that I can access contribution tasks that require an account.

flows.name: Open notifications
flows.description: As a logged-in contributor, I want to open my notifications from the suggested edits screen, so that I can review updates related to my account and edits.

flows.name: Refresh suggested edits tasks
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to refresh the suggested edits task list, so that I can see the latest tasks and account eligibility state.

flows.name: Retry after load error
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to retry loading suggested edits after an error, so that I can recover and access editing tasks.

flows.name: Review recent edits for vandalism
flows.description: As an eligible patroller, I want to start the vandalism patrol task, so that I can review recent edits and help protect articles from vandalism.

flows.name: Translate article descriptions
flows.description: As a multilingual contributor, I want to start a translate-description suggested edit task, so that I can translate article descriptions between app languages.

flows.name: Translate image captions
flows.description: As a multilingual contributor, I want to start a translate-caption suggested edit task, so that I can translate image captions between app languages.

flows.name: View first-time contributor onboarding message
flows.description: As a new contributor, I want to see an onboarding message on the suggested edits home screen, so that I understand how to get started with suggested edits.

flows.name: View personalized task availability
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to see only the suggested edit tasks that are available for my account, language, rights, contribution count, and block status, so that I can choose valid tasks I am eligible to perform.

flows.name: View unread notification count
flows.description: As a logged-in contributor, I want to see whether I have unread notifications, so that I know when there are updates needing my attention.

name: Survey feedback input dialog
description: Material AlertDialog with feedback text input and submit action, shown after selecting a non-satisfied feedback option.

flows.name: Dismiss feedback input dialog
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the feedback input dialog without submitting, so that I can leave the feedback flow if I change my mind.

flows.name: Enter written feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to type additional written feedback in the dialog, so that I can explain how the feature could be improved.

flows.name: Learn how to send future feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to see guidance after submitting feedback about where to send feedback in the future, so that I can report feature problems again later if needed.

flows.name: Receive submission confirmation
flows.description: As a user, I want to see confirmation after submitting feedback, so that I know my feedback was successfully submitted.

flows.name: Submit feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to submit my written feedback from the dialog, so that my comments are recorded and sent to help improve the feature.

name: Survey feedback options dialog
description: Material AlertDialog showing a custom feedback survey form with title, message, satisfaction options, cancel and submit controls; invoked via SurveyDialog.showFeedbackOptionsDialog.

flows.name: Cancel feedback survey
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the feedback survey dialog, so that I can dismiss it without submitting feedback.

flows.name: Open written feedback from submit control
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the Submit button in the survey dialog to continue to the written feedback form, so that I can provide feedback even without selecting a satisfaction option first.

flows.name: Provide details for neutral feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose the Neutral option and then enter optional written feedback, so that I can explain how the feature could be improved before submitting.

flows.name: Provide details for unsatisfied feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose the Unsatisfied option and then enter optional written feedback, so that I can explain what went wrong before submitting.

flows.name: Show feedback access tooltip after submission
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a tooltip after submitting feedback that explains where to submit feedback later, so that I can find the feedback option again if needed.

flows.name: Submit satisfied feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose the Satisfied option, so that I can quickly submit positive feedback and receive confirmation that it was sent.

flows.name: Submit written improvement feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to submit the written feedback form after selecting a non-positive response, so that my comments are sent and I receive a thank-you confirmation.

flows.name: View satisfaction survey prompt
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a feedback survey dialog with a title, explanatory message, and satisfaction choices, so that I understand I can rate my experience with the feature.

name: TabActivity

name: Tabs Count Box

flows.name: Open tabs from count badge
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the tab count badge when it appears in the toolbar, so that I can open the tabs interface to switch or manage my open tabs.

flows.name: View open tabs count
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the current number of open tabs in a compact bordered badge, so that I can quickly understand how many tabs I have open.

flows.name: Keep a single tab closed without undoing
flows.description: As a user, I want to ignore the tab-closed snackbar, so that the tab remains closed after the snackbar disappears.

flows.name: Keep all tabs closed without undoing

flows.name: Receive feedback after closing a tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a snackbar confirming which tab was closed after I close it, so that I understand that the tab was removed from my tab list.

flows.name: Receive feedback after closing all tabs
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a snackbar confirming that all tabs were closed after I confirm closing all tabs, so that I understand that my tab list was cleared.

flows.name: Undo closing a single tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap Undo on the tab-closed snackbar, so that the closed tab is restored to its previous position and the tab count and list are updated.

flows.name: Undo closing all tabs

name: Talk Template Delete Confirmation Dialog
description:
Material confirmation dialog shown from the Talk Templates multi-select action mode when deleting selected saved messages.
Displays pluralized delete warning with Delete and Cancel actions.

flows.name: Cancel deletion of selected saved messages
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the delete confirmation dialog, so that my selected saved messages remain in my list if I change my mind.

flows.name: Confirm deletion of selected saved messages
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm deleting the selected saved talk messages from the delete confirmation dialog, so that unwanted saved messages are removed from my list.

flows.name: See pluralized delete warning
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a delete warning that reflects whether I selected one or multiple saved messages, so that I understand the scope of the deletion before deciding.

name: Talk Template List Item Widget
description:
Custom RecyclerView item view for a talk template row.
Shows subject and message preview, supports a special instructional example row, checkbox selection styling, long-press/click callbacks, and optional drag handle for reorder mode.

flows.name: Enter selection mode with long press
flows.description: As a user, I want to long-press a saved template row, so that I can enter multi-select mode and choose messages to manage or delete.

flows.name: Open a template from row tap
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a talk template row, so that I can open that saved or example message for use or editing in the reply flow.

flows.name: Recognize selected row state
flows.description: As a user, I want selected template rows to show a checkbox and distinct background styling, so that I can clearly see which messages are currently selected.

flows.name: Reorder templates with drag handle
flows.description: As a user, I want to drag a template row by its handle while in edit mode, so that I can change the order of my saved messages.

flows.name: Swipe row to delete
flows.description: As a user, I want to swipe a saved template row, so that I can quickly delete a message without entering multi-select mode.

flows.name: Toggle row selection

flows.name: View instructional example row
flows.description: As a user, I want the first row in the example messages tab to appear as an instructional, non-selectable message, so that I understand how example messages work without accidentally choosing it as a template.

flows.name: View talk template summary
flows.description: As a user, I want to see each talk template's subject and message preview in the list, so that I can quickly recognize the message I want to use or manage.

Activity/fragment UI for managing or selecting talk warning/saved message templates.

flows.name: Add new saved message
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the add button to create a new saved message template, so that I can reuse custom talk messages later.

flows.name: Cancel selected message deletion
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the delete confirmation dialog, so that I can avoid accidentally removing selected templates.

flows.name: Delete selected saved messages
flows.description: As a user, I want to delete selected saved message templates after confirming the deletion, so that I can remove templates I no longer need.

flows.name: Edit or use saved message
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a saved message template to open the reply or editing flow with that template selected, so that I can send or update a reusable message.

flows.name: Enter message management mode
flows.description: As a user, I want to enter edit mode from the toolbar or by long-pressing a saved message, so that I can select, delete, or reorder saved templates.

flows.name: Exit message management mode
flows.description: As a user, I want to leave edit mode, so that the template list returns to normal browsing and selection behavior.

flows.name: Open associated page from toolbar
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the linked page title in the toolbar, so that I can open the related non-talk page in a new tab.

flows.name: Open examples from empty state
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the empty-state link to view example messages, so that I can start from predefined template ideas.

flows.name: Receive feedback after template changes
flows.description: As a user, I want to see confirmation or error messages after creating, editing, deleting, undoing, or reordering templates, so that I know whether my changes succeeded.

flows.name: Reorder saved messages
flows.description: As a user, I want to drag saved message templates by their handles in edit mode, so that I can control the order in which my templates appear.

flows.name: Retry after load error
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error state and retry loading templates, so that I can recover if my saved messages fail to load.

flows.name: Select or clear all saved messages
flows.description: As a user, I want to select all saved templates or clear the selection in edit mode, so that I can quickly manage many templates at once.

flows.name: Select saved messages for bulk actions
flows.description: As a user, I want to select and deselect saved message templates in edit mode, so that I can choose exactly which templates to manage.

flows.name: Swipe to delete a saved message
flows.description: As a user, I want to swipe a saved message template to delete it, so that I can quickly remove an unwanted template.

flows.name: Switch between saved and example messages

flows.name: View loading state

flows.name: View saved message templates
flows.description: As a user, I want to view my saved talk message templates in a list, so that I can choose and manage reusable talk messages.

name: Talk Templates Text Input Dialog
description:
Reusable Material alert input dialog for entering or editing a talk template subject.
Contains text input with validation error support, OK/Cancel buttons, optional radio choices to save as new or save existing, and automatically opens the soft keyboard.

flows.name: Cancel without saving
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel or dismiss the dialog without saving the template, so that I can return to reviewing or editing the message without changing saved templates.

flows.name: Confirm valid subject
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm the dialog after entering a valid subject, so that my subject choice is applied to the save action.

flows.name: Enter template subject
flows.description: As a user, I want to enter or edit a talk template subject in the dialog, so that I can name the message template before saving it.

flows.name: Prevent empty subject submission
flows.description: As a user, I want the dialog to prevent submitting an empty subject when saving as a new template, so that templates are not saved without a usable title.

flows.name: Save as new template
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose to save the message as a new template, so that I can add a new reusable warning message to my saved list.

flows.name: Show duplicate subject error
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error and be blocked from saving when the subject already exists, so that I can choose a unique name for a new saved message.

flows.name: Start typing immediately
flows.description: As a user, I want the subject field and soft keyboard to be ready when the dialog opens, so that I can begin entering the subject without an extra tap.

flows.name: Update existing template
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose to update an existing saved template when that option is available, so that my edited message replaces the selected saved template instead of creating a new one.

name: Talk Topics Sort Overflow Popup
description: PopupWindow dropdown anchored to a view that presents talk-topic sorting options and indicates the current sort order.

flows.name: Dismiss sort popup
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the talk-topic sort popup without selecting a sort option, so that I can return to the topic list without making changes.

flows.name: Sort by date published
flows.description: As a user, I want to sort talk topics by their published date and toggle between oldest-first and newest-first ordering, so that I can review discussions in the chronological order I prefer.

flows.name: Sort by date updated
flows.description: As a user, I want to sort talk topics by their most recent update date and toggle between ascending and descending ordering, so that I can find either recently active or older discussions more easily.

flows.name: Sort by topic name
flows.description: As a user, I want to sort talk topics by topic name and toggle between A-to-Z and Z-to-A ordering, so that I can browse discussions alphabetically in the direction I prefer.

flows.name: View current talk topic sort order
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the available talk-topic sorting options with the currently selected option and direction indicated, so that I understand how the topic list is currently ordered before changing it.

name: Talk link preview bottom sheet
description: Bottom-sheet link preview shown by the user-talk popup helper for non-user/non-talk internal links.

flows.name: Add linked page to reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to add the linked page to my reading list from the preview, so that I can save it for later reading.

flows.name: Continue to linked article
flows.description: As a user, I want to continue from the preview to the linked article or disambiguation page in the current tab, so that I can read the full destination page.

flows.name: Copy linked page address
flows.description: As a user, I want to copy the linked page address from the preview menu, so that I can paste the URL elsewhere.

flows.name: Dismiss failed preview
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the bottom sheet when the linked page preview fails or the page does not exist, so that I can return to the talk page after seeing the error.

flows.name: Dismiss link preview
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the link preview without opening the linked page, so that I can return to the talk page unchanged.

flows.name: Edit stub linked article
flows.description: As a user, I want to edit a linked main-namespace article when the preview shows it has no extract, so that I can help improve a stub or empty article.

flows.name: Open link preview for non-talk internal link
flows.description: As a talk page user, I want to open a bottom-sheet preview for an internal link that is not a talk page or user page link, so that I can inspect the destination without leaving the conversation.

flows.name: Open linked page in new tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the linked page in a new tab from the preview, so that I can keep my current talk page context while reading the destination later.

flows.name: Open preview image gallery
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap an image thumbnail in the preview gallery, so that I can browse the linked page’s media in the gallery view.

flows.name: Save link while offline
flows.description: As an offline user, I want to add the linked page to my reading list when the preview cannot load, so that I can keep the page for later access.

flows.name: Select preview extract text
flows.description: As a user, I want to select text in the preview extract, so that I can copy or reuse information from the snippet.

flows.name: Share linked page
flows.description: As a user, I want to share the linked page from the preview menu, so that I can send the article link to another app or person.

flows.name: View linked page preview
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the linked page title, thumbnail, extract, and related images in the bottom sheet, so that I can decide whether the link is relevant before opening it.

flows.name: View linked place on map
flows.description: As a user, I want to view the linked page on a map when coordinates are available, so that I can see where the subject is located.

name: Talk reply / new topic composer screen
description: Activity for composing a new talk topic, replying in a thread, or editing/saving a warning-message template; includes optional parent-thread preview, subject/body inputs with user mention support and edit keyboard overlay, temp-account footer, preview step, save/publish progress, and validation errors.

flows.name: Abandon modified message with confirmation
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to be warned before leaving after changing the subject or body, so that I do not accidentally discard unsaved work.

flows.name: Choose whether to save modified warning message
flows.description: As a patroller publishing a modified warning message, I want to choose whether to save it as a new template, update the existing template, or continue without saving it, so that I control how my warning messages are reused.

flows.name: Compose a new talk topic
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to enter a subject and message for a new talk topic and proceed only when required fields are valid, so that I can start a discussion with complete content.

flows.name: Copy parent-thread text
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to copy text from the displayed parent-thread message, so that I can reuse or reference it while composing.

flows.name: Create a saved warning-message template
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to compose and save a new warning-message template with a subject and body, so that I can reuse the message later.

flows.name: Edit an existing warning-message template
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to update the subject and body of an existing saved warning-message template, so that my reusable message stays current.

flows.name: Interact with parent-thread preview links
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to open links and media shown in the parent-thread preview, so that I can inspect referenced pages or files while composing my response.

flows.name: Learn more about warning messages
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open a learn-more link about warning messages, so that I can understand how and when to use them.

flows.name: Mention another user
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to type an @ mention and choose from suggested usernames, so that I can address another user correctly in my message.

flows.name: Open license and login links from preview
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to open the terms/license links or log in from the preview license notice, so that I can review contribution terms or publish under my account.

flows.name: Open related page from toolbar title
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to tap the linked page title in the toolbar, so that I can open the associated article or talk page context in a new tab.

flows.name: Preview message before publishing
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to preview the rendered talk message before saving it, so that I can verify how my subject and wikitext will appear.

flows.name: Publish talk message
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to publish my new topic or reply from the preview step and see progress and errors, so that I know whether my message was saved successfully.

flows.name: Reply to an existing talk thread
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to write a reply beneath an existing talk thread with the original thread shown for context, so that I can respond to the correct discussion.

flows.name: Resolve duplicate template subject
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to be prevented from saving a warning-message template with a duplicate subject, so that my saved messages remain distinguishable.

flows.name: Restore unsent reply draft
flows.description: As a contributor replying to a thread, I want my unsent reply text to be restored if I leave and return during the app session, so that I do not lose in-progress writing.

flows.name: Return from preview to editing
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to go back from the preview step to the composer, so that I can make changes before publishing.

flows.name: Use wikitext editing tools
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to use the editing keyboard overlay to insert wiki formatting, headings, links, templates, media, and mentions, so that I can compose richer talk messages more efficiently.

flows.name: View account status before editing
flows.description: As an anonymous or temporary-account contributor, I want to see account-status information and a one-time explanatory dialog with login, create-account, and help links, so that I understand how my edit identity will be shown.

name: Talk reply discard changes dialog
description: Confirmation dialog shown when backing out of a modified talk reply/new-topic draft, with abandon and keep-editing actions.

flows.name: Abandon modified draft
flows.description: As a talk page contributor, I want to confirm that I want to abandon my modified draft, so that I can exit the reply or new-topic editor without saving the changes.

flows.name: Keep editing modified draft
flows.description: As a talk page contributor, I want to cancel the exit from a modified draft, so that I can return to editing without losing my subject or message changes.

flows.name: Show discard changes confirmation
flows.description: As a talk page contributor, I want to be warned when I try to leave a modified reply or new-topic draft, so that I do not accidentally lose my subject or message changes.

name: Talk reply save-message dialog
description: Dialog shown from the reply composer when a warning message/template was modified, allowing saving as a new saved message, updating an existing saved message, or continuing without saving, with duplicate-subject validation.

flows.name: Continue without saving message changes
flows.description: As a user, I want to continue without saving my modified warning message/template, so that I can proceed to review and publish without changing my saved messages.

flows.name: Handle save message failure
flows.description: As a user, I want to be notified if saving or updating the saved message fails, so that I understand the change was not saved and can try again or continue later.

flows.name: Proceed after saving message changes
flows.description: As a user, I want the dialog to close and show the message preview after my saved message is created or updated, so that I can review the reply before publishing it.

flows.name: Save modified warning as new saved message
flows.description: As a user, I want to save my modified warning message/template as a new saved message with a chosen title, so that I can reuse the customized message later.

flows.name: Update existing saved message
flows.description: As a user, I want to update the existing saved warning message with my modifications, so that the saved message reflects my latest changes instead of creating a duplicate.

flows.name: Validate new saved message title
flows.description: As a user, I want the dialog to prevent saving a new saved message with an empty or duplicate title, so that my saved messages remain identifiable and conflict-free.

name: Talk reply temporary account dialog
description: Alert dialog explaining anonymous/temporary-account editing status in the talk reply flow, with OK, create account/login, and clickable help/login links.

flows.name: Dismiss temporary account dialog
flows.description: As an editor, I want to acknowledge the temporary account notice with OK, so that I can return to composing my talk reply.

flows.name: Open account creation from dialog action
flows.description: As an anonymous or temporary-account editor, I want to tap the create account/login dialog action, so that I can start creating or signing into a permanent account before editing.

flows.name: Open account creation from inline dialog link
flows.description: As an editor reading the temporary account dialog, I want to tap the inline create account link, so that I can create an account and access account-based editing benefits.

flows.name: Open login from inline dialog link
flows.description: As an editor reading the temporary account dialog, I want to tap the inline login link, so that I can sign in and have future edits attributed to my account.

flows.name: Open temporary account help from dialog
flows.description: As an anonymous editor, I want to tap the help link in the temporary account dialog, so that I can learn more about temporary accounts and editing attribution.

flows.name: Open temporary account help from footer
flows.description: As an anonymous or temporary-account editor, I want to tap the help link in the footer status message, so that I can review more information about temporary accounts while composing my reply.

flows.name: Refresh editing status after login
flows.description: As an editor who logs in from the temporary account dialog, I want the talk reply screen to update after a successful login, so that the screen reflects my authenticated editing status.

flows.name: Show temporary account dialog only once
flows.description: As an anonymous or temporary-account editor, I want the temporary account explanation dialog to appear only the first time it is needed, so that I am informed without being repeatedly interrupted in later talk reply sessions.

flows.name: View temporary account editing notice
flows.description: As an anonymous or temporary-account editor, I want to see a dialog explaining how my talk reply edit will be attributed, so that I understand whether a temporary account or my IP address will be associated with my edit.

flows.name: View temporary account footer status
flows.description: As an anonymous or temporary-account editor, I want to see a persistent footer message showing my current editing attribution status, so that I remain aware of how my talk reply will be credited after the dialog is dismissed.

name: Talk thread reply item overflow popup
description: Per-reply popup menu in a talk thread with share and copy-text actions.

flows.name: Confirm copied reply text
flows.description: As a talk page reader, I want to see confirmation after copying reply text, so that I know the reply content was placed on my clipboard.

flows.name: Copy reply text
flows.description: As a talk page reader, I want to copy the plain text of a specific reply from its overflow menu, so that I can paste or reuse the reply content elsewhere.

flows.name: Open reply overflow menu
flows.description: As a talk page reader, I want to open a reply's overflow menu, so that I can access additional actions for that specific reply.

flows.name: Share reply link
flows.description: As a talk page reader, I want to share a link to a specific reply from its overflow menu, so that I can direct others to that reply in the discussion.

name: Talk thread screen
description: Activity showing one discussion thread with header, nested replies, expandable/collapsible reply tree, pull-to-refresh, find-in-page action mode, share/edit-source actions, subscribe state, error/loading states, and reply submission undo snackbar.

flows.name: Collapse all reply branches
flows.description: As a reader, I want to collapse all nested replies from the toolbar menu, so that I can simplify the thread view and focus on higher-level comments.

flows.name: Copy reply text
flows.description: As a reader, I want to copy a reply's text from its overflow menu, so that I can reuse or quote the comment elsewhere.

flows.name: Edit thread source
flows.description: As a logged-in contributor, I want to open the source editor for the talk topic, so that I can make source-level changes to the discussion section.

flows.name: Expand all reply branches
flows.description: As a reader, I want to expand all nested replies from the toolbar menu, so that I can read the entire discussion tree at once.

flows.name: Expand or collapse a reply branch
flows.description: As a reader, I want to show or hide replies under an individual comment, so that I can control how much of the nested discussion tree is visible.

flows.name: Find text in thread
flows.description: As a reader, I want to search within the talk thread and see matching text highlighted, so that I can quickly locate relevant comments or metadata.

flows.name: Leave from error state
flows.description: As a reader, I want to go back from the error state, so that I can return to the previous screen when the talk thread cannot be loaded.

flows.name: Log in to subscribe
flows.description: As a logged-out reader, I want to be prompted to log in when subscribing to a topic, so that I can authenticate before enabling topic notifications.

flows.name: Open author actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a reply author's name, so that I can view user-related actions such as opening their user talk information.

flows.name: Open linked page from thread header or reply
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap links in the talk topic header or reply text, so that I can open related wiki pages, media pages, or edit diffs referenced by the discussion.

flows.name: Open thread at targeted reply
flows.description: As a reader following a direct reply link, I want the thread to expand and scroll to the targeted reply, so that I can immediately see the referenced comment.

flows.name: Pull to refresh thread
flows.description: As a reader, I want to pull down to refresh the talk thread, so that I can see the latest replies and subscription state.

flows.name: Reply to a comment
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to tap reply on a comment, so that I can add my response in the correct place in the discussion.

flows.name: Retry failed thread load
flows.description: As a reader, I want to retry loading the talk thread after an error, so that I can recover from network or service failures without leaving the screen.

flows.name: Share a specific reply
flows.description: As a reader, I want to share a link to an individual reply from its overflow menu, so that I can point someone directly to that comment.

flows.name: Share talk topic
flows.description: As a reader, I want to share a link to the current talk topic, so that I can send the discussion to someone else.

flows.name: Subscribe or unsubscribe to topic
flows.description: As a logged-in contributor, I want to subscribe or unsubscribe to the talk topic, so that I can control whether I receive updates about the discussion.

flows.name: Undo submitted reply
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to undo a newly submitted reply from the snackbar, so that I can remove an accidental response and return to editing it.

flows.name: View discussion thread
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view a talk topic header and its nested replies with authors, timestamps, body text, and thread structure, so that I can follow the discussion in context.

name: Talk thread subscribe login dialog
description: Alert dialog prompting anonymous users to log in before subscribing to a talk thread, with join/login and maybe-later actions.

flows.name: Log in to subscribe to thread
flows.description: As an anonymous user, I want to choose the join or log in action from the dialog, so that I can authenticate and have my talk thread subscription completed after a successful login.

flows.name: Postpone login for subscription
flows.description: As an anonymous user, I want to choose maybe later or dismiss the login dialog, so that I can return to the talk thread without subscribing or logging in right now.

flows.name: View login requirement for subscribing
flows.description: As an anonymous user, I want to see a clear dialog explaining that I need to log in before subscribing to a talk thread, so that I understand why my subscribe action cannot continue anonymously.

name: Talk topic row overflow popup
description: Popup menu for an individual topic in the topics list, offering mark read/unread, subscribe/unsubscribe, and share actions with dynamic icons/titles.

flows.name: Handle overflow action loading errors
flows.description: As a talk page reader, I want to be notified if the overflow popup cannot load topic action state, so that I know the requested menu actions are temporarily unavailable.

flows.name: Mark topic as read
flows.description: As a talk page reader, I want to mark an unread topic as read from the overflow popup, so that I can track which discussions I have already reviewed.

flows.name: Mark topic as unread
flows.description: As a talk page reader, I want to mark a read topic as unread from the overflow popup, so that I can return to or prioritize the discussion later.

flows.name: Open topic overflow menu
flows.description: As a talk page reader, I want to open the overflow menu for an individual topic, so that I can access additional actions for that topic.

flows.name: See context-sensitive popup actions
flows.description: As a talk page reader, I want the overflow popup to show action labels and icons that match the topic state, so that I understand whether I will mark read or unread and subscribe or unsubscribe before selecting an action.

flows.name: Share topic link
flows.description: As a talk page reader, I want to share a topic from the overflow popup, so that I can send others a link to the specific discussion.

flows.name: Subscribe to topic
flows.description: As a talk page reader, I want to subscribe to a subscribable topic from the overflow popup, so that I can receive updates about new activity in that discussion.

flows.name: Unsubscribe from topic
flows.description: As a talk page reader, I want to unsubscribe from a topic from the overflow popup, so that I stop receiving updates about that discussion.

name: Talk topics list screen
description: Activity showing a talk page's discussion topics with toolbar actions (language/page/history/share/watch/edit/archive/notifications), header search and sort controls, pull-to-refresh, error/empty states, floating new-topic button, swipe-to-mark-read, and topic rows with per-topic overflow actions.

flows.name: Change talk page language
flows.description: As a reader of a user talk page, I want to change the language of the talk page, so that I can view the corresponding user talk page in another wiki language.

flows.name: Create new topic
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to start a new talk page topic from the list screen, so that I can begin a new discussion even when the talk page is empty.

flows.name: Edit talk page source
flows.description: As a signed-in contributor, I want to edit the talk page source from the toolbar menu, so that I can make source-level changes to the discussion page.

flows.name: Leave error screen
flows.description: As a reader, I want to go back from the talk topics error state, so that I can return to where I came from when loading cannot be recovered.

flows.name: Mark topic read or unread
flows.description: As a reader, I want to mark individual talk topics as read or unread by swiping or using the topic overflow menu, so that I can track which discussions I have already reviewed.

flows.name: Navigate back
flows.description: As a reader, I want to use the toolbar back button to leave the talk topics screen, so that I can return to the previous screen.

flows.name: Open a topic
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap a discussion topic to open its full thread, so that I can read the complete conversation and replies.

flows.name: Open archived talk pages
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open archived talk pages from the toolbar menu, so that I can find older discussions that are no longer on the current talk page.

flows.name: Open associated article or user page
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the article or user page associated with the talk page from the toolbar title or menu, so that I can switch from discussion to the page being discussed.

flows.name: Open linked topic fragment
flows.description: As a reader following a talk-page link, I want the list screen to automatically open the referenced topic or reply when the page URL contains a fragment, so that I land directly on the relevant discussion.

flows.name: Open notifications
flows.description: As a signed-in reader, I want to open my notifications from the talk topics toolbar, so that I can review alerts and messages while browsing discussions.

flows.name: Refresh topics
flows.description: As a reader, I want to pull to refresh the talk topics list, so that I can load the latest discussions and replies.

flows.name: Retry after load error
flows.description: As a reader, I want to retry loading the talk topics after an error, so that I can recover when the page fails to load.

flows.name: Search topics
flows.description: As a reader, I want to search across topic titles, header content, replies, and authors, so that I can quickly find relevant discussions.

flows.name: See no search results
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see a clear no-results message when my topic search matches nothing, so that I know I need to change my query.

flows.name: Share talk page
flows.description: As a reader, I want to share the talk page link, so that I can send the discussion page to someone else.

flows.name: Share topic
flows.description: As a reader, I want to share a direct link to an individual discussion topic, so that I can point someone to a specific thread.

flows.name: Sort topics
flows.description: As a reader, I want to sort talk topics by published date, topic name, or updated date in ascending or descending order, so that I can browse discussions in the order that best suits me.

flows.name: Subscribe or unsubscribe topic
flows.description: As a reader, I want to subscribe or unsubscribe from an individual discussion topic, so that I can control notifications for that thread.

flows.name: Undo new topic submission
flows.description: As a contributor, I want to undo a newly submitted talk topic from the confirmation snackbar, so that I can reverse an accidental submission and reopen the draft content.

flows.name: View empty talk page state
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see an empty state when a talk page has no topics or has not been created, so that I understand there are currently no discussions and can choose to start one.

flows.name: View talk page edit history
flows.description: As a reader, I want to open the talk page edit history, so that I can inspect past revisions of the discussion page.

flows.name: View talk topics
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view a talk page's discussion topics with titles, reply counts, authors, dates, and previews, so that I can understand the current conversations on the page.

flows.name: Watch or unwatch talk page
flows.description: As a signed-in reader, I want to watch or unwatch the talk page, so that I can control whether changes to the discussion appear in my watchlist.

name: Talk topics sort popup
description: Overflow popup launched from the talk topics header sort button to choose the current topic sort mode.

name: TalkReplyActivity
description: Talk reply composition surface.

name: TalkTemplatesActivity
description: Talk templates selection surface.

name: TalkTopicActivity
description: Talk topic detail surface.

name: TalkTopicsActivity
description: Talk page topics list surface.

name: Template search screen
description:
Activity for searching wiki templates during editing.
Presents a toolbar search field, paged RecyclerView of matching/recent templates with title and description rows, empty and loading states, and an Insert action that becomes available after selecting/configuring a template.

flows.name: Browse paged search results
flows.description: As an editor, I want the template result list to load more results as needed, so that I can browse beyond the first page of matching templates.

flows.name: Clear template search
flows.description: As an editor, I want to clear the current search query from the toolbar, so that I can reset the results and start a new template search.

flows.name: Exit template search
flows.description: As an editor, I want to press the toolbar or system back button from the search results, so that I can leave template search without inserting a template.

flows.name: Fill template parameters
flows.description: As an editor, I want to enter values for required, suggested, and optional template parameters with labels, descriptions, and suggested values, so that the inserted template contains the information I intend.

flows.name: Handle template data load error
flows.description: As an editor, I want to be shown an error if the selected template's data cannot be loaded, so that I understand why I cannot proceed with that template.

flows.name: Insert generated template wikitext
flows.description: As an editor, I want to tap Insert after entering parameter values, so that generated template wikitext is returned to the editor.

flows.name: Learn more about template
