flows.description: As an editor, I want to open the selected template page from the Learn more link, so that I can read additional documentation before inserting it.

flows.name: Open missing TemplateData help links
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open the help links in the missing TemplateData notice, so that I can understand TemplateData and autogenerated parameters when a template lacks structured parameter data.

flows.name: Open template parameter entry
flows.description: As an editor, I want to select a template from the result list and open its parameter-entry panel, so that I can review the template and provide values before inserting it.

flows.name: Require mandatory parameters before insert
flows.description: As an editor, I want the Insert action to be disabled until all required template parameters are filled, so that I do not accidentally insert an invalid or incomplete template.

flows.name: Return from parameter entry to search
flows.description: As an editor, I want the back button to close the parameter-entry panel and return to the search results, so that I can choose a different template without leaving the screen.

flows.name: Review selected template information
flows.description: As an editor, I want to see the selected template's title, description, and notices about incomplete or missing TemplateData, so that I can understand what the template does and how reliable its parameter information is.

flows.name: Save inserted template as recent
flows.description: As an editor, I want an inserted template to be saved to my recent templates, so that I can find and reuse it quickly in future template insertions.

flows.name: Search templates
flows.description: As an editor, I want to type a template name in the search field and see matching wiki templates, so that I can find the template I need to insert.

flows.name: See no template results
flows.description: As an editor, I want to see a no-results message when no templates match my search, so that I understand there are no available matches for the query.

flows.name: See search loading state
flows.description: As an editor, I want to see a loading indicator while template results are being fetched, so that I know the search is in progress.

flows.name: See template result details
flows.description: As an editor, I want each template result to show its title and available description with matched search text emphasized, so that I can distinguish between similar templates before selecting one.

flows.name: Submit search from keyboard
flows.description: As an editor, I want submitting the search from the keyboard to dismiss the keyboard while keeping my results, so that I can view more of the matching templates.

flows.name: View recent templates
flows.description: As an editor, I want to see my recently used templates when the search field is empty, so that I can quickly reuse templates I commonly insert.

name: TemplatesSearchActivity
description: Template search/insert surface while editing.

name: Temporary account welcome message
description: Transient feedback popup/snackbar shown when a temporary account is first detected; displays the generated temporary username and remaining expiry days.

flows.name: Avoid repeated welcome messages
flows.description: As a temporary account user, I want the welcome snackbar to be shown only once after my temporary account is detected, so that I am not repeatedly interrupted by the same message.

flows.name: Read welcome after existing feedback
flows.description: As a temporary account user, I want the temporary account welcome message to appear after any current edit or suggested-edit snackbar is dismissed, so that I can see both pieces of feedback without one hiding the other.

flows.name: See generated temporary username
flows.description: As a temporary account user, I want the welcome message to show my generated temporary username, so that I can recognize which temporary account is associated with my edits.

flows.name: See remaining account expiry time
flows.description: As a temporary account user, I want the welcome message to show how many days remain before my temporary account expires, so that I understand how long the account will remain valid.

flows.name: View temporary account creation welcome
flows.description: As a temporary account user, I want to see a welcome snackbar when my temporary account is first detected, so that I know a temporary account was created for my published edit.

name: Test Kitchen error toast
description: Pre-beta analytics/Test Kitchen diagnostic popup: posts a long Toast with non-forbidden HTTP error details to loudly alert testers of event submission issues.

flows.name: Show Test Kitchen HTTP error toast
flows.description: As a pre-beta tester, I want to see a long toast containing non-forbidden HTTP error details when Test Kitchen event submission fails, so that I can immediately notice and report analytics submission issues.

flows.name: Suppress Test Kitchen toast outside pre-beta builds
flows.description: As a non-pre-beta app user, I want Test Kitchen HTTP submission failures to be logged without showing diagnostic toast popups, so that internal analytics diagnostics do not disrupt normal app use.

flows.name: Suppress forbidden Test Kitchen error toast
flows.description: As a pre-beta tester, I want forbidden HTTP submission errors to be excluded from the loud Test Kitchen toast alert, so that expected or non-actionable authorization failures do not unnecessarily interrupt testing.

name: Text Input Dialog
description: Material AlertDialog with primary and optional secondary text input fields, OK/Cancel actions, validation error display, and show/text-change callbacks.

flows.name: Cancel text input
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the dialog, so that I can dismiss it without applying the text I entered.

flows.name: Edit prefilled text
flows.description: As a user, I want the dialog to show existing text and optionally select it when opened, so that I can quickly replace or modify the current value.

flows.name: Enter optional secondary text
flows.description: As a user, I want to enter or edit text in an optional secondary input field when it is shown, so that I can provide additional information such as a description.

flows.name: Enter primary text
flows.description: As a user, I want to enter or edit text in the dialog's primary input field, so that I can provide the required value for the action I am performing.

flows.name: See validation feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to see validation errors and have the OK action disabled when my input is invalid, so that I can correct the text before submitting it.

flows.name: Submit text input
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm the dialog with the OK action, so that my primary and optional secondary text entries are accepted and used by the app.

flows.name: Use field hints
flows.description: As a user, I want the input fields to display contextual hints, so that I understand what text each field expects.

name: Text selection contextual action menu
description:
Contextual ActionMode menu on article text selection.
ShareHandler exposes Define and Edit here actions, requests the WebView selection payload, opens Wiktionary definition bottom sheet for supported languages, or starts section/description editing.

flows.name: Dismiss anonymous edit login prompt
flows.description: As an anonymous editor who has reached the description edit limit, I want to cancel the login prompt, so that I can return to reading without starting sign-in.

flows.name: Edit selected article section
flows.description: As an editor, I want to choose Edit here from the text selection menu on an article, so that I can start editing the section containing the selected text with the selection passed as context.

flows.name: Edit selected title description
flows.description: As an editor, I want Edit here on selected title-description text to open description editing, so that I can update the article description from the highlighted text context.

flows.name: Hide unavailable custom actions
flows.description: As a reader, I want unsupported custom text-selection actions to be hidden, so that the contextual menu only offers actions that can work for the current page and language.

flows.name: Log in after anonymous description edit limit
flows.description: As an anonymous editor who has reached the description edit limit, I want to be prompted to log in when I try to edit a selected title description, so that I can continue editing with an account.

flows.name: Open definition for selected text
flows.description: As a reader, I want to choose Define from the text selection menu, so that I can see a Wiktionary definition for the selected article text without leaving the article.

flows.name: Open linked Wiktionary term
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap links inside a Wiktionary definition, so that I can open a new definition for a related term.

flows.name: Select definition text
flows.description: As a reader, I want definition and example text in the Wiktionary bottom sheet to be selectable, so that I can copy or reuse definition content.

flows.name: View definition loading state
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see that a definition is loading after I tap Define, so that I know the app is retrieving Wiktionary information for my selection.

flows.name: View no definitions message
flows.description: As a reader, I want to be told when no Wiktionary definitions are found for selected text, so that I understand why no definition content is shown.

name: Thank revision confirmation dialog
description:
Material alert dialog in the diff details screen with a custom thank view.
Lets a logged-in user confirm or cancel sending thanks for the displayed revision, followed by success snackbar feedback.

flows.name: Cancel sending thanks
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to cancel the thank confirmation dialog, so that no thanks are sent if I change my mind.

flows.name: Confirm sending thanks
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to confirm sending thanks for the displayed revision, so that the revision's editor receives my appreciation.

flows.name: Handle thank send failure
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to be shown an error if sending thanks fails, so that I understand the thank action was not completed.

flows.name: Receive thank success feedback
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to see success feedback after my thanks are sent, so that I know the editor was thanked and I do not send duplicate thanks.

flows.name: View public thank confirmation
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to see a confirmation dialog explaining that thanking a revision is public and cannot be undone, so that I can make an informed decision before sending thanks.

name: Theme Chooser Bottom Sheet
description:
Appearance settings bottom sheet for selecting reading or editing theme options.
Includes text size controls and seek bar, theme buttons (Light/Dark/Black/Sepia), font family choices, match system theme, dim images, reading focus mode, and editing-specific switches such as syntax highlighting, monospace font, line numbers, and typing suggestions.

flows.name: Adjust editing text size
flows.description: As an editor, I want to increase, decrease, or drag a slider to change editor text size, so that I can edit wikitext at a comfortable size.

flows.name: Adjust reading text size
flows.description: As a reader, I want to increase, decrease, or drag a slider to change article text size, so that I can read content at a comfortable size.

flows.name: Choose black theme
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the black color theme, so that the app uses a pure black appearance that is comfortable on OLED or low-light devices.

flows.name: Choose dark theme
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the dark color theme, so that the app uses a darker appearance for reading or editing.

flows.name: Choose light theme
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the light color theme, so that the app uses a bright appearance for reading or editing.

flows.name: Choose sans serif reading font
flows.description: As a reader, I want to choose a sans serif font family, so that article text uses my preferred font style.

flows.name: Choose sepia theme
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the sepia color theme, so that the app uses a warmer appearance for reading or editing.

flows.name: Choose serif reading font
flows.description: As a reader, I want to choose a serif font family, so that article text uses my preferred font style.

flows.name: Dim images in dark themes
flows.description: As a reader, I want to toggle image dimming when using a dark theme, so that images are less bright while reading in dark mode.

flows.name: Dismiss appearance settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the theme chooser bottom sheet, so that I can return to reading or editing with my selected appearance settings applied.

flows.name: Enable reading focus mode
flows.description: As a reader, I want to toggle reading focus mode, so that I can reduce distractions while reading articles.

flows.name: Limit manual themes while matching system
flows.description: As a user, I want unavailable theme choices to be disabled when system theme matching is active, so that I only choose themes compatible with the current system light or dark mode.

flows.name: Match system theme
flows.description: As a user on a supported Android version, I want to enable matching the system theme, so that the app automatically follows my device light or dark mode setting.

flows.name: Toggle line numbers
flows.description: As an editor, I want to toggle line numbers, so that I can show or hide line references while editing wikitext.

flows.name: Toggle monospace editor font
flows.description: As an editor, I want to toggle a monospace font, so that editing text can align consistently and be easier to scan.

flows.name: Toggle syntax highlighting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to toggle syntax highlighting, so that wikitext markup can be easier to distinguish or less visually distracting while editing.

flows.name: Toggle typing suggestions
flows.description: As an editor, I want to toggle typing suggestions, so that I can control whether the keyboard suggests text while editing.

flows.name: View selected text size percentage
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the current text size percentage and default indicator, so that I understand the active reading or editing text scale.

name: Theme Fitting Room Screen
description:
Full-screen preview activity/fragment used from settings to try appearance settings.
Displays sample title/body text whose font size and family update in response to theme chooser changes, while the Theme Chooser bottom sheet is presented on top and closing it exits the screen.

flows.name: Change text size
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to increase, decrease, or drag a slider to change the reading text size, so that article text can be adjusted to a comfortable size and previewed immediately.

flows.name: Choose font family
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to switch between sans-serif and serif reading fonts, so that I can choose the font style that is easiest for me to read in the preview and articles.

flows.name: Dim images in dark themes
flows.description: As a settings user using a dark theme, I want to toggle image dimming, so that images are less bright while reading in dark mode.

flows.name: Dismiss fitting room
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to close or cancel the theme chooser bottom sheet, so that I exit the fitting room and return to the previous settings screen.

flows.name: Match system theme
flows.description: As a settings user on a supported Android version, I want to make the app theme follow my device system theme, so that Wikipedia automatically uses a light or dark appearance consistent with my device settings.

flows.name: Preview appearance changes
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to see sample title and body text in a full-screen fitting room, so that I can preview how reading appearance settings will look before leaving settings.

flows.name: Select color theme
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to choose light, sepia, dark, or black color themes, so that I can preview and save the reading color scheme I prefer.

flows.name: Toggle reading focus mode
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to turn reading focus mode on or off from the appearance sheet, so that I can control whether the reading interface reduces distractions.

flows.name: View text size percentage
flows.description: As a settings user, I want to see the current text size percentage and whether it is the default, so that I understand the exact size setting I am previewing.

name: ThemeFittingRoomActivity
description: App theme preview/customization surface.

name: Toggle List Settings Screen
description: Compose settings screen with top app bar, description text, and a scrollable list of setting rows with switches for showing/hiding modules.

flows.name: Cancel hiding all modules
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the warning shown after I turn off the last visible module, so that the last module I disabled is turned back on and the list is not left completely hidden.

flows.name: Confirm all modules hidden
flows.description: As a user, I want to acknowledge the warning shown after I turn off the last visible module, so that I can intentionally keep all modules hidden.

flows.name: Hide a module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn off a module's switch, so that the corresponding module is hidden from the feed or settings area that uses this component.

flows.name: Navigate back
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the top app bar back button, so that I can leave the module visibility settings screen and return to the previous screen.

flows.name: Open subtitle link
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a link embedded in a setting subtitle, so that I can navigate to the related configuration or help destination.

flows.name: Review toggleable settings
flows.description: As a user, I want to view the settings screen title, description, and each module's name, explanation, and current switch state, so that I can understand which modules are currently shown or hidden.

flows.name: Scroll settings list
flows.description: As a user, I want to vertically scroll through the list of module settings, so that I can access all available module visibility controls when they do not fit on the screen.

flows.name: Show a hidden module
flows.description: As a user, I want to turn on a module's switch, so that the corresponding module becomes visible again in the feed or settings area that uses this component.

name: Toolbar Toast Tooltip
description: Custom Toast surface displayed over an anchor view, using AppCompat tooltip layout to show a view's content description/plain text near the toolbar button.

flows.name: Read tooltip near its anchor
flows.description: As a user, I want the tooltip-style toast to appear at the location of the toolbar button I tapped, so that I can easily associate the explanatory text with the correct control.

flows.name: Show toolbar button tooltip
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a toolbar button to see its content description as a tooltip-style toast, so that I can understand what the button does before or while using it.

flows.name: View plain text tooltip content
flows.description: As a user, I want tooltip text to be shown as readable plain text without HTML markup, so that descriptions are clear and not cluttered by formatting tags.

name: Top App Bar With Search
description: Reusable Compose app bar surface that animates between a normal titled top bar and an inline search top bar with clear-query action.

flows.name: Clear search query
flows.description: As a user, I want to clear the current search query with a clear button, so that I can quickly reset the search field without manually deleting the text.

flows.name: Enter search query
flows.description: As a user, I want to type a search query into the inline search field, so that the containing screen can filter or search content based on my text.

flows.name: Exit search mode
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the back arrow while searching, so that I can clear the query and return to the normal top app bar.

flows.name: Navigate back from normal app bar
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the normal top app bar back arrow, so that I can leave the current screen or return to the previous destination.

flows.name: Open inline search
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the search action in the top app bar, so that I can switch from the normal title bar to an inline search field and start searching.

flows.name: Use accessible app bar controls
flows.description: As a user relying on accessibility services, I want the back, search, and clear-query controls to have descriptive labels, so that I can understand and operate the top app bar controls.

name: Top read articles screen
description:
Full-screen single-fragment activity listing all top-read articles for a selected date/site.
The toolbar title includes the date; content is a RecyclerView of article list rows.
Tapping opens the article; long-press exposes page actions via the shared list item long-press menu.

flows.name: Add article to another reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to add a top-read article to a different reading list from the long-press menu, so that I can organize saved articles in the list I choose.

flows.name: Browse top-read articles
flows.description: As a user, I want to view and scroll through all top-read articles for the selected date and wiki site, so that I can discover popular content from that day.

flows.name: Copy article link
flows.description: As a user, I want to copy a top-read article link from the long-press menu, so that I can paste the URL elsewhere.

flows.name: Identify the selected date
flows.description: As a user, I want the screen title to show the date for the top-read article list, so that I know which day's popular articles I am viewing.

flows.name: Move article between reading lists
flows.description: As a user, I want to move a saved top-read article from its current reading list to another list, so that I can reorganize where the article is stored.

flows.name: Navigate back
flows.description: As a user, I want to use the toolbar back button or system back navigation, so that I can leave the top-read articles screen and return to the previous screen.

flows.name: Open article actions menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to long-press a top-read article row, so that I can access additional actions for that article without opening it first.

flows.name: Open article from actions menu
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose Open page from the long-press menu, so that I can read the selected article.

flows.name: Open article from list
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a top-read article row, so that I can open and read the article in a new article tab.

flows.name: Open article in background tab
flows.description: As a user, I want to open a top-read article in a new background tab from the long-press menu, so that I can save it for later while staying on the top-read list.

flows.name: Remove article from reading lists
flows.description: As a user, I want to remove a saved top-read article from one or more reading lists, so that my saved lists no longer include articles I do not want.

flows.name: Save article to default reading list
flows.description: As a user, I want to save a top-read article to my default reading list from the long-press menu, so that I can read it later.

flows.name: Share article
flows.description: As a user, I want to share a top-read article from the long-press menu, so that I can send the article link to another app or person.

name: Top read feed module
description:
Explore feed card/module showing top-read articles for a wiki.
Displays a community-module header, up to five ranked article rows with trend/pageview indicators, thumbnails, per-article overflow menu anchor, hide-card/hide-module actions, and a footer link to view the full list.

flows.name: Copy top-read article link
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to copy a top-read article link from its overflow menu, so that I can paste the link elsewhere.

flows.name: Hide all top-read modules
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to hide the Top read module type from the module overflow menu, so that top-read cards no longer appear in my feed.

flows.name: Hide this top-read card
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to dismiss the current top-read card from the module overflow menu, so that this specific card is removed from my feed.

flows.name: Move saved article to another reading list
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to move a saved top-read article from its current reading list to another list from the overflow menu, so that I can categorize it correctly.

flows.name: Open a top-read article
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to tap a top-read article row, so that I can read the selected popular article.

flows.name: Open article from overflow menu
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to choose Open page from a top-read article overflow menu, so that I can read the article from the menu actions.

flows.name: Open article in new tab
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to open a top-read article in a new tab from its overflow menu, so that I can keep my current place while saving the article for separate browsing.

flows.name: Open article overflow menu
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to open the overflow menu for a top-read article, so that I can access additional actions for that article.

flows.name: Open module overflow menu
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to open the top-read module overflow menu, so that I can manage the card or the module from the feed.

flows.name: Remove saved article from reading lists
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to remove a saved top-read article from one or more reading lists from its overflow menu, so that my saved lists stay organized.

flows.name: Save article to reading list
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to save a top-read article to a reading list from its overflow menu, so that I can find and read it later.

flows.name: Share top-read article
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to share a top-read article from its overflow menu, so that I can send the article to someone else.

flows.name: Undo hiding this top-read card
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to undo dismissing a top-read card from the snackbar, so that the card is restored to my feed if I hid it by mistake.

flows.name: Undo hiding top-read module
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to undo hiding the Top read module type from the snackbar, so that top-read cards can appear in my feed again.

flows.name: View full top-read list
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to tap the More top read footer link, so that I can see the full list of top-read articles for the day.

flows.name: View top-read article rankings
flows.description: As a Wikipedia reader, I want to see the top-read feed module with ranked articles, pageview counts, trend indicators, and thumbnails when available, so that I can quickly discover what is popular on the current wiki.

name: TopReadArticlesActivity
description: Top read articles surface.

name: Turn Off Reading List Sync Confirmation Dialog
description: Material alert dialog displayed for logged-in users who turn off reading list sync, asking whether to delete remote synced lists or cancel.

flows.name: Cancel disabling reading list sync
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to cancel the turn-off-sync confirmation dialog, so that reading list sync remains enabled and my remote synced lists are not deleted.

flows.name: Confirm remote reading list deletion
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to confirm turning off reading list sync and deleting my remote synced reading lists, so that sync is disabled and the app removes the server-side copies from my account.

name: Undo action popup menu
description:
Popup menu anchored to the undo action when both undo and rollback are available.
Presents Undo and Rollback menu items with icons and routes the selection to the undo summary dialog or rollback confirmation dialog.

flows.name: Choose Rollback from popup
flows.description: As a logged-in editor with rollback rights, I want to select Rollback from the undo action popup menu, so that I can proceed to a confirmation dialog before rolling back the edit.

flows.name: Choose Undo from popup
flows.description: As a logged-in editor, I want to select Undo from the undo action popup menu, so that I can proceed to the undo summary dialog for reverting the selected edit.

flows.name: Dismiss undo action popup
flows.description: As an editor viewing the undo action popup menu, I want to dismiss it without selecting an option, so that I can return to the edit details screen without starting an undo or rollback action.

flows.name: Open undo action choices
flows.description: As a logged-in editor with both undo and rollback available, I want to tap the undo action and see a popup menu containing Undo and Rollback choices, so that I can choose the appropriate revert method.

name: Undo edit summary dialog
description:
Material alert dialog launched from the diff details undo flow.
Contains a custom text input for an undo edit summary, disabled destructive-colored Undo positive action until nonblank text is entered, and Cancel action; reports recent-edit patroller analytics for impression/confirm/cancel.

flows.name: Cancel undo summary dialog
flows.description: As a user reconsidering an undo, I want to cancel the undo summary dialog, so that I can dismiss it without submitting a revert.

flows.name: Confirm undo with summary
flows.description: As a user undoing an edit, I want to confirm the undo with my entered summary, so that the app submits the revert request and can show the result of the undo flow.

flows.name: Enter undo edit summary
flows.description: As a user undoing an edit, I want to type an edit summary in the dialog, so that the undo action includes my reason for reverting the change.

flows.name: Open undo summary dialog
flows.description: As a logged-in diff viewer, I want to open the undo edit summary dialog from the undo action, so that I can review the undo prompt before reverting an edit.

flows.name: Require non-empty summary
flows.description: As a user undoing an edit, I want the Undo action to remain unavailable until I enter a non-blank summary, so that I do not accidentally submit an undo without a reason.

flows.name: Track recent-edit undo dialog activity
flows.description: As a recent-edit patroller, I want my undo dialog impression, confirmation, and cancellation to be recorded, so that patrolling analytics reflect how the undo flow is used.

name: User Information Dialog
description: A DialogFragment using MaterialAlertDialogBuilder that displays a user's registration date and edit count, with loading and error states and a close button.

flows.name: Close user information dialog
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to close the user information dialog, so that I can return to reviewing edits after checking the user's details.

flows.name: Dismiss dialog from error state
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to dismiss the dialog from the error message action, so that I can return to the previous screen when user information is unavailable.

flows.name: See loading state while user information loads
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to see that the dialog is loading user information, so that I know the app is working while the details are being fetched.

flows.name: See user information load error
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to see an error message when the user's information cannot be loaded, so that I understand why the registration date and edit count are unavailable.

flows.name: View user account information
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to view a selected registered user's account registration date and total edit count, so that I can quickly assess the user's experience and context while reviewing edits.

name: User contributions filter screen
description: Activity screen for selecting filters for a user's contributions, including wiki/language choices, Commons/Wikidata, namespace filters, and an entry to update app languages in a RecyclerView.

flows.name: Keep wiki filter valid after language changes
flows.description: As a user, I want the selected contribution wiki filter to remain valid after updating app languages, so that a removed language does not leave the filter in an unusable state.

flows.name: See selected filters
flows.description: As a user, I want to see check or radio indicators beside the currently selected wiki and namespace filters, so that I understand which filters will be applied to the contributions list.

flows.name: Select Commons contributions
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose Wikimedia Commons as the wiki filter for user contributions, so that I can view contributions made on Commons.

flows.name: Select Wikidata contributions
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose Wikidata as the wiki filter for user contributions, so that I can view contributions made on Wikidata.

flows.name: Select contribution wiki language
flows.description: As a user, I want to select one of my app languages as the wiki filter for user contributions, so that the contributions list shows edits from the language wiki I care about.

flows.name: Toggle all namespace filters
flows.description: As a user, I want to toggle the all-namespaces option, so that I can quickly include all contribution namespaces or exclude all supported namespaces from the results.

flows.name: Toggle article namespace filter
flows.description: As a user, I want to include or exclude article namespace contributions, so that the contribution results match the type of edits I want to review.

flows.name: Toggle article talk namespace filter
flows.description: As a user, I want to include or exclude article talk namespace contributions, so that I can control whether discussion-page edits appear in contribution results.

flows.name: Toggle user namespace filter
flows.description: As a user, I want to include or exclude user namespace contributions, so that I can control whether user-page edits appear in contribution results.

flows.name: Toggle user talk namespace filter
flows.description: As a user, I want to include or exclude user talk namespace contributions, so that I can control whether user discussion edits appear in contribution results.

flows.name: Update app languages from filter
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the app language settings from the contribution filter screen, so that I can add or remove languages available for filtering contributions.

name: User contributions list screen
description: Activity screen showing a user's contribution statistics, searchable/filterable contribution history list with paging load/error states, empty messages, pull-to-refresh, and navigation to edit details or user talk popup via links.

flows.name: Exit contribution search
flows.description: As a user, I want to close the active contribution search, so that I can return to the unfiltered contribution list and stats header.

flows.name: Open contribution edit details
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a contribution in the list, so that I can see the detailed information for that specific article revision.

flows.name: Open contribution filters
flows.description: As a user, I want to open filtering options for the contribution list, so that I can narrow the history by project or namespace.

flows.name: Open filters from empty results
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the filter options from the empty-results message, so that I can adjust filters that may be hiding contributions.

flows.name: Open user talk popup from username link
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the linked contributor username in the stats header, so that I can open the user's talk popup for more user-related actions or context.

flows.name: Refresh contribution history
flows.description: As a user, I want to pull to refresh the contribution history, so that I can load the latest edits and updated results.

flows.name: Retry failed contribution loading
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry when loading contributions fails, so that I can recover from network or server errors without leaving the screen.

flows.name: Search contribution history
flows.description: As a user, I want to search a user's contributions by article title or edit summary, so that I can quickly find relevant edits.

flows.name: See active filter count
flows.description: As a user, I want to see how many contribution filters are active, so that I know the displayed history is constrained.

flows.name: See highlighted matching text in results
flows.description: As a user, I want matching search text to be highlighted in contribution titles, summaries, and size changes, so that I can recognize why each result matched my query.

flows.name: View empty contribution results message
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an empty-results message when no contributions match the current search or filters, so that I understand why the list has no items.

flows.name: View loading status while fetching contributions
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a loading indicator while contribution data is being fetched or more results are loading, so that I know the app is working.

flows.name: View paged contribution history
flows.description: As a user, I want to browse a paginated list of a user's contributions grouped by date, so that I can review their edit activity over time.

flows.name: View user contribution statistics
flows.description: As a user, I want to view a contributor's username, total edit count, registration year, and project information, so that I can understand their contribution history at a glance.

name: User talk thank confirmation dialog
description: Confirmation dialog with custom thank layout for sending thanks to a user's revision, including confirm and cancel actions.

flows.name: Cancel sending thanks
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to cancel the thank confirmation dialog, so that no public thank is sent if I change my mind.

flows.name: Confirm sending thanks
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to confirm the thank action for a user's revision, so that the editor receives my public appreciation and I see confirmation that it was sent.

flows.name: Dismiss thank confirmation
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to dismiss the thank confirmation dialog without choosing to send thanks, so that I can exit the confirmation flow without taking action.

flows.name: Review public thank warning
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to review a confirmation message explaining that sending thanks is public and cannot be undone, so that I can make an informed decision before thanking another editor.

name: User talk/profile popup menu
description: Context popup for user links that can open the user's profile page, user talk page, user information dialog, contributions list, or thank action, with visibility adjusted for anonymous users and available revision metadata.

flows.name: Cancel sending thanks
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to cancel the thank confirmation dialog, so that no public thanks is sent if I change my mind.

flows.name: Close user information dialog
flows.description: As a user, I want to close the user information dialog after viewing it or when it cannot load, so that I can return to the previous screen.

flows.name: Confirm sending thanks
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to confirm the thank action, so that my public thanks is sent to the editor and I receive success feedback.

flows.name: Open talk links directly
flows.description: As a user, I want a user talk or talk namespace link to open the talk topics screen directly, so that I can go straight to the discussion instead of choosing from user-page actions.

flows.name: Open user profile page
flows.description: As a user, I want to open a registered editor's user page from the popup menu, so that I can read their profile or user-page content.

flows.name: Open user talk page
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the selected editor's talk page from the popup menu, so that I can view or participate in discussions with that user.

flows.name: Preview non-user links
flows.description: As a user, I want links that are not user or talk pages to open in a link preview instead of the user popup, so that I get the appropriate context for the type of page I selected.

flows.name: Start thanking an editor
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to choose the Thank action for an eligible registered user's revision, so that I can review a confirmation before publicly thanking them for their edit.

flows.name: View contextual user actions
flows.description: As a user, I want to open a context popup for a user link and see only the actions that apply to that user and my login state, so that I can choose a relevant next step without unavailable options being shown.

flows.name: View user contributions
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the selected user's contributions list from the popup menu, so that I can review their editing history.

flows.name: View user information
flows.description: As a user, I want to open a user information dialog from the popup menu, so that I can see account details such as when the editor joined and their edit count.

name: UserContribFilterActivity
description: User contributions filters surface.

name: UserContribListActivity
description: User contributions list surface.

name: Vandalism patrol suggested edit card
description: Suggested-edit item/card for reviewing a recent edit inside the card flow, embedding ArticleEditDetailsFragment and advancing to the next page after undo or rollback success.

flows.name: Cancel undo or rollback
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to cancel an undo or rollback confirmation, so that I can avoid reverting an edit if I change my mind.

flows.name: Copy edit diff link
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to copy the edit diff link to the clipboard, so that I can paste it elsewhere.

flows.name: Dismiss error view
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to leave the edit detail view when an unrecoverable loading error is shown, so that I can stop reviewing a card that cannot be loaded.

flows.name: Expand diff line context
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to expand or collapse an individual diff line, so that I can inspect changed content with more context while reviewing the edit.

flows.name: Handle loading and unavailable diff states
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to see loading, error, or diff-unavailable states while edit details are fetched, so that I understand why the review content is not currently visible.

flows.name: Learn about quality and intent scores
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to tap the quality or intent score chips, so that I can open documentation explaining those filters and interpret the edit risk signals.

flows.name: Manage saved warning messages
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open my saved warning messages from the overflow menu, so that I can review or manage reusable talk-page warning templates.

flows.name: Navigate between adjacent revisions
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to move to older or newer revisions from the edit detail card, so that I can inspect surrounding edits before making a patrol decision.

flows.name: Open article or page from title
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open the edited page from the card title, so that I can inspect the article, talk page, file page, or external wiki page in the appropriate viewer.

flows.name: Open editor information
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open details and actions for the previous or current revision editor, so that I can learn about the contributor and access user-related patrol options.

flows.name: Open patrol help
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open the learn-more help from the overflow menu, so that I can understand how to use recent edits patrol features.

flows.name: Report feature feedback
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open feedback options for the patrol feature, so that I can report issues or share feedback about the review experience.

flows.name: Review recent edit details
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to view the article title, revision metadata, edit comments, ORES quality/intent scores, and diff for a suggested recent edit, so that I can decide whether the edit is constructive or vandalism.

flows.name: Rollback harmful edit and advance
flows.description: As a logged-in patroller with rollback rights, I want to choose rollback, confirm it, and automatically advance to the next suggested edit card on success, so that I can quickly revert vandalism.

flows.name: Set watchlist expiry
flows.description: As a logged-in patroller, I want to set an expiry after adding a page to my watchlist, so that the page is watched only for the duration I choose.

flows.name: Share edit diff
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to share a link to the edit diff from the overflow menu, so that I can send the reviewed change to someone else.

flows.name: Thank constructive editor
flows.description: As a logged-in patroller, I want to send thanks to the editor of a non-anonymous edit after confirming the action, so that I can positively reinforce constructive contributions.

flows.name: Undo harmful edit and advance
flows.description: As a logged-in patroller, I want to undo a harmful edit with an edit summary and then automatically advance to the next suggested edit card on success, so that I can efficiently continue vandalism patrol.

flows.name: View page edit history
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open the page's edit history from the overflow menu, so that I can inspect broader editing activity on the page.

flows.name: View published warning
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open the talk page from the warning-published snackbar, so that I can verify or continue the conversation after warning an editor.

flows.name: Warn editor on talk page
flows.description: As a patroller, I want to open warning message templates for the editor's talk page and see confirmation after publishing, so that I can notify contributors about problematic edits.

flows.name: Watch or unwatch edited page
flows.description: As a logged-in patroller, I want to add or remove the edited page from my watchlist, so that I can follow or stop following future changes to the page.

name: Vanish Account Confirmation Dialog
description: Icon-styled Material alert dialog shown from the account vanish option, confirming navigation to the account vanish request web form.

flows.name: Cancel vanish account request
flows.description: As a user viewing the vanish account warning, I want to cancel or dismiss the dialog, so that I can return to settings without starting the account vanishing request.

flows.name: Hide vanish option for temporary accounts
flows.description: As a temporary-account user, I want the vanish account option to be unavailable, so that I am not offered an account vanishing flow that does not apply to my account type.

flows.name: Open vanish account warning
flows.description: As a signed-in permanent-account user, I want to tap the Vanish account option and see a warning dialog explaining the consequences, so that I can make an informed decision before leaving the app for the account vanishing request process.

flows.name: Proceed to vanish request form
flows.description: As a user viewing the vanish account warning, I want to confirm that I want to vanish my account, so that I can be taken to the Wikimedia account vanish request web form.

name: Watchlist
description: Fragment-based watchlist screen showing watched-page changes in a RecyclerView with loading, empty, error, pull-to-refresh states, embedded search/filter bar, notification action, and item/user click navigation.

flows.name: Distinguish anonymous and registered editors
flows.description: As a user, I want watchlist items to indicate whether an editor is anonymous or registered, so that I can better interpret the source of a change.

flows.name: Exit watchlist search
flows.description: As a user, I want to close search mode and return to the full watchlist, so that I can resume browsing all changes.

flows.name: Identify change language
flows.description: As a multilingual user, I want watchlist items to show the wiki language code when more than one app language is configured, so that I can tell which wiki each change belongs to.

flows.name: Identify change size
flows.description: As a user, I want each editable watchlist change to show the byte difference with positive, neutral, or negative styling, so that I can quickly gauge the size and nature of the edit.

flows.name: Open edit details from change row
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a normal watchlist change row or its diff button to open the edit details, so that I can inspect what changed in that revision.

flows.name: Open filters from empty filtered results
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the active filters from the empty filtered-results message, so that I can adjust filters that may be hiding watchlist changes.

flows.name: Open notification center
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to open my notifications from the watchlist toolbar, so that I can review alerts and messages related to my account.

flows.name: Open watchlist filters
flows.description: As a user, I want to open watchlist filters from the search/filter bar, so that I can choose which languages and change types are included in the list.

flows.name: Pull to refresh watchlist
flows.description: As a user, I want to pull down on the watchlist to refresh it, so that I can manually check for the latest watched-page changes.

flows.name: Retry after watchlist error
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an error message and retry loading the watchlist when fetching fails, so that I can recover from temporary network or service problems.

flows.name: Search watchlist changes
flows.description: As a user, I want to search watchlist changes by page title, editor name, or edit summary, so that I can quickly find relevant changes.

flows.name: See active filter count
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the number of active non-default watchlist filters on the filter button, so that I know the list is being narrowed.

flows.name: See empty watchlist state
flows.description: As a user, I want to see an empty-state message when there are no watchlist changes to show, so that I understand why the list is blank.

flows.name: See no search results
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a clear no-results message when my watchlist search matches nothing, so that I know I should change or clear my search.

flows.name: See unread notification count
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to see an unread notification count or dot in the toolbar, so that I know when there are notifications needing attention.

flows.name: See watchlist loading state
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a loading indicator while my watchlist is being fetched, so that I know the app is working on retrieving my changes.

flows.name: View log events in watchlist
flows.description: As a user, I want to see watchlist log events such as moved, protected, or deleted pages with appropriate labels, so that I understand important non-edit changes even when they do not open edit details.

flows.name: View user actions for editor
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the editor name on a watchlist item to open user or talk actions, so that I can learn about or interact with the contributor who made the change.

flows.name: View watchlist changes
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to view recent changes to pages on my watchlist grouped by date, so that I can quickly monitor updates across my watched pages.

name: Watchlist Activity
description: Single-fragment activity that hosts the WatchlistFragment UI and forwards unread notification events to update its notification dot.

name: Watchlist Expiry Bottom Sheet Dialog
description:
Bottom sheet dialog fragment for selecting a watchlist expiry duration.
Uses Compose content with a title header and a lazy list of expiry options; selecting an option updates state, invokes the view model, shows feedback, and dismisses on success or error.

flows.name: Dismiss after expiry update result
flows.description: As a user, I want the expiry selection sheet to close after the update succeeds or fails, so that I can return to the previous screen after receiving feedback.

flows.name: Receive expiry change confirmation
flows.description: As a user, I want to receive confirmation after my watchlist expiry is updated, so that I know the change was saved successfully.

flows.name: Receive expiry change error
flows.description: As a user, I want to be shown an error if the watchlist expiry cannot be updated, so that I know the change did not complete.

flows.name: See selected expiry
flows.description: As a user, I want to see which watchlist expiry option is currently selected, so that I understand the active choice before making a change.

flows.name: Set one month watchlist expiry
flows.description: As a user, I want to select a one month watchlist expiry, so that the page is watched only for the next month.

flows.name: Set one week watchlist expiry
flows.description: As a user, I want to select a one week watchlist expiry, so that the page is watched only for the next week.

flows.name: Set permanent watchlist expiry
flows.description: As a user, I want to select the permanent watchlist option, so that the page stays on my watchlist indefinitely.

flows.name: Set six month watchlist expiry
flows.description: As a user, I want to select a six month watchlist expiry, so that the page is watched only for the next six months.

flows.name: Set three month watchlist expiry
flows.description: As a user, I want to select a three month watchlist expiry, so that the page is watched only for the next three months.

flows.name: View watchlist expiry choices
flows.description: As a user, I want to view the available watchlist expiry durations in a bottom sheet, so that I can decide how long the page should remain on my watchlist.

name: Watchlist Filter
description: Activity screen showing watchlist filter options in a RecyclerView with grouped headers, selectable wiki/language filters, category radio/checkbox filters, an add/update languages row, and reset menu action.

flows.name: Filter all wikis
flows.description: As a watchlist user, I want to select or deselect all app-language wikis at once, so that I can quickly include or exclude watchlist changes from every configured wiki.

flows.name: Filter by automated contributions
flows.description: As a watchlist user, I want to choose all editors, bot edits, or human edits, so that I can include or exclude automated contributions from my watchlist results.

flows.name: Filter by edit significance
flows.description: As a watchlist user, I want to choose all edits, minor edits, or non-minor edits, so that I can focus on changes with the level of significance I prefer.

flows.name: Filter by latest revision status
flows.description: As a watchlist user, I want to choose whether to show latest revisions or non-latest revisions, so that I can focus on changes with the revision status I need.

flows.name: Filter by seen or unseen changes
flows.description: As a watchlist user, I want to choose all changes, unseen changes, or seen changes, so that I can focus on watchlist activity based on whether I have already viewed it.

flows.name: Filter by type of change
flows.description: As a watchlist user, I want to select one or more change types such as page edits, page creations, category changes, Wikidata edits, and logged actions, so that I can tailor the watchlist to the kinds of changes I want to review.

flows.name: Filter by user status
flows.description: As a watchlist user, I want to choose all users, unregistered users, or registered users, so that I can focus on changes from a particular contributor type.

flows.name: Filter individual wikis
flows.description: As a watchlist user, I want to select or deselect individual language wikis, so that I can limit watchlist results to only the wikis I care about.

flows.name: Persist selected filters
flows.description: As a watchlist user, I want my selected watchlist filters to be saved immediately, so that the watchlist continues to use my preferences after I leave or reopen the screen.

flows.name: Refresh language filters after editing languages
flows.description: As a watchlist user, I want the available wiki filters to refresh after I return from editing app languages, so that the filter list reflects my current language choices.

flows.name: Reset filters to defaults
flows.description: As a watchlist user, I want to reset modified watchlist filters to their default settings, so that I can quickly return to the standard watchlist view.

flows.name: See active filter selections
flows.description: As a watchlist user, I want selected filters to be indicated with checkmarks or radio buttons, so that I can tell which watchlist filters are currently active.

flows.name: Update filter languages
flows.description: As a watchlist user, I want to open the app language editor from the filter screen, so that I can change which language wikis are available as watchlist filters.

flows.name: View grouped watchlist filters
flows.description: As a watchlist user, I want to view filter options organized by wiki, latest revisions, watchlist activity, automated contributions, significance, user status, and type of change, so that I can understand and adjust the watchlist results shown to me.

name: WatchlistActivity
description: Watchlist surface.

name: WatchlistFilterActivity
description: Watchlist filters surface.

name: Wiki Card and Message Card
description: Reusable Compose card widgets including a themed clickable WikiCard container and a MessageCard with optional image, title, HTML message, and positive/negative actions.

flows.name: Open links in message text
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap links embedded in HTML-formatted message text, so that I can open the linked content in an external browser.

flows.name: Select circular theme option
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a circular theme color button and see whether it is selected, so that I can choose a visual theme option.

flows.name: Tap app button
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a primary app-styled button, so that I can perform the main action offered by a card or component.

flows.name: Tap message card container
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the MessageCard itself when it is configured as clickable, so that I can perform the card-level action separate from its buttons.

flows.name: Tap negative message action
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the negative action button on a MessageCard, so that I can decline, dismiss, or choose the alternative action.

flows.name: Tap positive message action
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the positive action button on a MessageCard, so that I can accept or proceed with the suggested action.

flows.name: Tap text button
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a text-style app button, so that I can perform a secondary action without the emphasis of a primary button.

flows.name: Tap wiki card container
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a WikiCard when it is configured as clickable, so that I can trigger the card's associated action or navigation.

flows.name: View message card details
flows.description: As a user, I want to view a MessageCard with an optional image, title, and formatted message text, so that I can understand the information being presented to me.

flows.name: View themed card content
flows.description: As a user, I want to view content inside a themed WikiCard container, so that card-based information is visually grouped and readable in the current app theme.

name: Wiki Snackbar
description: Reusable Compose snackbar widget with HTML-capable message body and optional text action.

flows.name: Open snackbar message links
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap links embedded in a snackbar message, so that I can open related information in an external browser.

flows.name: Read long snackbar messages
flows.description: As a user, I want long snackbar messages to remain constrained within the snackbar, so that feedback is readable without overwhelming the screen.

flows.name: Use snackbar action
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap an optional snackbar action button, so that I can respond immediately to the message, such as undoing or viewing details.

flows.name: View HTML snackbar message
flows.description: As a user, I want to see snackbar messages with supported HTML formatting rendered correctly, so that feedback and notices are clear and readable.

name: Wiki Top App Bar
description: Reusable Compose top app bar with title, back navigation icon, optional actions, theme colors, elevation, and breadcrumb logging.

flows.name: Access screen actions
flows.description: As a user, I want to use action buttons shown in the top app bar, so that I can perform screen-specific commands without leaving the current screen.

flows.name: Log navigation breadcrumb
flows.description: As a user, I want my top app bar navigation tap to be recorded as a breadcrumb event, so that the app can support diagnostics and improve the navigation experience.

flows.name: Navigate back from top app bar
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the back navigation icon in the top app bar, so that I can return to the previous screen.

flows.name: Recognize themed app bar
flows.description: As a user, I want the top app bar to use the app's current theme colors and elevation, so that the navigation area is visually consistent and clearly separated from content when needed.

flows.name: Use accessible back button
flows.description: As a screen reader user, I want the back navigation icon to have a meaningful content description, so that I can identify and activate it reliably.

flows.name: View app bar title
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the current screen title in the top app bar, so that I understand where I am in the app.

name: Wiki games feed cards
description:
Composable card widgets for On This Day game surfaces in the Explore feed/Games hub.
Includes preview card with two event snippets, simple launcher card, in-progress card with continue button, completed card with score/countdown plus review/archive actions, and event thumbnail/text rows.

flows.name: Browse On This Day game cards
flows.description: As a user, I want to horizontally browse today's game, recent date cards, and the archive card, so that I can choose which On This Day game experience to open.

flows.name: Continue a recent in-progress archive game
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a recent archive card that shows my in-progress question number, so that I can resume that past-date game where I left off.

flows.name: Continue today's in-progress game
flows.description: As a user, I want to see my current question number and tap Continue on today's in-progress card, so that I can resume the daily game where I left off.

flows.name: Open archive from completed daily card
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the archive action on today's completed card, so that I can find another On This Day game to play after finishing today's challenge.

flows.name: Open the game archive
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the archive card, so that I can browse and choose older On This Day games.

flows.name: Preview today's events before playing
flows.description: As a user, I want to see two event snippets and available thumbnails for today's Which Came First game, so that I can understand the daily challenge before starting it.

flows.name: Refresh completed daily card when countdown ends
flows.description: As a user, I want the completed daily card to update after the countdown reaches the next day, so that the new daily challenge becomes available without me manually finding it.

flows.name: Review a completed recent archive game
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a completed recent archive card showing my score, so that I can revisit the results for that past-date game.

flows.name: Review today's completed results
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap Review results on today's completed card, so that I can revisit my answers and score for today's game.

flows.name: Start a recent archive game
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap a recent date card that has not been started, so that I can play the Which Came First game for that past date.

flows.name: Start today's game
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the play button on today's preview card, so that I can start today's Which Came First game.

flows.name: Track time until next daily game
flows.description: As a user, I want to see my completed score together with a countdown until the next daily game, so that I know when a new Which Came First challenge will be available.

name: Wikipedia Alert Dialog
description: Reusable Compose Material3 alert dialog with optional image/icon, title, message, confirm action, and optional dismiss action.

flows.name: Confirm alert action
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the alert dialog's confirm button, so that I can accept the prompt and continue with the primary action.

flows.name: Dismiss alert with secondary action
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap an optional dismiss button on the alert dialog, so that I can cancel or decline the prompt when a secondary action is available.

flows.name: Dismiss alert without choosing an action
flows.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the alert dialog using the system dismiss behavior, so that I can close the prompt without selecting a dialog button.

flows.name: View alert details
flows.description: As a user, I want to view an alert dialog with a title, message, and optional image or icon, so that I can understand important contextual information before taking action.

name: Wikipedia Compose base theme provider
description: Reusable Compose theming wrapper that supplies Wikipedia light/dark/black/sepia color palettes and ripple/indication configuration to descendant composables; not a standalone screen but a UI styling surface used by Compose screens and widgets.

name: Wikipedia language row widget
description:
Reusable custom LinearLayout row used in the languages list.
Displays language order, localized language name, language code, optional checkbox for multi-select removal, and optional drag handle.

flows.name: Add another language
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the add-language flow from the languages list, so that I can add more languages to my configured list.

flows.name: Cancel remove languages mode
flows.description: As a user, I want to exit remove mode without deleting selected languages, so that I can abandon an accidental removal action.

flows.name: Cancel selected language removal dialog
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the remove confirmation dialog, so that selected languages remain in my language list.

flows.name: Choose a language row as a result
flows.description: As a user coming from a language-selection context, I want to tap a language row to return that language choice to the previous screen, so that the previous task can continue using the selected language.

flows.name: Confirm selected language removal
flows.description: As a user, I want to confirm deletion of selected languages from a dialog, so that my language list is updated only after I approve the removal.

flows.name: Open remove languages mode
flows.description: As a user, I want to enter a multi-select remove mode from the languages list, so that I can choose languages to remove from my configured list.

flows.name: Prevent removing all languages
flows.description: As a user, I want to be warned when I select all languages for removal, so that I cannot accidentally leave the app with no configured languages.

flows.name: Reorder languages with drag handle
flows.description: As a user, I want to drag a language row by its handle to reorder my languages, so that I can set my preferred language priority.

flows.name: Select languages for removal
flows.description: As a user, I want to check or tap language rows while in remove mode, so that I can mark the languages I intend to remove.

flows.name: Unselect languages for removal
flows.description: As a user, I want to uncheck or tap selected language rows while in remove mode, so that I can correct the set of languages that will be removed.

flows.name: View language details in row
flows.description: As a user, I want to see each language's order, localized name, and language code in the languages list, so that I can understand which languages are configured and in what priority.

name: Wikipedia languages settings screen
description:
Activity/fragment screen for managing the user's Wikipedia app languages.
Shows a toolbar, a RecyclerView with a section header, ordered language rows with drag handles for reordering, and an add-language footer; supports returning a selected language when invoked from certain flows.

flows.name: Add a language
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to open the add-language flow from the languages settings screen, so that I can add another Wikipedia language to my app language list.

flows.name: Cancel removal confirmation
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to cancel the remove-languages confirmation dialog, so that selected languages are not removed if I change my mind.

flows.name: Enter remove language mode
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to enter a language removal mode from the overflow menu or by long-pressing a language, so that I can choose languages to remove from my app.

flows.name: Exit remove language mode
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user in removal mode, I want to cancel or leave removal mode, so that my current language list remains unchanged and normal list actions are restored.

flows.name: Hide reordering when only one language
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user with only one configured language, I want the screen to hide reordering controls, so that I am not shown an action that cannot be used.

flows.name: Prevent removing all languages
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to be warned and prevented from removing every configured language, so that the app always retains at least one Wikipedia language.

flows.name: Refresh language-dependent widget on exit
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want language-dependent widgets to refresh after I leave the languages settings screen, so that widgets reflect my current language preferences.

flows.name: Refresh list after adding languages
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want the languages settings screen to update after I add languages, so that I can immediately see my newly added languages and use them in the app.

flows.name: Remove selected languages
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to confirm removal of selected languages, so that unwanted languages are deleted from my app language list.

flows.name: Reorder languages
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to drag languages up or down in my language list, so that I can set my preferred language priority order.

flows.name: Return selected language to invoking flow
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user who opened the language settings screen from a language-picking flow, I want to tap a language and return it to the previous screen, so that the invoking feature can use my selected language.

flows.name: Return without selecting a language
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to leave the languages settings screen using the toolbar or system back navigation, so that I can return to the previous screen without making an additional selection.

flows.name: Select languages for removal
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user in removal mode, I want to select and deselect languages using checkboxes or by tapping rows, so that I can control exactly which languages will be removed.

flows.name: View app language list
flows.description: As a Wikipedia app user, I want to view my current app languages in priority order with their localized names and language codes, so that I can understand which Wikipedia languages are configured and their order of preference.

name: WikipediaLanguagesActivity
description: Wikipedia languages settings/management surface.

name: Wikitext Editor Field Widget
description:
Custom multiline EditText used by edit surfaces.
Handles syntax-highlight integration, plain-text paste behavior, typing suggestions, line-number gutter rendering, undo/redo key events, text highlighting/scroll-to-highlight, and cursor-scroll suppression during preference changes.

flows.name: Edit multiline wikitext
flows.description: As an editor, I want to type and edit multiline wikitext in a large text field, so that I can compose or revise article content directly in the editor.

flows.name: Insert line breaks from keyboard
flows.description: As an editor, I want the keyboard Enter key to insert line breaks in the wikitext field even when the keyboard shows an action key, so that I can format multiline content correctly.

flows.name: Jump to highlighted text
flows.description: As an editor, I want the editor to select and scroll to a requested text fragment, so that I can quickly find and review the relevant part of the wikitext.

flows.name: Paste as plain text
flows.description: As an editor, I want pasted content to be inserted as plain text, so that external formatting does not corrupt or alter the wikitext I am editing.

flows.name: Preserve viewport during preference changes
flows.description: As an editor, I want the text field to avoid unexpectedly scrolling to the cursor when editor preferences or highlighting are applied, so that I do not lose my place while editing.

flows.name: Read accurate wrapped line numbers
flows.description: As an editor, I want the line-number gutter to count actual wikitext lines rather than every visually wrapped row, so that the displayed line numbers remain meaningful in long wrapped paragraphs.

flows.name: Redo text changes
flows.description: As an editor, I want to redo undone text changes from the editor controls, so that I can restore edits I decide to keep.

flows.name: Show or hide line numbers
flows.description: As an editor, I want to show or hide line numbers beside the wikitext, so that I can navigate and reference long edits more easily when desired.

flows.name: Undo text changes
flows.description: As an editor, I want to undo recent text changes from the editor controls, so that I can quickly recover from mistakes while editing wikitext.

flows.name: Use typing suggestions preference
flows.description: As an editor, I want typing suggestions to be enabled or disabled according to my editing preference, so that I can choose whether the keyboard offers corrections while editing wikitext.

flows.name: View syntax-highlighted wikitext
flows.description: As an editor, I want recognized wikitext markup to be visually highlighted in the editor, so that I can better understand templates, links, references, headings, and formatting while editing.

name: Wikitext Formatting Keyboard Overlay
description:
Inline editor keyboard overlay/modal widget for applying wikitext formatting to the current selection.
Contains close/collapse plus bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, superscript, subscript, big, small, and code actions.

flows.name: Auto-hide overlay with editor keyboard state
flows.description: As an editor, I want the formatting overlay to hide when the editing keyboard is dismissed or the editor is no longer focused, so that formatting controls do not remain visible when they cannot be used.

flows.name: Collapse formatting overlay
flows.description: As an editor, I want to close the wikitext formatting overlay, so that I can return to the normal editing keyboard controls.

flows.name: Open formatting overlay
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open the wikitext formatting overlay from the editor keyboard, so that I can access inline formatting tools while editing.

flows.name: Scroll formatting actions
flows.description: As an editor, I want to horizontally scroll the formatting overlay, so that I can reach all formatting actions on smaller screens.

flows.name: Toggle bold formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove bold wikitext around the current selection or cursor, so that text is marked as bold in the article.

flows.name: Toggle code formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove code tags around the current selection or cursor, so that text is marked as inline code in the article.

flows.name: Toggle italic formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove italic wikitext around the current selection or cursor, so that text is marked as italic in the article.

flows.name: Toggle large text formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove big text tags around the current selection or cursor, so that text is marked as larger in the article.

flows.name: Toggle small text formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove small text tags around the current selection or cursor, so that text is marked as smaller in the article.

flows.name: Toggle strikethrough formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove strikethrough tags around the current selection or cursor, so that text is marked as struck through in the article.

flows.name: Toggle subscript formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove subscript tags around the current selection or cursor, so that text is marked as subscript in the article.

flows.name: Toggle superscript formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove superscript tags around the current selection or cursor, so that text is marked as superscript in the article.

flows.name: Toggle underline formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove underline tags around the current selection or cursor, so that text is marked as underlined in the article.

flows.name: Use formatting controls accessibly
