flows.description: As an editor using accessibility services or pointer hover, I want formatting and close controls to expose descriptive labels or tooltips, so that I can identify each available overlay action.

name: Wikitext editor headings overlay widget
description:
Custom overlay widget for selecting heading syntax levels H2-H5 from the wikitext editor keyboard.
Includes close/collapse control, accessibility labels/tooltips, and toggles heading markup around the current editor selection.

flows.name: Apply level 2 heading markup
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove H2 wikitext heading syntax around the current selection or cursor, so that I can create or undo a level 2 section heading quickly.

flows.name: Apply level 3 heading markup
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove H3 wikitext heading syntax around the current selection or cursor, so that I can create or undo a level 3 subsection heading quickly.

flows.name: Apply level 4 heading markup
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove H4 wikitext heading syntax around the current selection or cursor, so that I can create or undo a level 4 subsection heading quickly.

flows.name: Apply level 5 heading markup
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove H5 wikitext heading syntax around the current selection or cursor, so that I can create or undo a level 5 subsection heading quickly.

flows.name: Browse heading choices horizontally
flows.description: As an editor, I want to horizontally scroll the headings overlay when needed, so that I can access all heading level buttons on narrow screens.

flows.name: Close headings overlay
flows.description: As an editor, I want to close the headings overlay with its close control, so that I can dismiss the heading choices and continue editing.

flows.name: Open headings overlay
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open the headings overlay from the wikitext keyboard, so that I can choose a heading level without typing the markup manually.

flows.name: Toggle headings overlay from heading button
flows.description: As an editor, I want the heading keyboard button to collapse the headings overlay when it is already open, so that I can quickly return to the main wikitext keyboard.

flows.name: Use accessible heading controls
flows.description: As an editor using accessibility features, I want heading level buttons and the close control to have readable labels and tooltips, so that I can understand and use the overlay with assistive technology.

name: Wikitext editor keyboard toolbar widget
description:
Custom editor keyboard toolbar with controls for link insertion/toggling, formatting and heading overlays, template insertion, references, bulleted/numbered lists, media insertion, link preview, undo/redo, and user mentions.
Communicates user actions through WikiTextKeyboardView.Callback and edits the attached SyntaxHighlightableEditText.

flows.name: Access toolbar button labels
flows.description: As an editor using accessibility services or touch-and-hold tooltips, I want toolbar controls to expose descriptive labels, so that I can understand each wikitext action before activating it.

flows.name: Collapse syntax overlay
flows.description: As an editor, I want to close an open formatting or headings overlay using its close button, so that I can return to the main keyboard toolbar.

flows.name: Hide overlays when keyboard state changes
flows.description: As an editor, I want open formatting or heading overlays to close when the editing keyboard visibility changes, so that the toolbar does not remain in a stale expanded state.

flows.name: Insert bulleted list item
flows.description: As an editor, I want to insert bulleted-list wikitext at the cursor, so that I can quickly start a bullet list item.

flows.name: Insert link from search
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open link search from the toolbar and insert the selected page as wikitext, so that I can add an internal or language-prefixed wiki link without typing markup manually.

flows.name: Insert media
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open media insertion from the toolbar, so that I can add an image or other media item to the wikitext.

flows.name: Insert numbered list item
flows.description: As an editor, I want to insert numbered-list wikitext at the cursor, so that I can quickly start a numbered list item.

flows.name: Insert template
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open template search and insert a selected template's wikitext, so that I can add standard template markup efficiently.

flows.name: Mention a user
flows.description: As an editor, I want to insert an @ mention marker when the mention control is available, so that I can start mentioning another user in my comment or reply.

flows.name: Preview link target
flows.description: As an editor, I want to preview the link under my cursor or selected linked text, so that I can verify the target page before saving my edit.

flows.name: Redo edit
flows.description: As an editor, I want to redo an undone text change from the toolbar, so that I can restore edits I reversed accidentally.

flows.name: Show formatting overlay
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open or close the formatting toolbar overlay, so that I can access inline formatting shortcuts when I need them and hide them when I do not.

flows.name: Show headings overlay
flows.description: As an editor, I want to open or close the headings toolbar overlay, so that I can access heading-level shortcuts when structuring an article.

flows.name: Show keyboard toolbar while editing
flows.description: As an editor, I want to see the wikitext keyboard toolbar when the edit field is focused and the keyboard is open, so that I can access editing shortcuts while writing.

flows.name: Toggle bold formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove bold wikitext markup around the cursor or selected text, so that I can emphasize text strongly.

flows.name: Toggle code formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove code tags around the cursor or selected text, so that I can format inline code or markup examples.

flows.name: Toggle italic formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove italic wikitext markup around the cursor or selected text, so that I can emphasize text in italics.

flows.name: Toggle large text formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove large-text tags around the cursor or selected text, so that I can make text appear larger.

flows.name: Toggle level 2 heading
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove level 2 heading markup around the cursor or selected text, so that I can create a major section heading.

flows.name: Toggle level 3 heading
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove level 3 heading markup around the cursor or selected text, so that I can create a subsection heading.

flows.name: Toggle level 4 heading
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove level 4 heading markup around the cursor or selected text, so that I can create a nested subsection heading.

flows.name: Toggle level 5 heading
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove level 5 heading markup around the cursor or selected text, so that I can create a deeply nested subsection heading.

flows.name: Toggle link markup around text
flows.description: As an editor, I want to wrap selected text in wiki link markup or remove existing wiki link markup, so that I can quickly convert text to or from an internal link.

flows.name: Toggle reference tags
flows.description: As an editor, I want to insert or toggle reference tags around the cursor or selected text, so that I can add citations in wikitext quickly.

flows.name: Toggle small text formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove small-text tags around the cursor or selected text, so that I can make text appear smaller.

flows.name: Toggle strikethrough formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove strikethrough tags around the cursor or selected text, so that I can mark text as struck through.

flows.name: Toggle subscript formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove subscript tags around the cursor or selected text, so that I can format text as subscript.

flows.name: Toggle superscript formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove superscript tags around the cursor or selected text, so that I can format text as superscript.

flows.name: Toggle underline formatting
flows.description: As an editor, I want to apply or remove underline tags around the cursor or selected text, so that I can underline text in wikitext.

flows.name: Undo edit
flows.description: As an editor, I want to undo my latest text change from the toolbar, so that I can recover from mistakes while editing.

name: Wikitext rich-text syntax highlighting widget
description: Editor enhancement that applies visual spans to visible wikitext syntax regions and search matches while scrolling/typing, including colors for links/templates/refs, bold/italic/underline/strike, relative-size headings, sub/superscript, monospace code, and selected search-match highlighting.

name: Wiktionary Definition Bottom Sheet
description: Extended bottom sheet dialog showing Wiktionary definitions for selected text, with title row, loading/error states, scrollable definitions/examples, selectable HTML text, and in-dialog link handling.

flows.name: Open linked Wiktionary term in dialog
flows.description: As a reader, I want to tap supported links inside definitions or examples to open the linked Wiktionary term in a new definition bottom sheet, so that I can explore related terms without leaving the reading context.

flows.name: Read Wiktionary definitions by part of speech
flows.description: As a reader, I want to view Wiktionary definitions grouped by part of speech, so that I can understand the selected term's meanings in context.

flows.name: Read definition examples
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see example usages beneath definitions, so that I can understand how the selected term is used.

flows.name: Read definitions in page language direction
flows.description: As a reader of a right-to-left or left-to-right language, I want the Wiktionary bottom sheet to use the page language's layout direction, so that the definition content is presented naturally for my language.

flows.name: Scroll definition content
flows.description: As a reader, I want to scroll through the bottom sheet's definition content, so that I can read all definitions and examples when they exceed the visible area.

flows.name: Select definition text
flows.description: As a reader, I want to select text within definitions and examples, so that I can copy or reuse Wiktionary content from the bottom sheet.

flows.name: View no definitions message
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see a clear message when no Wiktionary definitions can be found, so that I know the selected text has no available definition or the lookup failed.

flows.name: View selected term title
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see the selected word or phrase as the title of the Wiktionary bottom sheet, so that I know which term the definitions belong to.

flows.name: Wait for definitions to load
flows.description: As a reader, I want to see a loading indicator while Wiktionary definitions are being fetched, so that I understand the app is working on my request.

name: Year in Review Activity
description: Full-screen Compose activity hosting the Year in Review screen deck via a NavHost; includes close/next/retry handling and can launch the donation bottom sheet.

flows.name: Dismiss Year in Review
flows.description: As a user, I want to close the Year in Review screen using the close button, system back, or error back action, so that I can return to the previous app experience when I am done.

flows.name: Donate from Year in Review
flows.description: As a user, I want to open the donation bottom sheet from eligible Year in Review slides, so that I can support Wikipedia after viewing my yearly recap.

flows.name: Finish deck from final highlights slide
flows.description: As a user, I want the next button on the final highlights slide to complete and close the Year in Review deck, so that I can exit after reaching the end.

flows.name: Navigate through slides
flows.description: As a user, I want to move through the Year in Review slides using the next button or horizontal swiping, so that I can browse the full deck at my own pace.

flows.name: Open Year in Review information
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the information icon on a slide to open the Year in Review FAQ, so that I can learn how the recap is calculated and used.

flows.name: Open links in slide text
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap links embedded in Year in Review slide text, so that I can get more context from linked pages or resources.

flows.name: Retry loading Year in Review after error
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry loading my Year in Review when an error occurs, so that I can recover from temporary failures and view the deck.

flows.name: Scroll slide content
flows.description: As a user, I want to vertically scroll slide content and the highlights card when it does not fit on screen, so that I can read all Year in Review details on smaller devices.

flows.name: Share current slide
flows.description: As a user, I want to share an image of the current standard or map Year in Review slide, so that I can post or send my recap outside the app.

flows.name: Share highlights summary
flows.description: As a user, I want to share the final Year in Review highlights card, so that I can share a concise summary of my annual Wikipedia activity.

flows.name: Track position in slide deck
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a page indicator for the Year in Review deck, so that I know where I am in the sequence of slides.

flows.name: View personalized Year in Review deck
flows.description: As a user, I want to view a personalized Year in Review slide deck generated from my reading, saving, editing, and location-related activity, so that I can reflect on my Wikipedia activity for the year.

flows.name: View reading geography map
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a map of geographically related articles from my Year in Review, so that I can understand where in the world my reading was focused.

flows.name: Wait for Year in Review to load
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a loading indicator while my Year in Review data is being prepared, so that I know the activity is working.

name: Year in Review Feedback Dialog
description: Non-cancelable Material alert dialog using feedback options layout for Year in Review survey rating and optional text feedback.

flows.name: Avoid repeated survey prompt
flows.description: As a user, I want the Year in Review feedback dialog to stop appearing after it has been shown, so that I am not repeatedly prompted for the same survey.

flows.name: Cancel feedback dialog
flows.description: As a user, I want to cancel the Year in Review feedback dialog, so that I can dismiss the survey without submitting feedback.

flows.name: Choose satisfaction rating
flows.description: As a user, I want to choose a satisfaction rating for Year in Review, so that I can indicate how satisfied or dissatisfied I am with the feature.

flows.name: Complete required dialog dismissal
flows.description: As a user, I want the non-cancelable feedback dialog to remain until I choose Cancel or Submit, so that I make an explicit decision about the Year in Review survey before returning to the app.

flows.name: Enter optional written feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to enter additional written thoughts in the feedback dialog, so that I can explain my Year in Review experience beyond the selected rating.

flows.name: Submit Year in Review feedback
flows.description: As a user, I want to submit my selected rating and optional written feedback, so that my feedback is recorded and I receive confirmation that it was sent.

flows.name: Submit feedback without a rating
flows.description: As a user, I want to submit the feedback dialog even if I have not selected a rating, so that I can skip rating while still closing the survey or sending only text feedback.

flows.name: View Year in Review feedback prompt
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a Year in Review feedback dialog when the survey is available, so that I can provide feedback about the feature at the appropriate time.

name: Year in Review Geo Slide
description: Compose Year in Review slide showing a non-interactive MapLibre map with article markers, headline/body text, and an info link for geographic reading highlights.

flows.name: Open Year in Review FAQ
flows.description: As a Year in Review user, I want to tap the information icon to open the Year in Review FAQ, so that I can learn more about how this geographic reading highlight is generated.

flows.name: Read geographic highlights summary
flows.description: As a Year in Review user, I want to read the headline and explanatory text naming the country and example articles related to my geographic reading pattern, so that I can understand why this highlight was shown.

flows.name: View geographic reading highlights map
flows.description: As a Year in Review user, I want to see a map centered on the geographic cluster of articles I read with markers for those articles, so that I can understand where my reading was geographically concentrated.

name: Year in Review Highlights Screen
description: Compose Year in Review highlights slide with thank-you messaging and a scrollable shareable card listing the user's highlight items.

name: Year in Review Highlights Share Capture
description: Offscreen/share Compose surface rendering the shareable highlights card on a white background with a bottom screenshot URL for bitmap capture.

flows.name: Capture after layout is ready
flows.description: As a user, I want the highlights share image to be captured only after the shareable content has been laid out, so that the image I share is complete rather than blank or partially rendered.

flows.name: Generate shareable highlights card
flows.description: As a user, I want my highlights to be rendered into a clean shareable card with the Wikipedia branding, hashtag, and my highlight values, so that the shared image clearly communicates my Year in Review summary.

flows.name: Include share attribution URL
flows.description: As a user, I want the captured highlights image to include the Year in Review URL at the bottom, so that recipients can identify where the shared summary came from.

flows.name: Return to Year in Review after sharing
flows.description: As a user, I want the temporary capture surface to be dismissed after the share flow completes, so that I return to the Year in Review experience without seeing an offscreen capture UI.

flows.name: Scroll long highlights card
flows.description: As a user, I want long highlights content to be scrollable with a visible scrollbar, so that all of my summary items can be viewed when they do not fit in the available card space.

flows.name: Share highlights summary image
flows.description: As a user, I want to share my Year in Review highlights summary as an image, so that I can post or send a polished recap of my activity outside the app.

flows.name: Share with preset message
flows.description: As a user, I want the highlights image share sheet to include a preset subject and message with the Year in Review link and hashtag, so that I can share useful context without composing it manually.

name: Year in Review Highlights Slide
description: Year in Review summary/highlights slide selected in the deck, with gradient rounded header styling and a bottom share button for exporting the highlights.

flows.name: Capture shareable highlights image
flows.description: As a user, I want the shared highlights image to include the formatted highlights card and screenshot attribution URL, so that the shared content is complete and recognizable outside the app.

flows.name: Close Year in Review deck
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the close button from the highlights slide, so that I can leave the Year in Review experience.

flows.name: Donate from highlights slide toolbar
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the donate action in the toolbar when it is available on the highlights slide, so that I can support Wikipedia from the Year in Review experience.

flows.name: Go back from loading error
flows.description: As a user, I want to go back or close from the Year in Review error state, so that I am not stuck if the highlights slide cannot be loaded.

flows.name: Navigate to next slide
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the forward navigation button from the highlights slide, so that I can continue through or finish the Year in Review deck.

flows.name: Read thank-you message
flows.description: As a user, I want to see a thank-you and looking-forward message above my highlights, so that the year-in-review summary feels complete and appreciative.

flows.name: Retry loading Year in Review
flows.description: As a user, I want to retry when the Year in Review deck fails to load, so that I can attempt to view the highlights slide after an error.

flows.name: Scroll highlights card
flows.description: As a user, I want to scroll the highlights card when its content is longer than the visible area, so that I can read every highlight in the summary.

flows.name: Share highlights summary
flows.description: As a user, I want to tap the bottom share button to share an image of my highlights summary with a preset subject, message, hashtag, and Year in Review link, so that I can post or send my annual Wikipedia highlights to others.

flows.name: Swipe between Year in Review slides
flows.description: As a user, I want to swipe horizontally between slides in the Year in Review deck, so that I can move to or away from the highlights slide naturally.

flows.name: Track current slide position
flows.description: As a user, I want to see the page indicator for the Year in Review deck while viewing the highlights slide, so that I know where I am in the slide sequence.

flows.name: View logged-out global highlights summary
flows.description: As a logged-out user, I want to view a year-in-review highlights slide with global or language-specific Wikipedia statistics, so that I can still see meaningful annual highlights without signing in.

flows.name: View personalized highlights summary
flows.description: As a logged-in user, I want to view a year-in-review highlights slide with my top articles, reading time, favorite day, articles read, categories, and edit totals when available, so that I can quickly understand my personal Wikipedia activity for the year.

name: Year in Review Login Prompt Dialog
description: Compose WikipediaAlertDialog shown from the onboarding activity prompting signed-out users to log in or continue without logging in.

flows.name: Continue without logging in
flows.description: As a signed-out user, I want to continue without logging in, so that I can view collective Year in Review insights without creating or using an account.

flows.name: Dismiss login prompt
flows.description: As a signed-out user, I want to dismiss the login prompt without choosing either option, so that I can return to the Year in Review onboarding screen before deciding how to proceed.

flows.name: Log in or join Wikipedia
